jobs.title: DMPK-PD Project Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicine. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
pRED's Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) group enables discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. PS supports discovery and development across the whole value chain from target assessment to on-market and beyond.

The Opportunity

As an experienced DMPK-PD Project Leader within the Translational DMPK-PD Group, you will be pivotal in ensuring the right drug is delivered at the right dose, safely and efficaciously, to patients. You will lead nonclinical and translational strategies, collaborating across therapeutic areas to transform scientific hypotheses into groundbreaking clinical candidates.

Your Impact & Responsibilities:

• Strategic Leadership: Define and lead advanced drug design, optimisation strategies, and comprehensive compound profiling, integrating cutting-edge DMPK principles with target biology validation and complex translational PK/PD concepts.

• Translational Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert, guiding early discovery teams in developing sophisticated translational strategies for clinical evaluation of target modulation, leveraging deep biochemical and pharmacological knowledge.

• Advanced Modelling & Simulation (M&S): Direct advanced M&S activities (including complex PKPD, PBPK, DDI, and sophisticated human dose/regimen prediction) to critically inform and de-risk projects from Lead Optimisation (LO) through early clinical development (EIH).

• Regulatory Mastery: Author and present definitive, high-quality scientific assessments of nonclinical DMPK data for critical internal program reviews and all major external regulatory submissions (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), ensuring global compliance and accelerated timelines.

• Implementation & Innovation: Pioneer and oversee the implementation of robust biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close partnership with key stakeholders to maximise patient safety and therapeutic benefit.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparent, data-driven decision-making, acting as a trusted advisor and cultivating high-trust professional relationships across global project teams, governance bodies, and external partnerships.

Who You Are

• You hold a PharmD or PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, Bioengineering or similar, coupled with over 10 years of progressive industry experience in a senior pharmacokinetic-related role.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED) , facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non soddisfatte del mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in medicina. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Il gruppo Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione di potere traduzione, migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerare lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. PS supporta la scoperta e lo sviluppo di tutta la catena del valore dalla valutazione dell'obiettivo al mercato e oltre. L'opportunità Come leader di progetto DMPK-PD esperto all'interno del gruppo DMPK-PD Traduzionale, sarete fondamentali per garantire che il farmaco giusto sia consegnato alla dose giusta, in modo sicuro ed efficace, ai pazienti. Condurrai strategie non cliniche e traduttive, collaborando in aree terapeutiche per trasformare le ipotesi scientifiche in candidati clinici innovativi. I vostri impatti e responsabilità:
• Leadership strategica: Definire e condurre la progettazione avanzata della droga, strategie di ottimizzazione e profilazione completa dei composti, integrando i principi DMPK all'avanguardia con la convalida della biologia di destinazione e concetti di PK/PD traduttivi complessi.
• Competenza traduttiva: Servire come esperto di materia tematica, guidare i team di scoperta precoce nello sviluppo di sofisticate strategie di traduzione per la valutazione clinica della modulazione target, sfruttando la conoscenza biochimica e farmacologica profonda.
• Advanced Modelling & Simulation (M&S): attività M&S avanzate dirette (comprese PKPD complessi, PBPK, DDI e sofisticate predizioni di dose/regimen) per informare criticamente e de-rischiare i progetti da Lead Optimisation (LO) attraverso lo sviluppo clinico precoce (EIH).
• Mastery di regolamentazione: Autore e presente valutazioni scientifiche definitive e di alta qualità dei dati DMPK non clinici per le revisioni critiche dei programmi interni e tutte le principali sottomissioni normative esterne (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), garantendo la conformità globale e tempi accelerati.
• Attuazione e innovazione: pioniere e supervisionare l'implementazione di robuste strategie biomarcatrici e bioanalitiche in stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder chiave per massimizzare la sicurezza dei pazienti e il beneficio terapeutico.
• Influenza trasversale: il processo decisionale trasparente, basato sui dati, funge da consulente affidabile e coltiva relazioni professionali di alta fiducia tra team di progetto globali, enti di governance e partnership esterne. Chi sei
• Ha un PharmD o PhD in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Farmacologia, Bioingegneria o simili, accoppiato con oltre 10 anni di esperienza nel settore progressivo in un ruolo legato alla farmacocinetica senior.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicine. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. pRED's Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) group enables discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. PS supports discovery and development across the whole value chain from target assessment to on-market and beyond. The Opportunity As an experienced DMPK-PD Project Leader within the Translational DMPK-PD Group, you will be pivotal in ensuring the right drug is delivered at the right dose, safely and efficaciously, to patients. You will lead nonclinical and translational strategies, collaborating across therapeutic areas to transform scientific hypotheses into groundbreaking clinical candidates. Your Impact & Responsibilities:
• Strategic Leadership: Define and lead advanced drug design, optimisation strategies, and comprehensive compound profiling, integrating cutting-edge DMPK principles with target biology validation and complex translational PK/PD concepts.
• Translational Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert, guiding early discovery teams in developing sophisticated translational strategies for clinical evaluation of target modulation, leveraging deep biochemical and pharmacological knowledge.
• Advanced Modelling & Simulation (M&S): Direct advanced M&S activities (including complex PKPD, PBPK, DDI, and sophisticated human dose/regimen prediction) to critically inform and de-risk projects from Lead Optimisation (LO) through early clinical development (EIH).
• Regulatory Mastery: Author and present definitive, high-quality scientific assessments of nonclinical DMPK data for critical internal program reviews and all major external regulatory submissions (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), ensuring global compliance and accelerated timelines.
• Implementation & Innovation: Pioneer and oversee the implementation of robust biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close partnership with key stakeholders to maximise patient safety and therapeutic benefit.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position In der Pharma- und Early Development-Organisation (pRED) von Roche machen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten, um einige der weltweit härtesten ungenutzten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED sind wir vereint von unserer Mission, Wissenschaft in die Medizin zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut definierte Kultur, in der unsere talentierten Menschen befähigt und inspiriert sind, außergewöhnliche lebensverändernde Innovation mit Geschwindigkeit voranzubringen. Die Gruppe Pharmazeutische Wissenschaften (PS) von pRED ermöglicht die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und effektiver Therapeutika bei optimalen Dosierungen in relevanten Populationen mit einer Vision zur Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Entwicklung der Medikamente von morgen. PS unterstützt Entdeckung und Entwicklung in der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette von der Zielbewertung bis zum Markt und darüber hinaus. Die Chance Als erfahrener DMPK-PD Projektleiter innerhalb der Translational DMPK-PD Gruppe, werden Sie entscheidend dafür sein, dass das richtige Medikament in der richtigen Dosis, sicher und effektiv, an Patienten geliefert wird. Sie führen nicht-klinische und translatorische Strategien, die über therapeutische Bereiche zusammenarbeiten, um wissenschaftliche Hypothesen in bahnbrechende klinische Kandidaten zu verwandeln. Ihre Auswirkungen und Aufgaben:
• Strategische Führung: Definieren und führen fortgeschrittenes Arzneimitteldesign, Optimierungsstrategien und umfassendes Compound-Profiling, Integration moderner DMPK-Prinzipien mit Zielbiologie-Validierung und komplexen Translations-PK/PD-Konzepten.
• Translationale Expertise: Als Fachexperte dienen, führen frühe Entdeckungsteams bei der Entwicklung anspruchsvoller Translationsstrategien für die klinische Bewertung der Zielmodulation, mit tiefem biochemischem und pharmakologischem Wissen.
• Fortgeschrittene Modellierung und Simulation (M&S): Direkte Fortgeschrittene M&S-Aktivitäten (einschließlich komplexer PKPD-, PBPK-, DDI- und ausgeklügelter menschlicher Dosis/Regimen-Prädiktion) zur kritischen Information und De-Risiko-Projekte von Lead Optimization (LO) durch frühe klinische Entwicklung (EIH).
• Regulatory Mastery: Autor und präsentieren endgültige, qualitativ hochwertige wissenschaftliche Bewertungen von nicht-klinischen DMPK-Daten für kritische interne Programmrezensionen und alle wichtigen externen regulatorischen Einreichungen (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), die globale Compliance und beschleunigte Timelines gewährleisten.
• Implementierung & Innovation: Pioneer und beaufsichtigen die Umsetzung von robusten Biomarker- und bioanalytischen Strategien in enger Partnerschaft mit den wichtigsten Akteuren, um die Patientensicherheit und den therapeutischen Nutzen zu maximieren.
• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparent, datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung, fungiert als vertrauenswürdiger Berater und kultiviert hoch vertrauensvolle Berufsbeziehungen über globale Projektteams, Governance-Einrichtungen und externe Partnerschaften. Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Doktortitel oder Doktortitel in der Pharmakologie, Pharmakologie, Bioengineering oder dergleichen, verbunden mit über 10 Jahren fortschrittlicher Branchenerfahrung in einer hochrangigen pharmakokinetischen Rolle.
• Sie verfügen über fundiertes, umfassendes Know-how über das gesamte Entdeckungs-, Nicht-Klinik- und Entwicklungsspektrum, das PK-Charakterisierung, Verteilung und PKPD für vielfältige Modalitäten (kleine Moleküle, Biologik, neuartige Therapeutika) abdeckt, die in maßgeblichem Wissen über Pharmakologie und Physiologie begründet sind.
• Sie demonstrieren Meisterschaft von fortschrittlichen Modellierungs- und Simulationsplattformen (z.B. Phoenix, Berkeley Madonna, GastroPlus, SimCyp) und verfügen über praktische Erfahrungen oder einen starken Antrieb zur Anwendung von künstlicher Intelligenz (KI)
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (PRED) , nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Chez PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médecine. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Le groupe des Sciences Pharmaceutiques (PS) de pRED permet de découvrir et de développer des traitements sûrs et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées, avec une vision pour la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. SP appuie la découverte et le développement dans l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au marché et au-delà. L'opportunité En tant que chef de projet expérimenté de DMPK-PD au sein du Groupe DMPK-PD, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour vous assurer que le bon médicament est livré à la bonne dose, de façon sûre et efficace, aux patients. Vous dirigerez des stratégies non cliniques et translationnelles, en collaborant dans des domaines thérapeutiques pour transformer des hypothèses scientifiques en candidats cliniques révolutionnaires. Votre impact et vos responsabilités :
• Leadership stratégique: Définir et diriger la conception avancée des médicaments, les stratégies d'optimisation et le profilage complet des composés, en intégrant les principes de pointe de DMPK avec la validation de la biologie cible et les concepts de PK/PD translationnels complexes.
• Expertise translationnelle: servir d'expert en matière, guidant les équipes de découverte précoce dans le développement de stratégies translationnelles sophistiquées pour l'évaluation clinique de la modulation cible, en tirant parti de connaissances biochimiques et pharmacologiques profondes.
• Modélisation et simulation avancées (M&S): Diriger les activités de M&S avancées (y compris la PKPD complexe, la PBPK, la DDI et la prédiction sophistiquée des doses/régimes humains) afin d'informer et de dérisquer les projets de l'optimisation du plomb (OL) jusqu'au développement clinique précoce.
• Maîtrise de la réglementation : Auteur et présentation d'évaluations scientifiques définitives de haute qualité des données DMPK non cliniques pour les examens internes critiques des programmes et toutes les principales présentations de réglementation externe (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), assurant la conformité mondiale et l'accélération des délais.
• Mise en œuvre et innovation: pionnier et supervision de la mise en œuvre de stratégies biomarqueurs et bioanalytiques robustes en partenariat étroit avec les principales parties prenantes afin de maximiser la sécurité des patients et les avantages thérapeutiques.
• Influence interfonctionnelle : Championne, prise de décisions transparente et axée sur les données, en tant que conseillère de confiance et en cultivant des relations professionnelles de haute confiance entre les équipes de projet mondiales, les organes de gouvernance et les partenariats externes. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un PharmD ou d'un doctorat en sciences pharmaceutiques, pharmacologie, bioingénierie ou similaire, associé à plus de 10 ans d'expérience industrielle progressive dans un rôle pharmacocinétique senior.
• Vous possédez une expertise approfondie et complète sur l'ensemble du spectre de découverte, non clinique et de développement, couvrant la caractérisation, la distribution et la PKPD de PKPD pour diverses modalités (petites molécules, produits biologiques, nouveaux traitements), fondées sur une connaissance autorisée de la pharmacologie et de la physiologie.
• Vous démontrez la maîtrise de plates-formes de modélisation et de simulation avancées (p. ex. Phoenix, Berkeley Madonna, GastroPlus, SimCyp) et vous possédez une expérience pratique ou un puissant effort pour appliquer l'intelligence artificielle (AI)

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Reportando al líder de Bids & Contracts en el Área Comercial, tu misión es colaborar de forma decisiva en el proceso integral de participación en licitaciones públicas para operaciones comerciales clave. Como experto de la filial en ofertas complejas, con un profundo conocimiento técnico y alto enfoque comercial , tu función se centra principalmente en asegurar la excelencia técnica y económica en la confección, revisión y presentación de ofertas.

Responsabilidades

• Acompañamiento a ventas : Especialmente en estadios comerciales preliminares visitando Clientes clave para afianzar la relación y garantizar el éxito de las operaciones.

• Asesoramiento experto en operaciones estratégicas: De la mano de ventas complementa las capacidades comerciales para asegurar que se define e implementa una estrategia ganadora que maximice oportunidades y minimice riesgos.

• Revisión exhaustiva de nuestras ofertas para las licitaciones estratégicas seleccionadas, asegurando la competitividad, la sostenibilidad y perfecta redacción.

• Seguimiento exhaustivo de operaciones clave : Monitorizando el proceso integral especialmente desde la fase previa a la publicación hasta la firma del contrato para operaciones complejas (incluyendo aclaraciones, subsanaciones o teniendo un rol clave en la construcción y revisión de los argumentos técnicos para alegaciones o recursos especiales en materia de contratación.

• Análisis holístico de todo el proceso integral de oferta y adjudicación para garantizar el cumplimiento de la estrategia y las simulaciones, lo que le permitirá mantenerse al día con los cambios en el mercado y la competencia. Comparte estos aprendizajes con el resto de la organización para futuras estrategias de licitación.

• Divulgación de los aprendizajes : Ser un referente formativo en ofertas, informando de forma continua de los principales aprendizajes / tendencias / noticias relevantes para otras operaciones. Capacitar al equipo completo de Bids, a la Red Comercial y al resto de la organización sobre la estrategia de ofertas con especial foco a la estrategia técnico-económica.

Requisitos y Habilidades

● Capacidad Analítica para interpretar datos de mercado, pliegos, revisar documentación técnica/económica compleja tanto propia como de la competencia y trabajar bajo presión cumpliendo plazos estrictos.
● Visión Estratégica y organizativa
● Alto nivel de conocimiento técnico y competitivo del mercado IVD y en contratación pública, unidos a una amplia visión comercial y económica
● Pensamiento crítico: Evaluar objetivamente la información, cuestionar suposiciones y tomar decisiones basadas en un análisis riguroso.
● Capacidad para analizar múltiples perspectivas y evidencias, evitando sesgos y prejuicios. Capacidad para resolver problemas y tomar decisiones efectivas en situaciones complejas y con poco tiempo.
● Se requieren excelentes habilidades de redacción y edición, con atención al detalle y capacidad para comunicar ideas complejas de forma clara y concisa.
● Capacidad divulgativa
● Se valorará muy positivamente la experiencia en el sector de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) o biotecnología.
● Conocimiento de la legislación española sobre contratación pública.
● Sin ser un requisito, se tendrá en cuenta si el candidato/a tiene experiencia en impugnaciones.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner – Oncology
We are looking for a dynamic Patient Journey Partner (Oncology) who will take ownership of end-to-end account management and drive meaningful impact across the patient care continuum.
Key Responsibilities:

• Manage end-to-end oncology accounts , ensuring seamless engagement with all key stakeholders

• Develop and implement patient-centric solutions that improve access, adherence, and outcomes

• Shape and strengthen the healthcare ecosystem by integrating our oncology portfolio effectively

• Collaborate with oncologists, hospitals to identify gaps and deliver tailored solutions

• Drive brand strategy execution through strong field insights and account planning

• Enable patient access programs , support services, and innovative care models

• Act as a strategic partner to healthcare providers, not just a product promoter

Ideal Candidate Profile:

• Strong experience in oncology sales / key account management

• Deep understanding of patient journey in oncology care

• Ability to think beyond products and offer holistic solutions

• Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills

• Strategic mindset with strong execution focus

Success in this Role Means:

• Creating a robust ecosystem around your accounts

• Driving better patient outcomes and access

• Positioning our portfolio as a solution provider, not just therapy

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Position: Manager/Senior Manager - Central Market Access Strategy, I2

您将有机会：
疾病领域产品准入策略

• 产品准入策略及规划： 根据公司整体品牌策略，制定并整合疾病领域新产品及在研产品的整体准入策略，包含医保报销（Reimbursement）、商保创新目录准入（C-list）及基药目录准入等的策略开发。

• 价值建议开发： 与医学、市场部协作，开发具有竞争力的产品价值建议（Value Proposition）及定制化的准入沟通材料及资料（如 DA、Value Deck等） 。

疾病领域产品准入落地执行

• 准入全流程管理： 负责统筹该 TA 在中央层面准入、地方准入互动及动态调整机制下的医保和卫生准入及具体落地工作，协助处理相关异议并确保准入结果交付 。

• 重点项目运营： 策划并执行部门疾病领域重点策略项目，确保项目目标与产品准入需求高度切合 。

• 工具与培训： 支持中央及地方团队的客户沟通，提供沟通工具包使用培训及政策异议处理支持 。

• 区域协同： 与区域准入团队配合，推动落地及本地政策项目的执行 。

疾病领域政策倡导

• 政策洞察与框架构建： 研究并监测国家及地方医药政策趋势（如 DRG/DIP、动态准入等），构建并优化疾病领域的准入政策影响框架 。

• 准入环境塑造： 统筹该疾病领域的政策倡导规划，通过与高层利益相关者（政府机构、智库、学术团体）的合作，推动有利于创新药准入的政策环境和疾病规范化管理 。

疾病领域准入 BP

• 业务战略协同： 作为 NMA 部门与业务部门（CE）、及其他准入团队沟通的桥梁，参与核心讨论及准入建议，确保准入视角融入产品全生命周期策略 。

• 跨团队资源整合： 协调跨部门资源（医学、市场、VEP等），支持疾病领域关键产品在国家/地方准入一体化策略中的执行，提升组织效能 。

• 客户需求洞察： 动态维护内疾病领域内核心政策及影响客户图谱，基于区域需求进行客户的协同拜访等，并针对疾病领域提供差异化的解决方案，提升准入工作的客户导向。

我们期待您：

• 需具备 5 年以上（经理）或8 年以上（高级经理）医疗行业工作经验，其中至少包含 3 年或5年以上市场准入相关经验；

• 教育背景：拥有相关领域的学位（医学、卫生政策、经济学、管理学等），硕士学位优先。

• 专业技能：具备项目管理与执行方面的专业知识者优先。

• 语言能力：具备优秀的英语口语及书面表达能力。

• 演讲技巧：具备良好的演示与汇报技巧。

• Job Required Competencies岗位所需胜任力

• 具备极强的准入政策趋势预判能力与深度的业务洞察力，能够精准识别政策变动中的准入机会与风险，并将洞察转化为驱动业务增长的整合准入策略。

• 极强的独立分析及解决问题的能力.

• 非常强的组织协调沟通能力。

• 语言能力-娴熟的英文掌握能力。

• 倡导诚信。

• 价值与客户导向。

• 协力成功。

• 结果导向。

• 不断学习。

• 出差频率：25% - 50%

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities (Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data.
● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation.
● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society.
● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards.
2) Data Generation
● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey.
● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy, incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc.
● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations.
● Support site feasibility assessments, site development plan, patients enrollment in trials and investigator engagementof Phase I-IIIa clinical studies under the direction of PDof Phase IIIb-IV Medical Affairs clinical studies in collaboration with clinical operations
3) Knowledge exchange
● Translate clinical/scientific evidence into local value messages and communicate those in cross functional collaboration to relevant stakeholders in a tailored manner.
● Exchange scientific data with HCPs; facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data, including but not limited to publications of clinical trials, guidelines, by ensuring they have the best quality available information they require.
● Develop and deliver medical training and education program to the target audience.
● Provide inputs to country medical manager on the aff

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position

At Roche, we are building a harmonized, scalable, and compliant omnichannel engagement ecosystem that enables personalized and data-driven interactions across channels.

As the PI Omnichannel Technical Product Owner, you will play a key role within Roche Digital Technologies (RDT), partnering closely with the Pharma International (PI), Marketing Technologies Solution Owner, and Business Product Owner for Marketing Automation to drive the execution and operational delivery of omnichannel orchestration and activation capabilities.

This role is focused on the technical delivery, orchestration, and operationalization of omnichannel engagement use cases across digital activation channels. You will work across business and technology teams to ensure campaigns, journeys, integrations, and activation capabilities are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and at scale.

You will operate within an Agile Release Train (ART) environment and work closely with internal teams, external vendors, and implementation partners to drive execution across sprint ceremonies, planning cycles, and delivery governance activities. This position will report to the Lead for Omnichannel Orchestration for Pharma International

The Opportunity

Own Omnichannel Activation Delivery : Own the end-to-end technical delivery and operational execution of omnichannel activation capabilities across digital engagement channels.
Drive Channel Orchestration : Support the orchestration and execution of customer journeys, triggers, segmentation, personalization, and campaign activation use cases across the omnichannel ecosystem.
Enable Business Activation : Partner closely with business stakeholders and Product Owners to translate business priorities into executable delivery plans and activation outcomes.
Coordinate Cross-Functional Workstreams : Drive alignment and execution across multiple workstreams including Integrations, segmentation, journeys and activation, reporting and insights, and vendor coordination
Support Agile Delivery Execution : Actively participate in Agile Release Train ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, release planning, delivery tracking
Market Onboarding & Campaign Enablement: Support affiliate onboarding activities, campaign execution readiness, and operational rollout of omnichannel capabilities across markets.
Operational Excellence & Governance: Help establish scalable operational processes, delivery governance, documentation standards, and execution best practices across omnichannel activation activities.

Who You Are
You are a delivery-oriented and collaborative leader who is comfortable operating across business and technology domains within large-scale enterprise transformation programs.

Experience

• 7+ years of experience in Marketing Technology, CRM, Marketing Automation, or Omnichannel engagement domains

• Experience working in large-scale enterprise transformation or digital engagement programs

• Experience operating within Agile delivery environments

• Strong understanding of omnichannel campaign execution and activation workflows

• Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with: Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), CRM and Marketing Automation ecosystems, Customer journeys and campaign orchestration, Segmentation and activation concepts, Email and digital engagement channels

• Experience coordinating cross-functional delivery teams and external vendors

• Ability to manage dependenc

This role is part of the Legal and Compliance department in Diagnostics Division with matrix reporting lines. Your direct report is to Head of Legal and Compliance with dotted line managers Head of Marketing and Head of Professional Services also with direct access to executive directors (as legally required).

The Cybersecurity and Digital Solutions Lead is responsible for developing and implementing cybersecurity policies and protocols to protect Roche's products, information systems and technologies and managing the roadmap, governance, and value realization of key digital initiatives across the Czech Affiliate and its Diagnostics and Pharma businesses. Using your expertise in Roche's products and environment, you will ensure systems comply with all security and regulatory standards. You will also apply your technical skills to manage and mitigate cyber threats.

The Opportunity

• Develop and oversee cybersecurity framework, strategy, policies and procedures (eg. ISO 27001 implementation, NIS2 local implementation) to safeguard digital systems and sensitive information.

• Manage the cybersecurity responsibilities across different teams in Roche Diagnostics and Pharma divisions and ensure cooperation throughout the organization and overall alignment with Roche's security objectives.

• Ensure Regulatory Compliance with cybersecurity and data protection requirements.

• Manage the Risk Framework and monitor risk management activities.

• Perform risk assessments to identify potential cyber threats and establish and coordinate a risk management plan in the context of the organisation as well as individual installation cases.

• Assess system vulnerabilities and implement security measures.

• Monitor network and information security systems for potential breaches and intrusions.

• Coordinate potential cyber security incidents.

• Cooperate and coordinate the process of cybersecurity asset management.

• Conduct regular security audits and compliance checks across all systems and applications and elaborate regular reports on cybersecurity risks and mitigation steps.

• Liaise and communicate directly with the regulatory Authorities and relevant Bodies on topics of cybersecurity.

• Communicate directly and regularly with the management on the topics of cybersecurity, support Executive Management in cybersecurity-related decisions

• Prepare Security Assessments and Reports for Leadership.

• Maintain updated knowledge of cybersecurity trends, emerging threats, and technologies.

• Collaborate with external IT and external business units (e.g. hospitals and laboratories, etc.) to ensure effective cybersecurity strategies are integrated into business processes.

• Provide training and awareness programs on cybersecurity best practices for all staff.

• Manage cybersecurity training and awareness programs across business functions.

• Oversee third-party risk management and vendor cybersecurity compliance.

• Define and maintain the digital portfolio roadmap for diagnostics, including connected devices, remote monitoring tools, and AI-driven decision support systems.

• Work cross-functionally with Product Management, IT, and Legal, Compliance and Regulatory teams to ensure timely and compliant delivery.

• Collaborate with all stakeholders (internal/ external) on development and implementation of Digital Products and Solutions strategy.

Who You Are

• Master’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

• Certifications su

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Der Bereich “Pharma Site Services“ der Roche Pharma ist am Standort Basel/Kaiseraugst verantwortlich für innovatives, kostengünstiges und GMP-gerechtes Planen und Realisieren von Investitionsprojekten. Mit der Standortlogistik kümmern wir uns auch um Güter und Sendungen, die aufs Areal kommen, hier gelagert und verteilt werden oder den Standort verlassen. Darüber hinaus macht der Bereich das Gebäude- und Betriebsingenieurwesen, das technische Qualitätsmanagement und ist verantwortlich für eine zuverlässige Störungsbehebung und Instandhaltung, inklusive dem Betreiben der erforderlichen Infrastruktur. Wir unterstützen unser Management und unsere Kunden bei biotechnologischen, chemischen und galenischen Produktionsanlagen, Laborbauten und Administrationsbauten.

Der Bereich “Energies & Utilities” ist am Standort Basel und Kaiseraugst für die Sicherstellung der Energie- und Medienversorgung, die Sicherstellung des Gebäudebetriebs, sowie die Erbringung von Dienstleistungen im Instandhaltungsbereich zuständig.

Der Circle “Energies & Utilities - Betrieb E2E” stellt den zuverlässigen, behördenkonformen und kostenbewussten Betrieb der Heiz-, Kühl- und Prozessmedien, inklusive der Ver- und Entsorgung sicher.
In dieser Position stellen Sie die Verfügbarkeit, den behördenkonformen sowie den wirtschaftlichen Betrieb der Systeme sicher und betreuen Anlagen im Auftrag unserer Kunden. Sie sind verantwortlich für den Betrieb der Anlagen, Störungsbehebung, Instandhaltung, kontinuierliche Optimierungen (Energie, Kosten) sowie die Fremdfirmenbetreuung. Weiterhin sollten Sie bereit sein, Pikettdienst zu leisten und in Projekten mitzuarbeiten.

Die Möglichkeit:

• Druck,-und Prozessluft Erzeugungsanlagen + Gasnetze (N2, Co2, Arg) etc. GMP & GEP konform, optimiert und inspektionsbereich betreiben

• Instandhaltung, Fremdfirmenmanagement, Verbesserungen und Weiterentwickeln der Systeme und Anlagen

• Logbücher führen und SOP verwalten

• Initiierung von Modernisierungen und Mithilfe bei der Kostenplanung

• Business Continuity Management für die Anlagen & Systeme umsetzen

• Ersatzteile bewirtschaften

• Energieverbräuche interpretieren und Maßnahmen ableiten

• Leistung von Pikettdienst in der Energieversorgung für das Areal Basel (Druck,- und Prozessluft, Kaltwasser,- und Soleerzeugung und verschiedene thermische Systeme (40°C, Fabrikwasser, Kühlabwasser, Hydranten, 95°C Netz)

Wer du bist:

• Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Betrieb und der Instandhaltung von Prozessanlagen in einem GMP-Umfeld

• Praktische Erfahrung in der Energieversorgung ist von Vorteil.

• In der Bedienung von Prozessleitsystemen der genannten Systeme bist Du geübt.

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung und idealerweise eine Weiterbildung als Instandhaltungsfachmann

• Selbständiges und selbstorganisierte Arbeitsweisen; Verständnis & gute Orientierungsfähigkeit innerhalb einer Matrix-Organisation

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver lif

In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La divisione “Pharma Site Services” di Roche Pharma presso la sede di Basilea/Kaiseraugst è responsabile della pianificazione e dell'attuazione di progetti di investimento innovativi, convenienti e conformi alle GMP. Con la logistica del sito ci occupiamo anche delle merci e delle spedizioni che arrivano al sito, vengono immagazzinate e distribuite qui o lasciano il sito. Inoltre, il dipartimento svolge attività di ingegneria edile e operativa, gestione della qualità tecnica ed è responsabile della risoluzione dei problemi e della manutenzione affidabili, compreso il funzionamento dell'infrastruttura necessaria. Supportiamo il nostro management e i nostri clienti con impianti di produzione biotecnologici, chimici e farmaceutici, edifici di laboratorio ed edifici amministrativi. Il reparto “Energie & Utilities” è responsabile dell'approvvigionamento energetico e dei media, della gestione dell'edificio e dei servizi di manutenzione nelle sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst. Il circolo "Energie e servizi pubblici - Operazione E2E" garantisce il funzionamento affidabile, conforme alle autorità e attento ai costi dei mezzi di riscaldamento, raffreddamento e processo, compresa la fornitura e lo smaltimento. In questa posizione garantirai la disponibilità, la conformità ufficiale e il funzionamento economico dei sistemi e manterrai i sistemi per conto dei nostri clienti. Sei responsabile del funzionamento dei sistemi, della risoluzione dei problemi, della manutenzione, dell'ottimizzazione continua (energia, costi) e del supporto dell'azienda esterna. Dovresti anche essere pronto a svolgere compiti di guardia e lavorare su progetti. La possibilità:
• Sistemi di generazione di aria compressa e di processo + reti di gas (N2, Co2, Arg) ecc. Conformi a GMP e GEP, ottimizzati e gestiti nell'area di ispezione
• Manutenzione, gestione aziendale esterna, miglioramenti e ulteriore sviluppo di sistemi e sistemi
• Tenuta di registri e gestione di SOP
• Avvio di modernizzazioni e assistenza nella pianificazione dei costi
• Implementazione della gestione della continuità operativa per sistemi e sistemi
• Gestione dei pezzi di ricambio
• Interpretazione del consumo di energia e misure derivate
• Fornitura di servizi di guardia nella fornitura di energia per l'area di Basilea (aria compressa e di processo, produzione di acqua fredda e salata e vari sistemi termici (40°C, acqua di fabbrica, raffreddamento delle acque reflue, idranti, rete a 95°C) Chi siete:
• Almeno tre anni di esperienza professionale nell'esercizio e nella manutenzione di sistemi di processo in un ambiente GMP
• L'esperienza pratica nella fornitura di energia è un vantaggio
• Avete esperienza nell'utilizzo dei sistemi di controllo dei processi dei sistemi menzionati.
• Hai completato la formazione professionale tecnica e preferibilmente una formazione continua come specialista della manutenzione.
• Metodi di lavoro indipendenti e auto-organizzati; Comprensione e buona capacità di orientamento all'interno di un'organizzazione a matrice
• Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca scritta e parlata, idealmente inglese, completano il tuo profilo Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo si impegnano a far progredire la scienza, garantendo a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi hanno portato a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e a oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Ci diamo la forza reciproca di esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alte le nostre ambizioni, in modo da poter offrire la vita

• Vous avez de l'expérience dans l'exploitation des systèmes de contrôle de procédés des systèmes mentionnés.

jobs.title: Verification & Validation Test Technician
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you someone who finds satisfaction in the details? Do you enjoy the process of systematically checking software to ensure it works perfectly with physical hardware?

In our cross functional and cross Site team, we are looking for a Test Technician with a strong interest in Instrument testing focusing on Software Testing to join our team in Sant Cugat. While you will be working with physical medical instruments, your primary focus will be on the software that drives them—executing test cases, documenting defects, and ensuring the system is reliable for patient use.

Your Role
In this position, you aren't just "clicking buttons"—you are the guardian of software quality. You will be responsible for the consistent execution of test protocols that bridge the gap between digital code and mechanical movement.

Key Responsibilities:

• Software-Centric medical device testing:
• Execute manual test cases focusing on software functionality, with a customer mindset on a medical device.

• Lifecycle Maintenance:
• Create, refine, and update software test cases over the entire life cycle of the medical device.

• Methodical Execution:
• Perform repetitive test cycles with high consistency to ensure software stability across different versions.

• Technical Documentation:
• Document every step of your process. You will record defects and test results with high precision to meet medical regulatory standards.

Your Profile
We are looking for a practical, detail-oriented professional with a genuine passion for technology. If you love troubleshooting, have a high affinity for software, and prefer hands-on execution over theoretical concepts, this is the role for you. Formación Profesional (Grado Medio/Superior), no university degree is required—we value your practical skills, technical curiosity, and drive to learn

Background:
Completed apprenticeship or solid job experience in a technical environment, laboratory, or IT-support setting. E.g. Técnico/a de Pruebas, Tester de Software y Hardware, Técnico de Verificación y Validación (V&V), Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Multiplataforma, Grado en Ingeniería Informática or similar

The "Tester" Mindset:
You are naturally conscientious and thorough. You enjoy a routine-oriented environment and take pride in performing repetitive tasks with 100% accuracy every time.

Software Affinity:
You have a keen interest in how software operates and a desire to build a career in instrument/system testing (no programming skills needed).

Quality First:
You understand that documenting a test is just as important as performing it.

Soft skills:
Ability to actively contribute to team collaboration, inclusion, sharing ideas and good team spirit, as well as mutual trust and respect (project team and sub chapter level)

Languages skills:
Expert Spanish (C1 or better) and expert English (C1 or better) language skills. The project language is English. Local team language is Spanish

Bonus skills:

• Basic understanding of customer workflows in the area of diagnostic instruments (e.g. in coagulation or serum work area)

• Basic skills with testing tools e.g. Retina

• Initial experience with software testing on instrument level

What you can expect from us:

Teamwork with ambitious and passionate people building high-quality products meeting customer’s needs
An agile working environment allowing for collaboration and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams
Fostered collaboration within the project and chapter to build and maintain a tr

jobs.title: SW Technical Lead - Data Platforms

titleByLocale.it: SW Technical Lead - Piattaforme di dati

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

SW Technical Lead - Data Platforms

As a Custom Software Developer, you will act as a strategic leader and innovator. You will define tasks for others, drive large-scale initiatives, and mentor colleagues to foster growth. This role involves providing global-level support for technical initiatives, sharing knowledge internationally, and shaping the organization's technical direction. You will possess deep expertise across multiple technology areas, set high standards for code quality and security, and remove obstacles for teams, continuously improving developer productivity and the overall software development lifecycle.

The Opportunity:

• Scope: Provide strategic technical guidance and set the direction for digital product development in alignment with business goals and priorities.

• Architectural Evolution: Lead the strategic transition from a modular monolith to microservices, ensuring domain boundaries are respected and performance remains high. Take ownership of the development of new components and ideas as you cooperate with a multidisciplinary team to deliver end-to-end experiences to the End Users.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Define tasks for others and drive successful Medium to Large (M/L) initiatives at the Product or Product Line level. Challenge others in a growth-enabling way, leverage team strengths effectively, and act as a coach and/or lead for others.

• Stakeholder Management: Possess a strong grasp of stakeholder ecosystems and their needs, excelling in negotiations and partnerships for mutual benefits. Provide direction for mid- to long-term goals and objectives.

• Impact/Strategy: Provide global-level support for innovative and technological initiatives. Give speeches and share knowledge in local/international events and knowledge-sharing initiatives, and actively engage in RDT Data Domain/Site-related activities.

• Complexity/ (Product Size): Operate at the Product / Domain / Site level.

• Business/Technical ability: Actively contribute to the advancement of technical knowledge within the field through publications, presentations, and mentorship (for example, by serving as a capability owner). Inspire innovation, drive innovative solutions in line with technology trends, and focus on designing new approaches to existing problems.

Who you are:

• 10+ years proven experience driving cross-functional collaboration to solve organization-wide technical problems and aligning disparate engineering efforts toward common goals.

• Possess a deep understanding of data processing principles and AI-readiness data needs. Hold experience in building solutions for data experts (e.g., Data Owners, Data Consumers, Data Product Owners, and Digital Asset Management).

• Exhibit deep expertise in multiple technology areas and the ability to select and apply appropriate technologies to solve complex problems.

• Maintain proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Event-driven architecture, or similar technologies.

• Demonstrate a strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices, including performance tuning and scalability.

• Leverage excellent knowledge of market-available software development tooling to suggest adoption into the current Roche toolset, continuously improving developer productivity and experience Roche-wide.

• Apply expertise in cybersecurity best practices, ensuring that software solutions comply with security standards in coordination with appropriate Roche expert

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione SW Technical Lead - Piattaforme di dati Come sviluppatore di software personalizzato, si agirà come leader strategico e innovatore. Definirai i compiti per gli altri, guiderai iniziative su larga scala e i colleghi di mentore per promuovere la crescita. Questo ruolo consiste nel fornire supporto a livello globale per iniziative tecniche, condividere conoscenze a livello internazionale, e modellare la direzione tecnica dell'organizzazione. Possiederai una profonda esperienza in più aree tecnologiche, stabilirai standard elevati per la qualità del codice e la sicurezza, e rimuoverai gli ostacoli per le squadre, migliorando continuamente la produttività degli sviluppatori e il ciclo di vita globale dello sviluppo del software. L'opportunità:
• Ambito: fornire una guida tecnica strategica e impostare la direzione per lo sviluppo di prodotti digitali in linea con gli obiettivi e le priorità aziendali.
• Evoluzione architettonica: guidare la transizione strategica da un monolite modulare a microservizi, assicurando che i confini del dominio siano rispettati e le prestazioni rimangono elevate. Partecipa allo sviluppo di nuovi componenti e idee collaborando con un team multidisciplinare per offrire esperienze end-to-end agli utenti finali.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Definire i compiti per gli altri e guidare le iniziative di successo Medium to Large (M/L) a livello Product Line. Sfidare gli altri in un modo di crescita, sfruttare i punti di forza del team in modo efficace, e agire come allenatore e / o guidare per gli altri.
• Gestione degli stakeholder: Possedere una forte comprensione degli ecosistemi delle parti interessate e delle loro esigenze, eccellendo nei negoziati e nelle partnership per i benefici reciproci. Fornire la direzione per obiettivi e obiettivi a medio-lungo termine.
• Impatto/Strategia: fornire supporto a livello globale per iniziative innovative e tecnologiche. Fai discorsi e condividi la conoscenza in eventi locali/internazionali e iniziative di condivisione delle conoscenze, e impegnarsi attivamente in attività correlate a RDT Data Domain/Site.
• Complessità/ (dimensione del prodotto): Operare a livello del prodotto / dominio / sito.
• Capacità aziendale/tecnica: contribuire attivamente all'avanzamento della conoscenza tecnica all'interno del campo attraverso pubblicazioni, presentazioni e mentorship (ad esempio, servendo come proprietario di capacità). Ispirare l'innovazione, guidare soluzioni innovative in linea con le tendenze tecnologiche, e concentrarsi sulla progettazione di nuovi approcci ai problemi esistenti. Chi sei:
• 10+ anni di esperienza collaudata che guida la collaborazione interfunzionale per risolvere i problemi tecnici a livello organizzativo e allineare gli sforzi di ingegneria disparati verso obiettivi comuni.
• Possiede una profonda comprensione dei principi del trattamento dei dati e delle esigenze di protezione dell'intelligenza artificiale. Tenere esperienza nella costruzione di soluzioni per gli esperti di dati (ad esempio, Data Owners, Data Consumers, Data Product Owners e Digital Asset Management).
• Esprimi una profonda esperienza in più aree tecnologiche e la capacità di selezionare e applicare tecnologie adeguate per risolvere problemi complessi.
• Mantenere la competenza in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Architettura basata su eventi o tecnologie simili.
• Dimostrare una forte comprensione delle pratiche del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del software, compresa la messa a punto delle prestazioni e la scalabilità.
• Levare la conoscenza eccellente dello sviluppo software disponibile sul mercato strumenti per suggerire l'adozione nell'attuale strumenti Roche, migliorando continuamente la produttività degli sviluppatori e l'esperienza Roche-wide.
• Applicare competenze nelle best practice di sicurezza informatica, assicurando che le soluzioni software conformi agli standard di sicurezza in coordinamento con l'esperto Roche appropriato

The Opportunity:

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein Team
Als Applikationsspezialist (m/w/d) im Außendienst in der Region Münster / Bielefeld / Dortmund wirst Du Teil von Roche Diagnostics Deutschland, einem weltweit führenden Unternehmen in den Bereichen Pharma und Diagnostik. Wir entwickeln und vertreiben hochmoderne diagnostische Systeme für Labore und Kliniken. Deine Aufgabe ist es, mit Leidenschaft und Know-how vor Ort dafür zu sorgen, dass unsere Systeme zuverlässig laufen, unsere Kund:innen unterstützt werden und exzellenten Service erleben.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

Als Applikationsspezialist (m/w/d) im Außendienst bist du das Gesicht von Roche vor Ort und trägst so maßgeblich zur Kundenzufriedenheit bei. Deine Aufgaben erledigst du sowohl im direkten Kundenkontakt als auch in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team:

• Umfassende Betreuung und Schulung der Kunden:innen an Roche-Systemlinien (Pathologie und/oder molekulare Diagnostik/PCR) mit den Schwerpunkten Applikation, Bedienung und Nachbetreuung.

• Sicherstellung der Systemverfügbarkeit und der Ergebnisqualität beim Kunden.

• Eigenverantwortliche Analyse und Behebung von Fehlern auf Applikationsebene in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Expert:innen.

• Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen (vor Ort und telefonisch) mit Fokus auf die optimale Lösungsfindung.

• Anwendungstechnische Beratung der Kunden:innen zur optimalen Nutzung der Systeme.

• Aktive Unterstützung des Vertriebsteams und der regionalen Systemleitung mit Fach- und Anwendungswissen.

• Durchführung von Systeminstallationen, Inbetriebnahmen und Software-Modifikationen ausgewählter Systeme sowie Dokumentation der Einsätze im CRM-System.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als MTA/BTA mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung oder naturwissenschaftliches Studium (Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss).

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im diagnostischen Labor oder als Applikationsspezialist:in, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Pathologie und/oder molekulare Diagnostik (PCR).

• Gute Applikations- und Qualitätssicherungskenntnisse diagnostischer Analysesysteme sowie vertiefte Kenntnisse in der Humandiagnostik.

• IT-Grundwissen (Netzwerke) und sicherer Umgang mit MS Office/Google Suite; idealerweise CRM-Erfahrung.

• Hohe Lösungsfindungskompetenz, methodische Herangehensweise bei kniffligen Problemen und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Inhalte verständlich zu vermitteln.

• Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung, Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke sowie eine ergebnisorientierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise.

• Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse (ca. B1/B2-Niveau), um technische Dokumentationen zu verstehen und dich im Team auszutauschen.

• Für die optimale Betreuung der Region besitzt du einen gültigen Führerschein und wohnst idealerweise in der Region Münster / Bielefeld / Dortmund und bringst eine hohe Reisebereitschaft mit, um unsere Kunden:innen in der Region zu betreuen.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente: Aktueller Lebenslauf. Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Team Lead Reagents Operations (QC Lab)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz is one of the world's leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for hospitals, laboratories, and physician offices. With over 2,200 employees, Rotkreuz is one of Roche Diagnostics' main sites. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity.

The Team Lead QC Reagents role at the Roche Rotkreuz S&C (Sensor & Cartridge Manufacturing) site is a central leadership position responsible for the quality control of reagents, ensuring product quality and compliance with regulatory requirements. This includes assuming technical responsibility for compounding in reagent production, and supporting all production processes to drive improvement in collaboration with the respective Team Leaders (Peers)

The Opportunity

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 8 specialists, fostering talent and managing the team’s training matrix and status using adult learning methods.

• Take responsibility for all Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) roles within the team, implementing risk reduction measures and ensuring full compliance with GMP, GSP, and mQMS.

• Translate S&C Operations Strategy into measurable team objectives and KPIs, while optimizing manufacturing and personnel costs through performance analysis.

• Ensure supply according to long-term resource planning (12 months) and optimize the production plan in collaboration with the supply chain.

• Assume technical responsibility for compounding in reagent production and lead the Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) to increase quality and efficiency standards.

• Act as the central interface to departments like Supply Chain, R&D, and MSAT to ensure cross-functional order coordination and planning optimization.

• Monitor Quality-KPIs such as Right-First-Time (RFT) and Statistical-Process-Control (SPC), and contribute to department-wide improvements as a member of the S&C Manufacturing Rotkreuz Leadership Team.

Who You Are

• You hold a higher natural science education (BSc, MSc, PhD), ideally as a Chemist, Biochemist, Process Engineer, or Materials Scientist.

• You have proven experience in employee leadership with an empathetic style and a genuine passion for coaching and empowering a diverse team in a production environment.

• You possess profound experience with GMP in highly regulated environments, a strong quality awareness, and a very good command of written and spoken German and English.

• You have strong analytical thinking skills, an understanding of complex contexts, and an interest in Shopfloor Management and data-based decision-making.

• You demonstrate excellent communication skills, high self-reflection, and the ability to represent the department’s interests effectively.

Have we sparked your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your complete application documents (cover letter, CV, references, diplomas, etc.).

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Location

• Pune, India

• Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia

Job description

• As a Senior Business Analyst, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, tackling complex and ambiguous business problems. Applying a deep understanding of the Manufacturing Business domain and IT infrastructure, you will translate site-specific requirements into strategic implementation plans, ensuring solutions are fit-for-purpose and meet site-specific needs for operational efficiency.

• In this role, you will be accountable for active partnering, managing and prioritizing infrastructure demand, and coordinating the end-to-end delivery of new product implementations and complex requests. You will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, resolving conflicts, and contributing significantly to solution design.

Description of the area
Within RDT Pharma Technical Operations and specifically in the context of Manufacturing Technologies, this IT Business Analyst for Infrastructure ensures the seamless fit of our manufacturing business solutions into the Roche ecosystem. Maximizing manufacturing ROI requires stable, robust, and high-performance infrastructure solutions.

Our scope includes:

• All Pharma and DIA Manufacturing Sites

• RDT Standard technologies to be adopted as core solutions for the infrastructure

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manages end-to-end business analysis workstreams without guidance, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks, mentors junior and intermediate BAs, and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability / Problem Solving : Leads the analysis of business problems, performs thorough domain research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to solution selection, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers impact that extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster, contributing to domain goals by ensuring solutions provide demonstrable business value. Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans, influences tactical decisions, and contributes to long-term solution roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size) : Works at a solution or product level involving multiple solutions, handling ambiguous requirements and systematically interacting with stakeholders across a broader product environment. Evaluates solution impacts considering both immediate and long-term business implications.

• Business / Technical ability: Demonstrates a deep understanding of the Manufacturing Business domain and IT infrastructure technologies, and their interdependencies. Independently applies tools, principles, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis to manage interconnections and improve overall efficiency.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor or advanced degree

• 5+ years of Business Analysis / Consultancy experience, with at least 3&

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Immerse yourself in the fascinating everyday working life at Roche Diagnostics surrounded by beautiful mountains, not far from the scenic Lake Zug and yet close to the cities of Zug, Zurich and Lucerne. Here, where we have been rooted for over 50 years, we develop and produce diagnostic solutions and help to find answers to health questions. The Rotkreuz site, where a wide variety of disciplines work hand in hand, is a meeting place for over 2,700 talented employees from 70 different nations. Our campus invites people to work together, be creative and realise their full potential. We believe that a positive work environment, employee satisfaction, inclusion and sustainability are key to growing together and improving the lives of patients around the world. Welcome to Roche in Rotkreuz.
Embark on a transformative learning experience with Roche Diagnostics in Rotkreuz. Designed to nurture emerging talent, this program offers a dynamic and immersive opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the field of diagnostics, fostering personal and professional growth.
The Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) team within Sensor and Cartridge Operations ensures the efficient and high-quality production of electrochemical sensors and cartridges, reagents and fluid packs by bridging the gap between product development and full-scale manufacturing.

The Opportunity

• You transform raw manufacturing data into actionable intelligence to ensure high-quality product consumable assemblies.

• Your role involves evaluating and deploying a microscopy-based optical stage to inspect and analyze product components.

• You apply Machine Learning algorithms for automated feature extraction and classification to establish accept/reject criteria before final assembly.

• Data analysis guides your work as you leverage classical statistics and predictive modeling to correlate imaging features with process parameters and quality.

• Collaboration and presentation are key as you present analytical findings to multidisciplinary teams (Operations, R&D) to drive data-backed mitigations for in-field quality issues.

• Your work focuses on a critical, high-priority product care project, solving real-life issues that occur at the customer site to bring solutions to the market.

• The position offers a supportive culture with professional growth, mentorship, and a modern work-life balance including on-site perks and work-from-home options.

Who You Are

• You have completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree within the last 12 months, or are currently enrolled in a Master’s program, specializing in Biomedical, Mechanical, or Process Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.

• You are a tech-enthusiast who loves to see code come to life in physical products and has a genuine interest in how cutting-edge technology meets modern manufacturing

• You possess a strong analytical and troubleshooter mindset, acting as an independent worker who is also a dedicated team player.

• Technical expertise in Python and its ecosystem is a strength you bring to the role, alongside your proficiency in image analysis tools.

• You can leverage any additional knowledge in optics and spectroscopy, which is considered a plus for this position.

• A strong foundation in statistical data analysis ensures that you remain highly data-analysis driven in all your tasks.

• You are fluent in English, while German is a plus as it facilitates a collaborative environment within the team.

Application Process

•

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Territory Manager based in Coimbatore , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals.

The Opportunity

• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.

• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.

• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.

• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.

• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.

• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.

• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.

• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.

• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.

• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.

• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.

• You are comfortable with field travel within the Coimbatore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come.
