jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Szukamy zorganizowanej i skrupulatnej osoby, która wesprze nasz zespół w zarządzaniu obiegiem używanego sprzętu medycznego. Będziesz kluczowym ogniwem w procesie procesowania zwrotów – od momentu odebrania paczki, przez jej cyfrową ewidencję, aż po koordynację wysyłki do naszej centrali w Niemczech.

Twoja Rola:

• Obsługa przesyłek przychodzących: Odbieranie oraz fizyczne segregowanie paczek reklamacyjnych trafiających do magazynu.

• Ewidencja cyfrowa: Wprowadzanie danych o przesyłkach do systemów operacyjnych ( SAP / Rexis ).

• Wstępna diagnostyka: Klasyfikacja urządzeń pod kątem zgłoszonych usterek i uszkodzeń aparatury medycznej.

• Logistyka międzynarodowa: Identyfikacja i przygotowanie wysyłki paczek o statusie „krytycznym” do centrali w Mannheim w celu dalszej ewidencji.

• Współpraca z zespołem: Bieżąca komunikacja z działem serwisu i logistyki.

O Tobie:

• Wykształcenie: Minimum średnie (zapraszamy również studentów w trakcie nauki).

• Dyspozycyjność: Możliwość pracy 2 dni w tygodniu (grafik do ustalenia).

• Zdolności analityczne: Umiejętność trafnej klasyfikacji usterki na podstawie dokumentacji i stanu faktycznego.

• Komunikatywność: Jasne przekazywanie informacji i umiejętność pracy w zespole.

• Doskonała organizacja: Umiejętność priorytetyzacji zadań i dbałość o porządek w dokumentacji systemowej.​

Oferujemy:

• Elastyczność: Idealna praca dla osób łączących naukę z życiem zawodowym.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner (Hematology & Hemophilia - Timisoara)

titleByLocale.it: Partner del Viaggio Paziente (Hematology & Hemophilia - Timisoara)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) in Hematology & Hemophilia will be at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering extraordinary medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption.

As an empowered leader and the face of Roche, you will collaborate closely with all partners directly touching the patient journey, gaining a deep understanding of their needs, in service of connecting Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions. In addition, you will be responsible for:

• Acting as a trusted partner and the primary point of contact between stakeholders and Roche, prioritising and securing resources, and driving solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• Collaborating with patient journey partners to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• Guiding Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supporting their appropriate use, sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.

• Ensuring great experiences whenever partners in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services.

Who You Are
You demonstrate personal purpose in improving the patient journey, as well as a strong passion to bring value and impact to the healthcare ecosystem.
You are a true visionary, defining and embedding the strategy around creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand).

In addition, you bring the following skills & experience:

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche

• Self managed and self directed - altruistic in supporting the global network

• Display of integrity in everything as a leader who senses, reflects and responds

• Boldly acts on key decisions and opportunities and boldly stops any activity that is not adding value.

• Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and organizations is required.

• Experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams

• Keen eye for business with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience excellence

• Able to understand and use digital means and tools

• Deep knowledge of patient journey(s) and related treatments in defined disease area(s), enabling engagement at the specialist level.

• Broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions

• Robust understanding of medical affairs strategies and tactics including clinical research

• You are fluent in Romanian and English languages

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Partner del Viaggio Paziente (PJP) in Ematologia & Hemophilia sarà al centro della nuova organizzazione Roche, ponendo in risalto il ruolo che giochiamo nella società - dall'offrire per lo più medicine straordinarie verso una maggiore collaborazione, innovazione e interruzione generativa. Come leader potenziato e il volto di Roche, collaborerai a stretto contatto con tutti i partner che toccano direttamente il percorso del paziente, acquisendo una profonda comprensione delle loro esigenze, al servizio della connessione delle capacità di Roche per creare soluzioni significative. Inoltre, sarete responsabili di:
• Agire come partner affidabile e punto di contatto primario tra le parti interessate e Roche, priorità e protezione delle risorse, e soluzioni di guida che forniscono risultati più velocemente.
• Collaborare con i partner di viaggio del paziente per rimuovere i blocchi stradali e sbloccare le possibilità di offrire valore ai pazienti e alla comunità.
• Guidare i prodotti Roche attraverso il loro ciclo di vita e sostenere il loro uso appropriato, condividendo i loro meriti con HCP in modo veritiero ed equilibrato.
• Assicurare grandi esperienze quando i partner dell'ecosistema si impegnano con dipendenti, prodotti e servizi Roche. Chi sei Lei dimostra lo scopo personale nel migliorare il viaggio del paziente, nonché una forte passione per portare valore e impatto all'ecosistema sanitario. Sei un vero visionario, definendo e incorporando la strategia intorno alla creazione di migliori risultati di salute per più pazienti più velocemente, portando una forte mentalità imprenditoriale con eccellenti capacità di partner (coaching, consulenza, capacità di ascoltare profondamente, domanda e capire). Inoltre, si portano le seguenti competenze & esperienza:
• mentalità di crescita, in grado di imparare e scatenare rapidamente, correre rischi e sperimentare, e contribuire al ciclo di apprendimento condividendo la conoscenza con gli altri all'interno e all'esterno Roche
• Autogestito e autodiretto - altruista nel sostenere la rete globale
• Visualizzazione dell'integrità in tutto come leader che percepisce, riflette e risponde
• Agisce coraggiosamente su decisioni e opportunità chiave e ferma audacemente qualsiasi attività che non aggiunge valore.
• Eccellenti capacità di coinvolgimento degli stakeholder, tra cui la collaborazione con gli esperti di area terapeutica (TAEs) e le organizzazioni è necessaria.
• Esperienza sia nella formulazione di strategie interfunzionali che nell'orchestrazione di team interfunzionali
• Occhio sicuro per il business con esperienza desiderata nella commercializzazione, l'eccellenza dell'esperienza medica e del cliente
• In grado di comprendere e utilizzare mezzi e strumenti digitali
• Una profonda conoscenza del percorso dei pazienti e dei trattamenti correlati nell'area(i) definita della malattia, consentendo l'impegno a livello specialistico.
• Ampia comprensione del portafoglio attuale di Roche e della futura pipeline, in modo da poter lavorare su soluzioni future
• Robusta comprensione delle strategie di affari medici e tattiche, compresa la ricerca clinica
• Sei fluente in lingua rumena e inglese Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) in Hematology & Hemophilia will be at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering extraordinary medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. As an empowered leader and the face of Roche, you will collaborate closely with all partners directly touching the patient journey, gaining a deep understanding of their needs, in service of connecting Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions. In addition, you will be responsible for:
• Acting as a trusted partner and the primary point of contact between stakeholders and Roche, prioritising and securing resources, and driving solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
• Collaborating with patient journey partners to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.
• Guiding Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supporting their appropriate use, sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.
• Ensuring great experiences whenever partners in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services. Who You Are You demonstrate personal purpose in improving the patient journey, as well as a strong passion to bring value and impact to the healthcare ecosystem. You are a true visionary, defining and embedding the strategy around creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand). In addition, you bring the following skills & experience:
• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche
• Self managed and self directed - altruistic in supporting the global network
• Display of integrity in everything as a leader who senses, reflects and responds
• Boldly acts on key decisions and opportunities and boldly stops any activity that is not adding value.
• Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and organizations is required.
• Experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams
• Keen eye for business with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience excellence
• Able to understand and use digital means and tools
• Deep knowledge of patient journey(s) and related treatments in defined disease area(s), enabling engagement at the specialist level.
• Broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions
• Robust understanding of medical affairs strategies and tactics including clinical research
• You are fluent in Romanian and English languages Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Der Patient Journey Partner (PJP) in Hematologie & Hemophilia wird im Zentrum der neuen Roche-Organisation stehen und die Rolle, die wir in der Gesellschaft spielen, auf den Kopf stellen - von meist außergewöhnlichen Medikamenten bis hin zu viel mehr Partnering, innovative und führender Generativstörung. Als kraftvoller Leiter und Gesicht von Roche werden Sie eng mit allen Partnern zusammenarbeiten, die die Patientenreise direkt berühren und ein tiefes Verständnis für ihre Bedürfnisse gewinnen, um Roches Fähigkeiten zu verbinden, um sinnvolle Lösungen zu schaffen. Darüber hinaus sind Sie für:
• Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner und primärer Ansprechpartner zwischen Stakeholdern und Roche, Priorisierung und Sicherung von Ressourcen und Fahrlösungen, die Ergebnisse schneller liefern.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Patienten-Reisepartnern, um Straßensperren zu entfernen und Möglichkeiten zu entsperren, um Wert für Patienten und die Gemeinschaft zu liefern.
• Die Produkte von Roche über ihren Lebenszyklus zu informieren und ihre angemessene Nutzung zu unterstützen und ihre Verdienste mit HCPs in wahrhaftiger und ausgewogener Weise zu teilen.
• Sicherstellung großer Erfahrungen, wenn die Partner im Ökosystem mit Roche-Mitarbeitern, Produkten und Dienstleistungen zusammenarbeiten. Wer bist du? Sie zeigen persönliche Ziele bei der Verbesserung der Patientenreise sowie eine starke Leidenschaft, um Wert und Auswirkungen auf das Ökosystem der Gesundheitsversorgung zu bringen. Sie sind ein wahrer Visionär, definieren und einbetten die Strategie um bessere gesundheitliche Ergebnisse für mehr Patienten schneller zu schaffen, eine starke unternehmerische Mentalität mit hervorragenden Partnerfähigkeiten (Coaching, Beratung, Fähigkeit zu tief zu hören, Frage und Verständnis). Darüber hinaus bringen Sie die folgenden Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung:
• Wachstumsgeist, schnell lernen und unlernen können, Risiken und Experimente eingehen und zum Lernzyklus beitragen, indem sie Wissen mit anderen innerhalb und außerhalb von Roche teilen
• Selbst verwaltet und selbstgerichtet - altruistisch bei der Unterstützung des globalen Netzes
• Anzeige der Integrität in allem als Anführer, der Sinne, Spiegel und Antworten
• Boldly wirkt auf Schlüsselentscheidungen und Chancen und stoppt kühn jede Tätigkeit, die keinen Wert addiert.
• Ausgezeichnete Stakeholder-Verlobungskompetenzen, einschließlich der Zusammenarbeit mit Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) und Organisationen sind erforderlich.
• Erfahrungen bei der Formulierung von funktionsübergreifenden Strategien und der Orchestrierung von funktionsübergreifenden Teams
• Keen Auge für Unternehmen mit gewünschtem Know-how in der Kommerzialisierung, Medizin und Customer Experience Exzellenz
• Befähigt, digitale Mittel und Werkzeuge zu verstehen und zu verwenden
• Tiefe Kenntnis der Patientenreise(n) und damit zusammenhängenden Behandlungen in definierten Krankheitsbereichen, die das Engagement auf der Fachebene ermöglichen.
• Weitreichendes Verständnis von Roches gegenwärtigem Portfolio und zukünftiger Pipeline, so dass sie an zukunftsorientierten Lösungen arbeiten können
• Robustes Verständnis von medizinischen Strategien und Taktiken einschließlich klinischer Forschung
• Sie sind fließend in rumänische und englische Sprachen Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Lassen Sie uns eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le Patient Journey Partner (PJP) en Hématologie et en Hémophilie sera au centre de la nouvelle organisation Roche, tournant à l'envers le rôle que nous jouons dans la société - de l'offre surtout de médicaments extraordinaires à beaucoup plus de partenariat, d'innovation et de principale perturbation génératrice. En tant que leader et visage de Roche, vous collaborerez étroitement avec tous les partenaires touchant directement le parcours patient, en acquérant une compréhension profonde de leurs besoins, au service de la connexion des capacités Roches pour co-créer des solutions significatives. De plus, vous serez responsable :
• Agir en tant que partenaire de confiance et principal point de contact entre les parties prenantes et Roche, hiérarchiser et sécuriser les ressources, et conduire des solutions qui produisent des résultats plus rapidement.
• Collaborer avec des partenaires de voyage pour éliminer les barrages routiers et débloquer les possibilités de fournir de la valeur pour les patients et la communauté.
• Guider les produits Roches tout au long de leur cycle de vie et soutenir leur utilisation appropriée, en partageant leurs mérites avec les HCP de manière honnête et équilibrée.
• Assurer de bonnes expériences chaque fois que les partenaires de l'écosystème s'engagent avec les employés, les produits et les services de Roche. Qui vous êtes Vous faites preuve d'un but personnel en améliorant le parcours des patients, ainsi qu'une forte passion pour apporter valeur et impact à l'écosystème de santé. Vous êtes un véritable visionnaire, définir et intégrer la stratégie autour de la création de meilleurs résultats de santé pour plus de patients plus rapidement, apportant une forte mentalité entrepreneuriale avec des capacités de partenariat exceptionnelles (coaching, consultation, capacité à écouter profondément, questionner et comprendre). En outre, vous apportez les compétences et l'expérience suivantes:
• L'état d'esprit de croissance, capable d'apprendre et de désapprendre rapidement, de prendre des risques et d'expérimenter, et de contribuer au cycle d'apprentissage en partageant les connaissances avec d'autres à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de Roche
• Autogéré et autogéré - altruiste pour soutenir le réseau mondial
• Affichage de l'intégrité en tout en tant que leader qui sens, réfléchit et répond
• Agir avec audace sur les décisions et les opportunités clés et arrêter avec audace toute activité qui n'apporte pas de valeur ajoutée.
• D'excellentes compétences en matière d'engagement des parties prenantes, y compris des partenariats avec des spécialistes des domaines thérapeutiques (ETA) et des organisations, sont nécessaires.
• Expérience dans la formulation de stratégies interfonctionnelles et l'orchestration d'équipes interfonctionnelles
• Keen œil pour les affaires avec l'expertise souhaitée dans la commercialisation, l'expérience médicale et client excellence
• Capable de comprendre et d'utiliser des moyens et des outils numériques
• Une connaissance approfondie du ou des parcours(s) patient(s) et des traitements connexes dans un ou des domaines de maladie définis, permettant l'engagement au niveau des spécialistes.
• Une large compréhension du portefeuille actuel et du futur pipeline de Roches, afin qu'ils puissent travailler sur des solutions basées sur l'avenir
• Compréhension rigoureuse des stratégies et tactiques médicales, y compris la recherche clinique
• Vous parlez couramment le roumain et l'anglais Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Laissez-nous construire un avenir plus sain

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Accountant - Arabic Speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:
As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and Arabic

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience
• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage
• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues
• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions
• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations
• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment
• Proficiency in English and Arabic In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
La atención sanitaria está evolucionando y Roche Diagnostics responde esforzándose continuamente por alcanzar el mayor rendimiento posible, adoptando enfoques innovadores y estratégicos para las asociaciones comerciales y clínicas. Nuestros equipos de ventas gestionan proactivamente el ecosistema sanitario, contribuyendo de forma vital a mejorar los resultados de salud y garantizando que Roche siga haciendo ahora lo que los pacientes necesitarán después.

The Responsabilities:

Este puesto se integra dentro de la organización Comercial, centrándose en áreas de alta complejidad que están transformando la medicina moderna. Como Sales Specialist - Specialty , serás un motor clave para el desarrollo de negocio en áreas críticas como Microbiología, Anatomía Patológica, Genética y Secuenciación.
Trabajando en el área de Madrid, aportarás una visión de 360° para gestionar relaciones estratégicas en los centros sanitarios. Serás responsable de identificar oportunidades de alto valor y asegurar la rentabilidad y el crecimiento de tu zona asignada. Actuarás como un socio estratégico, utilizando un enfoque de venta consultiva para acortar la distancia entre las necesidades diagnósticas complejas y nuestras soluciones innovadoras.
Como Sales Specialist - Specialty , desempeñarás diversas funciones según tu experiencia, conocimientos y requisitos generales del negocio, incluyendo pero no limitado a:

• Actuarás como experto en tu territorio, identificando y desarrollando nuevas oportunidades de mercado en los segmentos de especialidad (Microbiología, Patología, Genética) en alineación con la estrategia comercial de Roche Diagnostics.

• Serás el responsable de la relación con el cliente, fortaleciendo vínculos con los diferentes interlocutores estratégicos para comprender sus desafíos y transmitir propuestas de valor estructuradas que respondan a sus necesidades específicas.

• Liderarás la ejecución de los planes de acción locales, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de Marketing y Servicio para garantizar la satisfacción del cliente y la sostenibilidad del negocio a largo plazo.

• Adoptarás e impulsarás metodologías comerciales rigurosas y un pensamiento analítico para gestionar tanto los aspectos técnicos como comerciales de tu cartera.

Who You Are:

• Posees una titulación universitaria con un sólido trasfondo científico , lo que te permite mantener discusiones técnicas de alto nivel.

• Cuentas con experiencia contrastada en ventas en el sector sanitario , preferiblemente con un conocimiento profundo en Microbiología, Anatomía Patológica, Genética o Secuenciación.

• Tienes un conocimiento sólido en las áreas de Enfermedades Infecciosas y Oncología ; se valorará muy positivamente la experiencia adicional en Genética.

• Eres un experto en venta consultiva , con una mentalidad orientada a resultados y una trayectoria de consecución de objetivos comerciales mediante el uso de metodologías estructuradas.

• Demuestras una visión de negocio de 360° , con capacidad para equilibrar los logros a corto plazo con el crecimiento estratégico a largo plazo.

• Muestras una actitud proactiva hacia la gestión del cambio , con alta capacidad de adaptación, autonomía y toma de decisiones responsable en entornos dinámicos.

• Eres un gran comunicador, capaz de actuar como un asesor de confianza ante decisores clínicos y administrativos.

• Se valorará significativamente el conocimiento en contratación pública y poseer una red de contactos establecida con los principales decisor

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The opportunity
As a Technical Support Partner for Lab-IT, you are responsible for carrying out field service functions for Roche Diagnostics Digital Products. Your primary duties include digital product troubleshooting, installation, commissioning, and performing preventive maintenance procedures. Reporting to the Technical Support Lead for Lab-IT, you will respond promptly to all service calls and handle various after-sales service issues to ensure customer satisfaction and optimal instrument performance.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, proactive, service-minded with strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across functions.
You will be responsible for

• Perform digital product installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting for all Roche Diagnostics digital Products.

• Respond promptly and effectively to all service calls from customers.

• Conduct preventive maintenance according to the established schedule to ensure instrument & digital product reliability.

• Manage and resolve other issues related to digital solution after-sales service to maintain high levels of customer support.

Who you are
Experience and Competencies:

• Strong in analytical and troubleshooting skills.

• Able to drive and travel in upcountry areas and be flexible to work outside of normal working hours.

• Independent, a team player, flexible, and solution-driven with an agile mindset.

• Good command of spoken and written English.

• Good communication skills.

• Demonstrates a desire to influence your own development and pursue interests across functions.

• Industry Experience:

• Bachelors or Masters in IT or related fields.

• Minimum of 1 year of work experience as a IT Specialist in the healthcare business is preferred.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The people leader leads a team of China Technical Partners (CTPs) and CMC professionals that are accountable for China regulatory CMC submissions, through developing and implementing robust end-to-end China filing strategies based on close collaboration with global development teams, China business priorities, China regulatory requirements and landscape. The scope includes the complete Roche portfolio, the global products (small molecules, biologics, new modalities). The focus of this role is to lead and coach the team members in order to accelerate drug access and continuous supply to the patients by ensuring right first-time submissions to Chinese Health Authorities and effective interactions with the Health Authority. The incumbent of the role is responsible to shape the regulatory environment in China in close collaboration with PTR Policy and translate that into innovative regulatory strategies. In line with Roche’s China strategy and the China First initiative, this is a role with a high business impact.
In this position, the people leader is responsible for the management of China Technical Partners (CTPs) and CMC program managers, which includes setting performance objectives, providing timely feedback, and ensuring alignment of short-term development goals with longer-term career goals. Provides guidance and manages work activities of others for specific projects and/or objectives. Demonstrates the fundamentals of effective coaching skills and mentoring. Adapts coaching style to meet the needs of the individual.
The people leader leads cross-functional regulatory initiatives and strategies, defines associated critical steps and resources needed and takes responsibility for implementation of these initiatives and strategies. Proactively communicates with regulatory and cross-functional personnel in support of internal and partner-associated project goals. Collaborates with management in leading communications with HA on projects and initiatives of major complexity. Makes decisions based on cross-functional priorities rather than functional area priorities.

Project People Leader

• Provide leadership to a team of regulatory professionals.

• Responsible for performance management of employees.

• Work with direct reports and ensure that objective and timely feedback is provided to employees, focus on the development of the employee by facilitating regular development discussions and check-ins.

• Provide coaching and mentoring to colleagues for an assigned area of technical regulatory responsibility.

• Work closely with the Portfolio Leader to coordinate resources and priorities at a Portfolio level.

• Regularly follow up and check in the progress of every specific project in the team, enlighten the team to work out submission strategies for different applications and identify regulatory risks and develop migration plans.

• Build and maintain a healthy relationships with internal & external key stakeholders, like NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, Supply Chain, Quality and compliance, PDR China and PTR global,

• Collaborate with internal key stakeholders for development and alignment of technical strategy, maximizing and balancing regulatory and supply needs in China.

QUALIFICATIONS
Education
Master’s Degree in life science disciplines is preferred; Post Graduate Degree is a plus.

Experience

• 8 or more years work experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or related industry and CMC, quality, regulatory or related experience.

• Previous People management o

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il leader della gente guida un team di Cina partner tecnici (CTPs) e professionisti CMC che sono responsabili per le presentazioni CMC di regolamentazione della Cina, attraverso lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di robuste strategie di archiviazione end-to-end Cina basate sulla stretta collaborazione con i team di sviluppo globale, le priorità aziendali della Cina, i requisiti normativi della Cina e il paesaggio. La portata include il portafoglio completo di Roche, i prodotti globali (piccole molecole, biologiche, nuove modalità). L'obiettivo di questo ruolo è quello di guidare e allenare i membri del team al fine di accelerare l'accesso alla droga e la fornitura continua ai pazienti assicurando le giuste presentazioni di prima volta alle autorità sanitarie cinesi e le interazioni efficaci con l'Autorità sanitaria. L'incombente del ruolo è responsabile di modellare l'ambiente normativo in Cina in stretta collaborazione con PTR Policy e tradurlo in strategie normative innovative. In linea con la strategia cinese di Roche e la prima iniziativa della Cina, questo è un ruolo con un alto impatto commerciale. In questa posizione, il leader delle persone è responsabile per la gestione dei partner tecnici cinesi (CTPs) e dei gestori dei programmi CMC, che include l'impostazione degli obiettivi di performance, il feedback tempestivo e l'allineamento degli obiettivi di sviluppo a breve termine con obiettivi di carriera a lungo termine. Fornisce indicazioni e gestisce attività di lavoro di altri per progetti e/o obiettivi specifici. Dimostra i fondamenti delle competenze di coaching efficaci e di mentoring. Adapts stile di coaching per soddisfare le esigenze dell'individuo. Il leader delle persone guida iniziative e strategie di regolamentazione interfunzionali, definisce i passi critici associati e le risorse necessarie e si assume la responsabilità per l'attuazione di queste iniziative e strategie. Proattivamente comunica con personale normativo e interfunzionale a supporto degli obiettivi di progetto interni e associati ai partner. Collabora con la gestione nelle principali comunicazioni con HA su progetti e iniziative di grande complessità. Prende decisioni basate su priorità interfunzionali piuttosto che su priorità di area funzionale. Leader del progetto
• Fornire leadership a un team di professionisti di regolamentazione.
• Responsabile per la gestione delle prestazioni dei dipendenti.
• Lavorare con rapporti diretti e garantire che il feedback oggettivo e tempestivo sia fornito ai dipendenti, concentrarsi sullo sviluppo del dipendente facilitando le discussioni e i check-in di sviluppo regolari.
• Fornire coaching e mentoring ai colleghi per un'area assegnata di responsabilità tecnica di regolamentazione.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il Leader Portfolio per coordinare risorse e priorità a livello Portfolio.
• Seguire regolarmente e controllare i progressi di ogni progetto specifico nel team, illuminare il team per elaborare strategie di presentazione per diverse applicazioni e identificare i rischi normativi e sviluppare piani di migrazione.
• Costruire e mantenere un rapporto sano con gli stakeholder chiave interni ed esterni, come NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, Supply Chain, Qualità e conformità, PDR Cina e PTR globale,
• Collaborare con le parti interessate chiave interne per lo sviluppo e l'allineamento della strategia tecnica, massimizzare e bilanciare le esigenze normative e di fornitura in Cina. QUALIFICA Istruzione Laurea magistrale in scienze della vita è preferito; Laurea post è un plus. Esperienza
• 8 o più anni di esperienza lavorativa nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o relativo settore e CMC, qualità, normazione o relativa esperienza.
• Gestione delle persone precedenti

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Der Menschenführer führt ein Team von China Technical Partners (CTPs) und CMC-Profis, die für China regulatorische CMC-Vorträge verantwortlich sind, durch die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von robusten End-to-End-China-Filing-Strategien basierend auf einer engen Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Entwicklungsteams, China-Geschäftsprioritäten, China-Regelanforderungen und Landschaft. Der Umfang umfasst das komplette Roche-Portfolio, die globalen Produkte (kleine Moleküle, Biologik, neue Modalitäten). Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt darin, die Teammitglieder zu leiten und zu trainieren, um den Drogenzugriff und die kontinuierliche Versorgung der Patienten zu beschleunigen, indem die richtigen Erstanträge an chinesische Gesundheitsbehörden und effektive Interaktionen mit der Gesundheitsbehörde sichergestellt werden. Die Rolle ist dafür verantwortlich, das regulatorische Umfeld in China in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der PTR-Politik zu gestalten und in innovative regulatorische Strategien umzusetzen. Im Einklang mit der China-Strategie von Roche und der China-First-Initiative ist dies eine Rolle mit einem hohen geschäftlichen Einfluss. In dieser Position ist der Personenführer für das Management von China Technical Partners (CTPs) und CMC-Programmmanagern verantwortlich, die Leistungsziele festlegen, zeitnah Feedback liefern und eine Ausrichtung von kurzfristigen Entwicklungszielen mit langfristigen Karrierezielen gewährleisten. Bietet Beratung und verwaltet Arbeitsaktivitäten von anderen für spezifische Projekte und/oder Ziele. Demonstriert die Grundlagen der effektiven Coaching Fähigkeiten und Mentoring. Passt Coaching-Stil, um die Bedürfnisse des Einzelnen zu erfüllen. Der Menschenführer führt funktionsübergreifende regulatorische Initiativen und Strategien, definiert assoziierte kritische Schritte und Ressourcen, die benötigt werden, und übernimmt die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung dieser Initiativen und Strategien. Proaktiv kommuniziert mit regulatorischen und funktionsübergreifenden Mitarbeitern zur Unterstützung interner und partnerschaftlicher Projektziele. Zusammenarbeit mit Management in führenden Kommunikationen mit HA über Projekte und Initiativen großer Komplexität. Entscheidungen auf der Grundlage von funktionsübergreifenden Prioritäten statt funktioneller Schwerpunkte. Projekt People Leader
• Führen Sie ein Team von Regulierungsexperten.
• Verantwortlich für das Leistungsmanagement der Mitarbeiter.
• Arbeiten Sie mit direkten Berichten und stellen Sie sicher, dass den Mitarbeitern objektives und zeitnahes Feedback zur Verfügung gestellt wird, konzentrieren Sie sich auf die Entwicklung des Mitarbeiters durch regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche und Check-ins.
• Bereitstellung von Coaching und Mentoring an Kollegen für einen zugewiesenen Bereich der technischen Regulierungsverantwortung.
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Portfolioleiter zusammen, um Ressourcen und Prioritäten auf Portfolioebene zu koordinieren.
• Befolgen und überprüfen Sie regelmäßig den Fortschritt jedes einzelnen Projekts im Team, erleuchten Sie das Team, um Einreichungsstrategien für verschiedene Anwendungen zu entwickeln und regulatorische Risiken zu identifizieren und Migrationspläne zu entwickeln.
• Erstellen und pflegen Sie eine gesunde Beziehung zu internen und externen Schlüsselakteure, wie NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, Supply Chain, Qualität und Compliance, PDR China und PTR global,
• Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schlüsselakteuren für die Entwicklung und Ausrichtung der technischen Strategie, Maximierung und Balance der regulatorischen und Versorgungsbedürfnisse in China. • 8 oder mehr Jahre Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen, biotechnologischen oder verwandten Industrie und CMC, Qualität, regulatorische oder verwandte Erfahrung.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le chef du personnel dirige une équipe de partenaires techniques chinois (PTC) et de professionnels du CMC qui sont responsables des présentations de CMC réglementaires en Chine, en élaborant et en mettant en oeuvre des stratégies de classement de bout en bout de la Chine fondées sur une collaboration étroite avec les équipes de développement mondial, les priorités commerciales de la Chine, les exigences réglementaires de la Chine et le paysage. La portée comprend le portefeuille complet de Roche, les produits mondiaux (petites molécules, produits biologiques, nouvelles modalités). Ce rôle a pour but de diriger et d'entraîner les membres de l'équipe afin d'accélérer l'accès aux médicaments et l'approvisionnement continu des patients en veillant à ce que les premières présentations appropriées aux autorités sanitaires chinoises et les interactions efficaces avec l'autorité sanitaire. Le titulaire du rôle est responsable de façonner l'environnement réglementaire en Chine en étroite collaboration avec la Politique sur les PTR et de la traduire en stratégies réglementaires novatrices. Conformément à la stratégie de la Chine et à l'initiative China First, il s'agit d'un rôle qui a un impact commercial élevé. Dans ce poste, le chef de file est responsable de la gestion des partenaires techniques de la Chine (PTC) et des gestionnaires de programme du MCC, ce qui comprend l'établissement d'objectifs de rendement, la fourniture de rétroaction en temps opportun et l'harmonisation des objectifs de perfectionnement à court terme avec les objectifs de carrière à plus long terme. Fournit des conseils et gère les activités de travail d'autres personnes pour des projets ou des objectifs précis. Démontre les principes fondamentaux de l'efficacité de l'encadrement et du mentorat. Adapte le style de coaching pour répondre aux besoins de l'individu. Le chef des personnes dirige des initiatives et des stratégies de réglementation interfonctionnelles, définit les étapes et les ressources essentielles qui s'y rattachent et assume la responsabilité de la mise en oeuvre de ces initiatives et stratégies. Communiquer de façon proactive avec le personnel de réglementation et le personnel interfonctionnel à l'appui des objectifs des projets internes et associés aux partenaires. Collabore avec la direction pour diriger les communications avec l'AP sur les projets et les initiatives de grande complexité. Prendre des décisions fondées sur des priorités interfonctionnelles plutôt que sur des priorités fonctionnelles. Chef de projet Personnes
• Diriger une équipe de professionnels de la réglementation.
• Responsable de la gestion de la performance des salariés.
• Collaborer avec des rapports directs et veiller à ce que des commentaires objectifs et opportuns soient fournis aux employés, en mettant l'accent sur le perfectionnement de l'employé en facilitant des discussions régulières sur le perfectionnement et des vérifications.
• Fournir un encadrement et un encadrement aux collègues dans un domaine de responsabilité réglementaire technique assigné.
• Collaborer étroitement avec le chef de portefeuille pour coordonner les ressources et les priorités au niveau du portefeuille.
• Suivre et vérifier régulièrement l'avancement de chaque projet spécifique de l'équipe, éclairer l'équipe pour élaborer des stratégies de soumission pour différentes applications, identifier les risques réglementaires et élaborer des plans de migration.
• Établir et maintenir des relations saines avec les principaux acteurs internes et externes, tels que NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, chaîne d'approvisionnement, qualité et conformité, PDR Chine et PTR mondial,
• Collaborer avec les principales parties prenantes internes à l'élaboration et à l'alignement de la stratégie technique, en maximisant et en équilibrage des besoins en matière de réglementation et d'approvisionnement en Chine. QUALIFICATIONS Éducation Masters Le diplôme en sciences de la vie est préféré; le diplôme d'études supérieures est un plus. Expérience
• 8 ans ou plus d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, la biotechnologie ou l'industrie connexe et le CMC, la qualité, la réglementation ou l'expérience connexe.
• Gestion des personnes précédente

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
规范诊疗
1.基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
2.基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升

学科建设
1.访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

疾病全程管理
支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限
•3年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•跨职能 工 作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
•在试用期内通过RDPAC考试
•在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Country Study Start Up Team Leader

titleByLocale.it: Country Study Start Up Capo squadra
titleByLocale.en: Country Study Start Up Team Leader
titleByLocale.de: Country Study Start Up Team Leader
titleByLocale.fr: Country Study Start Up Team Leader

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Country Study Start-up Team Leader (cSTL)
Roche Nederland B.V., Woerden

The Opportunity
At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. In our Global Clinical Operations (PDG) team, we are looking for a Country Study Start-up Team Leader (cSTL) to take on a dual-impact role that is vital to our mission. You will be the driving force behind clinical trial submissions while simultaneously serving as a People Leader (for +- 30% of your time), guiding a dedicated team to success in our country delivery operations.
In this pivotal role, you will balance strategic oversight of study start-up with hands-on leadership in regulatory submissions and people management. Your work ensures that we deliver innovative medicines to patients faster and more efficiently by streamlining the bridge between clinical design and site activation.

In this role, you will:

• Lead the country strategy for study start-up, driving efficiency and innovation to ensure timely site activation.

• Drive clinical trial submissions and regulatory coordination, managing complex submission packages and responding to Health Authority queries.

• Serve as a People Leader for approximately 30% of your time, providing coaching, support, and professional development to your direct reports.

• Architect and oversee the management of Informed Consent Forms (ICF) and clinical site documentation to ensure global compliance.

• Champion process innovation by identifying opportunities for automation to improve trial initiation timelines.

• Collaborate with global stakeholders, including CROs and Health Authorities, to harmonise systems and influence the local start-up environment.

• Manage clinical site budgets and contracts, ensuring financial and legal alignment through expert negotiation.

Who you are
You are a proactive, visionary leader who combines deep technical expertise in clinical submissions with a genuine passion for developing others. You thrive in complex, matrixed environments and possess the analytical prowess to turn data into strategic improvements.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Extensive industry expertise: Proven experience in clinical trial start-up and regulatory submissions, with deep knowledge of ICH-GCP and EU CTR.

• Transformation leadership: A track record in coaching, mentoring, and leading high-performing teams to deliver significant business impact.

• Advanced scientific background: A University degree (MD, PhD, MS, or BS) in life sciences; a postgraduate degree is highly desirable.

• Technical proficiency: Experience navigating complex clinical systems such as Veeva Vault, CTIS, and RIM.

• Exceptional communication: The ability to influence and partner with stakeholders, from local operational teams to global executive leadership.

• Language skills: Mandatory fluency in English and fluency in Dutch is strongly preferred

Why Roche?
For over 125 years, Roche has been working towards a healthier future with one clear goal: "Doing now what patients need next". We believe that the greatest medical challenges can only be solved through intensive collaboration with healthcare professionals and patients.
Our impact goes beyond healthcare; we also take full responsibility for our planet. • Collaborate with global stakeholders, including CROs and Health Authorities, to harmonise systems and influence the local start-up environment.

jobs.title: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

titleByLocale.en: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Operating within an innovation-driven biotech environment, our Technology department (RDT) sits at the intersection of regulatory compliance, quality systems, risk management, and digital transformation. We focus on defining and managing governance frameworks, policies, and processes that ensure our technology platforms—supporting both GxP and non-GxP critical business processes—operate in full compliance with internal standards and external regulations. Our mission is to embed compliance by design, strengthening the quality and risk posture of our systems while simultaneously enabling speed, scalability, and technological innovation. In this collaborative environment, we partner closely with Business Quality, Regulatory, Security, Legal, and Audit functions to advise executives and drive enterprise-wide strategy.

As the Head of Compliance and Quality Governance (Practice Leader), you will be accountable for the entire lifecycle of this critical function, from strategic planning and service design to operational execution and continuous improvement. Operating as a senior escalation and decision authority, you will define the functional vision, strategy, and roadmap, transforming business needs into tangible, high-value capabilities. Leveraging a distinctive combination of deep domain expertise, technical proficiency, and business insight, you will lead multidisciplinary teams to build and deliver desirable, viable, and sustainable functional services that meet the evolving needs of our users while maintaining strict regulatory compliance.

The Opportunity

• Strategy & Vision: Define and own the Technology Compliance & Quality Governance strategy, establishing clear governance frameworks, decision models, and accountabilities while translating global biotech regulations and corporate policies into clear technology outcomes.

• Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve as a trusted partner and senior escalation authority for executives, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Security leadership, representing Technology in executive forums, audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions.

• Functional Management & Delivery: Oversee the end-to-end delivery and lifecycle of defined functions (e.g., QMS), ensuring Technology adherence to GxP, CSV, data integrity, privacy, and global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO) through pragmatic, risk-based interpretations.

• Risk Management & Assurance: Lead enterprise-wide technology risk assessments and compliance maturity evaluations, ensuring timely and effective remediation of findings, deviations, and CAPAs.

• Team Leadership & Development: Build, coach, and develop a high-performing global team of professionals, fostering a culture of accountability and transparency while guiding senior leaders on risk-based decision-making.

• Operational Excellence & Improvement: Define success metrics (KPIs/OKRs) and leverage data analytics to drive informed decisions, immediate operational improvements, and strategic optimizations to achieve business goals.

• Financial & Resource Management: Manage the immediate team's budget and resources, developing detailed business cases—including cost-benefit analyses and resource estimates—for new functional initiatives and significant process changes.

Who You Are

• Experienced Global Leader: You bring 15+ years of IT domain experience, including 10+ years managing global multidisciplinary teams and 10+ years in Technology, Compliance, Quality, or Risk within highly regulated ind

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Customer Account Manager for our Managed Service Contracts in the North region, you will act as the vital link between Roche and our healthcare partners. You will ensure our customers receive a superior experience while bringing their voice directly into our organization to shape the future of diagnostics.

• Build meaningful partnerships: Develop and maintain long-term commercial relationships across all levels of your assigned customer base.

• Drive strategic value: Connect customer business goals with Roche’s product and service suite to support their success during periods of healthcare transformation.

• Lead service delivery: Co-create Strategic account plans and coordinate cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Technical Services) to ensure seamless execution.

• Manage the lifecycle: Oversee the full customer experience for our Optimall branded Managed Services, serving as the primary point of escalation for Roche and third-party partners.

• Foster a culture of excellence: Champion the "voice of the customer" internally to ensure we continue to "do now what patients need next."

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker and a passionate customer advocate who thrives on delivering value and building resilient commercial relationships.

• Experienced Account Manager: You bring a proven track record in contract management and commercial engagement within the healthcare sector.

• Strategic & Analytical: You possess the ability to interrogate large datasets to draw meaningful insights (Advanced Excel) and understand complex business workflows.

• Collaborative Leader: You are skilled at managing multiple complex projects simultaneously while working alongside experts in technical support, finance, and marketing.

• Effective Communicator: You are a strong listener who can identify pain points and develop clear solutions, maintaining a professional demeanor under pressure.

• Education: You are educated to degree level or equivalent in a relevant field.

Together, we’ll create a healthier, brighter future for all.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Technical Product Owner for Web Experience, you will be a key driver in evolving Roche Diagnostics' global and regional digital ecosystem. You will enable scalable, customer-centric digital experiences that support healthcare professionals, laboratories, and patients worldwide. This role sits at the heart of our digital transformation, bridging the gap between ambitious business needs and high-quality technical execution.

Your Responsibilities

• Own the Digital Backlog: You will prioritize and manage the backlog for Web Experience and Web Analytics platforms, translating business requirements into clear, actionable technical stories.

• Drive Global Delivery: Collaborate closely with engineering teams and external partners to drive sprint planning, testing, and successful releases.

• Shape Platform Capabilities: Support the continuous improvement of global websites, content publishing workflows, search discoverability, and personalization.

• Lead Technical Integrations: Coordinate activities across major platforms like Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), content repositories (DAM), and Marketing Automation ecosystems.

• Ensure Excellence & Compliance: Guarantee that all web solutions are secure, accessible, and compliant with global regulations such as GDPR.

• Facilitate Global Collaboration: Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, UX/UI specialists, and regional teams to ensure delivery consistency across the globe.

Who You Are

• You are a proactive technical leader who thrives in complex environments and possesses a deep understanding of how to build and scale global web platforms. You bring a collaborative mindset and the ability to influence both technical teams and business stakeholders to deliver measurable impact.

• Experienced Product Professional: You bring 5+ years of experience as a Technical Product Owner or Digital Product Manager, specifically delivering enterprise-level web platforms or portals.

• Agile Expert: You have a proven track record working with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and SAFE.

• Technical Strategist: You possess a strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and connected digital architectures (e.g., CMS, DAM, and Analytics ecosystems).

• Skilled Communicator: You excel at managing stakeholders across diverse business and technical teams, simplifying complex technical concepts into clear priorities.

• Analytical Problem Solver: You have a natural ability to identify delivery risks and technical dependencies while maintaining a focus on quality and platform stability.

Ready to make a difference?
At Roche, you’re empowered to design your own learning path. With access to training, job rotations, and leadership development, we support your unique growth journey.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Titolare del Prodotto Tecnico per la Web Experience, sarai un driver chiave nell'evoluzione dell'ecosistema digitale globale e regionale di Roche Diagnostics. Potrai attivare esperienze digitali scalabili e orientate al cliente che supportano professionisti sanitari, laboratori e pazienti in tutto il mondo. Questo ruolo si trova al centro della nostra trasformazione digitale, colmando il divario tra ambiziose esigenze aziendali ed esecuzione tecnica di alta qualità. Le tue responsabilità

• Assicurare Eccellenza e conformità: garantire che tutte le soluzioni web siano sicure, accessibili e conformi alle normative globali come GDPR.
• Facilitate Global Collaboration: Agite come interfaccia primaria tra gli stakeholder aziendali, gli specialisti UX/UI e i team regionali per garantire la coerenza delle consegne in tutto il mondo. Chi sei
• Sei un leader tecnico proattivo che prospera in ambienti complessi e possiede una profonda comprensione di come costruire e scalare piattaforme web globali. Porti una mentalità collaborativa e la capacità di influenzare sia i team tecnici che gli stakeholder aziendali per fornire un impatto misurabile.
• Professionista del Prodotto Interessato: Porti 5+ anni di esperienza come Titolare del Prodotto Tecnico o Digital Product Manager, specificatamente fornendo piattaforme web di livello enterprise o portali.
• Agile Expert: Hai un record di traccia collaudato che funziona con metodologie Agile, tra cui Scrum e SAFE.
• Strategista Tecnico: Possiedi una forte comprensione di API, integrazioni e architetture digitali connesse (ad esempio, CMS, DAM e gli ecosistemi di Analytics).
• Communicatore esperto: Eccellente nella gestione delle parti interessate di diversi team aziendali e tecnici, semplificando i concetti tecnici complessi in chiare priorità.
• Risolvere dei problemi analitici: hai una capacità naturale di identificare i rischi di consegna e le dipendenze tecniche mantenendo un focus sulla qualità e sulla stabilità della piattaforma. Pronto a fare la differenza? A Roche, sei abilitato a progettare il tuo percorso di apprendimento. Con l'accesso alla formazione, alle rotazioni di lavoro e allo sviluppo della leadership, sosteniamo il vostro viaggio di crescita unico. Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Madrid. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Diagnostics, we are redefining how we connect with customers globally. We are seeking a Solution Architect - Content Supply Chain & Web Experience to lead the technical evolution of our next-generation ecosystem. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in shaping modular, cloud-native, and AI-enabled customer engagement capabilities across global and local markets. You will work within a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment alongside product leads, engineers, and strategic partners to translate business capabilities into future-state architecture.

Your Responsibilities

• Shape Architecture Strategy: Define and maintain the target architecture, integration patterns, and technical guardrails for our Content Supply Chain and Web Experience capabilities.

• Design Scalable Solutions: Create reusable, secure, and compliant end-to-end architectures spanning content planning, creation, storage, activation, and real-time personalization.

• Lead Ecosystem Integration: Direct technical architecture across premiere platforms, including Adobe Experience Cloud (Sites, Assets, Workfront, GenStudio), Veeva Vault PromoMats, and advanced Customer Data Platforms (CDPs).

• Govern Technical Quality: Drive robust non-functional requirements including scalability, performance, security, and global compliance standards (such as GDPR).

• Collaborate and Guide: Partner closely with Technical Product Owners and engineering teams to validate technical designs, manage architectural dependencies, and ensure sustainable deliveries.

• Foster Innovation: Evaluate emerging technologies, championing proof-of-concepts in AI-enabled content operations, dynamic content assembly, and enterprise content intelligence.

Who You Are

• You are a forward-thinking technical leader who thrives on turning complex digital ecosystem challenges into simplified, high-performing platform realities.

• You excel at bridging the gap between business vision and deep technical engineering, utilizing your exceptional stakeholder management skills to influence distributed global teams.

• Extensive Architecture Experience: 8+ years of proven success in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, or complex digital platform engineering.

• Ecosystem Mastery: Demonstrated experience designing, integrating, and scaling enterprise web content management, digital asset management (DAM), and dynamic personalization technologies.

• Modern Engineering Mindset: Strong, practical understanding of cloud-native architectures, API-first delivery, integration patterns, and composable platform ecosystems.

• Technical Governance & Compliance: Robust knowledge of navigating non-functional requirements like web security, accessibility, performance optimization, and international data privacy regulations.

• Academic Foundation: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

• Nice-to-have highlights: Experience in regulated environments (such as life sciences or healthcare) or direct technical familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud and Veeva Vault platforms is highly valued.

At Roche, we embrace emerging innovations, like AI, to enhance the patient journey. If you’re passionate about new technology and thinking ahead, we want you to join us!

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Warsaw Grafit is 228,900.00 PLN-425,100.00 PLN. Final compensation will be deter

• Sei un leader tecnico avanzato che prospera nel trasformare complesse sfide dell'ecosistema digitale in realtà piattaforme semplificate e performanti.
• Si eccelle nel colmare il divario tra visione aziendale e ingegneria tecnica profonda, utilizzando le vostre eccezionali capacità di gestione degli stakeholder per influenzare i team globali distribuiti.

• Ecosystem Mastery: Dimostrata esperienza di progettazione, integrazione e scalare la gestione dei contenuti web aziendali, gestione degli asset digitali (DAM), e tecnologie di personalizzazione dinamica.
• Modern Engineering Mindset: Forte, comprensione pratica di architetture cloud-native, API-first delivery, modelli di integrazione e ecosistemi di piattaforma componibili.

• highlights: l'esperienza in ambienti regolamentati (come le scienze della vita o la sanità) o la conoscenza tecnica diretta con le piattaforme Adobe Experience Cloud e Veeva Vault è molto apprezzata. A Roche, abbracciamo innovazioni emergenti, come l'IA, per migliorare il viaggio dei pazienti. Se siete appassionati di nuove tecnologie e di pensare avanti, vogliamo che vi unisca a noi!
