jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Lead Engineer will lead the end-to-end algorithm lifecycle—from development through validation and regulatory-ready deployment—ensuring alignment with GxP, SaMD, and Imaging Governance frameworks. Acting as the single point of accountability across gRED, pRED, PD, RDT, and RIS, the role will deliver scalable analytical platform capabilities, promote automation, and ensure quality, documentation, and compliance standards are consistently applied.

This position drives the vision, strategy, and execution of the imaging algorithm ecosystem, enabling faster, reproducible, and compliant development and deployment across research and clinical domains. You will be responsible for defining tasks for others and driving medium to large-scale initiatives across a product. In this strategic role, you will coach and lead other engineers, excel in stakeholder negotiations, and provide direction for mid to long-term goals. You will actively contribute to technical knowledge, inspire innovation, and lead the design of complex multi-service and multi-modal solutions. With expertise in AI/ML models architecture and interoperability, advanced analysis application frameworks and cloud features, you will promote architectural consistency, drive technical strategy for major components, and mentor senior engineers to ensure the highest standards of engineering quality across the organization.

This Senior Lead Engineer role requires daily engagement with scientific, regulatory, clinical, and informatics partners to align on strategy, prioritization, and execution to strengthen collaboration and visibility across global teams, providing a direct bridge between Imaging Governance, Algorithm Development, and Platform Operations.

The Opportunity:

• Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for multi-modal (including Radiology and Digital Pathology) Imaging Data & Insights within the Global Imaging Platform (GIP).

• Prioritize and deliver initiatives that enhance data quality, accessibility, and reusability for R&D, translational research, and clinical development.

• Act as the primary product owner for the imaging modalities analysis applications, coordinating across gRED, pRED, PD, RDT, and RIS.

• Partner with scientific, clinical, and technical leads to translate business requirements into scalable and compliant technical solutions.

• Manage stakeholder relationships and external collaborations to ensure interoperability, compliance, and strategic alignment.

• Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of multi-modal imaging data analysis applications, visualization, and analytics.

• Ensure timely delivery of product enhancements, standardized workflows, and integration of AI/ML-enabled tools.

• Collaborate with engineering, quality, and regulatory teams to ensure adherence to GxP, FAIR, and data-governance standards.

• Drive alignment across R&D, Diagnostics, and Data Science functions to enable shared data and analysis pipelines and unified processes.

• Manage dependencies, risks, and milestones for all digital pathology deliverables and communicate progress through KPIs and performance reports.

• Identify and implement opportunities to increase scalability, automation, and efficiency across analysis workflows.

• Monitor industry and technology trends in digital pathology, AI/ML, and digital health to guide ongoing product innovation .

• Identify and introduce the common format for deployment, reducing conversion costs and enhancing inference speed across har

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'Ingegnere di Piombo Senior porterà il ciclo di vita dell'algoritmo end-to-end - dallo sviluppo attraverso la validazione e l'implementazione di norma-ready - garantendo l'allineamento con GxP, SaMD e Imaging Governance framework. Essendo l'unico punto di responsabilità tra gRED, pRED, PD, RDT e RIS, il ruolo fornirà funzionalità scalabili di piattaforma analitica, promuovere l'automazione e garantire la qualità, la documentazione e gli standard di conformità sono costantemente applicati. Questa posizione guida la visione, la strategia e l'esecuzione dell'ecosistema dell'algoritmo di imaging, consentendo uno sviluppo e una distribuzione più rapidi, riproducibili e conformi tra ricerca e ambiti clinici. Sarete responsabili della definizione dei compiti per gli altri e della guida di iniziative su larga scala su un prodotto. In questo ruolo strategico, istruirai e guiderai altri ingegneri, eccellerai nei negoziati con le parti interessate, e fornirai una direzione per obiettivi a medio e lungo termine. Contribuirai attivamente alla conoscenza tecnica, ispirerai l'innovazione e guiderai la progettazione di soluzioni multi-servizio e multi-modali complesse. Grazie all'esperienza nell'architettura e nell'interoperabilità dei modelli AI/ML, ai framework applicativi avanzati di analisi e alle caratteristiche cloud, promuoverai la consistenza architettonica, guiderai la strategia tecnica per i principali componenti e gli ingegneri senior del mentore per garantire i più elevati standard di qualità ingegneristica in tutta l'organizzazione. Questo ruolo di Senior Lead Engineer richiede l'impegno quotidiano con partner scientifici, normativi, clinici e informatici per allineare la strategia, la priorità e l'esecuzione per rafforzare la collaborazione e la visibilità tra i team globali, fornendo un ponte diretto tra Imaging Governance, Algorithm Development e Platform Operations. L'opportunità:
• Definire ed eseguire la strategia del prodotto e la roadmap per multi-modali (tra cui Radiologia e Patologia Digitale) Imaging Data & Insights all'interno della piattaforma di imaging globale (GIP).
• Priorizzare e fornire iniziative che migliorano la qualità dei dati, l'accessibilità e la riutilizzabilità per R&D, la ricerca traduttiva e lo sviluppo clinico.
• Agire come proprietario principale del prodotto per le applicazioni di analisi delle modalità di imaging, coordinando attraverso gRED, pRED, PD, RDT e RIS.
• Il partner scientifico, clinico e tecnico porta a tradurre i requisiti aziendali in soluzioni tecniche scalabili e conformi.
• Gestire le relazioni degli stakeholder e le collaborazioni esterne per garantire l'interoperabilità, la conformità e l'allineamento strategico.
• supervisionare il ciclo di vita end-to-end di applicazioni di analisi dei dati di imaging multi-modale, visualizzazione e analisi.
• Assicurare la consegna tempestiva dei miglioramenti del prodotto, flussi di lavoro standardizzati e l'integrazione di strumenti abilitati AI/ML.
• Collabora con team di ingegneria, qualità e regolamentazione per garantire l'adesione a standard GxP, FAIR e data-governance.
• Allineamento dell'unità attraverso le funzioni R&D, Diagnostics e Data Science per abilitare i dati condivisi e le pipeline di analisi e processi unificati.
• Gestire dipendenze, rischi e pietre miliari per tutti i materiali di patologia digitale e comunicare i progressi attraverso KPI e report sulle prestazioni.
• Identificare e implementare opportunità per aumentare la scalabilità, l'automazione e l'efficienza attraverso i flussi di lavoro di analisi.
• Monitorare l'industria e le tendenze tecnologiche nella patologia digitale, AI/ML e la salute digitale per guidare l'innovazione dei prodotti in corso.
• Identificare e introdurre il formato comune per la distribuzione, ridurre i costi di conversione e migliorare la velocità di inferenza attraverso l'arros

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'ingénieur principal dirigera le cycle de vie de bout en bout de l'algorithme, depuis le développement jusqu'à la validation jusqu'au déploiement réglementaire, pour assurer l'alignement avec les cadres de gouvernance GxP, SaMD et Imaging. Agissant en tant que point unique de responsabilisation pour gRED, pRED, PD, RDT et RIS, le rôle fournira des capacités de plate-forme analytique évolutives, favorisera l'automatisation et assurera l'application uniforme des normes de qualité, de documentation et de conformité. Cette position stimule la vision, la stratégie et l'exécution de l'écosystème de l'algorithme d'imagerie, permettant un développement et un déploiement plus rapides, reproductibles et conformes dans les domaines de la recherche et de la clinique. Vous serez responsable de la définition des tâches pour les autres et de la conduite d'initiatives de moyenne à grande échelle à travers un produit. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous entraînerez et dirigerez d'autres ingénieurs, excellerez dans les négociations avec les intervenants et fournirez une orientation pour les objectifs à moyen et à long terme. Vous contribuerez activement aux connaissances techniques, inspirerez l'innovation et dirigerez la conception de solutions multiservices et multimodales complexes. Avec une expertise en architecture et en interopérabilité des modèles AI/ML, des cadres d'applications d'analyse avancés et des fonctionnalités cloud, vous favoriserez la cohérence architecturale, piloterez la stratégie technique pour les principaux composants, et mentorez les ingénieurs seniors pour assurer les plus hautes normes de qualité d'ingénierie dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Ce rôle d'ingénieur principal exige un engagement quotidien avec les partenaires scientifiques, réglementaires, cliniques et informatiques afin de s'aligner sur la stratégie, l'établissement des priorités et l'exécution afin de renforcer la collaboration et la visibilité entre les équipes mondiales, fournissant un pont direct entre la gouvernance de l'imagerie, le développement de l'algorithme et les opérations de la plateforme. La possibilité :
• Définir et exécuter la stratégie et la feuille de route des produits multimodaux (y compris la radiologie et la pathologie numérique) Imager des données et des informations au sein de la plateforme mondiale d'imagerie (GIP).
• Privilégier et mettre en oeuvre des initiatives qui améliorent la qualité des données, leur accessibilité et leur réutilisabilité pour la R-D, la recherche translationnelle et le développement clinique.
• Agir en tant que principal propriétaire du produit pour les applications d'analyse des modalités d'imagerie, en coordonnant entre gRED, pRED, PD, RDT et RIS.
• Partenaire avec des pistes scientifiques, cliniques et techniques pour traduire les exigences commerciales en solutions techniques évolutives et conformes.
• Gérer les relations avec les parties prenantes et les collaborations externes pour assurer l'interopérabilité, la conformité et l'alignement stratégique.
• Surveiller le cycle de vie de bout en bout des applications d'analyse de données d'imagerie multimodale, de visualisation et d'analyse.
• Veiller à ce que les améliorations apportées aux produits, les flux de travail normalisés et l'intégration des outils compatibles avec l'IA et le LM soient fournis en temps voulu.
• Collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de qualité et de réglementation pour assurer le respect des normes GxP, FAIR et de gouvernance des données.
• Conduire l'alignement entre les fonctions R-D, Diagnostics et Data Science pour permettre le partage de données et d'analyses et des processus unifiés.
• Gérer les dépendances, les risques et les jalons pour tous les produits de pathologie numérique et communiquer les progrès au moyen des ICR et des rapports de performance.
• Identifier et mettre en œuvre des possibilités d'évolutivité, d'automatisation et d'efficacité dans tous les flux de travail d'analyse.
• Surveiller les tendances de l'industrie et de la technologie en matière de pathologie numérique, d'IA/ML et de santé numérique pour guider l'innovation de produits en cours.
• Identifier et introduire le format commun pour le déploiement, réduire les coûts de conversion et améliorer la vitesse d'inférence dans tous les secteurs

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Technical Services and Operations (TSO) group within DDC is accountable for providing application support (Level 1-3) for hundreds of software solutions. In addition, TSO is responsible for DevOps and Operations for the DDC’ application landscape, both Cloud and On Premise. Finally, TSO provides technical support for systems that offer tools to train large language models (LLMs) and create autonomous agents, as well as ensuring users are effectively enabled to leverage these advanced systems, from LLM training platforms to autonomous agent building tools.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will join the TSO Leadership team and will work closely with DDC colleagues as well as directly with our key stakeholders including Computational Scientists, ML Scientists and Research Scientists. You will also work closely with vendors who provide managed services which form the core of many of the TSO activities.

You are an experienced and hands-on technical expert with the proven ability to lead and deliver enterprise scale technical operations. You will be managing operations for Applications and Software and also contributing as an SRE supporting our Infrastructure. Together with the Technical Operations leadership team, you will integrate expertise across on-premises operations, cloud services, and advanced AI/ML technologies. Your strategic focus will be on ensuring high performance, user enablement, and efficient service delivery while effectively managing relationships with external vendors. This comprehensive approach will drive operational excellence and support the evolving technical needs of our organization.

The Opportunity

• Strategic Planning & Service Integration – Develop and implement strategic plans aligned with organizational goals, integrating managed services, on-premises operations, and cloud initiatives while leveraging AI as a key accelerator.

• Vendor & Stakeholder engagement – Vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and ensure adherence to SLAs.

• Operational Excellence & Change Management – Applying software engineering principles to operations to scale and maintain highly reliable production systems, balancing the rapid release of new features w

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, i dati e le scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CS CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare il potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e mutevoli per la vita per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. All'interno dell'organizzazione CS CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduce l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi computazionali e dati integrando le tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per potenziare gli stakeholder, promuovere la scienza dei dati e accelerare il processo decisionale. Il gruppo Servizi Tecnici e Operazioni (TSO) all'interno di DDC è responsabile per fornire supporto alle applicazioni (Level 1-3) per centinaia di soluzioni software. Inoltre, TSO è responsabile per DevOps e Operazioni per il paesaggio delle applicazioni DDC, sia Cloud che On Premise. Infine, TSO fornisce supporto tecnico per sistemi che offrono strumenti per la formazione di modelli linguistici di grandi dimensioni (LLM) e per la creazione di agenti autonomi, oltre a garantire che gli utenti siano effettivamente abilitati a sfruttare questi sistemi avanzati, dalle piattaforme di formazione LLM agli strumenti di costruzione di agenti autonomi. Come Ingegnere Principale Software, si unirà al team di Leadership TSO e lavorerà a stretto contatto con i colleghi DDC e direttamente con i nostri principali stakeholder, tra cui scienziati computazionali, scienziati ML e scienziati di ricerca. Potrai anche lavorare a stretto contatto con i fornitori che forniscono servizi gestiti che formano il nucleo di molte delle attività TSO. Sei un esperto e pratico esperto tecnico con la comprovata capacità di guidare e fornire operazioni tecniche su scala aziendale. Potrai gestire le operazioni per applicazioni e software e contribuire anche come SRE supportando la nostra infrastruttura. Insieme al team di leadership Technical Operations, integrerai le competenze nelle operazioni on-premise, nei servizi cloud e nelle tecnologie AI/ML avanzate. Il vostro obiettivo strategico sarà quello di garantire prestazioni elevate, l'attivazione degli utenti e la consegna efficiente dei servizi, mentre la gestione efficace dei rapporti con i fornitori esterni. Questo approccio completo guiderà l'eccellenza operativa e sosterrà le esigenze tecniche in evoluzione della nostra organizzazione. L'opportunità
• Strategic Planning & Service Integration – Sviluppare e implementare piani strategici allineati a obiettivi organizzativi, integrando servizi gestiti, operazioni on-premise e iniziative cloud, sfruttando l'IA come acceleratore chiave.
• L'impegno del venditore & Stakeholder – le relazioni del venditore, negoziare i contratti e garantire l'adesione a SLAs.
• Eccellenza operativa & Change Management – Applicare i principi di ingegneria del software alle operazioni per scalare e mantenere sistemi di produzione altamente affidabili, bilanciando il rapido rilascio di nuove funzionalità

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Fortschritte in der KI, Daten und rechnerische Wissenschaften transformieren die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von Drogen. Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen von Genentech (gRED) und Pharma (pRED) haben gezeigt, wie diese Technologien die FuE beschleunigen, Daten nutzen und neue Rechenmodelle nutzen, um Auswirkungen zu erzielen. Der nahtlose Datenaustausch und der Zugriff auf Modelle über gRED und pRED sind unerlässlich, um diese Möglichkeiten zu maximieren. Das Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) ist eine strategische, einheitliche Gruppe, deren Ziel es ist, die transformative Kraft von Daten und Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) zu nutzen, um unseren Wissenschaftlern sowohl pRED als auch gRED zu helfen, innovativere und lebensverändernde Medikamente für Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Innerhalb der CS CoE-Organisation führt die Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC)-Organisation die Modernisierung unserer Rechen- und Datenökosysteme durch die Integration digitaler Technologien in Forschung und Frühentwicklung, um Stakeholder zu stärken, datenorientierte Wissenschaft zu fördern und die Entscheidungsfindung zu beschleunigen. Die Gruppe Technical Services and Operations (TSO) innerhalb des DDC ist für die Bereitstellung von Anwendungsunterstützung (Level 1-3) für Hunderte von Softwarelösungen verantwortlich. Darüber hinaus ist die TSO für DevOps und Operations für die Anwendungslandschaft des DDC verantwortlich, sowohl Cloud als auch On Premise. Schließlich bietet die TSO technische Unterstützung für Systeme, die Werkzeuge bieten, um große Sprachmodelle (LLMs) zu trainieren und autonome Agenten zu schaffen, sowie sicherzustellen, dass die Nutzer effektiv in der Lage sind, diese fortschrittlichen Systeme zu nutzen, von LLM Trainingsplattformen bis zu autonomen Agent Building Tools. Als Principal Software Engineer werden Sie dem TSO Leadership Team beitreten und eng mit DDC-Kollegen sowie direkt mit unseren wichtigsten Interessenvertretern wie Computational Scientists, ML Scientists und Research Scientists zusammenarbeiten. Sie arbeiten auch eng mit Anbietern zusammen, die Managed Services anbieten, die den Kern vieler TSO-Aktivitäten bilden. Sie sind ein erfahrener und praktischer technischer Experte mit der bewährten Fähigkeit, technische Operationen im Unternehmensmaßstab zu führen und zu liefern. Sie leiten den Betrieb für Anwendungen und Software und tragen auch als SRE zur Unterstützung unserer Infrastruktur bei. Gemeinsam mit dem Team der Technischen Operations werden Sie Know-how in On-Premises-Betriebe, Cloud-Services und fortschrittliche AI/ML-Technologien integrieren. Ihr strategischer Fokus liegt auf der Sicherstellung von hoher Leistung, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und effizienten Service-Lieferung, während die Beziehungen mit externen Anbietern effektiv verwalten. Dieser umfassende Ansatz wird operative Exzellenz fördern und die sich entwickelnden technischen Bedürfnisse unserer Organisation unterstützen. Die Chance
• Strategische Planung & Service-Integration – Entwickeln und implementieren strategische Pläne, die mit organisatorischen Zielen ausgerichtet sind, die Integration von Managed Services, On-Premises-Operationen und Cloud-Initiativen und die Nutzung von AI als Schlüsselbeschleuniger.
• Vendor & Stakeholder-Verlobung – Vendor-Beziehungen, verhandeln Verträge und sorgen für die Einhaltung von SLAs.
• Operational Excellence & Change Management – Die Anwendung von Software-Engineering-Prinzipien auf den Betrieben, um hochsichere Produktionssysteme zu skalieren und zu erhalten, die schnelle Freigabe neuer Features mit
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les progrès de l'IA, des données et des sciences informatiques transforment la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Les organismes de recherche et de développement précoce de Genentech (GRED) et de Pharma (PRED) ont démontré comment ces technologies accélèrent la R-D, tirent parti des données et de nouveaux modèles de calcul pour produire des effets. Le partage de données sans soudure et l'accès aux modèles à travers gRED et pRED sont essentiels pour maximiser ces opportunités. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles (CS CoE) est un groupe stratégique unifié dont l'objectif est d'exploiter la puissance transformatrice des données et de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider nos scientifiques dans les domaines pRED et gRED à fournir des médicaments plus innovants et changeants pour les patients du monde entier. Au sein de l'organisation du Conseil de l'Europe, l'organisation Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) dirige la modernisation de nos écosystèmes informatiques et de données en intégrant les technologies numériques dans la recherche et le développement précoce pour autonomiser les parties prenantes, faire progresser la science axée sur les données et accélérer la prise de décisions. Le groupe Services et opérations techniques (TSO) au sein du DDC est responsable de fournir un soutien aux applications (niveau 1-3) pour des centaines de solutions logicielles. En outre, TSO est responsable de DevOps et des opérations pour le paysage d'application DDC, à la fois Cloud et On Premise. Enfin, TSO fournit un soutien technique aux systèmes qui offrent des outils pour former de grands modèles de langue (LLM) et créer des agents autonomes, ainsi que pour veiller à ce que les utilisateurs soient efficacement en mesure de tirer parti de ces systèmes avancés, des plates-formes de formation LLM aux outils de construction d'agents autonomes. En tant qu'ingénieur principal du logiciel, vous vous joindrez à l'équipe de leadership de l'OST et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des collègues de DDC ainsi qu'avec nos principaux intervenants, notamment les scientifiques en informatique, les scientifiques en ML et les chercheurs. Vous travaillerez également en étroite collaboration avec les fournisseurs qui fournissent des services gérés qui constituent le cœur de nombreuses activités du BSF. Vous êtes un expert technique expérimenté et pratique avec la capacité éprouvée de diriger et de livrer des opérations techniques à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Vous gérerez les opérations pour les applications et les logiciels et contribuerez également en tant que SRE soutenant notre infrastructure. Avec l'équipe de direction des opérations techniques, vous intégrerez l'expertise dans les opérations sur site, les services cloud et les technologies avancées d'IA/ML. Votre objectif stratégique sera d'assurer une performance élevée, l'habilitation des utilisateurs et une prestation de services efficace tout en gérant efficacement les relations avec les fournisseurs externes. Cette approche globale favorisera l'excellence opérationnelle et soutiendra l'évolution des besoins techniques de notre organisation. L'opportunité
• Planification stratégique et intégration des services – Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des plans stratégiques alignés sur les objectifs organisationnels, intégrant les services gérés, les opérations sur site et les initiatives en nuage tout en tirant parti de l'IA comme un accélérateur clé.
• Engagement des fournisseurs et des parties prenantes – Relations avec les fournisseurs, négociation des contrats et respect des ALS.
• Excellence opérationnelle et gestion du changement – Appliquer les principes d'ingénierie logicielle aux opérations pour mettre à l'échelle et maintenir des systèmes de production très fiables, en conciliant la sortie rapide de nouvelles fonctionnalités w

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Digital Sales Specialist- Near Patient Care

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
Come join the Roche Digital Solutions sales organization as a Near Patient Care Digital Sales Specialist, where you will be responsible for selling the Roche navify digital portfolio in the Point of Care testing space. This field-based position requires consultative sales experience and expertise in POCC and POC testing workflows, IT infrastructure, data flow, informatics, operations, digital applications (i.e. middleware, business intelligence tools, etc.), and Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) to effectively consult with stakeholders on customized Roche digital solutions and provide strategic recommendations on digital processes. This position engages early in the sales cycle to understand customer needs, deliver customized demos, and design customized digital solutions in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Roche’s and customers’ teams.

Responsibilities:

• Generates new customer demand across the full portfolio of Near Patient Care navify products (middleware, connectivity, informatics, apps, etc).

• Engage in strategic digital discussions with key customer buying influences, from technical end users to executive level decision makers.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across sales and implementation teams to define and align on total solution sales strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

• Conduct workflow process analysis, develop solution proposal presentations, and deliver recommendations to customers in close alignment with internal stakeholders.

• Deliver software demos and tailored technical presentations to internal and external audiences.

• Adept at translating customer needs into internal action to meet those needs while balancing key business priorities and goals.

• Strong clinical and financial acumen with a demonstrated ability to understand and translate customer needs to effectively position the value of Roche digital solutions.

• Effectively qualify leads and utilize outcomes from workflow analysis and impact studies to provide competitive differentiation and value to the overall customer solution.

• Provides in-depth technical expertise regarding assigned product lines.

• Work cross functionally with internal stakeholders to share information and best practices while remaining actively informed on industry/customer trends that impact business.

• Follow a standardized end-to-end approach that creates evidence-based, differentiated value for the solution portfolio, both inside and outside the areas responsible for testing.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (i.e. Information Technology, Medical Technology, Life Sciences) or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years relevant or equivalent experience (i.e. healthcare digital solutions sales, diagnostics sales)

• Must be autonomous and organized with effective communication, negotiation, and problem solving skills

• Familiarity with digital solutions, middleware solutions and hospital LIS systems

• Experience with presenting technical information to large external and internal audiences

Preferred Qualifications:

• Preferred experience in the POC testing space.

• 3+ years of experien

• Forte acume clinico e finanziario con una capacità dimostrata di comprendere e tradurre le esigenze del cliente per posizionare efficacemente il valore delle soluzioni digitali Roche.
• Efficacemente qualificare i cavi e utilizzare i risultati dell'analisi del flusso di lavoro e gli studi di impatto per fornire differenziazione e valore competitivi alla soluzione globale del cliente.
• Fornisce competenze tecniche approfondite per quanto riguarda le linee di prodotto assegnate.
• Il lavoro intercorre in modo funzionale con gli stakeholder interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, pur rimanendo attivamente informati sulle tendenze del settore/cliente che influiscono sul business.

• Corso di laurea in un campo relativo (ossia tecnologia dell'informazione, tecnologia medica, scienze della vita) o esperienza equivalente.
• 5+ anni di esperienza rilevante o equivalente (ad es. vendite di soluzioni digitali sanitarie, vendite di diagnostica)
• Deve essere autonomo e organizzato con efficaci capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e problem solving
• Familiarità con soluzioni digitali, soluzioni middleware e sistemi LIS ospedalieri
• Esperienza con la presentazione di informazioni tecniche a grandi pubblico esterno e interno Requisiti preferenziali
• Esperienza preferenziale nello spazio di prova POC.
• 3+ anni di esperienza

• Must be autonomous and organized with effective communication, negotiation, and problem solving skills

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Investigator Relations Technology Informatics Partner

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Site and Investigator Engagement area delivers the comprehensive digital ecosystem and integrated platforms required to manage the end-to-end lifecycle of clinical site interactions, covering efficient study planning, country and site selection, site activation, and patient enrollment forecasting. Additionally, it manages the core technologies to handle complex administrative tasks, including budgeting and negotiation, clinical contracts, payments, and clinical information exchange. The team acts as a strategic liaison connecting Global Pharma Clinical Operations, Country Operations, strategic CROs, and Clinical Sites. Through this alignment, the area architects technology portfolios that foster strong external relationships and drive a unified, partner-centric clinical ecosystem. ​

As an Informatics Partner at this level, you lead strategic and complex cross-functional efforts across countries or domains, aligning initiatives with country-wide priorities and business outcomes. You anticipate and solve complex, systems-level problems, drive innovation, and shape domain vision while managing multiple workstreams with high accountability.

The opportunity:

• Scope/Content Leadership: Leads initiatives across multiple teams, and actively shapes business outcomes. Acts as a subject matter expert, influencing country-wide or cross-functional strategies, and fostering collaborations with stakeholders across organizational levels. Responsible for aligning team or domain objectives with country-wide goals, focusing on strategic projects that drive substantial impact. Frequently manages complex, cross-functional work streams.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads problem-solving at the country-wide or cross-functional level, taking accountability for multiple workstreams or outcomes that influence strategic objectives. Anticipates and mitigates potential issues before they arise, using advanced analysis to address complex problems. Employs a systems-thinking approach to propose solutions that align with business and global goals, demonstrating high accountability in driving sustained improvements and efficiencies across teams. Navigates highly complex, competing demands between global and local teams. Employs data-driven frameworks to transition subjective business priorities into objective, scalable technology roadmaps and robust operational resolutions.

• Stakeholder Management: Manages relationships across Global Pharma Clinical Operations, Co

Employs framework data-driven a priorità aziendali soggettive di transizione in roadmap obiettive, scalabili e risoluzioni operative robuste.

Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. La zone d'engagement du site et du chercheur offre l'écosystème numérique complet et les plateformes intégrées nécessaires pour gérer le cycle de vie de bout en bout des interactions du site clinique, couvrant la planification efficace des études, la sélection du pays et du site, l'activation du site et la prévision de l'inscription des patients. De plus, il gère les technologies de base pour gérer des tâches administratives complexes, notamment la budgétisation et la négociation, les contrats cliniques, les paiements et l'échange d'information clinique. L'équipe agit comme une liaison stratégique reliant les Opérations cliniques Global Pharma, les Opérations par pays, les ORC stratégiques et les Sites cliniques. Grâce à cet alignement, les portefeuilles technologiques d'architectes régionaux qui favorisent de solides relations externes et stimulent un écosystème clinique unifié et axé sur les partenaires. En tant que partenaire informatique à ce niveau, vous dirigez des efforts interfonctionnels stratégiques et complexes dans tous les pays ou domaines, en alignant les initiatives sur les priorités nationales et les résultats opérationnels. Vous anticipez et résolvez des problèmes complexes au niveau des systèmes, stimulez l'innovation et façonnez la vision du domaine tout en gérant plusieurs flux de travail avec une haute responsabilité. L'occasion :
• Portée et contenu Leadership : Dirige les initiatives de plusieurs équipes et oriente activement les résultats opérationnels. Agir à titre d'expert en la matière, influencer les stratégies nationales ou interfonctionnelles et favoriser la collaboration avec les intervenants à tous les niveaux organisationnels. Responsable de l ' harmonisation des objectifs de l ' équipe ou du domaine avec les objectifs nationaux, en mettant l ' accent sur les projets stratégiques qui ont un impact considérable. Il gère fréquemment des flux de travail complexes et interfonctionnels.
• Responsabilisation/Résoudre les problèmes : dirige la résolution des problèmes à l'échelle du pays ou au niveau interfonctionnel, en prenant en compte la responsabilité de multiples secteurs de travail ou résultats qui influent sur les objectifs stratégiques. Anticiper et atténuer les problèmes potentiels avant qu'ils ne surviennent, en utilisant une analyse avancée pour résoudre les problèmes complexes. Utilise une approche de conception de systèmes pour proposer des solutions qui s'harmonisent avec les objectifs commerciaux et mondiaux, démontrant une haute responsabilité dans la conduite d'améliorations et d'efficacités durables entre les équipes. Navigue sur des demandes très complexes et concurrentes entre équipes mondiales et locales. Utiliser des cadres fondés sur les données pour transformer les priorités subjectives des entreprises en feuilles de route technologiques objectives, évolutives et des résolutions opérationnelles robustes.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Estamos comprometidos no sólo con el avance de soluciones diagnósticas que puedan ayudar a los profesionales sanitarios a tomar decisiones críticas para la salud de sus pacientes, sino también con la mejora de la forma en que estas herramientas esenciales se integran en los sistemas sanitarios de todo el mundo, a un coste menor, sin dejar de obtener los mejores resultados posibles.
En más de 100 países, ofrecemos la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector, combinada con apoyo a la toma de decisiones clínicas, consultoría, diagnóstico digital, gestión de enfermedades, automatización de laboratorios y soluciones de software para proporcionar soluciones integradas a laboratorios, clínicos y sistemas sanitarios.

What is your Mission?
You will be the key operational engine within Roche Diagnostics Spain (RDE), reporting directly to the leadership team. Your main mission is to ensure business agility and efficiency, freeing up high-value time for our strategic and customer-facing teams.

You will combine excellence in administrative management with innovation, optimizing processes through the implementation of Artificial Intelligence and ensuring regulatory compliance at a national level. If you are passionate about efficiency, technology, and strategic impact, this is your place.

Your Key Responsibilities:

• Executive Management and Agile Coordination: Administer and coordinate complex agendas, plan travel, and organize key events for leadership and commercial teams, always prioritizing direct business impact.

• Strategic External and Internal Articulation: Facilitate and coordinate the leaders' interaction with strategic external and internal partners to drive commercial success, strategic initiatives, and cross-functional projects in our commercial headquarters.

• Commercial Strategic Support: Provide direct support to key account teams, including preparing client briefings, managing data in the CRM system, and administrative follow-up on executive actions.

• Pioneer in AI and Automation: Proactively identify repetitive tasks in various areas and design and implement automation solutions, using AI agents (such as generative models).

• Compliance Assurance: Act as a liaison to ensure that all administrative processes strictly comply with internal policies for Finance, Human Resources, and Business Integrity.

• Cross-functional Collaboration and Support: Participate in coordinating mutual support among assistants, ensuring service continuity and a balanced workload across the organization.

What We Look for in You:

• Education: Professional degree or equivalent. Training in project management will be especially valued.

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years of demonstrable experience in executive support roles, team coordination, or administrative management in large-scale corporate environments (ideally in matrix or network structures).

• Languages: Fluent command (oral and written) of English and Spanish (essential).

• Digital and Technological Experience and Mindset: Advanced user of cloud ecosystems (Microsoft 365/Google Workspace) and a proactive, demonstrable curiosity for the application of Generative Artificial Intelligence.

Competency:
1. Business and Operation Skills:

• Process Architecture: Ability to analyze a complex activity and break it down into logical, efficient, and automatable flows.

• Prompt Engineering: Practical ability to interact with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) for content generation, summarization,

jobs.title: PostDoc Position in Immunology (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Developing enzymes for Roche internally as well as externally means for us the development of tailor-made biocatalysts and biological targets for creating the best-in-class molecules for Roche and our clients. Combining several biotechnological methods such as expression profiling, cell cultivation, enzyme purification portfolio, enzyme engineering and biochemical investigations, we always try to improve, to maintain or to design new enzymes. Mandatory, the complete value chain as a platform thought of Roche is given. We are working cross-functional for both the diagnostic and pharma division of Roche worldwide. Being an R&D function we always try to keep close contacts with our clients as with our production for ensuring a fast, but qualitatively high development which should result in functional Roche products finally.

As a Post-Doc Position in Novel Enzymes (m/f/d) , you actively shape the development of new enzymes using biotechnological and bioinformatic methods. Become part of an innovative research team that consolidates a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab to develop customized enzymes for our diagnostics. We offer you a unique opportunity to translate your scientific ideas into practice and thus contribute to the improvement of patient health.

The opportunity

• You ensure the development of new enzymes using a combination of biotechnological and bioinformatic methods

• You are responsible for the independent production of tailored proteins/enzymes using molecular biological methods or the establishment of new production and screening methods for protein variants

• You support the consolidation of a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab, suitable for the protein engineering of novel enzymes

• You implement new biochemical and biophysical readouts suitable for the screening and development of tailored enzymes

• You pursue scientific and technical education by continuously following and reading the relevant scientific literature

Who you are

• You possess a university degree (Dr. / Ph.D.) in a relevant field

• You have specialized knowledge in the areas of protein engineering, bioinformatics, and molecular biology

• Experience in microbiology, downstream and upstream processing, as well as chemistry, is an advantage

• You demonstrate knowledge and expertise in recombinant protein expression, protein purification, and the development of protein analytical methods for protein characterization

• You are willing to provide consultation and troubleshooting regarding enzyme challenges in Research & Development and Production

This position is limited to 2 years.

Application documents
To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only a motivation letter and your updated CV . References and certificates are not required at this stage.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Diagnostics are an integral part of decision-making along every step of a person’s health, wellness and disease journey. A diagnostic test alone can help clinicians change the course of someone’s healthcare experience – and their life. We are a healthcare pioneer and the industry’s global leader in in-vitro diagnostics, our Diagnostics Division pushes boundaries and challenges the status quo to redefine what’s possible. Our commitment to research and development means we can bring to the market integrated solutions in diagnostic testing, laboratory efficiency, healthcare digitalisation and decision support tools and software. Our products deliver increasingly precise information to help save lives, prevent or control the risk of infection and monitor treatment effectiveness.

The Opportunity
This position is primarily responsible for initiating, directing, and executing scientific research, development, and manufacturing process strategies to support both new and existing products. A central pillar of this role involves creating and scaling a comprehensive digital pathology workflow, bridging the gap between traditional histology and high-throughput data analysis. You will investigate the feasibility of applying a wide variety of scientific principles to potential inventions and products, with a specific emphasis on integrating state-of-the-art imaging tools and automated analysis platforms into the laboratory ecosystem.
As a subject matter expert, you will maintain a broad knowledge of cutting-edge theories, serving as an in-house and outside consultant while making meaningful contributions to scientific literature and international conferences. You may act as a primary spokesperson for corporate scientific affairs and provide strategic advice to top management regarding the evolution of digital pathology and assay innovation. Furthermore, you will participate in and promote the professional growth of junior scientists. Utilizing advanced professional concepts, you will contribute to the development of product and process principles, achieving complex objectives through creative and effective methodologies.

• Digital Pathology & CDx Development: Participate in the creation and implementation of digital pathology workflows for Companion Diagnostics (CDx) projects, ensuring all methods and processes are optimized for clinical-grade imaging and data integrity.

• Research & Experimental Design: Plan and execute complex R&D projects using advanced scientific knowledge and DOE (Design of Experiments) to define new components, identify technical challenges, and develop potentially patentable reagents or systems.

• Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Analyze experimental data to form technical conclusions and implement improvements in work processes or documentation, consistently promoting a "Quality First Time" approach to all deliverables.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross functional teams to share expertise, contribute to project planning, and deliver presentations of results to internal and external stakeholders to advance corporate scientific goals.

Who You Are:

• Bachelor's Degree in a relevant discipline plus 8 or more years of progressive work experienc

Sustain a win-win relationship with external vendors, as well as monitor the vendor performance through routine and /or project work. Initiate or participate in squad teams based on business needs to deliver required business outcomes.

• Lead and facilitate people processes in line with Roche Leadership commitments, People Practices and policies. Build a strong competitive team based on identified HR Support Solutions/PSS core and functional competencies as well as Roche values.

Through frequent check ins, ensure that ongoing dialog occurs on the topics of Career, Capabilities, Connections and Contributions. Coach team members regarding their individual development and career plan & ensure succession plans. Create safe and positive team environment and ensure team demonstrating the right mindset and attitude (Trust, growth mindset, customer centricity, E2E accountability, problem solving). jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Key activities & Deliverables

• Co-ordinate and execute month end, quarter end and year end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with work instructions and month end close checklist

• Perform and analyse booking accounting transactions, working and calculations are executed on timely and accurately

• Clearing of open items in accounts

• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, cost center checks and transaction posting checks

• Ensure accruals are properly justified and correctly posted

• To ensure all journals are performed accurately and timely

• Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliation, highlight and rectify any anomalies encountered

• Submission of monthly, quarterly and yearly reporting packages accurately and within specified timescale

Documentation & Controlling

• Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines

• Perform back up function and other duties, including job rotation to other functional teams as and when required

• Participate in any compliance audits and respond to audit queries

Transformation/ Continuous Improvement Implementations

• Initiate and execute the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Work collaboratively with customers and stakeholders

• Engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Proactively identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation

• Assist to ensure effective knowledge transfer as for sustainable development knowledge and sharing of best practices within the team

Coaching/Sharing

• Support the review entries posted by the team to ensure accuracy

• Extends coaching and guidance to juniors in daily operation

• Support the when there are any ad hoc activities or projects

• Contribute inputs/findings to establish a knowledge database of issue encountered, proposed resolution steps to facilitate continuous learning, development and cross sharing of knowledge and lesson learnt across the teams

Qualifications & Experience Required

• Degree or Diploma in Finance & Accounting/Commerce or equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English.

• Minimum 5 years working experiences in the related field, preferable in the area of General Accounting and Management Accounting

• SAP knowledge or other ERP accounting systems and MS Office tools

• Proficiency in English and Japanese language are mandatory with good communication skill (writing and speaking).

Desirable qualifications

• External experience in a shared service or business process outsourcing engagement will be preferable

• Prior leadership or project management type supervisory role may be an advantage.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare soluti

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

• Project Undertaking and Delivery: Assist and take ownership of key projects from various teams (MWA/OMSS/CB); responsible for decomposing strategic objectives into specific action plans. Lead project progress control, resource coordination, and cross-functional communication to ensure on-time and high-quality delivery.

• Project Implementation: Collaborate with Product Managers to develop effective promotion tools; ensure product strategies and marketing activities are efficiently executed and implemented at the sales terminal.

• AI Technology Empowerment: Act as the department's AI application expert; guide and assist product groups in building AI-based product management tools and intelligent workflows to drive digital transformation. Precisely identify business pain points within the ML department; develop and promote AI solutions to enhance the quality and efficiency of content generation.

• Team Productivity Enhancement: Leverage AI technology to deeply optimize internal approval processes, online operating systems, and user-facing business material preparation, significantly reducing the time investment of Product Managers in repetitive and administrative tasks.

• Large-scale Event Management: Oversee the planning and execution of major internal and external conferences (both online and offline) and brand promotion activities; responsible for vendor management and on-site operations.

• Omni-channel Media Operations: Optimize and maintain departmental marketing communication channels (e.g., WeChat, webinar platforms, and 3rd party professional media); ensure published content is highly aligned with corporate branding and compliance requirements.

• Vendor and Budget Management: Manage vendors to ensure projects meet departmental KPIs and compliance policies; monitor project implementation and strictly control budgets following the ROI principle.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Clinical Medicine, Biological Engineering, Marketing, Business Management, or a related discipline.

• Proficiency in both spoken and written English

• Deep expertise in AI application tools (e.g., LLMs, Workflow Automation) and digital marketing; ability to translate business needs into technical AI solutions.

• Expertise in MS Office Suite and project management software (e.g., MS Project, Trello, or Jira). PMP or equivalent certification is a significant plus.

• At least 5 years working experience in a similar capacity and in a similar industry.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Expertise in MS Office Suite and project management software (e.g., MS Project, Trello, or Jira). PMP or equivalent certification is a significant plus.

jobs.title: Associate Group Director (Team Lead)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Our Clinical Safety organisation is dedicated to delivering meaningful improvements to patients through medically-differentiated therapies. In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability

In this pivotal leadership role as the Team Lead Associate Group Director, you will bridge the gap between complex scientific safety activities and strategic business delivery. You will be responsible for fostering a high-performance culture, driving innovation in safety science, and ensuring that our clinical trials and products meet the highest global regulatory standards.

The Opportunity:

• Provide line leadership for a diverse team of scientists, physicians, and other HCPs, fostering a culture of growth, agility, and continuous improvement.

• Oversee the delivery of critical pharmacovigilance (PV) and risk management deliverables, including clinical trial safety support, periodic safety reports, and signal management activities.

• Build strong partnerships across global functions to ensure seamless scientific and PV outputs.

• Take accountability for resource planning, recruitment, and the professional development of your team through proactive coaching and mentoring.

• Maintain oversight of team performance and compliance with GxP, ICH, and global Health Authority requirements.

• Role model the mindsets and behaviors necessary to thrive in our evolving global operating model.

• Contribute to the broader Clinical Safety vision and priorities by leading and engaging with strategic Safety projects.

Who You Are
You are a visionary leader who balances scientific expertise with a passion for people development. You thrive in a global matrix environment and are motivated by the challenge of transforming complex safety data into meaningful actions that protect patients.
You will also have:

• Healthcare Professional or Life Sciences graduate (MD, PhD, PharmD, or MSc preferred).

• Extensive experience of at least 10+ years in biopharmaceuticals or clinical research, with a deep understanding of the drug development lifecycle and likely to have direct experience in delivering safety-related activities in support of clinical drug development and/or pharmacovigilance..

• Possess a strong command of PV and clinical risk management, including GVP, GCP, and CTR requirements.

• Track record of leading both people and projects, with the ability to coach diverse teams to reach their full potential.

• Exceptional communicator, able to build relationships and negotiate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.

• Demonstrate strong critical thinking and the ability to anticipate risks and opportunities in a fast-changing environment.

Relocation Benefits are not available for this job posting.

We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role.

This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd.

jobs.title: Associate Safety Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Our Clinical Safety organisation is dedicated to delivering meaningful improvements to patients through medically-differentiated therapies. In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability

The Opportunity:
As an Associate Safety Director, you will be a key member of the safety team providing safety oversight across the development and marketed portfolio. You will deliver safety science and pharmacovigilance support, from early and late phase development through post-marketed signal and risk management. Working under the matrix leadership of the Safety Strategy Leader (SSL), you will ensure our medicines reach patients safely and efficiently.

• Develop and maintain an understanding of the safety profile for assigned products, providing clinical input into the interpretation of emerging safety data.

• Contribute to aggregate case analysis and reporting activities including preparation of periodic safety reports (ie. DSUR, PBRER)

• Drive signal management activities, including signal detection and assessment, and contribute to risk management activities (e.g.RMPs/REM) and provide advice and interpretation of whether/how risks may impact the overall clinical risk-benefit balance of an asset.

• Support the preparation and review of safety sections for regulatory filings (IND, NDA, MAA) and labeling documents like the Company Core Data Sheet, or Investigator’s Brochure

• Represent Clinical Safety on development study teams and prepare and/or review safety sections of study documents (e.g. protocol, Informed consent, etc)

• Contribute to and/or and provide input into internal or external Drug Monitoring Committees.

• In partnership with the SSL, support presentation of safety issues to the internal Safety governance committee.

• Coordinate with vendors and may act as a functional business process owner or subject matter expert to improve our safety science practices.

• Partner with functions including Clinical Science, Regulatory, Data Science and Clinical Operations teams to ensure seamless execution of business initiatives.

• Mentor & Lead: Act as a subject matter expert within the function, coaching junior scientists.

Who You Are:
You are a proactive and independent safety professional who thrives in a collaborative, matrix environment. You bring a growth mindset and are willing to challenge the status quo to bring agile, innovative approaches to our safety science practices.
You will also have:

• 5+ years of experience and hold a degree in Life Sciences or are a qualified healthcare professional (PhD, MSc, or PharmD preferred).

• Extensive experience in drug development, with a significant track record specifically within drug safety or pharmacovigilance.

• Possess a deep understanding of GCP, GVP, and the end-to-end clinical trial lifecycle.

• Skilled at applying complex data analysis to interpret and present scientific data with clarity and impact.

• Excel at influencing stakeholders and building partnerships across global, remote teams.

• Proven ability to manage high-priority projects and act as a subject matter expert in safety science activities.

Relocation Benefits are not available for this job posting.
#MQRS

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 1

jobs.title: Medical Safety Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Our Clinical Safety organisation is dedicated to delivering meaningful improvements to patients through medically-differentiated therapies. In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability.

As a Medical Safety Director, you will play a pivotal role in our Safety organisation, providing essential safety science and pharmacovigilance expertise across our diverse portfolio. You will be responsible for ensuring the safety of our trial participants and the reliability of our data, directly impacting how we deliver life-changing medicines to patients.

The Opportunity:
Working under the matrix leadership of the Safety Strategy Leader (SSL):

• Develop and maintain an expert understanding of product safety profiles and drive the overarching safety strategy for assigned molecules.

• Drive signal detection and management activities, ensuring proactive identification and evaluation of safety issues.

• Take independent responsibility for risk management activities, including the preparation and maintenance of Risk Management Plans, Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies, and labelling documents.

• Review clinical protocols, Investigator’s Brochures (IB), and informed consent forms to ensure alignment with safety strategies.

• Lead safety science contributions for global regulatory filings, including INDs, NDAs, and MAAs.

• In partnership with the SSL, you will support the presentation of important safety issues to internal and external review and governance committees, as needed.

• Act as a functional business process owner or subject matter expert to improve our safety science practices.

• You may be expected to support non-molecule projects, due diligence evaluations and other projects as needed.

• Partner with functions including Clinical Science, Regulatory, Data Science and Clinical Operations and Surveillance teams to ensure seamless execution of business initiatives.

• Mentor & Lead: Act as a subject matter expert within the function, coaching junior scientists

Responsibilities due to medical qualifications include:

• Acting in a formal capacity as the assigned medically-qualified approver/signatory for any relevant safety-related documents where there may be a regulatory and/or legal requirement for an assessment or approval to be provided by a person who holds formal medical qualifications in a given area of clinical practice, or in a given territory.

• Interpretation of emerging safety-relevant data, in the context of experience gained whilst practicing in relevant areas of clinical medicine/healthcare.

• Performing medical practice impact assessments in the context of product quality safety issues (e.g. as part of defined activities outlined in PT-managed processes that require formal assessment by medically qualified individuals).

• Determining the potential clinical medical impact of non-clinical safety findings, and/or the interpretation of potential product risks associated with such findings, in the context of current external clinical practice.

• Providing advice and interpretation of whether/how risks may impact the overall clinical risk-benefit balance of an asset, in the context of typical clinical medical
