jobs.title: Associate Medical Safety Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Our Clinical Safety organisation is dedicated to delivering meaningful improvements to patients through medically-differentiated therapies. In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability.

As a Portfolio Clinical Safety Scientist (Associate Medical Director), you will be a key member of the safety team, providing medical expertise and safety oversight across the development and marketed portfolio. You will apply your clinical medical knowledge to deliver safety science and pharmacovigilance support, from early and late phase development through post-marketed signal and risk management. Working under the matrix leadership of the Safety Strategy Leader (SSL), you will ensure our medicines reach patients safely and efficiently.

The Opportunity:

• Develop and maintain an understanding of the safety profile for assigned products, providing clinical input into the interpretation of emerging safety data in the context of experience gained whilst practising in relevant areas of clinical medicine/healthcare..

• Contribute to aggregate case analysis and reporting activities including preparation of periodic safety reports (ie. DSUR, PBRER)

• Drive signal management activities, including signal detection and assessment, and contribute to risk management activities (e.g.RMPs/REM) and provide advice and interpretation of whether/how risks may impact the overall clinical risk-benefit balance of an asset, in the context of typical clinical medical practice in the territories/countries where the product/asset will be used.

• Support the preparation and review of safety sections for regulatory filings (IND, NDA, MAA) and labeling documents like the Company Core Data Sheet, or Investigator’s Brochure

• Represent Clinical Safety on development study teams and prepare and/or review safety sections of study documents (e.g. protocol, Informed consent, etc)

• Contribute to and/or and provide input into internal or external Drug Monitoring Committees.

• In partnership with the SSL, support presentation of safety issues to the internal Safety governance committee.

• Coordinate with vendors and may act as a functional business process owner or subject matter expert to improve our safety science practices.

• Partner with functions including Clinical Science, Regulatory, Data Science and Clinical Operations teams to ensure seamless execution of business initiatives.

• Mentor & Lead: Act as a subject matter expert within the function, coaching junior scientists.

Who You Are:
You are a proactive medical professional with a passion for drug safety and a desire to shape the future of medicine. You thrive in global, matrix environments and bring a collaborative mindset to complex problem-solving. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work at the forefront of safety science, benefiting from a culture of continuous learning and the chance to make a measurable impact on patient lives worldwide.

You will also have:

• A formal medical degree (MD, MB BS, MB ChB) with post-graduate clinical experience in relevant medical specialties.

• 5+ years of clinical drug development experience in pharma or biotech, including at least 2 years specifically in clinical drug safety.

• A solid understanding of GxP, regulated processes, and the en

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• Medical Information Consultant Intern
• 1. 职位职责：
• （ 1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （ 2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （ 3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （ 4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （ 1 ）在校大学生
• （ 2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （ 3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4 ）熟练运用 Excel 、 PPT 、 Word 等办公应用软件
• （ 5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche , we believe that access to reliable diagnostics plays a critical role in improving patient outcomes. As a Field Service Engineer, you will be at the forefront of ensuring our instruments operate at their best—supporting healthcare professionals with timely, high-quality technical service.

This role offers the opportunity to work directly with cutting-edge diagnostic technologies while building strong partnerships with customers across your territory.

Your Opportunity
As a Field Service Engineer, you will:

• Deliver installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of diagnostic instruments at customer sites

• Perform preventive maintenance and ensure all service activities are completed accurately and on time

• Provide technical training and support to customers to ensure optimal product usage

• Document service activities, product issues, and maintenance reports in internal systems

• Manage spare parts, service logs, and administrative responsibilities in a timely manner

• Travel within assigned territory to support hospitals, labs, and healthcare facilities

• Support continuous improvement by contributing to preventive maintenance procedures

• Build trusted relationships with customers, becoming a reliable technical partner in their operations

Who you are
You are a technically capable and customer-focused professional who thrives in a hands-on environment, with a structured approach to problem-solving and a strong sense of accountability in delivering service excellence.

• Diploma (D3) or Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Electrical, Electronic, Electro-Medical (ATEM), Instrumentation, or Physics Engineering

• Fresh graduates are welcome; 2+ years of experience as a Service Engineer in diagnostics or medical devices is an advantage

• Able to read and understand wiring diagrams, block diagrams, and system functions

• Familiar with measurement tools (e.g., multimeter, voltmeter)

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail and the ability to manage time effectively while working under pressure

• Effective communication skills, including basic English proficiency

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer | Laboratory Diagnostics

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere del campo | Diagnostica del laboratorio

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche.

• Global reputable company | Career growth opportunities

• Full time permanent position | Annual Bonus and Car Allowance

• Base salary between $100,000-$120,000

• Supportive and dynamic team | Agile ways of working

Roche Diagnostics New Zealand (RDNZ) has just opened an exciting opportunity for the position of Field Service Engineer to be based in Wellington. The key purpose of this position is to carry out the engineering service function for the assigned Squad, but the responsibilities may flex across the other squads as per business requirements. There is a requirement of training and continuing education on the portfolio, instrument and product troubleshooting, instrument installation and commissioning, instrument maintenance procedures and all manufacturer modifications, and other issues of instrument aftersales services to the satisfaction of the RDNZ customer base and in line with our organisational SOPs and policies.

Leveraging your Laboratory Diagnostics engineering experience, responsibilities of this role include but are not limited to;

• Ensure existing and new customer base are supported with quality after-sales service.

• Participate in an on-call roster to ensure customers are supported 24 hours 7 days.

• Instrument trouble-shooting service is provided, is efficient and fulfils the needs of our customers.

• Ensure RD maintains Service Level Agreements (SLA) conditions with regards response times for phone support and onsite customer visits.

• Chapter Lead Service, relevant Marketing Managers and Strategic Key Account Managers are kept aware of all product issues.

• Participate in Account Management Strategies.

• Spare parts stock are organized and maintained to avoid excess stock accumulation in consignment and are returned to 3PL warehouse.

• To complete all documentation required within the required timeline requested.

• Business opportunities are identified and implemented in accordance with internal and external stakeholders.

• To keep CRM (Rexis/\NFSS) customer records up to date, relevant and accurate.

• Ensure Service Contract information is followed for all service activities / work orders.

• Provide cover and travel as required for territories where engineering resources are required to meet business demands and customer needs.

• Complete timely pre-installation inspections and installation of new and refurbished RD and other analytical systems within areas of responsibility.

• Displays an understanding of, and adhere to, all SHE policies and principles to ensure the health and safety of all at the workplace.

Who You Are:

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies and where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

To be successful in this position, you will be an experienced engineer, and will be able to demonstrate the following:

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role with tertiary qualification in Engineering (Electrical / Mechanical) or Science is desired

• Understanding of Diagnostic & Research Laboratories environment

• Appropriate work-r

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche.
• Azienda globale stimabile | Opportunità di crescita Carriera
• Posizione permanente a tempo pieno | Bonus annuale e Auto Consentimento
• stipendio base tra $100,000-$120,000
• Team di supporto e dinamico | Modi di lavoro Agile Roche Diagnostics Nuova Zelanda (RDNZ) ha appena aperto un'opportunità emozionante per la posizione di Field Service Engineer di essere basato a Wellington. Lo scopo principale di questa posizione è quello di svolgere la funzione di servizio di ingegneria per la squadra assegnata, ma le responsabilità possono flettersi tra le altre squadre secondo i requisiti aziendali. C'è un requisito di formazione e formazione continua sul portafoglio, strumento e risoluzione dei problemi di prodotto, installazione degli strumenti e messa in servizio, procedure di manutenzione degli strumenti e tutte le modifiche del produttore, e altre questioni dei servizi di postvendita dello strumento per la soddisfazione della base clienti RDNZ e in linea con i nostri SOP organizzativi e politiche. Sfruttando la vostra esperienza di ingegneria diagnostica del laboratorio, le responsabilità di questo ruolo includono ma non sono limitate a;
• Assicurarsi che la base clienti esistente e nuova sia supportata da un servizio post-vendita di qualità.
• Partecipare a un roster on-call per garantire che i clienti siano supportati 24 ore 7 giorni.
• Il servizio di risoluzione dei problemi degli strumenti è fornito, è efficiente e soddisfa le esigenze dei nostri clienti.
• Assicurare RD mantiene le condizioni di Service Level Agreements (SLA) per quanto riguarda i tempi di risposta per il supporto telefonico e le visite dei clienti in loco.
• Il servizio capofila, i responsabili di marketing rilevanti e i responsabili strategici del conto chiave sono tenuti a conoscenza di tutti i problemi del prodotto.
• Partecipare alle strategie di gestione degli account.
• Le scorte di ricambi sono organizzate e mantenute per evitare l'accumulo di scorte in eccesso nella spedizione e vengono restituite al magazzino 3PL.
• Per completare tutta la documentazione richiesta entro la cronologia richiesta.
• Le opportunità di business sono identificate e implementate in conformità con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.
• Per mantenere aggiornati i record dei clienti CRM (Rexis/\NFSS), pertinenti e precisi.
• Assicurarsi che le informazioni del contratto di servizio siano seguite per tutte le attività di servizio / ordini di lavoro.
• Fornire copertura e viaggio come richiesto per i territori in cui le risorse ingegneristiche sono necessarie per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali e dei clienti.
• Completare ispezioni tempestive di preinstallazione e l'installazione di nuovi e rinnovati sistemi RD e altri sistemi analitici all'interno di aree di responsabilità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The team provides timely, accurate and decision-relevant information to support the Head of Group Controlling and Accounting, Head of Strategic Finance, Pharma CFO and ultimately the CEO, the Corporate Executive Committee and the Board of Directors in value creation and financial performance management. In addition, it provides timely, accurate and decision-relevant information and analysis of actual and planned financial performance of the Pharmaceutical Division management units.

The Opportunity

The Enterprise Center of Excellence (eCoE) focuses on three areas: delivering a high-level of financial expertise, innovative insights, and an entrepreneurial mindset that enables agility and flexibility for stakeholders.
This role involves preparing presentations for the Pharma Leadership Team and Pharma Finance Leadership Team, alongside supporting the compilation of critical management reports for the Corporate Executive Committee, Board of Directors, and other key decision-makers. You will also assist in analyzing the performance of the Roche Pharma Division, generating valuable insights, and contributing to various ad-hoc financial projects, ensuring all reports are updated and continuously enhanced. Furthermore, you will assist in the preparation of evidence and supporting documents to back-up the reported financial results.

Who You are:

• You are currently enrolled at University studying Finance / Economics or a similar degree, or you completed your degree within the past 12 months prior to the start date.

• You are someone who wants to influence your own development and you are an enthusiastic team player who enjoys working in a global and dynamic environment.

• You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions.

• Exceptional Analytical and Technical Proficiency: Possess strong analytical skills, quick perception, and a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail. This includes advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VBA is a plus) and PowerPoint, as well as Google Sheets and Google Slides.

• Adaptability and Resilience: Demonstrate an accurate working style and the ability to perform effectively under pressure and within tight timelines, coupled with an open-minded and flexible attitude.

• Strong Communication and Language Skills: Exhibit excellent command of English, enabling clear and effective communication within a global environment.

• High Motivation and Continuous Learning Mindset: Show outstanding motivation and a strong willingness to continuously learn and develop, reflecting a genuine interest in Finance.

• Proactive and Improvement-Oriented Approach: A growth mindset with a passion for improving the status quo is highly valued, as are IT skills for introducing automation.

Application process:

• Please upload your current CV and a Motivation Letter, where you indicate your preferred start date of the internship.

Additional Information:

• Please note, due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university for the whole duration of this internship.

• Part-time employment is not possible.

• Earliest start date: 1 August 2026 or upon availability

• Duration: 12 months, full- time (40 hours/ week)

• Location: Basel

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il team fornisce informazioni tempestive, accurate e rilevanti per le decisioni per supportare il responsabile del controllo del gruppo e della contabilità, responsabile delle finanze strategiche, Pharma CFO e, infine, il CEO, il Comitato Esecutivo Societario e il Consiglio di Amministrazione nella creazione di valore e gestione delle prestazioni finanziarie. Inoltre, fornisce informazioni e analisi puntuali, accurate e rilevanti per le decisioni sulle prestazioni finanziarie reali e pianificate delle unità di gestione della Divisione Farmaceutica. L'opportunità L'Enterprise Center of Excellence (eCoE) si concentra su tre settori: fornire un alto livello di competenze finanziarie, intuizioni innovative e una mentalità imprenditoriale che consente agilità e flessibilità per gli stakeholder. Questo ruolo consiste nella preparazione di presentazioni per il Pharma Leadership Team e Pharma Finance Leadership Team, oltre a sostenere la compilazione di report di gestione critica per il Comitato Esecutivo Societario, Consiglio di Amministrazione e altri decisori chiave. Assisterai anche ad analizzare le prestazioni della Roche Pharma Division, generando preziose intuizioni e contribuendo a vari progetti finanziari ad-hoc, garantendo che tutte le relazioni siano aggiornate e continuamente migliorate. Inoltre, vi aiuterà nella preparazione di prove e documenti di supporto per il backup dei risultati finanziari segnalati. Chi sei:
• Sei attualmente iscritto presso l'Università di studiare finanza / economia o un grado simile, o hai completato la laurea negli ultimi 12 mesi prima della data di inizio.
• Sei qualcuno che vuole influenzare il proprio sviluppo e sei un giocatore di squadra entusiasta che gode di lavorare in un ambiente globale e dinamico.
• State cercando una società in cui avete la possibilità di perseguire i vostri interessi attraverso le funzioni.
• Eccezionale competenza analitica e tecnica: Possede forti competenze analitiche, rapida percezione e un elevato grado di precisione e attenzione ai dettagli. Questo include la competenza avanzata in Microsoft Excel (VBA è un plus) e PowerPoint, così come Google Sheets e Google Slides.
• Adaptability and Resilience: Dimostrare uno stile di lavoro accurato e la capacità di eseguire efficacemente sotto pressione e in tempi stretti, accoppiato con un atteggiamento aperto e flessibile.
• Forte comunicazione e competenze linguistiche: Esibizione eccellente comando dell'inglese, che consente una comunicazione chiara ed efficace all'interno di un ambiente globale.
• High Motivation e Continuous Learning Mindset: mostrare una motivazione eccezionale e una forte volontà di imparare e sviluppare continuamente, riflettendo un autentico interesse per la finanza.
• Approccio proattivo e orientato al miglioramento: una mentalità di crescita con la passione per il miglioramento dello status quo è altamente apprezzata, così come le competenze IT per l'introduzione dell'automazione. Processo di applicazione:
• Si prega di caricare il CV corrente e una lettera di motivazione, dove si indica la data di inizio preferita dello stage. Informazioni aggiuntive:
• Si prega di notare che, a causa di regolamenti, i cittadini non UE/EFTA devono fornire un certificato dall'università che afferma che un tirocinio è obbligatorio nell'ambito dei documenti di richiesta e deve essere continuamente iscritto nella loro università per tutta la durata di questo stage.
• L'occupazione a tempo parziale non è possibile.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'équipe fournit des renseignements opportuns, exacts et pertinents pour appuyer le chef du groupe Contrôle et comptabilité, le chef des finances stratégiques, le DPF Pharma et, en bout de ligne, le chef de la direction, le comité de direction et le conseil d'administration en matière de création de valeur et de gestion du rendement financier. En outre, il fournit des renseignements opportuns, exacts et pertinents en matière de décision et analyse le rendement financier réel et prévu des unités de gestion de la Division des produits pharmaceutiques. L'opportunité Le Centre d'excellence de l'entreprise (eCoE) se concentre sur trois domaines : fournir une expertise financière de haut niveau, des idées novatrices et un esprit d'entreprise qui permet l'agilité et la flexibilité aux parties prenantes. Ce rôle consiste à préparer des présentations pour l'équipe de leadership Pharma et l'équipe de leadership Pharma Finance, en plus d'appuyer la compilation de rapports de gestion critiques pour le Comité de direction de l'entreprise, le conseil d'administration et d'autres décideurs clés. Vous contribuerez également à l'analyse du rendement de la Division Roche Pharma, à la production de précieux renseignements et à la contribution à divers projets financiers ponctuels, en veillant à ce que tous les rapports soient mis à jour et continuellement améliorés. De plus, vous aiderez à la préparation de preuves et de documents à l'appui des résultats financiers déclarés. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes actuellement inscrit à l'université de finance / économie ou un diplôme similaire, ou vous avez terminé votre diplôme dans les 12 derniers mois avant la date de début.
• Vous êtes quelqu'un qui veut influencer votre propre développement et vous êtes un joueur d'équipe enthousiaste qui aime travailler dans un environnement global et dynamique.
• Vous êtes à la recherche d'une entreprise où vous avez la possibilité de poursuivre vos intérêts dans toutes les fonctions.
• Compétences analytiques et techniques exceptionnelles : possède de solides compétences analytiques, une perception rapide et un degré élevé de précision et d'attention aux détails. Cela inclut la compétence avancée dans Microsoft Excel (VBA est un plus) et PowerPoint, ainsi que Google Sheets et Google Slides.
• Adaptabilité et résilience: Démontrer un style de travail précis et la capacité de fonctionner efficacement sous pression et dans des délais serrés, avec une attitude ouverte et flexible.
• Compétences en communication et en langue fortes : montrer une excellente maîtrise de l'anglais, permettant une communication claire et efficace dans un environnement mondial.
• Motivation élevée et apprentissage continu : Montrez une motivation exceptionnelle et une forte volonté d'apprendre et de se développer en continu, reflétant un véritable intérêt pour les finances.
• Approche proactive et orientée vers l'amélioration: une mentalité de croissance avec une passion pour l'amélioration du statu quo est très appréciée, tout comme les compétences informatiques pour introduire l'automatisation. Processus de demande :
• Veuillez télécharger votre CV actuel et une lettre de motivation, où vous indiquez votre date de début préférée du stage. Renseignements supplémentaires :
• Veuillez noter qu'en raison de la réglementation, les citoyens non membres de l'UE/AELE doivent fournir un certificat de l'université indiquant qu'un stage est obligatoire dans le cadre des documents de candidature et doivent être inscrits en permanence dans leur université pendant toute la durée de ce stage.
• L'emploi à temps partiel n'est pas possible.
• Date de début la plus proche: 1er août 2026 ou dès disponibilité
• Durée: 12 mois, temps plein (40 heures/semaine)
• Lieu: Bâle Si vous êtes fier de contribuer et de sentir que vous avez le dévouement au travail d'équipe et à l'innovation que nous

jobs.title: Commercial Finance Partner(Demand Management)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose
This role acts as a "T-shaped" Value Orchestrator. The primary mission is to break down traditional silos between procurement and finance by autonomously leading procurement strategies and end-to-end (E2E) processes. Crucially, this role ensures that the "savings" and "cash flow optimizations" generated from procurement activities are directly reflected in the affiliate's financial planning and budgeting (P&L), thereby maximizing enterprise business value.

Key Responsibilities
1. Procurement Strategy & Vendor Management

• Develop and implement procurement strategies and savings plans to support business objectives and financial targets.

• Execute comprehensive Vendor Management, which includes coordinating supplier selection, onboarding, regular performance evaluations, and maintaining strong, strategic vendor relationships.

• Lead supplier negotiations to secure favorable commercial terms.

• Optimize payment terms to significantly reduce deposit/advance invoices and improve company cash flows.

2. Budgeting & Financial Planning

• Integrate procurement savings and cost optimization plans directly into the affiliate's planning events, including Business Plan (BP), T0, T3, Baseline, as well as Period cost, and M&D budgets.

• Ensure procurement savings initiatives are tightly aligned with and realized in the company’s financial targets and P&L.

3. E2E Process, Governance & SOPs

• Create, maintain, and regularly update Procurement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and formalized purchasing policies to ensure operational efficiency and compliance across all departments.

• Establish and maintain governance frameworks for the full procurement lifecycle and internal controls.

• Continuously evaluate and enhance procurement processes and controls to ensure scalability and effectiveness.

4. Collaboration & Network Orchestration

• Act as the bridge between Finance and Procurement, and collaborate closely with the Supply Chain team to align procurement processes with operational needs.

• Work with the Roche network (other affiliates and global) to find better solutions and share best practices.

5. Compliance & Risk Management

• Perform risk management on supply contracts, proactively identifying and resolving supply or quality issues.

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and external regulations.

Key Requirements

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree or above, preferably in Business Administration, Finance, or related.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain management, or financial planning in Multinational Companies (MNCs).

• Professional Skills: Strong negotiation, analytical, and financial acumen (understanding of budgeting and P&L). Expertise in vendor management, procurement governance, SOP creation, and E2E processes. Familiarity with financial systems (e.g., SAP) is required.

• Attributes & Languages: Proven ability to solve problems, influence cross-functional teams, and build stakeholder relationships. Fluent in both oral and written English and Mandarin. Good compliance track record.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicin

jobs.title: Senior Financial Accountant - Talent Pool
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This posting is for Talent Pool purposes and may not correspond to a current vacancy with an active recruitment process. However, it reflects a role for which we regularly recruit or anticipate having openings in the near future for permanent or fixed term opportunities.

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process. In this position in close collaboration with the Country Chief Accountant, you will focus on:

• Leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities

• Taxes, GL journals and accruals/ provisions, reconciling BS accounts

• Clearing customer accounts and bank suspense accounts, collecting direct debit, daily bank posting, posting and reconciling treasury transactions

• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices

• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling

• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP

• Performing Month-end Closing and Reporting for Consolidation and for Divisions

• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:
University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• 2-4 years of experience in a relevant position

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Outstanding customer orientation and service focus

• Strong interpersonal skills and team player attitude

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This posting is for Talent Pool purposes and may not correspond to a current vacancy with an active recruitment process. However, it reflects a role for which we regularly recruit or anticipate having openings in the near future for permanent or fixed term opportunities. The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity. The Opportunity As a Senior Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process. In this position in close collaboration with the Country Chief Accountant, you will focus on:
• Leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities
• Taxes, GL journals and accruals/ provisions, reconciling BS accounts
• Clearing customer accounts and bank suspense accounts, collecting direct debit, daily bank posting, posting and reconciling treasury transactions
• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices
• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling
• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP
• Performing Month-end Closing and Reporting for Consolidation and for Divisions
• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits Who you are We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have: University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline
• 2-4 years of experience in a relevant position
• Excellent communication and analytical skills
• Outstanding customer orientation and service focus
• Strong interpersonal skills and team player attitude
• Proficiency in English In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.
• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.
• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Affairs International (EAi), part of the Roche Pharma CEO Office, ensures the company can shape the policies, funding decisions, and market conditions that determine how healthcare innovation is valued and rewarded. We influence globally where strategic priorities are defined and enable locally where business impact is delivered. Through focused advocacy and a connected global network, EAi builds trusted relationships with governments, multilateral institutions, and global partners, develops third-party advocates, and forges alliances that protect and grow Roche’s business while improving patient access to innovation.

The Opportunity
The Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy is a high-impact strategic expert responsible for designing and driving Roche’s policy strategies across priority Therapeutic Areas (TAs). Reporting to the Global Disease Area Policy Team Lead, you serve as the definitive policy expert, ensuring that the external policy environment and healthcare systems deliver rapid and sustainable access to innovation. This role requires a unique blend of technical policy mastery, commercial acumen and strategic diplomacy to navigate complex supra-national environments, influence senior stakeholders, and orchestrate global-to-local disease area policy alignment without the need for direct hierarchical authority.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive the development and implementation of the global policy strategy portfolio and performance metrics across priority TAs, ensuring full alignment with global, regional, and affiliate functions.

• Define the long-term global disease area policy vision, strategy, objectives and crafting sophisticated policy projects, evidence, tools and positioning that addresses the needs of patients, medical professionals, and the business.

• Act as a primary catalyst for shaping policy environments by architecting external engagement and advocacy frameworks for a broad cross-section of disease area policy and health system stakeholders, while identifying and mitigating barriers to access among governments and NGOs.

• Serve as the primary global point-of-contact for disease area policy, providing timely and expert direction to the business

• Partner strategically across Roche regions and affiliates to ensure consistent application of health policy expertise, enabling local implementation of disease area policy strategies, and to drive the External Affairs mission through the organization.

• Lead the development of portfolio-wide content, analytical tools, and disease area policy strategies that translate complex external policy and healthcare challenges into actionable business insights and tactics.

• Manage high-impact global strategic policy initiatives and project workstreams, ensuring resource transparency and evidence-based recommendations to enable high-level business decision-making.

• Support organizational growth by sharing global health policy expertise and educating cross-functional peers to foster a culture of functional excellence and innovation.

Who You Are

• You hold a Master’s degree, MBA, or equivalent in Political Science, Public Policy, Public Health, Healthcare Management, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in health policy or public affairs within the life sciences sector or government,with a deep mastery and knowledge of disease area policy, health system and access environments.

• A recognized leader with a demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and policymakers

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Esterni International (EAi), parte dell'Ufficio CEO di Roche Pharma, assicura che l'azienda possa modellare le politiche, le decisioni di finanziamento e le condizioni di mercato che determinano come l'innovazione sanitaria sia valutata e premiata. Influenziamo a livello globale dove vengono definite le priorità strategiche e consentiamo a livello locale dove l'impatto aziendale viene consegnato. Attraverso l’advocacy focalizzata e una rete globale collegata, EAi costruisce relazioni di fiducia con governi, istituzioni multilaterali e partner globali, sviluppa sostenitori di terze parti, e forgia alleanze che proteggono e crescono gli affari di Roche, migliorando l’accesso dei pazienti all’innovazione. L'opportunità La politica globale Lead, Malattia Area Policy è un esperto strategico ad alto impatto responsabile della progettazione e della guida delle strategie politiche di Roche attraverso aree terapeutiche prioritarie (TA). Segnalando al Global Disease Area Policy Team Lead, sei l'esperto di politica definitiva, assicurando che l'ambiente di politica esterna e i sistemi sanitari garantiscano un accesso rapido e sostenibile all'innovazione. Questo ruolo richiede una miscela unica di padronanza della politica tecnica, acume commerciale e diplomazia strategica per navigare ambienti sovranazionali complessi, influenzare gli stakeholder senior e orchestrare l'allineamento della politica globale-locale delle malattie senza la necessità di autorità gerarchiche dirette. Principali responsabilità
• Guidare lo sviluppo e l'attuazione del portafoglio di strategia di politica globale e metriche di performance attraverso TA prioritari, garantendo il pieno allineamento con le funzioni globali, regionali e affiliate.
• Definire la visione, la strategia, gli obiettivi e la realizzazione di progetti politici sofisticati, prove, strumenti e posizionamento a lungo termine che rispondono alle esigenze dei pazienti, dei medici e del business.
• Agire come catalizzatore primario per la modellazione degli ambienti politici attraverso l'archiviazione di schemi di impegno e di advocacy esterni per una vasta sezione trasversale delle parti interessate della politica della malattia e del sistema sanitario, identificando e mitigando le barriere all'accesso tra governi e ONG.
• Servire come punto di contatto principale globale per la politica dell'area delle malattie, fornendo una direzione tempestiva ed esperta al business
• Partner strategicamente nelle regioni e nelle affiliate di Roche per garantire un'applicazione coerente delle competenze in materia di politica sanitaria, consentendo l'implementazione locale delle strategie di politica delle malattie e di guidare la missione Affari Esteri attraverso l'organizzazione.
• Condurre lo sviluppo di contenuti a livello di portafoglio, strumenti analitici e strategie politiche di area malattia che traducono complesse sfide di politica esterna e di assistenza sanitaria in insight aziendali e tattiche attuabili.
• Gestire iniziative di politica strategica globale ad alto impatto e flussi di lavoro di progetto, garantendo trasparenza delle risorse e raccomandazioni basate su prove per consentire un processo decisionale di alto livello.
• Sostenere la crescita organizzativa condividendo le competenze della politica sanitaria globale e istruire i coetanei interfunzionali per promuovere una cultura di eccellenza funzionale e innovazione. Chi sei
• Hai un master, MBA, o equivalente in Scienze Politiche, Politica Pubblica, Salute Pubblica, Gestione della Sanità, o un campo relativo.
• 8+ anni di esperienza nella politica sanitaria o negli affari pubblici nel settore delle scienze della vita o del governo, con una profonda padronanza e conoscenza della politica della zona delle malattie, del sistema sanitario e degli ambienti di accesso.
• Un leader riconosciuto con una capacità dimostrata di influenzare dirigenti e politici senior

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position External Affairs International (EAi), Teil des Roche Pharma-CEO-Büros, sorgt dafür, dass das Unternehmen die Politiken, Förderentscheidungen und Marktbedingungen prägen kann, die bestimmen, wie Innovationen im Gesundheitswesen geschätzt und belohnt werden. Wir beeinflussen global, wo strategische Prioritäten definiert sind und lokal in die Lage versetzt werden, wo Geschäftsauswirkungen erzielt werden. Durch fokussierte Advocacy und ein vernetztes globales Netzwerk baut EAi vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Regierungen, multilateralen Institutionen und globalen Partnern auf, entwickelt Drittanbieter-Befürworter und forge Allianzen, die das Unternehmen von Roche schützen und wachsen und gleichzeitig den Zugang zu Innovationen verbessern. Die Chance Die Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy ist ein hochprägsamer strategischer Experte, der die politischen Strategien von Roche in vorrangigen Therapeutischen Bereichen (TAs) entwickelt und vorantreibt. Als definitiver politischer Experte, der sicherstellt, dass das außenpolitische Umfeld und die Gesundheitssysteme einen schnellen und nachhaltigen Zugang zu Innovation bieten. Diese Rolle erfordert eine einzigartige Mischung aus technischer Politik-Meisterschaft, kommerzieller acumen und strategischer Diplomatie, um komplexe supranationale Umgebungen zu navigieren, Senior Stakeholder zu beeinflussen und global-to-local Disease Area politische Ausrichtung ohne direkte hierarchische Autorität. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten
• Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Umsetzung des globalen Strategieportfolios und der Performance Metriken über prioritäre TAs aus, um eine vollständige Ausrichtung auf globale, regionale und Affiliate-Funktionen zu gewährleisten.
• Definieren Sie die langfristige globale Strategie, Strategie, Ziele und die Gestaltung von anspruchsvollen politischen Projekten, Beweisen, Werkzeugen und Positionierungen, die sich auf die Bedürfnisse von Patienten, medizinischen Fachleuten und das Geschäft beziehen.
• Aktivieren Sie als primärer Katalysator für die Gestaltung von politischen Umgebungen, indem Sie externes Engagement und Advocacy-Framework für einen breiten Querschnitt von Interessenvertretern im Bereich der Krankheits- und Gesundheitspolitik unter gleichzeitiger Identifizierung und Minderung von Barrieren für den Zugang zwischen Regierungen und NRO darstellen.
• Als primärer globaler Ansprechpartner für die Politik des Krankheitsbereichs dienen und dem Unternehmen zeitnah und kompetente Orientierung geben
• Partner strategisch über Roche-Regionen und Affiliates, um eine konsequente Anwendung der Gesundheitswesen-Expertise zu gewährleisten, die lokale Umsetzung von Krankheitsgebiet-Politikstrategien zu ermöglichen und die Mission für Auswärtige Angelegenheiten durch die Organisation zu fördern.
• Führen Sie die Entwicklung von portfolioweiten Content-, analytischen Tools- und Krankheitsfeldstrategien, die komplexe externe Politik- und Gesundheitsprobleme in handlungsfähige Unternehmens- und Taktiken übersetzen.
• Verwalten hocheffizienter globaler strategischer Initiativen und Projektarbeit, um Ressourcentransparenz und evidenzbasierte Empfehlungen zu gewährleisten, um eine hochrangige Unternehmensentscheidung zu ermöglichen.
• Unterstützung des organisatorischen Wachstums durch den Austausch globaler gesundheitspolitischer Expertise und Ausbildung von funktionsübergreifenden Peers, um eine Kultur funktionaler Exzellenz und Innovation zu fördern. Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Master-Abschluss, MBA oder gleichwertig in Politikwissenschaft, Public Policy, Public Health, Healthcare Management oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• 8+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Gesundheitspolitik oder öffentlichen Angelegenheiten im Bereich der Lebenswissenschaften oder der Regierung, mit einer tiefen Beherrschung und Kenntnisse der Krankheitsgebietspolitik, des Gesundheitssystems und der Zugangsumgebungen.
• Ein anerkannter Führer mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, Führungskräfte und Politiker zu beeinflussen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position External Affairs International (EAi), qui fait partie du bureau du PDG de Roche Pharma, veille à ce que l'entreprise puisse façonner les politiques, les décisions de financement et les conditions du marché qui déterminent la valeur et la récompense de l'innovation en matière de soins de santé. Nous influons à l'échelle mondiale là où les priorités stratégiques sont définies et nous permettons à l'échelle locale d'avoir un impact sur les entreprises. Grâce à un plaidoyer ciblé et à un réseau mondial connecté, EAi établit des relations de confiance avec les gouvernements, les institutions multilatérales et les partenaires mondiaux, développe des défenseurs tiers et forge des alliances qui protègent et développent les affaires de Roches tout en améliorant l'accès des patients à l'innovation. L'opportunité Le responsable de la politique mondiale, Politique sur les zones de maladies, est un expert stratégique à fort impact chargé de concevoir et d'orienter les stratégies stratégiques de Roche dans les zones thérapeutiques prioritaires. Rendre compte au responsable de l'équipe de la politique mondiale sur les maladies, vous êtes l'expert en politiques définitives, vous assurant que l'environnement politique externe et les systèmes de soins de santé offrent un accès rapide et durable à l'innovation. Ce rôle exige un mélange unique de maîtrise des politiques techniques, de sens commercial et de diplomatie stratégique afin de naviguer dans des environnements supranationaux complexes, d'influencer les principaux intervenants et d'orchestrer l'alignement des politiques mondiales sur les zones de maladies locales sans avoir besoin d'une autorité hiérarchique directe. Principales responsabilités
• Diriger l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre du portefeuille de stratégies politiques mondiales et des indicateurs de performance dans les AT prioritaires, en assurant une alignement complet avec les fonctions mondiales, régionales et affiliées.
• Définir la vision politique, la stratégie, les objectifs et l'élaboration de projets politiques sophistiqués, de données probantes, d'outils et de positionnement qui répondent aux besoins des patients, des professionnels de la santé et des entreprises.
• Agir en tant que principal catalyseur de la mise en place d'un environnement politique en élaborant des cadres d'engagement et de plaidoyer extérieurs pour un large éventail d'acteurs de la politique et du système de santé, tout en identifiant et en atténuant les obstacles à l'accès entre les gouvernements et les ONG.
• Servir de principal point de contact mondial pour la politique en matière de maladies, fournissant une orientation opportune et experte aux entreprises
• Établir des partenariats stratégiques dans les régions de Roche et les filiales afin d'assurer une application cohérente de l'expertise en matière de politique de santé, de permettre la mise en œuvre locale des stratégies de lutte contre la maladie et de conduire la mission Affaires extérieures à travers l'organisation.
• Diriger l'élaboration de contenus à l'échelle du portefeuille, d'outils d'analyse et de stratégies politiques dans le domaine des maladies qui traduisent des politiques extérieures complexes et des défis en matière de soins de santé en idées et tactiques opérationnelles réalisables.
• Gérer les initiatives stratégiques mondiales à haut impact et les axes de travail des projets, en assurant la transparence des ressources et en formulant des recommandations fondées sur des données factuelles pour permettre une prise de décisions de haut niveau.
• Soutenir la croissance organisationnelle en partageant l'expertise mondiale en matière de politique de santé et en éduquant les pairs interfonctionnels pour favoriser une culture d'excellence fonctionnelle et d'innovation. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master, d'un MBA ou d'un équivalent en sciences politiques, politiques publiques, santé publique, gestion des soins de santé ou un domaine connexe.
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience en matière de politique de santé ou d'affaires publiques dans le secteur des sciences de la vie ou au sein du gouvernement, avec une maîtrise et une connaissance approfondies de la politique en matière de maladies, du système de santé et des environnements d'accès.
• Un dirigeant reconnu ayant une capacité démontrée d'influencer les cadres supérieurs et les décideurs

jobs.title: IT Workplace Services Professional
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Be part of our inclusive team at Roche Informatics, where we're driven by a shared passion for technological novelties and optimal IT solutions. As an IT Workplace Services Professional you continuously evaluate and improve the employee experience through subject matter expertise in the digital workplace, focusing on efficiency, employee satisfaction, and ensuring business continuity. This is a varied role and can give you a springboard into other careers in Informatics and beyond.

The Opportunity

• You will act as a digital enabler for our business colleagues & functions

• You act as the owner of the digital employee experience for the respective site

• You drive employee productivity through consultancy, provide intimacy and site proximity at the sites, and ensure a personalized Roche employee experience.

• You leverage available data (e.g.: Nexthink, SNOW) for proactive support

• You support and manage the Incident/ Request management processes to ensure SLAs are met and drive continuous improvement through trend analysis.

• You manage IT hardware lifecycle management & deskside support processes/managed services for the site

• You provide support & guidance for onsite services (e.g. events and meetings) by leveraging from internal and external providers. Drive the user experience and promote best practices.

• You drive and enable standard workplace infrastructure, global/local projects, and deployments in collaboration with product teams.

• You proactively address and follow through on process-improvement ideas

• You support & drive budgeting process related to the respective site

• You support local audit, inspection and certification requirements

• You support local Business Continuity and IT Disaster Recovery planning activities

Who you are:

• Exhibits a Lean-Agile Mindset

• Manages risks progressively and in a way that leads to opportunity

• Enterprise mindset that can break down silos. Focus on delivery through collaboration, and bringing people together to work towards the same purpose across organizational boundaries.

• Exhibits intellectual curiosity and integrity and has a strong passion for innovation

• Understanding of Roche-supported operating systems, devices and applications, including the Google Suite of Applications, MS Office, etc.

• Experience with ticketing systems and troubleshooting hardware, software and mobile devices.

• Excellent working knowledge of the ITIL v3 processes in an IT service delivery

• Solid written and oral communication skills in German and English.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
● Ensure that the following works are effectively executed to support LS and QC related business
确保如下工作被有效执行，以支持QC相关业务
⮚ Roche Global digital system aspect, including but not limit to
罗氏全球数字化系统相关，包括但不限于
● Responsible for the deployment of the end-to-end process for BIOVIA (Electronic Lab Notebook). Drive the implementation of QC electronic analytical records and system integration in a project management approach, including formula development, formula testing, formula validation, formula optimization and integration, as well as system interaction testing and application.
负责BIOVIA (Electronic Lab Notebook) 端到端流程的部署。以项目管理的方式逐步推进QC电子分析记录和系统交互建立，包括配方开发，配方测试，配方确认，配方优化和融合，系统交互测试和应用等
● Utilize QbD thinking to ensure end-to-end compliance of Roche's global digital systems. This includes eliminating GMP and Data Integrity risks, simplifying and optimizing processes, and improving Right-First-Time performance.
运用QbD思维，确保罗氏全球数字化系统端到端流程全面合规。包括消除GMP和Data Integrity风险，简化&优化流程，提高Right-First-Time。
● Roche global digital systems directly associated with testing such as BIOVIA, SingleLIMS，Labx, Empower, SAP. Including creation of user processes, using and maintenance; Creation of Master Data/Method and it's processes, using and maintenance etc.
其他罗氏全球数字化系统，如LIMS，Labx，Empower，SAP等的使用和维护等

⮚ Laboratory testing and related work, including but not limited to:
实验室检测及相关工作，包括但不限于
● Inspect and examine samples from processes such as packaging, excipients, finished product manufacturing, in-process control, environmental monitoring, change control, and customer complaints, providing timely and accurate analytical results and reports, as well as supporting trend analysis.
对包装，辅料，成品生产制造、制程控制，环境监测、变更控制和客户投诉等过程中的样品进行检验和检查，提供及时、准确的分析结果和报告以及支持趋势分析。

执行和支持实验室对OOS, OOT, OOE 及其它生产相关问题的调查，确保所有分析过程处于受控状态。
● Assist the laboratory manager in daily sample management, reference standard management, and stability sample management.
协助实验室经理处理日常样品管理、标准品管理、稳定性样品管理。

仪器/设备生命周期流程的管理和相关业务的执行，如仪器/设备的确认和验证，周期性回顾，备份/归档/恢复，内外部的校准和测试，退役，维护和维修，合同和订单等。

● Complete the other tasks assigned by the leader.
完成上级领导布置的其他任务

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/

理学士及以上学位
● Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biochemistry, microbiology and equivalent
药学、化学、生物化学、微生物及相关学科
● At least 4 years of relevant experience in laboratory analysis and/or QC dig

jobs.title: Learning Intern - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Learning Intern , you will join our Global Learning Services (GLS) team within the People Support Solutions (PSS) organization in Roche. In this role, you will assist with executing routine administrative and system data maintenance activities in our Learning Management System ( Cornerstone ). You will gain hands-on learning experience in a shared service environment, supporting learning processes and ensuring high-quality, customer-focused support for our global learning community.

Your Key Responsibilities

• System Administration : Execute routine data maintenance and system administrative tasks within Cornerstone and other relevant learning systems in a timely and accurate manner.

• Process Support : Assist with the administrative coordination of various training events, including new employee orientation, leadership training, professional training, and other training requests.

• Customer Support : Help provide customer service and troubleshooting support regarding training records, learning processes, and system inquiries to internal HR experts and business partners.

• Documentation : Assist in keeping team knowledge up to date by contributing to and updating Standard Work Instructions (SWIs) and local Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Continuous Improvement : Actively participate in team meetings, workshops, and work-related events to help identify process improvements and support new ways of learning.

• Compliance & Integrity : Perform daily duties with high integrity, adhering to global and local guidelines, including strict data privacy rules and safety, security, and environmental (SHE) regulations.

Who You Are
We are looking for an analytical, proactive and collaborative university students who bring the following skills and competencies:

• Education : Currently enrolled in a university program with active/passive full-time student status in Hungary (studies in HR, Business, or Social Sciences are preferred).

• Able to work 25-30 hrs/week .

• Languages: Fluent English (C1) is required. German (B2-C1) also required.

• System & IT Skills : Experience with standard IT applications (Google Suite or Microsoft) and an eagerness to learn cloud-based learning management software (like Cornerstone).

• Growth Mindset : An agile learner who is open to seeking and giving feedback, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and capable of navigating complex data.

• Customer Centricity : Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on delivering reliable support and managing customer expectations.

• Collaboration : A supportive team player who enjoys working in a multicultural, cross-border matrix environment.

What We Offer

• Hands-on experience operating Cornerstone and various other tools.

• Deep exposure to a global Shared Service Center environment.

• Competitive salary.

• A collaborative and supportive team environment that values your development and continuous learning.

• Flexible working hours according to your studies.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changi

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
On en Roche

Looking to launch your career in healthcare and make a real impact from day one?
Join a global leader in diagnostics and be part of shaping the future of healthcare operations, finance, and supply chain at scale.

What is it?

• ON en Roche is a 2-year rotational graduate program within Finance & Operations designed for high-potential early-career professionals.

• From day one, you will take ownership of real business challenges that directly impact operations, customer experience, and Roche’s end-to-end value chain.

• You will rotate across different areas within Finance & Operations, gaining hands-on experience and a holistic understanding of how a global healthcare organization operates.

• The program is designed to accelerate your development through structured rotations, cross-functional exposure, and continuous learning.

Why join?

• Real ownership from day one on business-critical challenges

• Exposure to an end-to-end healthcare value chain at global scale

• Rotations across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations

• High-impact projects with international and cross-functional teams

• Structured development, mentoring, and continuous feedback

• Clear fast-track career progression within Roche

The Opportunity

Optimize real-world operations by improving efficiency, scalability, and digital transformation in industrial environments.

Rotations may include:

• Site Operations

• Warehouse operations & material flow

• Customer Fulfillment & Service Operations

• Direct Procurement

The Position

• Support site capacity planning and growth readiness

• Improve warehouse layout, material flow, and productivity

• Analyze operational flows to identify improvement opportunities

• Contribute to automation, analytics, and process redesign projects

• Translate operational data into actionable insights

Who you are

We are looking for high-potential early-career professionals with a strong analytical mindset and motivation to build a career in healthcare and operations.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations - focused profiles , or related fields

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Fluent Spanish and English (written and spoken)

• Interest in healthcare, operations, and data-driven environments

• Full availability for a 24-month program

Timelines & further information

• Full-time 24-month graduate contract (not a university internship agreement)

• Based in Sant Cugat (Barcelona)

• Start date: September 2026

• Assessment Center: July 15th

• Applications reviewed on a rolling basis

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
On en Roche

Looking to launch your career in healthcare and make a real impact from day one?
Join a global leader in diagnostics and be part of shaping the future of healthcare operations, finance, and supply chain at scale.

What is it?

• ON en Roche is a 2-year rotational graduate program within Finance & Operations designed for high-potential early-career professionals.

• From day one, you will take ownership of real business challenges that directly impact operations, customer experience, and Roche’s end-to-end value chain.

• You will rotate across different areas within Finance & Operations, gaining hands-on experience and a holistic understanding of how a global healthcare organization operates.

• The program is designed to accelerate your development through structured rotations, cross-functional exposure, and continuous learning.

Why join?

• Real ownership from day one on business-critical challenges

• Exposure to an end-to-end healthcare value chain at global scale

• Rotations across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations

• High-impact projects with international and cross-functional teams

• Structured development, mentoring, and continuous feedback

• Clear fast-track career progression within Roche

The Opportunity

Enhance global supply chain performance through analytics, planning, and service optimization. Get familiar with the entire order fulfillment process and how we support our customers on a daily basis.
Rotations may include:

• Demand & Supply Planning

• Transport & 3PL Network Management

• Order management & customer collaboration

The Position

• Monitor and analyze key supply chain KPIs

• Support demand and supply planning activities

• Manage small scale projects within some of the Supply Chain areas, participate in the daily operations to get to know the activities like e.g. in order management & customer collaboration.

• Contribute to inventory optimization and stock management

• Collaborate with logistics partners to ensure reliable delivery

• Support projects for network optimization and process improvement initiatives

• Prepare insights and reports for decision-making

Who you are

We are looking for high-potential early-career professionals with a strong analytical mindset and motivation to build a career in healthcare and operations.
You should have:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Supply Chain , analytics profiles or related fields

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Fluent Spanish and English (written and spoken)

• Interest in healthcare, operations, and data-driven environments

• Full availability for a 24-month program

Timelines & further information

• Full-time 24-month graduate contract (not a university internship agreement)

• Based in Sant Cugat (Barcelona)

• Start date: September 2026

• Assessment Center: July 15th

• Applications reviewed on a rolling basis

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal
