jobs.title: Medical Affairs Advisor
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
Roche Diagnostics provides integrated solutions for diagnostics testing in commercial and hospital labs, medical centers and laboratory networks. Our products and solutions support healthcare professionals in clinical decision making in a wide field of indications .
Within the Healthcare Transformation and Access Department, we are seeking a Medical Affairs Advisor Advisor to provide medical and scientific support for our solutions with an initial core focus on Oncology diseases. The Medical Affairs Partner is a field-based medical expert in one or more therapeutic areas, responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) in order to create a better understanding of products and increase disease/product awareness, providing clinical and scientific support for HCPs, and providing medical information for our products to patients, caregivers, and the general public.

Role scope:

Key responsibilities

• Drives business-aligned medical strategy by leading annual and ongoing medical planning, including inputs on situational analyses and strategies

• Plan and implement medical tactics and activities for assigned therapeutic areas

• Plan and handle medical budgets

• Communicate, drive, and handle clinical research/study for medical evidence generation that helps practitioners, patients and payers make good health care decisions

• Establish and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) to create a better understanding of the company’s products and increase disease/product awareness

• Provide clinical and scientific support for HCPs, including answering questions about products and other related issues

• Prepare and deliver presentations on the therapeutic areas and company products, and participate in panel discussions

• Keep up to date on scientific and clinical developments in the therapeutic areas, and provide medical information to internal and external customers

• Review of non-, and promotional materials

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

Additional task, duties and responsibilities:

• Responsible for acting in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice (such as Roche Code of Conduct and any other Roche directives and guidelines)

• Work in a cross functional setup applying agile working methodology

• Ensure compliance with HCP interaction guidelines (e.g. iHCP) , and other guidelines from Roche quality and compliance groups

Requirements:
Education and experience

• Master’s degree or higher in science or related fields

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the life sciences industry (diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or biotechnology).

• Hands-on experience in medical affairs, clinical development, scientific communication, or product strategy .

• Prior experience in Oncology diseases is highly preferred.

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

Required skills and qualifications

• Good knowledge of Compliance requirements and clear understanding of high standards of Integrity

• Scientific and commercial understanding of diagnostic products, knowledge of product development and tri

• Review of non-, and promotional materials

• Responsible for acting in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice (such as Roche Code of Conduct and any other Roche directives and guidelines)
• Work in a cross functional setup applying agile working methodology
• Ensure compliance with HCP interaction guidelines (e.g. iHCP) , and other guidelines from Roche quality and compliance groups Requirements: Education and experience

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the life sciences industry (diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or biotechnology).
• Hands-on experience in medical affairs, clinical development, scientific communication, or product strategy .

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As the Commercial Business Leader (CBL) for Foundation Medicine, you will work within an innovative ecosystem led by Foundation Medicine, a pioneer with over 15 years of leadership in combining scientific and technology advancement with transformative treatment strategies. At Roche, we are committed to transforming healthcare and making a positive impact on patients' lives. Joining our team means contributing to driving healthcare transformation on a global scale within a dynamic environment that fosters collaboration and excellence.
In this high-impact role, you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of Precision Medicine on a global scale and ensure that our innovative solutions translate into life-changing benefits for patients across the globe. As a core member of the International Business Team (IBT), you will represent the International Commercial Business Unit, serving as the strategic bridge between global functions and regional/local execution. In this capacity, you will act as the primary Commercial Liaison to the FMI Business Area, bringing the "Voice of the Customer" to the forefront of the organization to inform product requirements and shape portfolio priorities.

The Opportunity

• Commercial Strategy & Execution: Drive the design, execution, and prioritization of commercial strategies, operating models, and key strategic projects (e.g., squads, communities of practice) for International Markets in collaboration with the regions.

• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: Act as the Commercial Liaison to the corresponding Business Area, Pharma, and Disease Area Network, representing the customer voice of International Markets to prioritize the product portfolio roadmap.

• Affiliate Support & Market Expansion: Steer the business, support affiliates with diverse business needs, drive the successful implementation of FMI products, identify new market opportunities/trends, and manage market risks as defined in the Business Plan and P&L.

• High-Stakes & Stakeholder Management: Support affiliates in high-stakes/C-level customer meetings (e.g., top hospitals, labs, payers), provide central resources for contract negotiations/tenders, and accelerate cross-functional synergies across FMI IBTs, iKAMs, and Pharma.

• Disease Management Integration: Ensure the integration of your focus area into an overall disease management approach where applicable, collaborating closely with Medical & Government Affairs / MAx and the regional strategy and innovation chapter.

• Change & Risk Management: Drive organizational changes, develop regional networking concepts, anticipate risk scenarios, and establish suitable risk management and mitigation strategies.

• Financial Planning: Collaborate with other commercial business leaders and finance to prepare, track, and adjust the International Business budget and business planning in response to internal and external influences.

Who You Are

• Experienced Commercial Leader: Holds a minimum of a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) with at least 7 years of experience in IVD or related sectors, a strong track record of strategic commercial decision-making, and preferred experience in a customer-facing or field-based role.

• Strategic & Business Acumen: Demonstrates proven strategic agility to translate broad conceptual plans into simplified actions, strong business acumen, and a robust understanding of the clinical/prescriber market (e.g., Oncology care) and healthcare systems.

• Project & Change Champion: P

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come Commercial Business Leader (CBL) per Foundation Medicine Institute, lavorerai all'interno di un ecosistema innovativo guidato da Foundation Medicine, un pioniere con oltre 15 anni di leadership nel combinare il progresso scientifico e tecnologico con le strategie di trattamento trasformativo. A Roche, ci impegniamo a trasformare la salute e ad avere un impatto positivo sulla vita dei pazienti. Unire il nostro team significa contribuire a promuovere la trasformazione della salute su scala globale in un ambiente dinamico che favorisce la collaborazione e l'eccellenza. In questo ruolo di alto impatto, avrete l'opportunità unica di plasmare il futuro della Medicina di Precisione su scala globale e garantire che le nostre soluzioni innovative traducono in benefici che cambiano la vita per i pazienti di tutto il mondo. Come membro centrale del International Business Team (IBT), rappresenterai l'International Commercial Business Unit, che fungerà da ponte strategico tra le funzioni globali e l'esecuzione regionale/locale. In questa capacità, si agirà come principale Collegamento Commerciale all'Area Business FMI, portando la "Voce del Cliente" all'avanguardia dell'organizzazione per informare i requisiti del prodotto e modellare le priorità del portafoglio. L'opportunità
• Strategia commerciale e esecuzione: guidare la progettazione, l'esecuzione e la priorità delle strategie commerciali, dei modelli operativi e dei progetti strategici chiave (ad esempio, le squadre, le comunità di pratica) per i mercati internazionali in collaborazione con le regioni.
• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: agire come collegamento commerciale alla corrispondente Business Area, Pharma e Rete Area Malattia, che rappresenta la voce del cliente dei mercati internazionali per dare priorità alla roadmap del portafoglio prodotti.
• Supporto affiliato & Market Expansion: Steer the business, supporto affiliati con diverse esigenze aziendali, guidare la riuscita implementazione dei prodotti FMI, identificare nuove opportunità di mercato / corsi, e gestire i rischi di mercato come definito nel Business Plan e P&L.
• High-Stakes & Stakeholder Management: Support affiliati in riunioni di clienti di alto livello / C (ad esempio, ospedali di alto livello, laboratori, paganti), fornire risorse centrali per trattative di contratto / clienti, e accelerare sinergie trasversali attraverso FMI IBT, iKAMs e Pharma.
• Integrazione della gestione delle malattie: assicurare l'integrazione della vostra area di attenzione in un approccio globale di gestione delle malattie, ove applicabile, collaborando strettamente con gli Affari medici e governativi / MAx e il capitolo della strategia regionale e innovazione.
• Change & Risk Management: Guidare cambiamenti organizzativi, sviluppare concetti di rete regionale, anticipare scenari di rischio, e stabilire adeguate strategie di gestione del rischio e mitigazione.
• Pianificazione finanziaria: collaborare con altri leader commerciali e finanza per preparare, tracciare e regolare il budget e la pianificazione aziendale internazionale in risposta alle influenze interne ed esterne. Chi sei
• Leader commerciale esperto: possiede un minimo di un diploma di laurea (o equivalente) con almeno 7 anni di esperienza in settori IVD o correlati, un forte record di decisioni commerciali strategiche, e l'esperienza preferita in un ruolo orientato al cliente o sul campo.
• Acume Strategico & Business: Dimostra l'agilità strategica comprovata per tradurre ampi piani concettuali in azioni semplificate, forte acume aziendale, e una solida comprensione del mercato clinico/prescrittivo (ad esempio, cura Oncologia) e sistemi sanitari.
• Progetto e cambiamento C

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Als Commercial Business Leader (CBL) for Foundation Medicine Institute arbeiten Sie in einem innovativen Ökosystem unter der Leitung von Foundation Medicine, einem Pionier mit über 15 Jahren Führungskraft bei der Kombination von wissenschaftlichen und technologischen Fortschritten mit transformativen Behandlungsstrategien. Bei Roche sind wir verpflichtet, die Gesundheitsversorgung zu transformieren und positive Auswirkungen auf das Leben der Patienten zu haben. Das Mitmachen unseres Teams bedeutet, in einem dynamischen Umfeld, das die Zusammenarbeit und Exzellenz fördert, einen Beitrag zur weltweiten Gesundheitstransformation zu leisten. In dieser wirkungsstarken Rolle haben Sie die einzigartige Möglichkeit, die Zukunft der Präzisionsmedizin global zu gestalten und sicherzustellen, dass unsere innovativen Lösungen weltweit zu lebensverändernden Vorteilen für Patienten übergehen. Als zentrales Mitglied des International Business Teams (IBT) vertreten Sie die International Commercial Business Unit, die als strategische Brücke zwischen globalen Funktionen und regionaler/lokaler Ausführung dient. In dieser Funktion fungieren Sie als primäre kommerzielle Verbindung zum FMI Business Area und bringen die "Voice of the Customer" an die Spitze der Organisation, um Produktanforderungen zu informieren und Portfolioprioritäten zu formen. Die Chance
• Kommerzielle Strategie & Ausführung: Fahren Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit den Regionen mit der Gestaltung, Durchführung und Priorisierung von Handelsstrategien, Betriebsmodellen und strategischen Schlüsselprojekten (z.B. Quads, Praxisgemeinschaften) für den internationalen Markt.

• Affiliate Support & Market Expansion: Geschäftsführung, Support-Partner mit unterschiedlichen Geschäftsanforderungen, die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von FMI-Produkten, die Identifizierung neuer Marktchancen/Trends und die Bewältigung von Marktrisiken im Geschäftsplan und P&L.
• High-Stakes & Stakeholder Management: Support-Partner bei High-Stakes/C-Level-Kundensitzungen (z.B. Top-Krankenhäuser, Labore, Zahler), bieten zentrale Ressourcen für Vertragsverhandlungen/Tender und beschleunigen funktionsübergreifende Synergien über FMI IBTs, iKAMs und Pharma.
• Integration des Krankheitsmanagements: Stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihr Schwerpunktgebiet in einen Gesamtansatz des Krankheitsmanagements eingebunden wird, der eng mit Medical & Government Affairs / MAx und dem regionalen Strategie- und Innovationskapitel zusammenarbeitet.
• Change & Risk Management: Organisationsänderungen antreiben, regionale Netzwerkkonzepte entwickeln, Risikoszenarien antizipieren und geeignete Risikomanagement- und Minderungsstrategien etablieren.
• Finanzplanung: Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Führungskräften und Finanzen für die Vorbereitung, Verfolgung und Anpassung des International Business Budgets und der Geschäftsplanung in Reaktion auf interne und externe Einflüsse. Wer bist du?
• Erfahrener Handelsführer: Erhält ein Minimum eines Bachelor-Abschlusses (oder gleichwertig) mit mindestens 7 Jahren Erfahrung in IVD oder verwandten Sektoren, eine starke Erfolgsbilanz der strategischen kommerziellen Entscheidungsfindung und bevorzugte Erfahrung in einer kundenorientierten oder feldbasierten Rolle.
• Strategische & Business-Acumen: Demonstrate bewährte strategische Agilität, um breite konzeptionelle Pläne in vereinfachte Aktionen, starkes Business-Acumen und ein robustes Verständnis des klinischen/Präscriber-Marktes (z.B. Oncology Care) und Gesundheitssysteme zu übersetzen.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que chef commercial (CBL) de la Fondation Medicine Institute, vous travaillerez au sein d'un écosystème novateur dirigé par Foundation Medicine, un pionnier de plus de 15 ans de leadership dans la combinaison des progrès scientifiques et technologiques avec des stratégies de traitement transformatrices. Chez Roche, nous nous engageons à transformer les soins de santé et à avoir un impact positif sur la vie des patients. Rejoindre notre équipe signifie contribuer à la transformation des soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale dans un environnement dynamique qui favorise la collaboration et l'excellence. Dans ce rôle à impact élevé, vous aurez l'occasion unique de façonner l'avenir de la médecine de précision à l'échelle mondiale et de veiller à ce que nos solutions innovantes se traduisent par des avantages qui changent la vie des patients à travers le monde. En tant que membre principal de l'International Business Team (IBT), vous représenterez l'International Commercial Business Unit, servant de pont stratégique entre les fonctions mondiales et l'exécution régionale/locale. À ce titre, vous agirez en tant que principale liaison commerciale avec le secteur d'activité de l'IMF, en mettant la « voix du client » au premier plan de l'organisation pour informer les exigences du produit et façonner les priorités du portefeuille. L'opportunité
• Stratégie commerciale et exécution: Diriger la conception, l'exécution et la hiérarchisation des stratégies commerciales, des modèles opérationnels et des projets stratégiques clés (par exemple, les équipes, les communautés de pratique) pour les marchés internationaux en collaboration avec les régions.
• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: Agir comme la liaison commerciale avec le Business Area, Pharma, et le réseau correspondant, représentant la voix des clients des marchés internationaux pour prioriser la feuille de route du portefeuille de produits.
• Soutien aux filiales et expansion du marché : dirigez l'entreprise, soutenez les filiales ayant des besoins d'affaires variés, dirigez la mise en oeuvre réussie des produits de l'IMF, identifiez de nouvelles opportunités/tendances du marché et gérez les risques du marché tels que définis dans le plan d'affaires et P&L.
• Hautes étapes et gestion des parties prenantes: soutenir les filiales dans les réunions de clients de haut niveau/C (p. ex., les hôpitaux de haut niveau, les laboratoires, les payeurs), fournir des ressources centrales pour les négociations contractuelles/appels d'offres, et accélérer les synergies interfonctionnelles entre les IBT de l'IMF, les iKAM et les Pharma.
• Intégration de la gestion des maladies : assurez l'intégration de votre domaine d'intervention dans une approche globale de gestion des maladies, le cas échéant, en collaborant étroitement avec les Affaires médicales et gouvernementales/MAx et le chapitre sur la stratégie régionale et l'innovation.
• Changement et gestion des risques: Diriger les changements organisationnels, élaborer des concepts de réseautage régional, anticiper les scénarios de risque et établir des stratégies appropriées de gestion et d'atténuation des risques.
• Planification financière: Collaborer avec d'autres chefs d'entreprise et de finance pour préparer, suivre et ajuster le budget des affaires internationales et la planification des affaires en réponse aux influences internes et externes. Qui vous êtes
• Leader commercial expérimenté : est titulaire d'un baccalauréat (ou d'un équivalent) d'au moins 7 ans d'expérience en DIV ou dans des secteurs connexes, d'une solide expérience en matière de prise de décisions commerciales stratégiques et d'une expérience privilégiée dans un rôle axé sur le client ou sur le terrain.
• Œuvre stratégique et d'affaires : Démontre une agilité stratégique éprouvée pour traduire des plans conceptuels généraux en actions simplifiées, un Œuvre forte d'affaires et une solide compréhension du marché clinique/prescripteur (par exemple, les soins oncologiques) et des systèmes de santé.
• Projet & Changement C

jobs.title: Near Patient Care Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a Near Patient Care Sales Specialist based in Ireland (ideally Dublin area).

Job Summary

As a Near Patient Care Sales Specialist at Roche Diagnostics Ltd. in Ireland, you are at the forefront of the healthcare revolution, moving diagnostics closer to the patient to enable faster, more clinical decision-making. You will manage a high-value portfolio—including Point-of-Care (POC) and associated digital solutions—across hospitals, HSE clinics, and community care settings.

• Location: Field-based (Ireland).

• Role Type: Permanent

• Company: Roche Diagnostics Ltd.

• Primary Goal: To drive the adoption of "Near Patient Care" technologies, ensuring healthcare providers have the tools to deliver real-time results that improve patient outcomes and hospital efficiencies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Sales & Territory Management

• Drive Revenue: Meet and exceed sales targets for the Near Patient Care portfolio (e.g., blood gas, glucose monitoring, and rapid diagnostic platforms).

• Market Growth: Identify new business opportunities within the HSE, private hospitals, and community health districts.

• Tender Management: Lead and contribute to complex tender submissions for business acquisition and retention within the Irish healthcare landscape.

2. Customer Partnership & Consultation

• Relationship Building: Nurture deep relationships with key stakeholders, including Hospital Managers, Laboratory Directors, Point of Care Coordinators, and HSE procurement.

• Solution Selling: Consult with clinical teams to understand their workflow challenges and develop tailored diagnostic solutions that enhance service delivery.

• Clinical Education: Provide high-quality product demonstrations and in-service training for healthcare professionals to ensure the effective use of Roche technology.

3. Market Intelligence & Analysis

• Competitive Awareness: Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and emerging technologies to inform strategic sales planning.

• CRM Management: Maintain accurate records and sales pipelines within Salesforce to support forecasting and territory reporting.

Requirements & Qualifications

Essential:

• Education: Degree level in Life Sciences, Biomedical Science, or a related field.

• Experience: Proven track record in medical device or diagnostic sales with experience in the Irish HSE ecosystem.

• License: Full, clean driving license.

• Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and "respectfully challenge the status quo".

Desirable:

• Point-of-Care Expertise: Specific knowledge of "Near Patient" or Point of Care (POC) diagnostic workflows.

• Agile Mindset: Ability to work in an agile environment and adapt to a rapidly evolving pathology pipeline.

Why Join Roche?

• Impact: Be part of a global leader that aims to "prevent, stop, and cure diseases" by ensuring access to healthcare today and for generations to come.

• Culture: A collaborative environment that encourages "personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections".

• Growth: Extensive opportunities for professional development and career progression within the broader Roche network.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines

titleByLocale.it: Guida del catalizzatore del valore di AI

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
This role serves as a strategic leader driving the scaling and value acceleration of Roche’s AI and digital healthcare solutions from “10 to 100.” You will lead a hybrid team of AI Solution Catalyst Managers and Incubator & Partnership Managers to expand application scenarios, accelerate ecosystem adoption, and strengthen Roche’s leadership positioning in AI & Digital
healthcare through ecosystem collaboration and innovation initiatives. The mandate is anchored in two core pillars:
1. AI Solution Value Amplification & Scaling
Accelerating the adoption, expansion, and measurable value realization of Roche’s established AI and digital solutions across internal and external healthcare ecosystems.
2. Ecosystem Architecture & Policy Shaping
Building strategic partnerships, influencing healthcare innovation dialogue, and shaping policy and ecosystem mechanisms that enable sustainable AI healthcare transformation.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. AI Solution Value Amplification & Scaling
Lead the strategic scaling and value acceleration of Roche AI and digital healthcare solutions by expanding application scenarios, accelerating ecosystem adoption, and establishing scalable value realization models.
➢ Scaling Strategy, Scenario Expansion & Product Generalization:
Drive the “10 to 100” scaling strategy for Roche AI and digital solutions by identifying scalable application scenarios, healthcare customer groups, and ecosystem opportunities, while translating successful pilots into reusable healthcare solution models.
➢ Customer Adoption & Value Realization:
Drive the adoption and integration of Roche AI solutions across hospitals, HCPs, and ecosystem partners through effective deployment strategies, value demonstration frameworks, and measurable clinical and business impact validation.
➢ Strategic Storytelling & Scaling Optimization:
Translate complex AI capabilities into compelling healthcare and business narratives while leveraging real-world insights and ecosystem feedback to continuously optimize solution positioning and scaling strategy.
2. Ecosystem Architecture, Policy Shaping & Healthcare Value Acceleration
Architect and orchestrate a sustainable healthcare innovation ecosystem that accelerates AI solution value release through strategic partnerships, ecosystem collaboration, innovation platforms, and policy engagement.
➢ Healthcare Ecosystem Architecture & Digital Intelligence Incubator Leadership:
Build strategic collaborations with hospitals, academic institutions and other ecosystem stakeholders. Through the Digital Intelligence Incubator, connect healthcare scenarios, validation resources, ecosystem partners to accelerate solution maturation and value realization.
➢ Healthcare Value Model Exploration & Policy Shaping:
Explore innovative healthcare value frameworks, collaboration mechanisms, reimbursement pathways, and policy engagement opportunities that unlock sustainable value creation for patients and healthcare systems.
➢ Innovation Platform, External Engagement & Thought Leadership:
Lead ecosystem collaborations, and strategic engagement initiatives [e.g., WAIC, CIIE…] to strengthen Roche’s leadership positioning in AI & Digital healthcare and identify future ecosystem opportunities.
3. Team Leadership & Capability Development
Manage and mentor a hybrid team composed of AI Solution Catalyst Managers and Incubator & Partnership Managers to accelerate AI solution scaling, ecosystem collabor

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Roche UK

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

The Opportunity

Imagine working for an organization that puts people at the heart of everything they do, where your contributions directly impact patient outcomes. At Roche, our number one priority is our patients, and we believe that every person plays a key role in achieving this mission.
As a Regulatory Partner at Roche UK, you will be a vital part of our UK Regulatory Chapter. You will leverage your regulatory and scientific expertise to shape and drive strategic initiatives. This is your opportunity to make a difference and be part of a company dedicated to improving lives.

UK Regulatory Group Responsibilities
The Regulatory group collaborates with the wider business to translate the constantly evolving requirements of the UK regulatory environment into Roche policies, procedures, solutions, and strategies that ensure compliance and maximize the value for patients.
Our activities encompass:

• Clinical Trial Applications

• National Licensing Applications

• Early Access to Medicines Applications

• National components of medicines authorization via the European Centralized procedure

The team serves as Roche's primary contact with the MHRA, requiring effective cross-functional collaboration at both local and global levels, as well as the capability to negotiate and influence externally. Regulatory Partners need to be adaptable and entrepreneurial to identify opportunities, while maintaining a focused approach on ensuring compliance and playing a key role in retaining Roche UK's License to Operate.

Who You Are
You are a passionate regulatory expert with a clear vision for improving patient outcomes. With broad and comprehensive expertise within the UK regulatory environment, you will lead foundational work and partner with the business to solve complex regulatory issues impacting the chapter and/or wider business. You will contribute to the development of squad/chapter-based strategic plans and goals, and actively participate in the learning and development of other chapter members. You will have the ability to understand scientific and technical information relating to an assigned portfolio of Roche products.

You also bring :

• A Scientific University degree

• Extensive experience in UK Regulatory Affairs

• Proven experience managing UK submissions post-Brexit

• Experience providing strategic and technical advice

• In-depth knowledge and experience of UK and EU regulatory requirements and procedures

• A proven track record of developing, implementing, and communicating regulatory strategies

• Excellent documentation skills to ensure high-quality and timely submissions

• Experience as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in defined subject areas or therapeutic areas

• Experience in mentoring peers, as well as managing stakeholder relationships

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst - Monitoring & Incident Response
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Cybersecurity Analyst (Incident Response Operations)

The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a CyberSecurity Analyst, you will help protect proprietary information, patient data, keep computer systems clean, and provide a safe information environment for our users. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems.

As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents.

Responsibilities:

• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment

• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information

• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts

• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents

• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations

• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team

• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group

• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management

• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes

• Mentor newer team members

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment

• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices

• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience

• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents

• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts

• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)

• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)

• Excellent organization and communication skills.

• Fluent spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications:

• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment

• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring

• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)

• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)

• A passion for the field of computer and network security

• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets

• Public speaking or mentoring experience

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build

jobs.title: Field Application Specialist (Specialty_Aragón)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
En Roche Diagnostica España, estamos comprometidos no sólo con el avance de soluciones diagnósticas que puedan ayudar a los profesionales sanitarios a tomar decisiones críticas para la salud de sus pacientes, sino también con la mejora de la forma en que estas herramientas esenciales se integran en los sistemas sanitarios de todo el mundo, a un coste menor, sin dejar de obtener los mejores resultados posibles.
En más de 100 países, ofrecemos la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector, combinada con apoyo a la toma de decisiones clínicas, consultoría, diagnóstico digital, gestión de enfermedades, automatización de laboratorios y soluciones de software para proporcionar soluciones integradas a laboratorios, clínicos y sistemas sanitarios.

Principales responsabilidades:

• Responsable de la instalación y de la configuración de los analizadores en el laboratorio del cliente acordados conforme a los requisitos y los estándares de la compañía.

• Responsable de la formación a cliente/usuario, de los analizadores instalados conforme a los requisitos y los estándares de la compañía.

• Atiende a los clientes de acuerdo con responsabilidades previamente atribuidas (predominantemente jefe de laboratorio, jefe de sección, adjunto, técnico de laboratorio).

• Proporciona información científica y técnica a los clientes.

• Coordinación con los técnicos de mantenimiento para garantizar que la instalación se ejecute en el plazo establecido.

• Garantiza un uso óptimo de los instrumentos en el laboratorio del cliente y de las soluciones instaladas.

• Gestionar el cumplimiento de los estándares corporativos y divisionales para instalaciones, formación y entrenamiento a clientes, calidad, desarrollo de aplicaciones y seguimiento a productos de Roche.

• Implementación de los planes de acción anuales definidos por la dirección de Roche Diagnostics y de Customer Support dentro de la actividad de instalación.

• Planificar y coordinar con la red de ventas las instalaciones, presentaciones y pruebas de productos a clientes.

• Soporte al equipo de Ventas y Marketing para optimizar las operaciones comerciales participando en las fases de preventa, venta y postventa de las oportunidades comerciales manteniendo el ciclo de vida del cliente.

• Optimizar y mejorar el proceso de instalación, configuración y formación al usuario garantizando la sostenibilidad y la satisfacción del cliente utilizando las herramientas digitales que provee la compañía.

• Monitorización: Incorporar y promover el uso de herramientas digitales en el seguimiento de los clientes asignados para evolucionar hacia un modelo de servicio más eficiente, proactivo y orientado a maximizar la experiencia del cliente.

• Reporte y calidad: Registrar te en el CRM todas las actividades realizadas (remotas o in situ), garantizando la correcta documentación y actualización de las características técnicas de la instalación según los estándares de la organización.

• Planificación: Asegurar el seguimiento y cumplimiento en tiempo y forma de las modificaciones y mantenimientos mediante el uso del Dashboard de Servicio, en las cuentas asignadas.

Who You Are:

• Ciencias de la Salud o similares (Licenciatura o Grado)

• Máster Universitario

• Experiencia requerida: mínimo de 2 a 5 años de experiencia en una posición similar dentro del sector diagnóstico/in vitro

• Nivel fluido de español

• Buen nivel de inglés

• Movilidad geográfica en el territorio nacional

• Residencia en Zaragoza

Other Compet

jobs.title: Medical Communication Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
This role serves as a hybrid strategic leader, combining the leadership of a composite team (comprising Medical Information & Medical Review and AI Product) with the development of a data- and AI-driven medical communication strategy.
The mandate is anchored in establishing a "data-driven medical communication flywheel": leveraging AI to proactively capture customer perception insights, building personalized content generation platforms, and developing localized digital education platforms to empower strategic business decisions. Furthermore, the role drives the transformation of traditional MI and MR business models through the introduction of Agent technologies, forging a new paradigm of human-machine collaboration in medical inquiries and automated pre-approvals to accelerate internal process efficiencies and support high-quality business growth under strict compliance standards.

Principal Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. AI-Driven Strategy & Flywheel Construction Development and execution of a long-term, data-centric medical communication strategy, ensuring strict alignment with overarching business goals.

• Proactive Insight Generation: Leadership in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Social Listening) to proactively capture and analyze customer behaviors and perceptions, identifying market trends and opportunities to provide data-backed support for business decisions.

• Content Generation Platform & Impact: Establishment of a robust content generation platform to significantly accelerate the production speed of high-quality medical education materials. Leadership in the rapid construction of core scientific messaging and educational content derived from AI-driven insights to effectively influence and transform customer perceptions and clinical behaviors.

• Personalized Platform Development: Oversight of the construction of personalized content generation platforms and localized digital education platforms to ensure the medical value proposition is delivered precisely and efficiently based on targeted user personas.

2. Digital Product & Solution Leadership Lead the development, evolution, and ecosystem cooperation for strategic digital assets, ensuring they deliver measurable value to patients and the healthcare system.

• Portfolio Lifecycle Management: Oversee the roadmap and execution of key AI solutions, specifically, Social Listening, Content Generation, Digital Communication, MI Agent, and MR Agent.

• Agile Iteration: Driving the continuous iteration of cutting-edge technologies, such as Large Language Models (LLMs), within medical communication scenarios to optimize product performance in an evolving market landscape.

3. AI Agent Innovation & Human-Machine Collaboration

• Traditional Business Transformation: Leading the introduction and deployment of MI Agents and MR Agents to fundamentally revolutionize traditional medical information inquiries and compliance review workflows.

• Model Innovation: Establishment of a human-machine collaboration model for medical Q&A (MI Agent) and automated pre-approvals (MR Agent) to achieve a quantum leap in business responsiveness while ensuring 100% adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements.

4. Team Leadership & Capability Development Management and mentorship of a hybrid team of MI/MR and AI Product.

• Team Synergy: Elimination of functional barrier between traditional medical communication operations and technical product management

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
Wir suchen innerhalb der Funktion QC Packaging Material & Devices als Teil der Qualitätskontrolle BS/KAU ein neues Teammitglied für die Unit Packaging Speed Testing. Das Team Packaging Speed Testing überprüft die Qualität der Packmaterialien (z.B. Faltschachteln, Spritzen, Autoinjektoren), bevor diese im Verpackungsbetrieb, Entwicklung, Clinical Supply oder in den Abfüllbetrieben eingesetzt werden können.

Die Möglichkeit

• Durchführung von Packmittel Prüfungen gemäss Prüfvorschriften und Prüfmethoden

• Anwendung physikalischer Prüfmethoden nach Vorgaben in Prüfvorschriften

• Sicherstellung der strikten Einhaltung der guten Herstellungspraxis (cGMP)

• Bedienung einfacher Geräte sowie Initialisierung von Musterzügen

• Dokumentation der Prüfergebnisse im SAP. System. Vergleich von Messwerten mit der Spezifikation und Dokumentation der Ergebnisse.

• Durchführen von Chargenreview

• Projektleitung: Verbesserungsprojekte, Selbstorganisation, 5S, Prozessoptimierungen, Innovationen und Investitionen

• Weiterentwicklung der Selbstorganisation beider Circles

• Organisationsentwicklung durch “out of the box” thinking

Wer du bist

• Technische Ausbildung mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung sowie Berufserfahrung im GxP-Bereich

jobs.title: Medical Director (MD), Multiple Sclerosis
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche's Clinical Development organization is structured by therapeutic area and is responsible for developing and executing late-stage development (Phase II–III) clinical strategies that deliver medically differentiated therapies for patients. We are seeking a highly motivated Medical Director (grading commensurate with experience) to join our Neuroimmunology team, specifically focusing on Multiple Sclerosis (MS).

The Opportunity

As a Medical Director, you will participate in or lead the development of Clinical Development (CD) plans, ensuring the effective execution of strategies for assigned molecules and indications. This is a junior to mid-level individual contributor position without people management responsibilities. The Opportunity
To help us deliver life-changing therapies to patients, you will take on a vital role in our Neuroimmunology team and drive the following key responsibilities:

• CDP Strategy and Planning: Lead or contribute to the creation of the Clinical Development Plan (CDP), gathering data to ensure strategic alignment with long-term lifecycle plans.

• Study Design and Execution: Lead the design and execution of Phase II and III clinical studies, collaborating with cross-functional teams on study analytics, data management, and safety profiles.

• Scientific Leadership: Maintain the highest levels of scientific and clinical knowledge within the MS and Neuroimmunology therapeutic areas.

• Regulatory Engagement: Take an active role in Health Authority (HA) interactions and provide clinical expertise for regulatory filings, briefing packages, and labeling.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Build and cultivate relationships with clinical investigators, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and internal partners across research, commercial operations, and legal.

• Medical Monitoring: Act as a medical monitor for assigned studies, ensuring the correct interpretation of medical and scientific data.

Who You Are

We are looking for a resilient, scientifically driven expert who brings a blend of advanced clinical knowledge and collaborative leadership to our team:

• Academic & Clinical Expertise: M.D. required with relevant clinical experience as a Neurologist, including specialized training or a significant background working with Multiple Sclerosis patients.

• Scientific & Industry Experience: Strong scientific background (publishing in peer-reviewed journals, academic, or teaching background is a plus) alongside preferred prior industry experience in MS clinical development (>2 years) or recognition as an MS field expert (e.g., Assistant Professor).

• Clinical Trials & Regulatory Knowledge: Significant experience designing/conducting clinical trials, a strong understanding of Phase II–III drug development, and required knowledge of GCP, ICH, FDA, and EMA guidelines (preferred for entry-level candidates).

• Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills to present complex data, paired with the ability to build relationships and influence without authority in a complex, cross-functional environment.

• Strategic Leadership & Mobility: Sound judgment for ethical and business decision-making, strong cross-functional leadership acumen, and the ability to travel globally up to 30%.

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!

Who we are

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Costruire e coltivare i rapporti con gli investigatori clinici, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), e partner interni in materia di ricerca, operazioni commerciali e legali.
• Monitoraggio medico: agire come monitor medico per gli studi assegnati, garantendo la corretta interpretazione dei dati medici e scientifici. Chi sei Stiamo cercando un esperto resiliente e scientificamente guidato che porta una miscela di conoscenze cliniche avanzate e leadership collaborativa al nostro team:
• Academic & Clinical Expertise: M.D. richiesto con esperienza clinica rilevante come neurologo, tra cui formazione specializzata o uno sfondo significativo che lavora con pazienti con sclerosi multipla.
• Esperienza scientifica e industriale: forte background scientifico (publishing in peer-reviewed journals, accademico, o background di insegnamento è un plus) accanto all'esperienza del settore precedente preferita in MS sviluppo clinico (>2 anni) o il riconoscimento come esperto di campo MS (ad esempio, Professore Assistente).
• Studi clinici e conoscenza regolamentare: Esperienza significativa di progettazione/conduzione di studi clinici, una forte comprensione dello sviluppo della Fase II-III della droga, e la conoscenza richiesta di linee guida GCP, ICH, FDA e EMA (preferito per i candidati entry-level).
• Abilità comunicative e interpersonali: eccezionali capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali per presentare dati complessi, abbinati alla capacità di costruire relazioni e influenze senza autorità in un ambiente complesso e interfunzionale.
• Leadership strategica e mobilità: giudizio sonoro per il processo decisionale etico e commerciale, forte acume di leadership interfunzionale e la capacità di viaggiare a livello globale fino al 30%. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'organisme de développement clinique de Roche est structuré par domaine thérapeutique et est responsable de l'élaboration et de l'exécution de stratégies cliniques de développement en phase terminale (phase II–III) qui offrent des traitements différenciés sur le plan médical aux patients. Nous cherchons un directeur médical très motivé (en fonction de l'expérience) pour nous joindre à notre équipe de neuroimmunologie, en mettant l'accent sur la sclérose en plaques (SM). L'opportunité En tant que directeur médical, vous participerez ou dirigerez l'élaboration de plans de développement clinique (DC), assurant ainsi l'exécution efficace des stratégies pour les molécules et indications attribuées. Il s'agit d'un poste de cotisant individuel de niveau intermédiaire sans responsabilités de gestion des personnes. L'opportunité Pour nous aider à offrir des thérapies qui changent la vie aux patients, vous assumerez un rôle vital au sein de notre équipe de neuroimmunologie et assumerez les responsabilités clés suivantes :
• Stratégie et planification du PDC : Diriger ou contribuer à la création du Plan de développement clinique (PDC), recueillir des données pour assurer l'alignement stratégique sur les plans du cycle de vie à long terme.
• Conception et exécution de l'étude: Diriger la conception et l'exécution des études cliniques de phase II et III, en collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles sur l'analyse des études, la gestion des données et les profils de sécurité.
• Leadership scientifique : maintenir les niveaux les plus élevés de connaissances scientifiques et cliniques dans les domaines thérapeutiques de la sclérose en plaques et de la neuroimmunologie.
• Engagement en matière de réglementation : jouer un rôle actif dans les interactions entre les autorités sanitaires et fournir une expertise clinique pour les dossiers réglementaires, les trousses d'information et l'étiquetage.
• Collaboration avec les intervenants : établir et cultiver des relations avec les chercheurs cliniques, les leaders d'opinion clés (KOL) et les partenaires internes dans les domaines de la recherche, des opérations commerciales et du droit.
• Surveillance médicale: agir en tant que surveillance médicale pour les études attribuées, en assurant une interprétation correcte des données médicales et scientifiques. Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons un expert résilient et scientifique qui apporte un mélange de connaissances cliniques avancées et de leadership collaboratif à notre équipe :
• Expertise académique et clinique: M.D. nécessaire avec une expérience clinique pertinente en tant que neurologue, y compris une formation spécialisée ou une expérience importante de travail avec des patients atteints de sclérose en plaques.
• Expérience scientifique et industrielle : Une solide expérience scientifique (publication dans des revues, des études ou des cours évalués par des pairs) est en plus de l'expérience privilégiée de l'industrie dans le domaine du développement clinique de la SEP (>2 ans) ou de la reconnaissance en tant qu'expert de la SEP (p. ex. professeur adjoint).
• Essais cliniques et connaissances en matière de réglementation : expérience importante en matière de conception et de réalisation d'essais cliniques, bonne compréhension de la phase II–III du développement des médicaments et connaissance requise des lignes directrices du GCP, de l'ICH, de la FDA et de l'EMA (préférés pour les candidats de premier niveau).
• Compétences en communication et interpersonnelles : Compétences exceptionnelles en communication écrite et verbale pour présenter des données complexes, jumelées à la capacité d'établir des relations et une influence sans autorité dans un environnement complexe et interfonctionnel.
• Leadership stratégique et mobilité : un bon jugement pour la prise de décisions éthiques et commerciales, un leadership interfonctionnel fort et la capacité de voyager à l'échelle mondiale jusqu'à 30 %. titleByLocale.en: Senior Accounts Payable Accountant - Polish speaking

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

As a Senior Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and Polish

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste des comptes régionaux - Spectrométrie de masse

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
The Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry is specialized in launching, selling and promoting our breakthrough Mass Spectrometry solution to customers in the territory. Implements sales plans designed to achieve established revenue and financial goals. Accounts are key, highly strategic, and have complex requirements.

Responsible for significant key partner relationship management and development strategy for strategic accounts and ensures the strategy is executed. Sells the company's products or services to new accounts and/or expands existing accounts. Responsible for the development of new business opportunities or emerging areas. Focuses on critical, large, complex, highly visible, strategic or tactically important accounts. Develops and presents comprehensive financial proposals and contracts which enhance profitability and protect margins. Works in coordination with Account Managers to call on prospective and current customers. Conducts demonstration sessions on product characteristics. Involves technical personnel to resolve customer issues and problems as needed. May participate in the establishment of sales targets and design of the territory's sales plan, manages sales expenses.

Has broad expertise or unique knowledge in the lab testing segment and specific LC/MS experience is preferred. Uses skills to contribute to development of company objectives and principles and to achieve goals in creative and effective ways. Viewed as an expert by the company and in the field. Has complete knowledge of all Mass Spectrometry products and services and may be tasked with sales/development of new or strategic products. Works on significant and unique issues where analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of intangibles. Exercises independent judgment in methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Creates formal networks involving coordination among groups.

This is a field based role. The territory is Midwest US.

Job Facts:

• Manages and leads the development and implementation of capital equipment sales strategies to attain assigned sales objectives for highly strategic accounts

• Provides professional leadership in planning, organizing, and controlling balanced sales growth, continued account penetration, and customer satisfaction.

• Utilizes strong product/market knowledge and sales experience to manage complex sales and resolve customer questions and concerns.

• Retains, extends, and acquires customers through effective identification of opportunities and the creation and implementation of solutions.

• Establishes and builds strong client relationships that allow for growth, profitability and predictability. Communicates with other relevant Roche functions to ensure needed sales support and delivery of programs/products.

• Overnight travel as needed, including short notice, to most effectively and efficiently cover territory while maximizing customer facing time.

• Navigates the financial landscape of complex health systems, helping them to maximize their capital budget cycles to achieve growth goals

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

• 7+

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Specialista del Conto Regionale - Spettrometria di Massa Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità: Il Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry è specializzato nel lanciare, vendere e promuovere la nostra soluzione Mass Spectrometry innovativa ai clienti del territorio. Attuazione piani di vendita progettati per raggiungere i ricavi consolidati e obiettivi finanziari. I conti sono fondamentali, altamente strategici e hanno requisiti complessi. Responsabile di una significativa strategia di gestione e sviluppo delle relazioni con i partner chiave per i conti strategici e garantisce l'esecuzione della strategia. Vende i prodotti o servizi dell'azienda a nuovi account e/o amplia i conti esistenti. Responsabile per lo sviluppo di nuove opportunità di business o aree emergenti. Si concentra su conti critici, grandi, complessi, altamente visibili, strategici o tatticamente importanti. Sviluppa e presenta proposte finanziarie e contratti completi che migliorano la redditività e proteggono i margini. Funziona in coordinamento con Account Manager per chiamare i clienti potenziali e attuali. Conduce sessioni dimostrative sulle caratteristiche del prodotto. Invola il personale tecnico per risolvere i problemi e i problemi del cliente come necessario. Può partecipare alla creazione di obiettivi di vendita e progettazione del piano di vendita del territorio, gestisce le spese di vendita. Ha una vasta esperienza o una conoscenza unica nel segmento di test di laboratorio e l'esperienza specifica LC/MS è preferita. Utilizza le competenze per contribuire allo sviluppo di obiettivi e principi aziendali e per raggiungere gli obiettivi in modi creativi ed efficaci. Visto come esperto della società e del settore. Ha la conoscenza completa di tutti i prodotti e servizi Mass Spectrometry e può essere incaricato di vendite / sviluppo di prodotti nuovi o strategici. Funziona su questioni significative e uniche in cui l'analisi di situazioni o dati richiede una valutazione di immateriali. Esercizi giudizio indipendente in metodi, tecniche e criteri di valutazione per ottenere risultati. Crea reti formali che coinvolgono il coordinamento tra i gruppi. Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo. Il territorio è degli Stati Uniti del Midwest. Fatti di lavoro:
• Gestisce e guida lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di strategie di vendita di attrezzature di capitale per raggiungere obiettivi di vendita assegnati per conti altamente strategici
• Fornisce una leadership professionale nella pianificazione, nell'organizzazione e nel controllo della crescita delle vendite equilibrata, della penetrazione continua del conto e della soddisfazione del cliente.
• Utilizza una forte conoscenza del prodotto/mercato e un'esperienza di vendita per gestire le vendite complesse e risolvere le domande e le preoccupazioni del cliente.
• Mantiene, estende e acquisisce i clienti attraverso un'efficace identificazione delle opportunità e la creazione e l'implementazione di soluzioni.
• Stabilisce e costruisce forti relazioni con i clienti che permettono la crescita, la redditività e la prevedibilità. Comunica con altre funzioni Roche rilevanti per garantire il supporto di vendita necessario e la consegna di programmi / prodotti.
• Pernottamento di viaggio come necessario, tra cui breve preavviso, per coprire in modo più efficace ed efficiente il territorio, massimizzando il tempo di affrontare il cliente.
• Naviga il paesaggio finanziario di complessi sistemi sanitari, aiutandoli a massimizzare i loro cicli di budget per raggiungere gli obiettivi di crescita Chi sei:
• Corso di laurea o esperienza equivalente
• 7+

Arbeiten an signifikanten und einzigartigen Fragen, bei denen die Analyse von Situationen oder Daten eine Bewertung von immateriellen erfordert. Übungen unabhängiges Urteil über Methoden, Techniken und Bewertungskriterien für die Erzielung von Ergebnissen. Erstellt formale Netzwerke, die die Koordinierung zwischen Gruppen einschließen. • Verwaltet und führt die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Kapitalanlagen-Vertriebsstrategien zur Erreichung der zugewiesenen Verkaufsziele für hochstrategische Konten
• Bietet professionelle Führung bei der Planung, Organisation und Steuerung von ausgewogenem Umsatzwachstum, anhaltender Kontodurchdringung und Kundenzufriedenheit.
• Verwendet starkes Produkt- und Marktwissen und Verkaufserfahrung, um komplexe Verkäufe zu verwalten und Kundenfragen und -belange zu lösen.
• Erhält, erweitert und erwirbt Kunden durch eine effektive Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten und die Schaffung und Umsetzung von Lösungen.
• Erstellt und baut starke Kundenbeziehungen auf, die Wachstum, Rentabilität und Vorhersehbarkeit ermöglichen. Kommuniziert mit anderen relevanten Roche-Funktionen, um eine bedarfsgerechte Unterstützung und Lieferung von Programmen/Produkten zu gewährleisten.
• Übernachtfahrt nach Bedarf, einschließlich kurzfristig, um das Gebiet effektiv und effizient abzudecken, während der Kunde mit der Zeit zu maximieren.
• Navigiert die Finanzlandschaft komplexer Gesundheitssysteme und hilft ihnen, ihre Kapital-Budget-Zyklen zu maximieren, um Wachstumsziele zu erreichen Wer du bist:
• Bachelor-Studie oder gleichwertige Erfahrung
• 7+

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Spécialiste des comptes régionaux - Spectrométrie de masse Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. La possibilité : Le spécialiste de compte régional - spectrométrie de masse est spécialisé dans le lancement, la vente et la promotion de notre solution de spectrométrie de masse révolutionnaire aux clients du territoire. Mettre en oeuvre des plans de vente conçus pour atteindre les objectifs financiers et financiers établis. Les comptes sont essentiels, hautement stratégiques et comportent des exigences complexes. Responsable de la gestion des relations avec les partenaires clés et de la stratégie de développement des comptes stratégiques et s'assure que la stratégie est exécutée. Vend les produits ou services de l'entreprise à de nouveaux comptes et/ou élargit les comptes existants. Responsable du développement de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires ou de nouveaux domaines. Se concentre sur des comptes critiques, grands, complexes, très visibles, stratégiques ou d'importance tactique. Élaborer et présenter des propositions et des contrats financiers complets qui améliorent la rentabilité et protègent les marges. Travaille en coordination avec les gestionnaires de comptes pour faire appel aux clients potentiels et actuels. Organisation de séances de démonstration sur les caractéristiques du produit. Implique du personnel technique pour résoudre les problèmes des clients au besoin. Peut participer à l'établissement des objectifs de vente et à la conception du plan de vente du territoire, gère les frais de vente. A une vaste expertise ou des connaissances uniques dans le segment des essais en laboratoire et l'expérience spécifique de CL/SM est préférée. Utilise les compétences pour contribuer à l'élaboration des objectifs et des principes de l'entreprise et pour atteindre les objectifs de façon créative et efficace. Considéré comme un expert par l'entreprise et dans le domaine. A une connaissance complète de tous les produits et services de spectrométrie de masse et peut être chargé de la vente ou du développement de produits nouveaux ou stratégiques. Travaille sur des questions importantes et uniques où l'analyse des situations ou des données nécessite une évaluation des biens incorporels. Exerce un jugement indépendant sur les méthodes, les techniques et les critères d'évaluation pour obtenir des résultats. Créer des réseaux formels de coordination entre les groupes. C'est un rôle sur le terrain. Le territoire est Midwest US. Faits sur l'emploi :
• Gérer et diriger l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de vente d'équipement pour atteindre les objectifs de vente assignés aux comptes hautement stratégiques
• Fournit un leadership professionnel dans la planification, l'organisation et le contrôle de la croissance équilibrée des ventes, la pénétration continue des comptes et la satisfaction des clients.
• Utilise une solide connaissance des produits/marchés et une expérience de vente pour gérer les ventes complexes et résoudre les questions et les préoccupations des clients.
• Conserve, étend et acquiert des clients en identifiant efficacement les opportunités et en créant et en mettant en œuvre des solutions.
• Établir et établir de solides relations avec les clients qui permettent la croissance, la rentabilité et la prévisibilité. Communique avec d'autres fonctions pertinentes de Roche afin d'assurer le soutien des ventes et l'exécution des programmes et des produits nécessaires.
• Voyages de nuit au besoin, y compris un court préavis, pour couvrir le territoire le plus efficacement et efficacement tout en maximisant le temps face au client.
• Exploite le paysage financier des systèmes de santé complexes, en les aidant à maximiser leur cycle budgétaire pour atteindre les objectifs de croissance Qui vous êtes :
• Baccalauréat ou expérience équivalente
• 7+

jobs.title: P&C Business Partner (Advisory) - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
What we do:
The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. Join us now and be part of our unique transformational journey: we are building a global People & Culture (P&C/HR) Center of Excellence by bringing in talented HR professionals in order to cover complex and challenging HR functions and areas.

The Opportunity:
As a German speaking People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner (Advisory) you partner flexibly and mostly virtually with leaders across the globe, offering on-demand, ad-hoc support on Business Partnering topics that need more immediate or short-term guidance and value creation. With a good understanding of the business needs and the business context and an excellent ability to apply key P&C concepts, policies and processes, you provide coaching, guidance and support to leaders to help them diagnose and translate their business needs into immediate P&C approaches and ensure effective implementation of solutions in partnership with other chapters. You are a trusted member of the Business Partner Chapter and closely integrated into the PSS organization.
Your day to day responsibilities are:

• Strategic Guidance: Provide on-demand coaching and advisory to global leaders on critical P&C topics, including talent management, succession planning, performance management, and organizational design.

• Transformation Support: Lead and advise on complex organizational changes, transformations, and employee representation topics, ensuring risk-based decision-making and compliance with established policies.

• Global Rollouts: Deliver first-class support and coaching during the implementation of new global processes and projects, such as global grading systems or new system launches.

• Data-Driven Insights: Analyze P&C metrics and business data to recommend innovative solutions and provide insights that support our culture and strategic direction.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global/regional squads and PSS chapters to ensure the seamless execution of P&C initiatives and consistent policy application.

​
Who You Are:

• Experienced HR Professional: You bring 3–7 years of experience in similar roles such as HR Business Partnering, People Relations, or Labor Law.

• Bilingual Expert: You possess an excellent written and spoken command of both English and German, enabling you to support the DACH region and global stakeholders effectively.

• Skilled Coach & Communicator: You have a proven ability to provide difficult feedback, resolve conflicts, and influence leaders at all levels of management.

• Strategic Thinker: You can thoughtfully diagnose business needs, weigh the risks and benefits of various options, and propose fit-for-purpose HR approaches.

• You demonstrate strong knowledge in interpreting employment laws and policies, ensuring all solutions are legally sound and culturally sensitive.

• Agile Mindset: You thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, demonstrating high customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, and a passion for continuous learning.

• Relationship Builder: You are a natural networker who excels at navigating complex, matrixed reporting relationships across multiple cultures.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities
