descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Dies ist eine aufregende Zeit, sich dem Roche Support Network anzuschließen. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich über Problemlösung sind, dann ist dies die Position für Sie! Als forschungsorientiertes Healthcare-Unternehmen entdeckt, entwickelt und bietet Roche innovative Diagnostik und therapeutische Produkte und Dienstleistungen, die für Patienten und medizinische Fachkräfte von der Früherkennung und Prävention von Krankheiten bis hin zur Diagnostik, Behandlung und Therapieüberwachung profitieren. Roche ist ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen, das spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten bieten kann. Wir fördern und unterstützen Ihre Entwicklung in Bereichen Ihres Interesses, die Sie auf die nächste Stufe in Ihrem Karriereweg vorbereiten. Wir wissen, dass Menschen für unseren Erfolg verantwortlich sind und wir unsere Mitarbeiter schätzen. Unser Engagement ist es, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem das Gefühl geschätzt, respektiert und gestärkt wird, ein tägliches Erlebnis ist. Roche Sequencing & Life Science ist auf der Suche nach einem Field Applications Scientist-Sequencing, um einem Expertenteam von Field Application Scientists und Field Engineers beizutreten, das sich auf die Bereitstellung erstklassiger Kundenbetreuung konzentriert, darunter vor- und nachverkaufstechnische Unterstützung, Installation und Service. Dieses hochmotivierte Individuum wird für die Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebs- und Support-Teams verantwortlich sein, um als wissenschaftliche/technische Experte den Vertrieb zu unterstützen und Kunden zu unterstützen. Kundenkontomanagement, interne und externe Schulung, Vorverkaufsunterstützung und Instrumentenumsetzungen. Dieses Individuum wird routinemäßig mit Sales, Marketing und Support zusammenarbeiten, um wichtige Chancen und Business-Initiativen zu fördern und gleichzeitig ein ergebnisorientiertes, kundenzentriertes, leistungsstarkes Team zu unterstützen. Die Gelegenheit:
• Bereitstellung von Expertenwissen über Produkte und Anwendungen für Kunden, mit dem Ziel, beratende wissenschaftliche Unterstützung, z.B. Unterstützung bei der Produktauswahl, experimentelles Design, Workflow-Optimierung, etc.
• Koordination mit dem Vertrieb, um Kunden die wissenschaftliche und Produktunterstützung zu bieten, die erforderlich ist, um den Verkaufsprozess zu beschleunigen, wie Vorverkaufspräsentationen, die Erfolgsquoten der Produktbewertung zu erhöhen und weiterhin technische Unterstützung nach dem Verkauf zu bieten
• Umfangreiche lokale, regionale und nationale Reisen (50-80 % der Zeit) mit Sales Specialists zu arbeiten, Treffen mit Schlüsselkunden zu besuchen, Ausbildung und Unterstützung bei der Bewertung von NGS-Methoden und Präsentation von wissenschaftlichen Seminaren und technischen Präsentationen.
• regelmäßige Berichte über Aktivitäten auf dem Gebiet der Führung.
• Liefern Sie kundenorientierte Seminare, um Vertriebsmöglichkeiten zu unterstützen
• Nehmen Sie an der laufenden Schulung der Support & Applications Teams teil.
• Beantworten Sie technische Anfragen von Kunden, die per Telefon und E-Mail empfangen werden, während Sie sich aktiv mit dem Sales- und internen Support-Team zusammenarbeiten.
• Überwachen Sie technische Trends und liefern Sie Feedback zu Wettbewerbslandschaft, Konzeption von Produkterweiterungen, Produktpositionierung und Anwendungsentwicklung an Applications Manager und Product Manager.
• Besuchen Sie regionale und nationale Messen.
• Dies ist eine feldbasierte Rolle - das Gebiet wird die Staaten von Kentucky, Ohio, West Virginia, Virginia, Maryland, Delaware, Pennsylvania, New Jersey & New York City Region abdecken. Für diese Position wird 50 % bis 75 % Fahrweg erwartet. Der ideale Kandidat für diese Rolle sollte in einer großen Metropolregion wohnen. Wer sind Sie?
• Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich oder gleichwertige Arbeitserfahrung.
• 3 Jahre Erfahrung bei der Umsetzung und Auswertung komplexer Labors,

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position C'est une période passionnante pour rejoindre le réseau de soutien Roche. Si vous êtes passionné par la résolution de problèmes alors c'est la position pour vous! En tant qu'entreprise de soins de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche découvre, développe et fournit des produits et des services diagnostiques et thérapeutiques innovants qui procurent des avantages importants aux patients et aux professionnels de la santé, depuis la détection précoce et la prévention des maladies jusqu'au diagnostic, au traitement et au suivi du traitement. Roche est une entreprise prospère qui peut offrir des opportunités de carrière passionnantes. Nous encourageons et soutenons votre développement dans les domaines qui vous intéressent et qui vous prépareront au prochain niveau de votre parcours professionnel. Nous savons que les gens sont responsables de notre succès et nous apprécions nos employés. Notre engagement est de créer un environnement de travail où le sentiment de valeur, de respect et d'autonomie est une expérience quotidienne. Roche Sequencing & Life Science est à la recherche d'un spécialiste des applications sur le terrain pour rejoindre une équipe spécialisée de spécialistes des applications sur le terrain et d'ingénieurs de terrain qui s'emploient à fournir un soutien à la clientèle de premier ordre, y compris le soutien technique, l'installation et le service avant et après la vente. Cette personne hautement motivée sera chargée de s'associer avec les équipes de vente et de soutien en tant qu'expert scientifique/technique pour aider à conduire les ventes et fournir un soutien aux clients. gestion de compte client, formation interne et externe, support prévente et mise en œuvre d'instruments. Cette personne s'associera systématiquement avec les ventes, le marketing et le soutien pour stimuler les occasions clés et les initiatives d'affaires, tout en appuyant une équipe axée sur les résultats, axée sur le client et hautement performante. La possibilité :
• Fournir des connaissances spécialisées sur les produits et les applications aux clients, dans le but de fournir un soutien scientifique consultatif, par exemple en aidant à la sélection des produits, à la conception expérimentale, à l'optimisation des flux de travail, etc.
• Coordonner avec Sales pour fournir aux clients le soutien scientifique et produit nécessaire pour accélérer le processus de vente tels que les présentations avant vente, augmenter les taux de succès de l'évaluation des produits et fournir un soutien technique post-vente continu
• Voyages locaux, régionaux et nationaux approfondis (50 à 80 % du temps) pour travailler sur le terrain avec des spécialistes de la vente, assister à des réunions avec des clients clés, dispenser une formation et aider à l'évaluation des méthodes NGS et présenter des séminaires scientifiques et des présentations techniques.
• Faire rapport régulièrement aux dirigeants sur les activités menées sur le terrain.
• Organiser des séminaires destinés aux clients pour soutenir les opportunités de vente
• Participer à la formation continue des équipes Support & Applications.
• Répondre aux demandes techniques des clients reçues par téléphone et par e-mail, tout en s'associant activement avec l'équipe de vente et de soutien interne.
• Surveiller les tendances techniques et fournir un retour d'information sur le paysage concurrentiel, la conceptualisation des extensions de produits, le positionnement des produits et le développement d'applications aux responsables d'applications et de produits.
• Assister à des salons régionaux et nationaux.
• C'est un rôle de terrain - le territoire couvrira les États du Kentucky, de l'Ohio, de la Virginie occidentale, de la Virginie, du Maryland, du Delaware, de la Pennsylvanie, du New Jersey et de la ville de New York. Un voyage de 50 à 75 % est prévu pour ce poste. Le candidat idéal pour ce rôle devrait résider dans une grande région métropolitaine. Qui vous êtes :
• Baccalauréat dans un domaine connexe ou une expérience de travail équivalente.
• 3 ans d'expérience dans la mise en oeuvre et l'évaluation de laboratoires complexes,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Présentation de l’équipe :
Rattaché(e) à la Division Service Clients – Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) et reportant au Responsable Customer Support Hardware, tu prends en charge les demandes clients et les accompagner pour de l'assistance téléphonique

Quel sera ton impact ?
Tu seras amené(e) à travailler sur les missions suivantes :

• Réception et traitement des demandes clients

• documentation dans le CRM

• diagnostic de pannes et proposition de solutions

• utilisation des possibilités de support à distance

• identification et traitement des réclamations et des problèmes de qualité

• gestion de réclamations simples (communication avec RCSC et équipes filiales)

• identification des problèmes de qualité et escalade au niveau d’expertise supérieur

• participer aux différents projets innovants initiés au sein du service

• contribuer au partage des informations et à l’optimisation des pratiques

• assurer la progression de ses propres compétences.

Tu es quelqu'un qui veut influencer son propre développement. Tu recherches une entreprise où le titre du poste n'est pas considéré comme la définition finale de qui tu es, mais le point de départ.

Ton ADN:

• Formation Bac + 2/Bac +3 dans les domaines de l’automatisme, de l’instrumentation, de l’électronique et de l’informatique. (ex : DUT/BUT Mesures physiques, G2II…)

• Formation dans le domaine de l'analyse de biologie médicale avec une spécialisation dans l’instrumentation biomédicale (Licence professionnelle ScVBM, Instrumentation et Maintenance Biomédicales…)

• Français courant

• Anglais est indispensable (B1-B2)

Alternance de 12 mois à compter de septembre 2026
Poste basé à Meylan (38)

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Nous sommes convaincus qu’il est urgent de proposer des solutions thérapeutiques et de diagnostic dès aujourd’hui, tout en innovant pour l’avenir. Améliorer la vie des patients est notre raison d’être. Nous décidons et agissons avec courage. Et nous croyons fermement qu’une conduite responsable de nos activités servira le monde de demain. Rigueur scientifique, éthique irréprochable, accès à l’innovation médicale pour tous : tels sont nos engagements.

Chez Roche, nous considérons que la diversité est source d'innovation. Nous sommes ouverts à tous les profils et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail agréable et inclusif.

Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur et à propulser ta carrière avec Roche, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Field Engineering Specialist- Scranton, Pennsylvania

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste en génie de terrain - Scranton, Pennsylvanie

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is an exciting time to join Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

The Opportunity:
The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche-assigned product lines, and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory. The Field Engineering Specialist, in the Roche Support Network, position serves as a technical repair or installation specialist for Roche products for assigned product lines and geographies.

Location: must be located 30 miles from Scranton, Pennsylvania. This is a field position and may require being on call some days.

The Roche FES also:

• Provides routine technical support to customers on operational and maintenance aspects of system equipment

• Performs on-site service, repair and/or installation of company products - This may include any aspect of field support and is not limited to mechanical/system hardware and software, networking/wireless networking

• Serves as customer contact on routine technical and service related problems

• Schedules and performs preventative maintenance per department policy

• Monitors customer equipment performance and is able to respond and resolve most routine issues

• Refers complex problems and issues to higher levels

• Receives training and delivers service within the normal scope of the position

• Follows documented practices, policies, and procedures in providing repair and installation support

• Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures

• Determines most cost-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime

• Provides analysis, feedback and recommendations on product failure trends and serviceability issues

• Documents all activity in a manner compliant with company’s quality procedures

• Is responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions

• Is responsible for ensuring and maximizing customer satisfaction with Roche equipment and related products

• Promotes effective, positive, and productive communication among team to ensure and maximize satisfaction of customer base

• Manages customer accounts at a level that promotes goodwill, confidence and credibility in order to exceed customer expectations in terms of product, service, and support quality

• Identifies revenue generating and cost saving opportunities, implements the Roche Diagnostics service agreement policy, and seeks out opportunities to market service contracts to existing custom

As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche-assigned product lines, and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory. The Field Engineering Specialist, in the Roche Support Network, position serves as a technical repair or installation specialist for Roche products for assigned product lines and geographies. Location: must be located 30 miles from Scranton, Pennsylvania. This is a field position and may require being on call some days. The Roche FES also:
• Provides routine technical support to customers on operational and maintenance aspects of system equipment
• Performs on-site service, repair and/or installation of company products - This may include any aspect of field support and is not limited to mechanical/system hardware and software, networking/wireless networking
• Serves as customer contact on routine technical and service related problems
• Schedules and performs preventative maintenance per department policy
• Monitors customer equipment performance and is able to respond and resolve most routine issues
• Refers complex problems and issues to higher levels
• Receives training and delivers service within the normal scope of the position
• Follows documented practices, policies, and procedures in providing repair and installation support
• Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures
• Determines most cost-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime
• Provides analysis, feedback and recommendations on product failure trends and serviceability issues
• Documents all activity in a manner compliant with company’s quality procedures
• Is responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions
• Is responsible for ensuring and maximizing customer satisfaction with Roche equipment and related products
• Promotes effective, positive, and productive communication among team to ensure and maximize satisfaction of customer base
• Manages customer accounts at a level that promotes goodwill, confidence and credibility in order to exceed customer expectations in terms of product, service, and support quality
• Identifies revenue generating and cost saving opportunities, implements the Roche Diagnostics service agreement policy, and seeks out opportunities to market service contracts to existing custom

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was Dich erwartet:

Die Labordiagnostik ist das Herzstück unseres Gesundheitswesens und von entscheidender Bedeutung für jeden einzelnen Patienten. Schätzungsweise 70 % aller klinischen Entscheidungen basieren auf In-vitro-diagnostischen Tests. Die absolute Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme ist daher die Grundvoraussetzung für sichere Diagnosen und medizinische Weichenstellungen.

Für unser Praktikantenprogramm suchen wir motivierte, technologiebegeisterte und wissbegierige Studierende, die unser Service-Team tatkräftig unterstützen und gemeinsam mit uns den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche Karriere bei Roche legen möchten.

Werde Teil unserer dynamischen Serviceorganisation! Mit viel Energie, Leidenschaft und Innovationsgeist bringen wir die Labordiagnostik in Deutschland voran und gestalten die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mit. Bei uns kannst Du tagtäglich Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein theoretisches und praktisches Wissen einbringen, um komplexe technische Fragestellungen im Team zu lösen.

Als Praktikant:in (m/w/d) begleitest Du unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden bei der Planung, Installation, Wartung und Modifikation unserer Analysensysteme cobas® pro und cobas® pure . Darüber hinaus tauchst Du tief in die IT-Vernetzung unserer Systeme ein. Bei den täglichen Einsätzen in verschiedenen Krankenhaus- und Privatlaboren sind Deine Eigeninitiative, Deine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Dein technisches Geschick gefragt.

Dein perfekter Start: Zu Beginn Deines Praktikums erhältst Du eine fundierte Ausbildung auf unseren Immunologie cobas®-Systemen und wirst während Deines gesamten Außendiensteinsatzes von einem festen Mentor oder einer Mentorin intensiv begleitet.

Du wirst im Raum Nordrhein-Westfalen eingesetzt und genießt die Freiheit, Deinen Wohnort innerhalb dieses Gebiets frei zu wählen (idealerweise im Raum Köln, Bonn, Düsseldorf, Aachen, Ruhrgebiet).

Folgende Schwerpunkte erwarten Dich bei Deinem Praktikum im Service Außendienst:

• Professionelles Training: Du absolvierst im September ein spezialisiertes Wartungstraining an zwei Immunologie-Modulen ( cobas® e402 und cobas® e801 ).

• Praktische Technik: Du stellst Dein handwerkliches und technisches Geschick direkt bei Geräteinstallationen und präventiven Wartungen unter Beweis.

• Problem-Solving: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Analyse sowie Behebung komplexer technischer und applikativer Fragestellungen und unterstützt unser Team aktiv bei der Ursachenforschung.

• Perspektivenwechsel: Du fokussierst Dich auf die Bereiche Klinische Chemie und Immunologie, hast jedoch jederzeit die Möglichkeit, durch Hospitationen auch andere spannende Unternehmensbereiche kennenzulernen.

• Zukunftsthema IT: IT-Netzwerke und IT-Sicherheit wecken Deinen Ehrgeiz – bei der Installation von Firewalls lernst Du direkt von unseren IT-Spezialisten.

• Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Deine organisatorischen Fähigkeiten ein und übernimmst selbstständig definierte Aufgabenpakete (z. B. die professionelle Einweisung unserer Kunden in die Nutzung unserer Online-Plattform Navify ).

• Kommunikationstalent: Du schärfst Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im direkten Dialog mit unseren Kunden sowie bei der kollegialen Abstimmung im Team.

• Flexibilität: Kleinere Projektaufgaben bearbeitest Du ganz flexibel an einzelnen Tagen im Homeoffice. Die meiste Zeit bist Du jedoch dort, wo unsere Geräte stehen: direkt vor Ort bei unseren Kunden.

• Wachstumsumfeld: Wir bieten Dir ein attraktives und wertschätzendes Praktikumsumfeld mit groß

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Cosa vi aspetta: La diagnostica di laboratorio è il cuore della nostra assistenza sanitaria e cruciale per ogni singolo paziente. Il 70% di tutte le decisioni cliniche si basa su test diagnostici in vitro. L'assoluta affidabilità dei nostri sistemi è quindi il requisito fondamentale per la diagnosi sicura e le impostazioni mediche. Per il nostro programma di stage, siamo alla ricerca di studenti motivati, che migliorano la tecnologia e esperti che vogliono sostenere attivamente il nostro team di assistenza e insieme a noi hanno stabilito la base per una carriera di successo a Roche. Partecipa alla nostra organizzazione di servizi dinamica! Con molta energia, passione e spirito innovativo, proviamo la diagnostica di laboratorio in Germania e formiamo attivamente il futuro della salute. Con noi puoi portare le tue idee e le tue conoscenze teoriche e pratiche ogni giorno per risolvere complesse questioni tecniche nel team. Consulente senior (m/w/d) I nostri collaboratori esperti nella pianificazione, installazione, manutenzione e modifica dei nostri sistemi di analisi cobas® pro e cobas® pure. Inoltre, si immerge nella rete IT dei nostri sistemi. La vostra iniziativa, il vostro forte orientamento al cliente e le vostre competenze tecniche sono necessarie per l'uso quotidiano in vari laboratori ospedali e privati. Il vostro inizio perfetto: all'inizio del vostro tirocinio Hai una formazione ben fondata sui nostri sistemi di immunologia cobas® e sono intensamente accompagnati da un mentore o da un mentore solido durante l'intero campo dei servizi esterni. Siete impiegati nella zona del Nord Reno-Westfalia e godetevi la libertà di scegliere il vostro luogo di residenza all'interno di questa zona (idealmente nella zona di Colonia, Bonn, Düsseldorf, Aquisgrana, Ruhrgebiet). Le seguenti priorità vi attendono durante il vostro tirocinio nel servizio di assistenza:
• Formazione professionale: a settembre si completa un training di manutenzione specializzato su due moduli di immunologia (cobas® e402 e cobas® e801 ).
• Tecnologia pratica: impostate le vostre abilità tecniche e artigianali si rivelano direttamente nelle installazioni di dispositivi e manutenzione preventiva.
• Problem-Solving: Si ottiene approfondimenti approfonditi nell'analisi, così come affrontare complesse domande tecniche e applicative e sostenere attivamente il nostro team nella ricerca radice.
• Cambiamento di prospettiva: ti concentri sui campi della chimica clinica e dell'immunologia, ma in qualsiasi momento hai la possibilità di conoscere altre emozionanti aree di business per mezzo di ospitazioni.
• Argomento futuro IT: le reti IT e la sicurezza IT risvegliano la tua ambizione – imparano a installare firewall Lei direttamente dai nostri specialisti IT.
• Responsabilità: Porta le tue capacità organizzative e prendi pacchetti di attività autodefiniti (ad esempio l'assegnazione professionale dei nostri clienti nell'uso della nostra piattaforma online Navify).
• Talenti di comunicazione: È possibile creare le vostre capacità di comunicazione in dialogo diretto con i nostri clienti e in coordinamento collegiale nel team.
• Flessibilità: lavoro su piccoli compiti di progetto Siete molto flessibili nei singoli giorni presso l'ufficio di casa. La maggior parte del tempo si è, tuttavia, dove i nostri dispositivi si trovano: direttamente in loco con i nostri clienti.
• Ambiente di crescita: Vi offriamo un ambiente di tirocinio attraente e a valore aggiunto con grande

Du wirst im Raum Nordrhein-Westfalen eingesetzt und genießt die Freiheit, Deinen Wohnort innerhalb dieses Gebiets frei zu wählen (idealerweise im Raum Münster, Dortmund, Bielefeld, Hamm, Bochum, Kassel ).

• Professionelles Training: Du absolvierst im September ein spezialisiertes Wartungstraining an zwei Immunologie-Modulen ( cobas® e402 und cobas® e801 ).

• Zukunftsthema IT: IT-Netzwerke und IT-Sicherheit wecken Deinen Ehrgeiz – bei der Installation von Firewalls lernst Du direkt von unseren IT-Spezialisten.

• Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Deine organisatorischen Fähigkeiten ein und übernimmst selbstständig definierte Aufgabenpakete (z. B. die professionelle Einweisung unserer Kunden in die Nutzung unserer Online-Plattform Navify ).

• Kommunikationstalent: Du schärfst Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im direkten Dialog mit unseren Kunden sowie bei der kollegialen Abstimmung im Team.

Responsabilidades

• Gestión de Equipos y Recursos: Coordinar y asignar tareas, personal (interno y subcontratado), equipos y tiempos en el área de Reacondicionamiento para garantizar la productividad y la ejecución oportuna de los pedidos.

• Aseguramiento de Calidad y GxP: Verificar el cumplimiento irrestricto de las Buenas Prácticas (GxP/BPA) y los estándares de seguridad en todos los procesos y colaboradores bajo su responsabilidad.

• Gestión de Desviaciones y CAPA: Soportar el Sistema de Gestión de Calidad (SGC) mediante la documentación, investigación y análisis de desviaciones, incidentes o eventos operacionales, proponiendo y ejecutando acciones correctivas y preventivas (CAPA).

• Control Documental y Capacitación: Revisar y actualizar los Procedimientos Operativos Estándar (SOP) y asegurar que todo el personal a su cargo cumpla con los entrenamientos técnicos y normativos requeridos.

• Monitoreo y Mejora Continua: Evaluar la eficiencia y el desempeño de las operaciones para proponer e implementar proactivamente proyectos de mejora continua que optimicen el flujo de trabajo y el uso de recursos.

Quién Eres

• Profesional graduado o en etapa final de carrera en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas o afines, con dominio de inglés intermedio-avanzado (conversación, lectura y redacción técnica).

• Trayectoria previa en operaciones de manufactura o logística, idealmente en roles de coordinación como Líder de Línea o Supervisor de Producción.

• Dominio requerido de SAP EWM (gestión de almacenes), análisis de datos y manejo de herramientas informáticas (hojas de cálculo); conocimiento en Gestión de Proyectos es deseable.

• Conocimiento sólido y requerido en Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura, Almacenamiento y Distribución de Productos Farmacéuticos (BPM/BPA/BPD), así como en Seguridad y Salud Ocupacional.

• Dominio de metodologías Lean Manufacturing , Six Sigma y herramientas de Análisis de Causa Raíz (RCA).

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles para este puesto de trabajo.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Strategy and Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At the heart of Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) lies a mission to redefine what’s possible in healthcare through data. To achieve this, we need a backbone of strategic discipline and operational agility. As a key member of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, you will do more than manage processes, you will champion an innovation mindset, driving the evolution of our operating model and facilitating the strategies (such as in silico and 3D) that represent the future of medicine. Join us to help harmonize our strategic efforts and turn complex challenges into coordinated progress.

By connecting enterprise priorities with operational realities, BSO drives consistency, clarity, and coordinated progress across PDD and the broader development organization.

The Opportunity:

• You partner with sub-functional leaders to drive connectivity and coordinate planned and ad-hoc PDD-wide and functional strategic efforts in alignment with PDD priorities

• You drive key initiatives impacting the organization’s strategic and operating model, using an enterprise and innovation mindset

• You facilitate structured planning and reporting activities across sub-functions, proactively identifying and resolving issues in a dynamic and fast-paced setting to support the execution of strategies such as in silico and 3D

• You navigate high ambiguity and complexity, proactively driving clarity, alignment, and prioritization across multiple stakeholders and initiatives

• You operate with a continuous improvement mindset to proactively identify process gaps and opportunities for improved alignment, communications, and resource across key planned and ad-hoc efforts with a bias for action

• You independently organize and manage recurring leadership meetings (including Quant Team), develop agendas, and document and support the drive and follow-through of outcomes and next steps

• You maintain tools for initiative tracking, performance monitoring, and cross-functional alignment

• You lead or co-lead preparation of communications and presentations for functional updates, governance forums, senior leadership reviews, and evolving sub-functional or PDD-wide requirements in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders and leadership

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration, life sciences, public health, or data sciences

• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic operations, business planning, or project management in pharma or healthcare settings; or an advanced degree with 5 years of equivalent work experience

• You demonstrate ability to independently lead initiatives, manage planning cycles, and facilitate leadership forums

• You are familiar with data- and R&D-oriented operating models and cross-functional execution

• You have capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles

• You have excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond technical domain

• You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace

• You have excellent verbal and written communication skills, specifically in the areas of presentation and writing, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear language

Preferred:

• Prior experience managing operational workstreams or planning cycles within life sciences or data-focused environments

• Working knowledg

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Impacto sostenible
Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones.

La Oportunidad
Liderar la estrategia de acceso y políticas públicas para el portafolio de Roche Diagnóstica en la región de Ecuador y Perú-PEC. En este rol, serás el principal experto ante el Ministerio de Salud y aseguradoras así como otros stakeholders relevantes para el sistema de salud, generando evidencia clínica de alto impacto para reducir barreras y crear oportunidades en el sistema de salud y garantizar que nuestras innovaciones lleguen a quienes más las necesitan.

Responsabilidades

• Estrategia de Acceso y Valor: Diseñar y ejecutar el Plan de Acceso para productos de alto valor médico, anticipando tendencias del mercado para definir propuestas de valor innovadoras que aceleren su adopción.

• Relacionamiento de Alto Nivel e Influencia: Construir relaciones estratégicas con Líderes de Opinión (KOLs), sociedades científicas y autoridades gubernamentales para liderar la participación de la compañía en la modificación de políticas públicas y marcos regulatorios.

• Mapeo de Stakeholders y Ruta del Paciente: Desarrollar el mapeo de actores clave e instituciones objetivo, analizando el journey del paciente para identificar prioridades clínicas y nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento.

• Economía de la Salud (HECON): Implementar herramientas de economía de la salud y modelos de costo-beneficio para posicionar estratégicamente el portafolio en las entidades de salud de la región Perú y Ecuador.

• Liderazgo Científico y de Opinión: Actuar como el principal experto científico del portafolio, difundiendo evidencia clínica a través de publicaciones, paneles de expertos y traduciendo las necesidades de los pacientes y profesionales en estrategias de negocio.

• Colaboración Transversal: Trabajar en sinergia con los equipos comerciales, de estrategia y finanzas para agilizar los procesos de acceso y maximizar las oportunidades comerciales del portafolio.

Quién Eres

• Profesional en Ciencias de la Salud, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines, con dominio avanzado del idioma inglés (hablado y escrito).

• Más de 3 años en la industria farmacéutica o del cuidado de la salud, liderando roles de Acceso al Mercado y Política Pública.

• Profundo entendimiento del sistema de salud peruano- ecuatoriano, así como su normativa y los stakeholders relevantes para el ecosistema de salud

• Visión estratégica y sistémica, con capacidad demostrada para influir e inspirar a través del liderazgo colaborativo.

Deseable

• Estudios adicionales o especialización en Economía de la Salud y Políticas Públicas.

• Trayectoria comprobada en metodologías ágiles y colaboración en equipos multidisciplinarios.

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles para este puesto de trabajo.

• Anforderungen - Professur für Gesundheitswissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder verwandte Kurse, mit fortgeschrittener englischer Sprache (sprechend und geschrieben). - Mehr als 3 Jahre in der pharmazeutischen Industrie oder im Gesundheitswesen, was die Rollen des Marktzugangs und der öffentlichen Politik anführt. - Ein tiefes Verständnis des peruanischen und ecuadorianischen Gesundheitssystems sowie seiner für das Gesundheitsökosystem relevanten Rechtsvorschriften und Interessenvertreter. - Strategische und systemische Vision, mit bewährter Fähigkeit, durch kollaborative Führung zu beeinflussen und zu inspirieren. - Unerwünscht: - Zusätzliche Studien oder Spezialisierung in der Wirtschaft der Gesundheit und der öffentlichen Politik. - Trayectoria Kompromiss in methodlogías ágiles y colaboración en stattos multidisziplinaryrios. Kontakt Einzelheiten über die Transparenz des Entgelts werden auf der Grundlage der wichtigsten Veröffentlichungsposition angegeben. Für diese Rolle ist die Hauptposition Quito. Wenn Sie an anderen Stellen interessiert sind, in denen die Rolle zur Verfügung stehen könnte, geben wir Ihnen während des Rekrutierungsprozesses Angaben über die entsprechende Bezahlung. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft und stellen sicher, dass jeder heute und für zukünftige Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Digital Sales Specialist - Central Lab

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
Come join the Roche Digital Solutions sales organization as a Digital Central Lab Consultant where you will be responsible for selling the Roche navify digital portfolio to IHN, hospital, and reference laboratory customers. This field-based position requires consultative sales experience and expertise in lab workflow, IT infrastructure, data flow, informatics, laboratory medicine, laboratory operations, digital applications (i.e. middleware, business intelligence tools, etc.), and Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) to effectively consult with clinical laboratory stakeholders on customized Roche digital solutions and provide strategic recommendations on digital processes. This position engages early in the sales cycle to understand customer needs, deliver customized demos, and design customized digital solutions in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Roche’s and customers’ teams.

Responsibilities:

• Generates new customer demand across the full portfolio of Core Lab and Molecular navify products (middleware, connectivity, informatics, apps, etc).

• Engage in strategic digital discussions with key customer buying influences, from technical end users to executive level decision makers.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across sales and implementation teams to define and align on total solution sales strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

• Conduct laboratory process analysis, develop solution proposal presentations, and deliver recommendations to customers in close alignment with internal stakeholders.

• Deliver software demos and tailored technical presentations to internal and external audiences.

• Adept at translating customer needs into internal action to meet those needs while balancing key business priorities and goals.

• Strong clinical and financial acumen with a demonstrated ability to understand and translate customer needs to effectively position the value of Roche digital solutions.

• Effectively qualify leads and utilize outcomes from workflow analysis and impact studies to provide competitive differentiation and value to the overall customer solution.

• Provides in-depth technical expertise regarding assigned product lines.

• Work cross functionally with internal stakeholders to share information and best practices while remaining actively informed on industry/customer trends that impact business.

• Follow a standardized end-to-end approach that creates evidence-based, differentiated value for the solution portfolio, both inside and outside the walls of the laboratory.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (i.e. Information Technology, Medical Technology, Life Sciences) or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years relevant or equivalent experience (i.e. healthcare digital solutions sales, laboratory diagnostics sales)

• Must be autonomous and organized with effective communication, negotiation, and problem solving skills

• Familiarity with digital solutions, laboratory middleware solutions and hospital LIS systems

• Experience with presenting technical information to large external and internal audiences

Preferred Qualifications:

• Preferred experie

Roche - Digital Sales Specialist - Central Lab Mansioni - Digital Sales Specialist - Laboratorio Centrale Descrizione A Roche, puoi essere te stesso e prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente in una cultura che valorizza e rispetta l'individualità. La nostra missione è di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie, garantire l'accesso alla salute per tutti oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti alla nostra organizzazione di vendita Digital Solutions come Consulente Digital Central Lab. Sarai responsabile della vendita del portafoglio digitale Roche navify a IHN, ospedale e clienti di laboratorio di riferimento. Questo ruolo basato sul campo richiede competenze nel flusso di lavoro di laboratorio, infrastrutture IT, flusso di dati, informatica, medicina di laboratorio, applicazioni digitali e sistemi informativi di laboratorio (LIS). Responsabilità - Genera una nuova domanda del cliente attraverso il portafoglio completo dei prodotti Core Lab e Molecular Navify. - Impegna nelle discussioni strategiche digitali con influenze chiave di acquisto dei clienti, dagli utenti finali tecnici ai decisori di livello esecutivo. - Collabora con gli stakeholder interni per definire e allineare le strategie di vendita di soluzioni totali per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita. - Conduce l'analisi del processo di laboratorio, sviluppa presentazioni di proposte di soluzione e fornisce raccomandazioni ai clienti. - Fornisce demo software e presentazioni tecniche su misura per il pubblico interno ed esterno. - Traduci le esigenze del cliente nell'azione interna, bilanciando le priorità e gli obiettivi aziendali chiave. - Dimostra un forte acume clinico e finanziario per posizionare efficacemente il valore delle soluzioni digitali Roche. - Qualifica conduce e utilizza i risultati dall'analisi del flusso di lavoro e studi di impatto per fornire differenziazione e valore competitivi. - Fornisce competenze tecniche approfondite per quanto riguarda le linee di prodotto assegnate. - Funziona in modo interfunzionale con gli stakeholder interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, e rimane informato sulle tendenze del settore/cliente.
• Requisiti - Corso di laurea in un campo relativo (cioè, tecnologia dell'informazione, tecnologia medica, scienze della vita) o esperienza equivalente. - 5+ anni di esperienza rilevante nelle vendite di soluzioni digitali sanitarie, vendite di diagnostica di laboratorio, o equivalente. - Deve essere autonomo, organizzato e avere efficaci capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e problem solving. - Familiarità con soluzioni digitali, soluzioni middleware di laboratorio e sistemi LIS ospedalieri. - Esperienza che presenta informazioni tecniche a grandi pubblico esterno e interno. Qualifiche tecniche - Esperienza preferenziale nelle vendite di soluzioni digitali sanitarie, vendite di diagnostica di laboratorio o equivalente. Informationstechnologie, Medizintechnik, Life Sciences) oder gleichwertige Erfahrung. - 5+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Vertrieb von digitalen Lösungen im Gesundheitswesen, Vertrieb von Labordiagnostik oder Äquivalent. - Muss autonom, organisiert und haben effektive Kommunikation, Verhandlungen und Problemlösung Fähigkeiten. - Vertraut mit digitalen Lösungen, Labor Middleware-Lösungen und Krankenhaus-LIS-Systemen. - Erleben Sie technische Informationen für große externe und interne Publikum. Qualifiche bevorzugt - Bevorzugte Erfahrung im Vertrieb von digitalen Lösungen im Gesundheitswesen, im Vertrieb von Labordiagnostik oder im Äquivalent. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Anatomic Pathology Solutions Manager

The Opportunity

The Anatomic Pathology Solutions Manager in Tissue Diagnostics is responsible for protecting and growing the IHC, H&E and Special Stains portions of the business along with bundling additional platforms, driving business themselves and through others. This is an individual contributor sales specialist role with informal leadership responsibilities. Implements sales plans designed to achieve established revenue and financial goals. Knows and understands the Advanced Staining competitive landscape including product, sales tools, and pricing for RTD and all competitors. Leverages current business relationships to maintain and grow current customer base. Works in coordination with Account Managers and Strategic Account Managers to call on perspective and current customers.

Has a complete knowledge of company products and services, and viewed as an expert by the company and customers. May be tasked with sales of new or strategic products. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with internal and external personnel in own area of expertise. Focuses on critical, large, complex, high-visibility, strategic or tactically important accounts. Acts independently to determine methods and procedures on new or special assignments.

Job Facts:

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

• Assumes an active leadership role during the development and implementation of capital equipment sales strategies to attain assigned sales objectives. Intimacy with company and competitive market dynamics.

• Provides professional leadership in planning, organizing, and controlling balanced sales growth, continued account penetration, and customer satisfaction.

• Utilizes strong product/market knowledge and sales experience to manage complex sales and resolve customer questions and concerns.

• Continuously builds knowledge of current industry trends, competitive information, and industry/technical knowledge and shares with other Roche colleagues.

• Responsible for the effective management of sales funnel by identification of opportunities and the creation and implementation of solutions.

• Establishes and works with Account Managers and Strategic Account Managers to build strong client relationships that allow for growth, profitability and predictability. Communicates with other relevant Roche functions to ensure needed sales support and delivery of programs/products.

• Effectively utilizes internal sales and operations support teams to advance the sale.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

• You hold 5+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

Preferred:

• Expertise in competitive business and instrumentation, reimbursement landscape, and all other product lines.

• Leadership presence and business acumen with an understanding of the IHC and Anatomic Pathology laboratory landscape and the ability to create/drive solutions with others.

• Must have proven success in previous sales capacity, using consultative selling skills, along with demonstrated leadership and communication excellence.

• Presence and communication ability required with the ability to create and present impactful group presentations.

​ This is a field-based position - the

titleByLocale.en: Head of Commercial Strategy & Marketing, Diagnostics
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la stratégie commerciale et du marketing, Diagnostics

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Head of Commercial Strategy & Marketing , you will be a senior leader responsible for shaping the strategic direction, market positioning, and commercial growth of Roche Diagnostics Australia (RDA). As a member of the RDA Leadership Team, you will lead the Commercial Strategy & Marketing community in translating Roche’s global innovation pipeline and portfolio into impactful solutions for the Australian healthcare system. Working closely with Commercial, Medical, and Service teams, you will connect strategy to execution to accelerate the launch and adoption of innovative diagnostics and deliver sustainable commercial outcomes.

NOTE: To best meet our evolving business priorities, this position is being readvertised with a sharpened focus on diagnostics expertise and commercial leadership capability. We are specifically seeking professionals who bring strong hands-on experience within Core Lab environments (highly preferred) and/or Molecular Diagnostics . If you have already submitted your application for this role, your details remain in our system and there is no need to reapply.

What you will be working on:
As the Head of Commercial Strategy & Marketing, you will be responsible for, but not limited to:

• Setting the strategic direction for RDA’s portfolio, disease area, and solutions strategy to drive market differentiation and sustainable growth.

• Leading commercial strategy and execution to translate Roche’s global innovation pipeline into impactful solutions for the Australian healthcare system.

• Owning financial performance across the portfolio, ensuring sales, revenue, profitability, and growth targets are achieved.

• Developing and executing integrated go-to-market and marketing strategies to accelerate adoption of Roche’s diagnostics portfolio across multiple disease areas and testing segments.

• Leading new product launches and portfolio expansion initiatives to ensure successful market entry and rapid adoption of high-medical-value innovations.

• Overseeing portfolio lifecycle management and prioritisation to sustain the relevance, competitiveness, and growth of existing diagnostic products and solutions.

• Identifying emerging market opportunities, customer needs, competitor dynamics, and healthcare trends to position RDA for long-term success.

• Leveraging market insights, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to inform strategic decisions and commercial priorities.

• Building and leading a high-performing Commercial Strategy & Marketing organisation that delivers strong strategic and commercial outcomes.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que responsable de la stratégie commerciale et du marketing, vous serez un chef de file principal chargé de façonner l'orientation stratégique, le positionnement du marché et la croissance commerciale de Roche Diagnostics Australia (RDA). En tant que membre de l'équipe de leadership RDA, vous dirigerez la communauté Commercial Strategy & Marketing en traduisant le pipeline d'innovation et le portefeuille de Roches en solutions efficaces pour le système de santé australien. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales, médicales et de service, vous connecterez la stratégie à l'exécution pour accélérer le lancement et l'adoption de diagnostics innovants et fournir des résultats commerciaux durables. REMARQUE : Pour répondre au mieux à l'évolution de nos priorités opérationnelles, ce poste est reconverti en mettant davantage l'accent sur l'expertise diagnostique et la capacité de leadership commercial. Nous recherchons spécifiquement des professionnels qui apportent une forte expérience pratique dans les environnements Core Lab (fortement préféré) et/ou le diagnostic moléculaire. Si vous avez déjà soumis votre demande pour ce rôle, vos détails restent dans notre système et il n'y a pas besoin de présenter une nouvelle demande. Ce que vous allez travailler sur: En tant que responsable de la stratégie commerciale et du marketing, vous serez responsable, mais sans vous limiter à:
• Définir l'orientation stratégique du portefeuille de RDA, de la zone de maladie et de la stratégie de solutions pour stimuler la différenciation du marché et la croissance durable.
• Diriger la stratégie commerciale et l'exécution pour traduire Roches en solutions efficaces pour le système de santé australien.
• Posséder des résultats financiers sur l'ensemble du portefeuille, en veillant à ce que les ventes, les recettes, la rentabilité et les objectifs de croissance soient atteints.
• Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies intégrées de commercialisation et de commercialisation afin d'accélérer l'adoption du portefeuille de diagnostics de Roches dans plusieurs domaines de maladies et segments de tests.
• Diriger les lancements de nouveaux produits et les initiatives d'expansion de portefeuille pour assurer une entrée réussie sur le marché et l'adoption rapide d'innovations de haute valeur médicale.
• Superviser la gestion du cycle de vie du portefeuille et la hiérarchisation pour maintenir la pertinence, la compétitivité et la croissance des produits et solutions de diagnostic existants.
• Identifier les opportunités du marché émergent, les besoins des clients, la dynamique des concurrents et les tendances en matière de soins de santé pour positionner RDA pour le succès à long terme.
• Tirer parti des perspectives du marché, des commentaires des clients et de l'intelligence concurrentielle pour éclairer les décisions stratégiques et les priorités commerciales.
• Créer et diriger une organisation de stratégie commerciale et de marketing performante qui produit des résultats stratégiques et commerciaux solides.
• Faire la promotion de la collaboration interfonctionnelle entre les équipes commerciales, médicales, d'expérience client et de service pour offrir des solutions client intégrées et une exécution alignée.
• Renforcer les relations avec les principaux acteurs de la santé, notamment les réseaux de laboratoires, les cliniciens, les systèmes de santé, les décideurs et les partenaires stratégiques.
• Établir des partenariats avec des équipes régionales et mondiales pour faire en sorte que l'Australie contribue de manière significative au programme mondial d'innovation de Roches et à un impact plus large sur les soins de santé. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader stratégique et commerciale avec plus de 10 ans de marketing progressif, de ventes, de stratégie ou de leadership commercial au sein de l'industrie du diagnostic. Vous avez:
• Diagnostic solide et compréhension du marché, en particulier dans les environnements Core Lab (fortement préféré) et/ou Diagnostic moléculaire, avec une compréhension claire des besoins des clients, de la dynamique du marché, des paysages concurrentiels, et de l'avenir

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （1 ）在校大学生
• （2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4 ）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
The Delivery Services Manager leads the delivery and operational continuity of digital solutions supporting Pharma Technical Development (PTD) systems transitioning to RDT TechOps. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, compliance is our license to operate. As a Validation Lead within RDT Pharma Medicines TechOps, you will play a critical role in ensuring that the digital systems supporting Pharma Technical Development (PTD) meet the highest standards of quality, regulatory compliance, and patient safety. You will be the validation subject matter expert across a portfolio of GMP-critical systems transitioning from PTD to RDT TechOps – owning the end-to-end validation lifecycle and ensuring our systems remain audit-ready, compliant, and fit for purpose.
In everything we do, we think about patients.
Your work will directly support the integrity of processes that bring medicines to patients around the world.

The Opportunity
In this role, you will be responsible for:

• Validation Lifecycle Ownership: Lead the end-to-end Computer System Validation (CSV) and Computer System Assurance (CSA) activities for GMP-critical PTD systems, including validation planning, protocol development, execution oversight, and report approval – ensuring systems are validated, maintained, and audit-ready throughout their lifecycle.

• Risk-Based Validation: Apply a risk-based approach to validation, determining appropriate validation strategies, deliverables, and testing coverage for each system based on its GxP classification, business criticality, and regulatory impact.

• Knowledge Transfer Support: Ensure validation documentation, system histories, and compliance records are properly captured and transitioned as part of the PTD to RDT TechOps knowledge transfer, maintaining continuity of the validated state.

• Testing Strategy & Quality Oversight: Define and review test strategies, test plans, and test reports in collaboration with product owners and technical teams. Provide consultancy on test-related deviations, corrective actions, and preventive measures.

• Change Control & System Maintenance: Assess the validation impact of system changes, enhancements, and patches – ensuring that the validated state is preserved across all system updates and that change control processes are followed in accordance with Roche SOPs.

• Deviation & CAPA Management: Support deviation investigations to identify root causes and define corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), ensuring timely closure and regulatory compliance.

• Audit & Inspection Readiness: Act as the CSV subject matter expert during internal audits and regulatory inspections, supporting preparation, execution, and response activities for assigned systems.

• Periodic Reviews: Conduct and support system periodic reviews in accordance with Roche procedures, ensuring ongoing compliance and fitness for purpose.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with PTD business stakeholders, Technical Product Owners, Delivery Services Managers, Quality Assurance, and MSP vendors to embed a culture of compliance and quality across all delivery activities.

Who you are
You are a detail-oriented compliance professional with deep expertise in GxP-regulated digital environments and a pragmatic, risk-based approach to validation. You bring:

• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in IT and software validation (CSV/CSA, GAMP) within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences industry.

• Proven experience leading validation activities across GMP-regulated computerized systems, including system implementation, maintenance, and change control.

• Strong

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was Dich erwartet:

Die Labordiagnostik ist das Herzstück unseres Gesundheitswesens und von entscheidender Bedeutung für jeden einzelnen Patienten. Schätzungsweise 70 % aller klinischen Entscheidungen basieren auf In-vitro-diagnostischen Tests. Die absolute Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme ist daher die Grundvoraussetzung für sichere Diagnosen und medizinische Weichenstellungen.

Für unser Praktikantenprogramm suchen wir motivierte, technologiebegeisterte und wissbegierige Studierende, die unser Service-Team tatkräftig unterstützen und gemeinsam mit uns den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche Karriere bei Roche legen möchten.

Werde Teil unserer dynamischen Serviceorganisation! Mit viel Energie, Leidenschaft und Innovationsgeist bringen wir die Labordiagnostik in Deutschland voran und gestalten die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mit. Bei uns kannst Du tagtäglich Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein theoretisches und praktisches Wissen einbringen, um komplexe technische Fragestellungen im Team zu lösen.

Als Praktikant:in (m/w/d) begleitest Du unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden bei der Planung, Installation, Wartung und Modifikation unserer Analysensysteme cobas® pro und cobas® pure . Darüber hinaus tauchst Du tief in die IT-Vernetzung unserer Systeme ein. Bei den täglichen Einsätzen in verschiedenen Krankenhaus- und Privatlaboren sind Deine Eigeninitiative, Deine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Dein technisches Geschick gefragt.

Dein perfekter Start: Zu Beginn Deines Praktikums erhältst Du eine fundierte Ausbildung auf unseren Immunologie cobas®-Systemen und wirst während Deines gesamten Außendiensteinsatzes von einem festen Mentor oder einer Mentorin intensiv begleitet.

Du wirst im Raum Baden-Württemberg eingesetzt und genießt die Freiheit, Deinen Wohnort innerhalb dieses Gebiets frei zu wählen (idealerweise im Raum Pforzheim, Ludwigsburg, Stuttgart, Offenburg, Tuttlingen, Ulm ).

Folgende Schwerpunkte erwarten Dich bei Deinem Praktikum im Service Außendienst:

• Professionelles Training: Du absolvierst im September ein spezialisiertes Wartungstraining an zwei Immunologie-Modulen ( cobas® e402 und cobas® e801 ).

• Praktische Technik: Du stellst Dein handwerkliches und technisches Geschick direkt bei Geräteinstallationen und präventiven Wartungen unter Beweis.

• Problem-Solving: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Analyse sowie Behebung komplexer technischer und applikativer Fragestellungen und unterstützt unser Team aktiv bei der Ursachenforschung.

• Perspektivenwechsel: Du fokussierst Dich auf die Bereiche Klinische Chemie und Immunologie, hast jedoch jederzeit die Möglichkeit, durch Hospitationen auch andere spannende Unternehmensbereiche kennenzulernen.

• Zukunftsthema IT: IT-Netzwerke und IT-Sicherheit wecken Deinen Ehrgeiz – bei der Installation von Firewalls lernst Du direkt von unseren IT-Spezialisten.

• Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Deine organisatorischen Fähigkeiten ein und übernimmst selbstständig definierte Aufgabenpakete (z. B. die professionelle Einweisung unserer Kunden in die Nutzung unserer Online-Plattform Navify ).

• Kommunikationstalent: Du schärfst Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im direkten Dialog mit unseren Kunden sowie bei der kollegialen Abstimmung im Team.

• Flexibilität: Kleinere Projektaufgaben bearbeitest Du ganz flexibel an einzelnen Tagen im Homeoffice. Die meiste Zeit bist Du jedoch dort, wo unsere Geräte stehen: direkt vor Ort bei unseren Kunden.

• Wachstumsumfeld: Wir bieten Dir ein attraktives und wertschätzendes Praktik

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Cosa vi aspetta: La diagnostica di laboratorio è il cuore della nostra assistenza sanitaria e di vitale importanza per ogni singolo paziente. Il 70% di tutte le decisioni cliniche si basa su test diagnostici in vitro. L'assoluta affidabilità dei nostri sistemi è quindi il prerequisito fondamentale per la diagnosi sicura e le impostazioni mediche. Per il nostro programma di stage, stiamo cercando studenti motivati, appassionati di tecnologia e di conoscenza che supportano attivamente il nostro team di assistenza e insieme a noi vogliono porre le basi per una carriera di successo a Roche. Partecipa alla nostra organizzazione di servizi dinamica! Con molta energia, passione e spirito innovativo, proviamo la diagnostica di laboratorio in Germania e formiamo attivamente il futuro della salute. Con noi puoi portare le tue idee e le tue conoscenze teoriche e pratiche ogni giorno per risolvere complesse questioni tecniche nel team. Praktikant:in (m/w/d) I nostri collaboratori esperti nella progettazione, installazione, manutenzione e modifica dei nostri sistemi di analisi cobas® pro e cobas® pure. Inoltre, si immerge nella rete IT dei nostri sistemi. La vostra iniziativa, il vostro forte orientamento al cliente e le vostre competenze tecniche sono necessarie per l'uso quotidiano in vari laboratori ospedalieri e privati. Il vostro inizio perfetto: all'inizio del vostro tirocinio Hai una formazione ben fondata sui nostri sistemi di immunologia cobas® e sono intensamente accompagnati da un mentore o da un mentore solido durante l'intero campo dei servizi esterni. Sei impiegato nell'area di Baden-Württemberg e goditi la libertà di scegliere il tuo luogo di residenza all'interno di questa zona (idealmente nell'area Pforzheim, Ludwigsburg, Stuttgart, Offenburg, Tuttlingen, Ulm ).
• Formazione professionale: In settembre completerai una formazione di manutenzione specializzata su due moduli di immunologia (cobas® e402 e cobas® e801 ). La vostra maestria artigianale e tecnica si rivelano direttamente nelle installazioni dei dispositivi e nella manutenzione preventiva.
• Problem-Solving: Si otterrà approfondimenti nell'analisi, così come affrontare complesse domande tecniche e applicative e sostenere attivamente il nostro team nella ricerca radice.
• Cambiamento di prospettiva: ti concentri sui campi della chimica clinica e dell'immunologia, ma in qualsiasi momento hai la possibilità di conoscere altre aree di business emozionanti per mezzo di ospitazioni.
• Argomento futuro IT: le reti IT e la sicurezza IT risvegliano la tua ambizione – imparano a installare firewall Lei direttamente dai nostri specialisti IT.
• Responsabilità: Portate le vostre capacità organizzative e prendete in modo indipendente le attività definite (ad esempio l'assegnazione professionale dei nostri clienti all'uso della nostra piattaforma online Navify).
• Talenti di comunicazione: Stai sorridendo Le tue capacità di comunicazione in dialogo diretto con i nostri clienti e in coordinamento collegiale nel team.
• Flessibilità: lavoro su piccoli compiti di progetto Sei molto flessibile nei singoli giorni dell'ufficio. La maggior parte del tempo si è, tuttavia, dove i nostri dispositivi si trovano: proprio in loco con i nostri clienti.
• Ambiente di crescita: Vi offriamo uno stage attraente e di valore
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The position What awaits you: Laboratory diagnostics is the heart of our health care and crucial for each individual patient. Estimately 70 % of all clinical decisions are based on in vitro diagnostic tests. The absolute reliability of our systems is therefore the basic requirement for safe diagnosis and medical settings. For our internship program, we are looking for motivated, technology-enhancing and expert students who want to actively support our service team and together with us set the foundation for a successful career at Roche. Be part of our dynamic service organization! With a lot of energy, passion and innovative spirit, we advance laboratory diagnostics in Germany and actively shape the future of healthcare. With us you can bring your own ideas and your theoretical and practical knowledge every day to solve complex technical questions in the team. Senior Consultant (m/w/d) Our experienced employees in the planning, installation, maintenance and modification of our analysis systems cobas® pro and cobas® pure . In addition, you immerse yourself in the IT networking of our systems. Your own initiative, your strong customer orientation and your technical skills are required for daily use in various hospital and private laboratories. Your perfect start: At the beginning of your internship You have a well-founded training on our immunology cobas® systems and are intensively accompanied by a firm mentor or mentor during your entire field of external services. You are employed in the area of Baden-Württemberg and enjoy the freedom to choose your place of residence within this area (ideally in the area Pforzheim, Ludwigsburg, Stuttgart, Offenburg, Tuttlingen, Ulm ). The following priorities await you during your internship in the Service field service:
• Professional training: In September you complete a specialized maintenance training on two immunology modules (cobas® e402 and cobas® e801 ).
• Practical technology: you set Your craftsmanship and technical skills prove directly in device installations and preventive maintenance.
• Problem-Solving: You get deep insights into the analysis, as well as addressing complex technical and application questions and actively support our team in root research.
• Change of perspective: You focus on the fields of clinical chemistry and immunology, but at any time you have the opportunity to get to know other exciting areas of business by means of hospitations.
• Future topic IT: IT networks and IT security awaken your ambition – learn to install firewalls You directly from our IT specialists.
• Own Responsibility: You bring your organizational skills and take self-defined task packages (e.g. the professional assignment of our customers into the use of our Navify online platform).
• Communication talent: You can create your communication skills in direct dialogue with our customers and in collegial coordination in the team.
• Flexibility: Work on smaller project tasks You are very flexible on individual days at home office. Most of the time you are, however, where our devices are located: directly on site with our customers.
• Growth Area: We offer you an attractive and value-adding internship
