A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Stai cercando di plasmare attivamente l'assistenza sanitaria di domani e portare terapie innovative esattamente dove fanno la più grande differenza: al paziente. Come Customer Partnering Lead (CPL) (m/w/d) Sei la forza trainante dietro la nostra strategia di partner del cliente e collegare il nostro portafoglio forte nel campo dell'emofilia con le esigenze individuali del mercato sanitario. Insieme al vostro team, è possibile creare reti sostenibili e assicurarsi che le nostre innovazioni mediche hanno il loro pieno potenziale. La tua squadra Non vedo l'ora di Nel vostro ruolo, guidate un team dedicato di Customer Partnering Managers (CPMs) e insieme a loro plasmare le opportunità e le sfide nelle aree/regioni da responsabili – intorno a cliniche, HCP consolidati, le loro reti e altri player chiave nel sistema sanitario. In questo modo, non solo coordinare le attività congiunte, ma anche accompagnare attivamente il vostro team nel suo sviluppo professionale e personale. I Customer Partnering Manager assumono un ruolo olistico e orientato al cliente che soddisfa i requisiti di un ambiente di mercato in continua evoluzione. Questi includono il posizionamento promozionale mirato del nostro portafoglio prodotti, nonché il posizionamento scientifico-medico, non promozionale dei dati congressuali attuali. responsabilità Ti aspetti
• Ispirare la leadership: dare orientamento al vostro team, impostare un quadro chiaro e rafforzare una cultura di cooperazione, prendere la responsabilità, prendere decisioni e risolvere i conflitti costruttivamente. Accompagnate i vostri colleghi nel loro sviluppo, date impulsi e promuovete l'auto-responsabilità.
• Driver per la crescita & Synergies: Riconosce le opportunità a livello di malattia, sviluppa impulsi previsionali e promuove sinergie attraverso una stretta interazione con altri CPL e dirigenti. In questo modo, contribuisce a rendere visibile il potenziale in una fase iniziale e a consentire una crescita sostenibile.
• Analisi di rete & Mapping strategico: Si prende l'identificazione precoce, l'osservazione e l'analisi delle reti tematiche rilevanti e le relazioni nel mercato dell'emofilia. Le complesse relazioni e dinamiche all'interno di queste reti sono pronte Siete strutturati e visualizzati.
• Sviluppo di strategia: Lei è responsabile dell'individuazione di approcci strategici adeguati e della definizione di pietre miliari chiare al fine di sfruttare al meglio le strutture di rete catturate per i nostri obiettivi specifici della zona di malattia.
• Gestione Stakeholder & Project Management: coordina la cooperazione interdipartimentale sulle strutture di rete. Accompagnate i progetti che ne risultano dalla pianificazione all'implementazione e assicurate la continua integrazione di stakeholder interni ed esterni rilevanti.
• Gestione risorse e bilancio: si controllano i bilanci e gli investimenti in modo efficace, traducono obiettivi strategici in chiare priorità e misure concrete e allineano costantemente le attività, gli argomenti e i clienti con il miglior uso possibile delle risorse.
• Assicurare l'efficacia: creare le condizioni per la cooperazione per avere successo in modo efficace, prendere decisioni rapidamente e identificare gli ostacoli in una fase iniziale e sbarazzarsi di loro. Così

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Vous essayez de façonner activement les soins de santé de demain et d'apporter des thérapies innovantes exactement là où elles font la plus grande différence : pour le patient. En tant que chef de file pour les partenaires clients (LCP) (m/w/d) Vous êtes le moteur de notre stratégie de partenariat client et connectez notre solide portefeuille dans le domaine de l'hémophilie aux besoins individuels du marché des soins de santé. Avec votre équipe, vous pouvez créer des réseaux durables et vous assurer que nos innovations médicales ont tout leur potentiel. Votre équipe Vous pouvez attendre avec impatience Dans votre rôle, vous dirigez une équipe dédiée de gestionnaires de partenaires clients (CPM) et avec eux façonnent les opportunités et les défis dans les zones/régions pour être responsables – autour des cliniques, des HCP établis, leurs réseaux et d'autres acteurs clés dans le système de santé. Ce faisant, vous ne coordonnez pas seulement les activités conjointes, mais accompagnez activement votre équipe dans son développement professionnel et personnel. Les gestionnaires de partenaires clients assument un rôle holistique et axé sur le client qui répond aux exigences d'un environnement de marché en constante évolution. Ceux-ci comprennent le placement promotionnel ciblé de notre portefeuille de produits ainsi que le placement scientifique-médical, non promotionnel des données actuelles du congrès. Responsabilités Vous vous attendez
• Inspirer le leadership : vous donnez une orientation à votre équipe, définissez un cadre clair et renforcez une culture de coopération, prenez des responsabilités, prenez des décisions et réglez les conflits de manière constructive. Vous accompagnez vos collègues dans leur développement, donnez des impulsions et favorisez l'autoresponsabilité.
• Les moteurs de croissance et les synergies: Vous reconnaissez les opportunités à l'échelle de la zone de la maladie, développez des impulsions tournées vers l'avenir et favorisez les synergies par une interaction étroite avec d'autres CPL et cadres. De cette façon, vous contribuez à rendre le potentiel visible à un stade précoce et à favoriser une croissance durable.
• Analyse des réseaux et cartographie stratégique: vous prenez l'identification précoce, l'observation et l'analyse des réseaux thématiques pertinents ainsi que les relations sur le marché de l'hémophilie. Les relations complexes et la dynamique au sein de ces réseaux sont prêtes Vous êtes structuré et visualisé.
• Développement de la stratégie : vous êtes responsable de l'identification d'approches stratégiques appropriées et de la définition de jalons clairs afin d'utiliser au mieux les structures de réseau capturées pour nos cibles spécifiques à la zone de maladie.
• Gestion des parties prenantes et gestion de projet : Vous coordonnez la coopération interministérielle sur les structures du réseau. Vous accompagnez les projets qui en résultent, de la planification à la mise en œuvre et vous assurez l'intégration continue des parties prenantes internes et externes concernées.
• Gestion des ressources et du budget : vous contrôlez efficacement les budgets et les investissements, traduisez les objectifs stratégiques en priorités claires et en mesures concrètes et alignez systématiquement les activités, les sujets et les clients sur la meilleure utilisation possible des ressources.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Estamos buscando um(a) Key Account Manager para atuar em nossa estrutura da Roche Diagnóstica para ser responsável posição de alta visibilidade e liderança, responsável pela gestão de um portfólio que abrange dispositivos médicos, diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) e soluções de saúde digital. Você terá visão de ecossistema, assegurando o crescimento sustentável do negócio em uma das contas mais estratégicas da companhia.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Atuar como o principal ponto de contato executivo para uma rede diagnóstica nacional de primeira linha ( Tier-1 ), alinhando o roadmap de inovação da Roche aos objetivos de negócios de longo prazo do cliente.

• Liderar negociações de alto valor para dispositivos médicos, produtos de diagnóstico e serviços científicos, gerenciando todo o ciclo de vida comercial de ponta a ponta.

• Influenciar times internos (técnicos, científicos e de supply chain ) para garantir a excelência operacional e a entrega impecável nos sites do cliente.

• Identificar oportunidades de expansão e novas frentes de negócio dentro da pegada geográfica da conta, incluindo diagnósticos especializados.

• Graduação completa preferencialmente em áreas Científicas ou de Gestão. Pós-graduação ou MBA será considerado um diferencial.

• Histórico comprovado no gerenciamento e negociação com grandes redes de laboratórios ( Big Labs ) ou grandes grupos hospitalares no mercado brasileiro.

• Expertise em negociações B2B complexas, gestão de P&L e consultoria de saúde baseada em valor ( Value-Based Healthcare ).

• Pensamento estratégico, excelente comunicação executiva e resiliência para navegar em ambientes corporativos complexos.

jobs.title: Team Lead Design Control Excellence
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As the Team Lead for Design Control Excellence (DCE) in Sant Cugat, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how we develop life-saving diagnostic solutions. You will build and inspire a team of Process Managers dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of regulatory compliance and operational efficiency. This is an opportunity to lead a digital and cultural transformation, fostering a high-performance environment where agile mindsets drive better outcomes for patients.

Empower and Grow Talent: Coach and mentor a team of six Process Managers, focusing on their technical growth, strategic thinking, and long-term career journeys.

Champion Process Governance: Lead the optimization of critical system, software, and assay projects across Risk, 
• Requirements, Configuration, Defect Management and Verification & Validation.

Drive Operational Excellence: Ensure all development documentation meets rigorous global regulatory standards (such as ISO 13485) while championing radical simplification.

Foster Global Collaboration: Act as a key bridge between Development, Quality, Regulatory, and Customer Service teams to ensure seamless information flow and project success.

Model Agile Leadership: Serve as a catalyst for cultural change by encouraging experimentation, trust, and cross-functional collaboration within a matrixed organization.

Strategic Vision: Accelerate knowledge transfer and upskill your team to meet the evolving needs of a global diagnostics landscape.

Who You Are
You are a people-oriented leader who excels at navigating complex organizations through influence and collaboration. You are passionate about developing others and bring a strategic vision to technical process management.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

Strong Educational Foundation: An advanced university degree in Life Sciences, Natural Sciences, or Engineering.

Industry Expertise: At least five years of experience in Product Development or Process Management, ideally within the Diagnostics or Medical Device sector.

Leadership Track Record: Proven experience leading people in a line capacity with a focus on building networks and inspiring teams through change.

Analytical & Influencing Skills: A deep understanding of design control processes and the ability to resolve conflicts and align stakeholders across global locations.

Effective Communication: Excellent verbal and written English skills to partner with global teams; proficiency in Spanish or German is a valuable asset.

At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to excel and achieve strong results, together.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
​ Are you a people-oriented leader with a vision for how digital transformation can revolutionize internal customer support? As the Team Lead for our R&D ISS Global Support Center in Sant Cugat, you will have the unique opportunity to build and grow a dedicated service hub from the ground up. You will lead and manage a high-performing team that provides support to our global R&D "customers," ensuring our scientists and engineers can focus on life-changing innovation while you drive the evolution of the team through digital transformation and innovation of our internal processes.

Your main responsabilities:

• Build a New Service Hub: Establish and evolve a dedicated operational excellence center in Spain, managing and coaching a diverse team of specialists.

• Lead with Empathy & Vision: Act as a relationship-focused leader, balancing high-empathy service with a strategic vision for process automation and global support. Master R&D Support Operations: Oversee operational customer support in critical areas including Document Management (EDMS), Learning Management (LMS), and global data workflows in SAP S/4HANA.

• Champion Digital Innovation: Partner with global teams to identify repetitive "pain points" and leverage Agentic AI and automation to digitize tasks and improve efficiency and service quality.

• Drive Operational Excellence: Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to ensure timely, accurate resolution of requests while maintaining a constant state of audit-readiness.

• Navigate a Global Matrix: Collaborate effectively with leaders and colleagues across Spain, the US, Germany, and Switzerland to align the Sant Cugat hub with global R&D goals.

• Foster a High-Performing Culture: Integrate Roche Leadership Commitments into daily practice, utilizing agile principles to create an inspiring, motivating, and inclusive work environment.

Who You Are
You are a proactive "thinker" and leader who thrives in conditions of ambiguity. You possess the interpersonal skills to navigate organizational complexity and the strategic mindset needed to upskill a team for bridging daily operations in legacy systems while building the future of AI-driven support.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Advanced Educational Foundation: An advanced university degree or Bachelor’s degree in a technical, scientific, or business discipline.

• Proven Leadership Track Record: 5+ years of experience leading or managing technical, engineering, or global customer support teams.

• System & Quality Expertise: Expert knowledge of enterprise applications (e.g. EDMS, LMS, SAP) and experience operating in highly regulated environments (e.g. Diagnostics, Pharma, Finance, Automotive).

• Digital Transformation Mindset: Education or experience in Agentic AI, automation, or AI prompt engineering to drive modern support models

• Exceptional Communication & Influence: Expert fluency in English and the ability to influence senior stakeholders in a global, multicultural matrix organization. German language skills are a plus.

Our leaders empower you to achieve your fullest potential, fostering a culture where everyone can demonstrate leadership and navigate change with confidence.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26

jobs.title: Senior Process Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Senior Process Manager within our Design Control Excellence (DCE) team in Sant Cugat, you will be responsible for the essential development processes that ensure our life-saving products are safe, effective, and compliant. You will play a key role in executing requirement, risk, configuration, defect management management and verification & validation within complex development projects. This is an opportunity to join a growing innovation hub where you will work in a cross-functional environment to ensure compliant execution while continuously optimizing efficiency to meet evolving organizational needs.

• Lead Process Governance: Provide expert guidance and support for complex system, software, and assay projects across risk, requirements, configuration, and defect management.

• Master Requirements & Traceability: Support multi-level requirements traceability and ensure all data is maintained within a streamlined, database-driven approach across projects.

• Conduct Strategic Risk Assessments: Lead detailed product risk assessments by analyzing documents, reports, and market trends alongside cross-functional teams.

• Establish Configuration Management: Build and maintain configuration management for complex projects, ensuring a clear overview of past, present, and future product states.

• Ensure Regulatory Excellence: Provide specialized support to ensure that Verification & Validation (V&V) activities meet both internal standards and global regulatory requirements like ISO 13485.

• Drive Radical Simplification: Proactively identify opportunities for process optimization and simplification to improve time-to-market without compromising quality.

• Collaborate Globally: Thrive in an agile, multicultural setting where we experiment, learn, and trust each other to deliver the best results for patients.

Who You Are
You are a proactive and service-oriented professional who excels at solving complex problems independently. You bring strong analytical thinking and the ability to communicate precisely in a collaborative, global environment.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Advanced Academic Foundation: A Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Natural Sciences, or a related field.

• Experience : Minimum of three years of experience in a regulated environment within product development or process management (Medical Device or Diagnostics industry preferred).

• Technical Mastery: A strong understanding of Design Control processes and global standards such as ISO 13485 or IEC 62304 .

• Digital Fluency: Experience with ALM tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or specialized requirements management software is highly valued .

• Exceptional Communication: Precise and efficient communication skills in English, enabling effective collaboration across our international sites .

There are 2 positions of this role.

At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to excel and achieve strong results, together.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapte r is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.

The Role

We are seeking an R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist I to join our global service and support team. You are well organized and detail-oriented. You will be the reliable service provider handling critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.

This role requires building organizational know-how—understanding who our internal customers are, how they work, and solving problems in a way that anticipates their support needs. You are quick in learning new software systems and tools, enjoy helping your coworkers every day, and are motivated to innovate internal processes to automate tasks, you will fit right into our team!

Your key Responsibilities

As a part of a global centralized expert support team, execute enterprise tool system tasks based on R&D customer requests, leveraging expert knowledge of business tools, compliance requirements, and R&D teams and processes.

• Execute R&D System Requests: Fulfill customer tool requests using expertise in business systems and compliance standards.

• Provide Timely Expert Support: Offer professional, empathetic, and quick solutions to R&D operational issues and system problems. You may be the primary contact for R&D scientists and engineers in the use of our internal enterprise systems.

• Expert in our Global Business Applications: Act as the subject matter expert for one or more complex R&D business applications.

• Specialize in R&D Business Processes: Develop deep expertise in key processes (e.g., records management, lab data, training system data, change requests) for timely and accurate execution.

• Maximize Scientist Productivity: Use your expertise across business data and organizational structure to streamline operations and save significant time for R&D scientists.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Build organizational know-how of R&D roles and priorities to deliver proactive system support.

• Maintain Global Service Excellence: Demonstrate a strong, collaborative customer service mindset within a diverse, global team.

• Drive Process Improvement: Identify manual steps and actively suggest opportunities for digitization and improvement.

• Automate Administrative Tasks: Apply or develop automation and AI tools to reduce administrative load on R&D staff.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes, supporting audits and data retrieval.

Who you are:

Education : Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical, scientific, or business discipline.

Experience : 2+ years of professional experience in an operations, technical support, or system administration role, or equivalent academic projects / internships

Language Skills: Excellent written and verbal English Language skills are required to support our global organization. German language skills are a plus.

System Proficiency:

• Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new software, systems, and processes is essential.

• P

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapter is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing the complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.

The Role

We are seeking an R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist II to join our global internal service and support team. In this mid-level role, you will apply your conceptual knowledge and significant working experience to perform a range of assignments with limited guidance. You will act as a reliable service provider with a customer-oriented mindset to handle critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.
Rather than just managing system change requests, you will manage the integrity of the business process within our internal tools. By developing a deep understanding of the R&D organization and unique team needs, you will translate diverse business needs into effective system and data configurations. You will handle complex requests, ensuring that as our internal digital infrastructure evolves, our global R&D teams remain compliant, organized, and productive.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute System Requests with Limited Guidance: Fulfill customer requests and generate business metrics by performing a range of assignments related to your discipline, ensuring that enterprise system tool configurations / data updates align with actual R&D workflows / needs.

• Anticipate and Solve Complex Problems: Understand the impact of system changes on the broader level to anticipate issues. Analyze possible solutions to operational issues and system problems by relying on your experience, judgment, and established precedents.

• Functional Decision-Making: Use your knowledge of your internal customers (the R&D teams) and their diverse needs to make informed decisions on system logic, such as grouping training curricula based on learner job functions, or making logical document hierarchies based on your learned organisational knowledge.

• Organizational Transition Management: Execute structural data migrations and updates within system tools driven by acquisitions, reorganizations, and digitalization projects to ensure user permissions, configurations, access, and data reflect the current state of the company.

• Mentorship and Guidance: Provide guidance to new team members and R&D internal customers. Based on your expertise navigating our enterprise tool workflows, configurations, and data - you provide guidance and oversight of system usage. You routinely will need to explain information to others in a straightforward manner, and deliver presentations when needed to support training, onboarding, and engaging stakeholders participation in our projects.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Understand key organizational drivers and areas of expertise to proactively anticipate needs, accomplish your work, and represent internal customers' needs to global project teams.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes

• Provide data monitoring and statistics You may be asked to support audits by showing adherence to our quality management systems and pr

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Process Manager within our Design Control Excellence (DCE) team in Sant Cugat, you will be responsible for the essential development processes that ensure our life-saving diagnostic products are safe, effective, and compliant. You will play a key role in the execution of Requirement Management, Product Risk Management, Configuration Management, Defect Management and Verification & Validation within development projects. Joining a growing innovation hub, you will work in a cross-functional environment to secure compliant execution while continuously optimizing process efficiency to meet evolving organizational needs.

Key Responsabilities

• Process Support: Provide process guidance and support for system, software, and assay projects with low complexity across Risk, Requirements, Configuration, Verification & Validation and Defect Management.

• Product Requirements: Support the creation and maintenance of product requirements by using the respective IT tool. Ensure that the appropriate documentation is created and are responsible for obtaining approval from the stakeholders.Facilitate and maintain the requirements traceability throughout the development of the product

• R isk Assessment: Support execution of product risk assessments. Create and maintain respective risk documentation.

• Configuration Management : Establish and maintain Configuration Management for projects, maintaining a clear overview of past, present, and future product configurations.

• Defect Management: Support with defect management by creating the defect management plan and managing defects.

• Verification & Validation: Provide support to ensure that V&V activities are planned, executed and documented according to our internal procedures.

• Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process optimization and "radical simplification" to improve time-to-market without compromising quality

Who You Are

You are a proactive and service-oriented professional who excels at analytical thinking, problem-solving, and precise communication. You possess a collaborative mindset and are excited to grow your skills in a dynamic environment where we experiment and learn together.

• Educational Foundation: A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Natural Sciences, or a related field.

• Regulated Industry Expertise: A minimum of three years of professional experience in a regulated product development environment (or a Master's degree), with preferred exposure to the Medical Device or Diagnostics industry.

• Technical Process Mastery: A understanding of Design Control processes and relevant global standards, such as ISO 13485 or IEC 62304.

• Digital Fluency: Familiarity with ALM tracking systems (such as Jira, Azure DevOps, RETINA, or HP ALM) is considered a plus.

jobs.title: Medical Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Medical Affairs Lead, you will play a central, highly collaborative role in our global mission by planning and implementing medical activities for our products in the customer area of Core Lab Reagents with focus on our women's health and endocrinology portfolio. You will join a fast-paced, matrixed environment where your scientific acumen and operational focus will directly shape our Global Medical Plan. This is an opportunity to combine science with strategy, ensuring that clinical value and medical insights are seamlessly integrated across our product lifecycle.

Your main responsibilities

• Shape Global Medical Plans: Contribute to annual and ongoing medical planning, delivering situational analysis and defined strategy to drive the lifecycle of our diagnostic innovations .

• Master Stakeholder Engagement: Drive the mapping of global Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and professional societies, managing lists of current and emerging experts to bring external know-how in-house .

• Execute High-Impact Activities: Lead the end-to-end execution of medical education, advisory boards, and scientific activities at major international congresses in close collaboration with our local affiliates .

• Manage Strategic Budgets: Oversee medical activity budgets and plan resource allocation in alignment with broader product teams and corporate finance .

• Ensure Scientific Integrity: Conduct thorough reviews of non-promotional medical materials, ensuring absolute alignment with global legal, regulatory, and company codes of practice .

• Cultivate Global Partnerships: Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional leaders, clinical trial investigators, and external alliance partners, including Contract Research Organizations (CROs) .

• Drive Process Optimization: Permanently optimize processes to increase quality and efficiency standards across our medical operations .

Who You Are
You are a proactive, adaptable professional who thrives when collaborating across diverse teams . You are deeply patient-centric, possessing the strategic mindset and communication skills needed to translate complex data into clear medical concepts and influence diverse points of view .

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Advanced Scientific Background: An advanced degree in Life Science or a related field, combined with relevant expertise in the healthcare industry or academia .

• Deep Sector Experience: 5+ years of experience in medical affairs, clinical development or scientific communication functions is preferred; project management or product marketing experience is a plus. As well as experience in one or more of the following indications Women's Health, Endocrinology, Laboratory Medicine

• Matrix Leadership Mastery: A proven track record of leading within matrixed organizations, making strategic decisions, and effectively influencing stakeholders .

• Cross-Cultural Agility: Demonstrated capability to partner across diverse regions, cultures, and time zones to actively build an environment of belonging and inclusion .

• Effective Communication: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, allowing you to independently navigate complex situations and explain difficult concepts .

At Roche, inclusion isn’t just a policy—it’s a way of life. Together, we don’t just accept individuality—we embrace it.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni L'opportunità Come Leader per gli Affari Medici, svolgerai un ruolo centrale e altamente collaborativo nella nostra missione globale, pianificando e implementando attività mediche per i nostri prodotti nell'area clienti di Core Lab Reagents con particolare attenzione al portafoglio di salute e e endocrinologia femminile. Ti unirai a un ambiente a matrice rapida, dove il tuo acum scientifico e il tuo focus operativo plasmaranno direttamente il nostro Piano Medico Globale. Questa è un'opportunità per combinare la scienza con la strategia, assicurando che il valore clinico e le intuizioni mediche siano perfettamente integrate nel nostro ciclo di vita del prodotto. Le tue principali responsabilità - Forma Piani Medici Globali: Contribuisci alla pianificazione medica annuale e continua, fornendo analisi situazioni e strategia definita per guidare il ciclo di vita delle nostre innovazioni diagnostiche. - Master Stakeholder Engagement: Guidare la mappatura dei leader globali delle opinioni chiave (KOL) e società professionali, gestendo liste di esperti attuali ed emergenti per portare il know-how esterno in-house. - Esecuzione di attività ad alto impatto: condurre l'esecuzione end-to-end di educazione medica, consiglieri e attività scientifiche nei principali congressi internazionali in stretta collaborazione con i nostri affiliati locali. - Gestione dei bilanci strategici: supervisionare i bilanci delle attività mediche e pianificare l'allocazione delle risorse in allineamento con le squadre di prodotto più ampie e la finanza aziendale. - Assicurare l'integrità scientifica: Condurre valutazioni approfondite di materiali medici non promozionali, garantendo un allineamento assoluto con i codici di pratica legali, regolamentari e aziendali globali. - Coltivare partenariati globali: costruire e mantenere relazioni forti e collaborative con leader interfunzionali, ricercatori di sperimentazione clinica e partner di alleanza esterna, tra cui le Organizzazioni di Ricerca Contrattuali (CRO). - Ottimizzazione del processo di trasmissione: ottimizzare costantemente i processi per aumentare la qualità e gli standard di efficienza nelle nostre operazioni mediche.
• Requisiti Chi sei Sei un professionista proattivo e adattabile che prospera quando collabora tra diverse squadre. Sei profondamente paziente-centrico, possedendo le competenze strategiche e di comunicazione necessarie per tradurre i dati complessi in chiari concetti medici e influenzare diversi punti di vista. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta: - Sfondo scientifico avanzato: un grado avanzato in Life Science o un campo correlato, combinato con competenze rilevanti nel settore sanitario o accademia. - Esperienza nel settore profondo: 5+ anni di esperienza negli affari medici, lo sviluppo clinico o le funzioni di comunicazione scientifica è preferito; la gestione del progetto o l'esperienza di marketing del prodotto è un plus. Oltre all'esperienza in una o più delle seguenti indicazioni: Salute femminile, Endocrinologia, Medicina di laboratorio. - Matrix Leadership Mastery: un comprovato track record di leader all'interno di organizzazioni matrici, prendere decisioni strategiche e influenzare efficacemente gli stakeholder. - Agility interculturale: Capacità dimostrata di collaborare in diverse regioni, culture e fusi orari per costruire attivamente un ambiente di appartenenza e inclusione. - Comunicazione efficace: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese verbali e scritte, permettendo di navigare in modo indipendente situazioni complesse e spiegare concetti difficili. Cosa? A Roche, l’inclusione non è solo una politica: è un modo di vivere. Insieme, non accettiamo solo l’individualità – lo abbracciamo. Contatto Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, l'intervallo di paga non è fornito.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mansion Die Chance Als Medical Affairs Lead spielen Sie eine zentrale, hochkollaborative Rolle in unserer globalen Mission, indem Sie medizinische Aktivitäten für unsere Produkte im Kundenbereich von Core Lab Reagents planen und implementieren, die sich auf das Gesundheits- und Endokrinologieportfolio unserer Frauen konzentrieren. Sie werden sich einer rasanten, Matrix-Umgebung anschließen, in der Ihr wissenschaftlicher Schwerpunkt und Ihr operativer Schwerpunkt direkt unseren globalen medizinischen Plan prägen. Dies ist eine Gelegenheit, Wissenschaft mit Strategie zu kombinieren, um sicherzustellen, dass klinische Werte und medizinische Erkenntnisse nahtlos in unseren Produktlebenszyklus integriert sind.
• Ihre Hauptaufgaben - Shape Global Medical Plans: Beitrag zur jährlichen und laufenden medizinischen Planung, Bereitstellung von Situationsanalysen und definierter Strategie, um den Lebenszyklus unserer diagnostischen Innovationen voranzutreiben. - Master Stakeholder Engagement: Führen Sie die Mapping von globalen Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) und Berufsgesellschaften, Managementlisten von aktuellen und aufstrebenden Experten, um externes Know-how in-house zu bringen. - Execute High-Impact-Aktivitäten: Führen Sie die End-to-End-Ausführung der medizinischen Ausbildung, Beratung und wissenschaftlichen Aktivitäten auf großen internationalen Kongressen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren lokalen Affiliates. - Verwalten Sie Strategische Budgets: Beaufsichtigen Sie die Budgets für medizinische Aktivitäten und planen Sie Ressourcenzuweisung in Abstimmung mit breiteren Produktteams und Unternehmensfinanzierung. - Vergewissern Sie sich, dass wissenschaftliche Integrität: Durchführung gründlicher Überprüfungen von nicht-promotionalen medizinischen Materialien, Sicherstellung absoluter Übereinstimmung mit globalen Rechts-, Regulierungs- und Unternehmenscodes der Praxis. - Cultivate Global Partnerships: Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung starker, kollaborativer Beziehungen zu funktionsübergreifenden Führungskräften, klinischen Tester und externen Allianzpartnern, einschließlich Contract Research Organizations (CROs). - Prozessoptimierung: Prozessoptimierung permanent optimieren, um Qualitäts- und Effizienzstandards im gesamten medizinischen Betrieb zu erhöhen. Voraussetzungen Wer bist du? Sie sind ein proaktiver, anpassungsfähiger Profi, der bei der Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen Teams lebt. Sie sind zutiefst geduldig, besitzen die strategischen Denkweise und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die benötigt werden, um komplexe Daten in klare medizinische Konzepte zu übersetzen und verschiedene Gesichtspunkte zu beeinflussen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie: - Fortgeschrittener wissenschaftlicher Hintergrund: Ein fortgeschrittener Abschluss in Life Science oder einem verwandten Bereich, kombiniert mit relevanten Fachkenntnissen in der Gesundheitsbranche oder in der Wissenschaft. - Deep Sector Experience: 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in medizinischen Angelegenheiten, klinische Entwicklung oder wissenschaftliche Kommunikationsfunktionen ist bevorzugt; Projektmanagement oder Produktmarketing-Erfahrung ist ein Plus. Neben der Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Hinweise: Frauengesundheit, Endokrinologie, Labormedizin. - Matrix Leadership Mastery: Ein bewährter Track-Recording von führenden in Matrix-Organisationen, strategische Entscheidungen zu treffen und effektiv Einfluss auf die Interessengruppen. - Cross-Cultural Agility: Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, in verschiedenen Regionen, Kulturen und Zeitzonen zusammenzuarbeiten, um aktiv ein Umfeld der Zugehörigkeit und Inklusion aufzubauen. - Effektive Kommunikation: Ausgezeichnete verbale und geschriebene englische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, so dass Sie selbstständig komplexe Situationen navigieren und schwierige Konzepte erklären.
• Cosa offriamo Bei Roche ist die Integration nicht nur eine Politik – es ist eine Lebensweise. Gemeinsam akzeptieren wir nicht nur Individualität – wir umarmen es. Contattoo Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle wird der Lohnbereich nicht bereitgestellt.

Vous vous joindrez à un environnement matricié et rapide où votre acuité scientifique et votre concentration opérationnelle façonneront directement notre Plan Médical Mondial. C'est l'occasion de combiner la science et la stratégie, en veillant à ce que la valeur clinique et les connaissances médicales soient intégrées de façon transparente dans notre cycle de vie des produits. Vos principales responsabilités - Former des plans médicaux mondiaux : contribuer à la planification médicale annuelle et continue, fournir une analyse de situation et une stratégie définie pour conduire le cycle de vie de nos innovations diagnostiques. - Maîtriser l'engagement des parties prenantes : Conduire la cartographie des leaders mondiaux de l'opinion et des sociétés professionnelles, gérer les listes d'experts actuels et émergents pour apporter un savoir-faire externe en interne. - Exécuter des activités à haut impact : Diriger l'exécution de bout en bout de l'enseignement médical, des conseils consultatifs et des activités scientifiques dans les grands congrès internationaux en étroite collaboration avec nos affiliés locaux. - Gérer les budgets stratégiques : Surveiller les budgets des activités médicales et planifier l'affectation des ressources en fonction des équipes de produits et des finances de l'entreprise. - Assurer l'intégrité scientifique : procéder à des examens approfondis du matériel médical non promotionnel, en assurant un alignement absolu sur les codes de pratique mondiaux en matière de droit, de réglementation et d'entreprise. - Cultiver des partenariats mondiaux : établir et maintenir des relations de collaboration solides avec des chefs de file interfonctionnels, des chercheurs en essais cliniques et des partenaires d'alliance externes, y compris des organismes de recherche contractuels. - Optimisation des processus d'entraînement : Optimisation permanente des processus pour améliorer la qualité et l'efficacité de nos opérations médicales.
• Requisiti Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel proactif et adaptable qui prospère en collaborant entre différentes équipes. Vous êtes profondément axé sur le patient, possédant l'état d'esprit stratégique et les compétences de communication nécessaires pour traduire des données complexes en concepts médicaux clairs et influencer divers points de vue. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez : - Contexte scientifique avancé : Diplôme d'études supérieures en sciences de la vie ou dans un domaine connexe, associé à une expertise pertinente dans l'industrie de la santé ou les universités. - Expérience de secteur profond: 5 ans et plus d'expérience dans les affaires médicales, le développement clinique ou les fonctions de communication scientifique est préféré; la gestion de projet ou l'expérience de marketing de produits est un plus. En plus de l'expérience dans une ou plusieurs des indications suivantes: santé des femmes, endocrinologie, médecine de laboratoire. - Maîtrise du leadership matricielle : une expérience éprouvée de leadership au sein des organisations matricielles, de prise de décisions stratégiques et d'influence efficace des intervenants. - Agilité transculturelle : Capacité démontrée de s'associer à diverses régions, cultures et fuseaux horaires pour construire activement un environnement d'appartenance et d'inclusion. - Communication efficace : Excellentes compétences de communication verbale et écrite en anglais, vous permettant de naviguer de façon indépendante dans des situations complexes et d'expliquer des concepts difficiles.
• Cosa offriamo À Roche, l'inclusion n'est pas seulement une politique, c'est un mode de vie. Ensemble, nous n'acceptons pas seulement l'individualité, nous l'embrassons. Contatto Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'échelle de rémunération n'est pas fournie.

jobs.title: Clinical Site Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Clinical Site Manager for the Study Delivery Near Patient Care CVMD team, you are designing, planning, coordinating, and conducting all activities involved in initiating, monitoring, and completing clinical research studies at the clinical study sites. You are delivering other data generation methodologies, working independently to ensure studies are delivered, recorded, and reported in accordance with protocol, standard operating procedures, good clinical practices, and other applicable regulatory requirements.

The Opportunity

Acting as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, coordinating training, certification, and providing technical assistance to ensure successful study execution.

• Performing site assessments and qualification visits to support the site selection decision process and site activation activities, including contracting and obtaining IRB/EC/Health Authority approvals in compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Developing and managing key study site documentation, such as Study Monitoring Plans, informed consent documents, source documents, patient instruction guides, and case report forms, while contributing technical expertise to review study protocols, data management plans, reports, and manuscripts.

• Overseeing CROs for the delivery of site management activities, including training CRO CRAs, escalating issues, and collaborating with international investigators and key customers while mentoring and supporting colleagues to enhance their skills and expertise.

• Executing site management activities for sponsored studies in assigned focus areas across all phases of study (start-up, conduct, and close-out) for both registrational and non-registrational purposes.

• Validating product performance claims, supplying data for critical regulatory submissions, defining the functional and clinical utility of products, and gathering feedback and opinions from laboratories or customers regarding the products.

• Working in local and global study teams, including virtual teams, demonstrating diversity, cultural awareness, and fostering strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional team members, internal stakeholders, and external partners to achieve business goals and ensure operational excellence.

Who You Are

• You bring a Bachelor's degree in Science Degree preferably in Health Sciences like Clinical Diagnostics or engineering (or equivalent combination of education and work experience)

• You have 3 years of working experience in either the Medical Device or Diagnostics industry, and 2 years of working experience in clinical study of IVD/Medical Device/Drug.

• You have experience particularly in the cardiovascular/metabolic indication and Near Patient Care or Point of Care. Experience with studies in an emergency department setting is a plus.

• Excellent understanding of ICH GCP guidelines in the execution of clinical trials

Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal applicant.

• Exhibits the ability to make sound decisions and to analyze and solve problems; makes independent choices and takes responsibility

• ​ Demonstrates flexibility and adaptability to perform in a fast-paced, matrixed environment where fluid, cross-team collaboration is crucial.

jobs.title: Clinical Contract Administrator
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Clinical Contract Administrator, you will play a vital role in ensuring the smooth financial and operational execution of our clinical studies. You will act as a key collaborator between Clinical Operations, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Procurement, Legal, and Finance to manage the lifecycle of supplier contracts and payments. This is an opportunity to join a high-performing team where your attention to detail directly supports the delivery of innovative healthcare solutions.

The key accountabilities for this position include but are not limited to

• Drive Financial Accuracy: Create and track purchase orders (POs), invoices, and accruals using our financial systems to ensure all supplier payments are precise and timely.

• Optimize Data Integrity: Maintain and update contract information within our tracking tools to ensure completeness and accuracy at all times.

• Master Contract Lifecycle Management: Take end-to-end responsibility for the contract signature process, from initial request through to service termination and final reconciliation. Track, maintain, and update assigned contract information within the CDMA tracking tools to ensure completeness and accuracy, as applicable.

• Champion Compliance Reporting: Prepare and submit reports regarding transfers of value to healthcare providers, ensuring full adherence to industry transparency standards like the Sunshine Act.

• Build Strategic Partnerships: Cultivate strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional leaders and external suppliers to meet ambitious business goals.

• Help drive the site budget negotiations in alignment with Fair Market Value.

• Other tasks may be assigned from time to time to support the overall CDMA function.

Who You Are
You are an organized and detail-oriented professional who thrives in fast-paced, matrixed environments. You are a natural collaborator who enjoys solving complex financial administrative challenges while working alongside diverse global teams.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Educational Foundation: A Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field (or equivalent relevant expertise in the healthcare industry).

• Sector Experience: 3-5+ years of professional experience, with specific expertise in purchase order (PO) creation and invoice management. Experience with negotiating budgets with clinical sites is a plus.

• Technical Proficiency: Proven experience tracking financial data such as accruals and payments within complex business environments.

• Collaborative Mindset: The ability to work independently while effectively partnering across functions like Legal, Procurement, and Clinical Operations.

• Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to perform in a fast-paced, matrixed environment where fluid, cross-team collaboration is crucial.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English).

At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to excel and achieve strong results, together.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Sant Cugat del Vallès. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

descriptionByLocale.it: Amministratore Contratto Clinico - Roche Mansioni Come Amministratore Contratto Clinico, contribuirai in modo fondamentale alla corretta esecuzione finanziaria e operativa dei nostri studi clinici. Collaborerai consapevole con le funzioni di Clinical Operations, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Procurement, Legale e Finance per gestire il ciclo di vita dei contratti e dei pagamenti dei fornitori. Unisciti al nostro team di alto rendimento, dove la tua attenzione ai support direttamente la consegna di soluzioni sanitarie innovative. Compiti chiave I compiti chiave per questo ruolo includono, ma non si limitano a: - Guidare l'Accuratezza Finanziaria: Creare e monitorare gli ordini di acquisto (POs), le fatture e accantonamenti utilizzando i nostri sistemi finanziari per garantire che tutti i pagamenti dei fornitori siano precisi e tempestivi. - Ottimizzare l'Integrità dei Dati: Mantenere e aggiornare le informazioni contrattuali all'interno dei nostri strumenti di tracciamento per garantire la completezza e l'accuratezza in ogni momento. - Gestire il Ciclo di Vita del Contratto: Assumi la responsabilità end-to-end del processo di firma del contratto, dalla richiesta iniziale alla terminazione del servizio e alla confession finale. Traccia, mantiene e aggiorna le informazioni contrattuali assegnate all'interno degli strumenti di tracciamento CDMA per garantire la completezza e l'accuratezza, se applicabile. - Promuovere la Conformità alle Relazioni: Preparare e presentare i rapporti sulle restrizioni di valore con i fornitori sanitari, garantendo il rispetto degli standard di trasparenza del settore come l'Act Sunshine. - Costruire Partnership Strategiche: Coltiva relazioni collaborative e solide con i leader cross-functionali e i fornitori esterni per raggiungere gli ambiziosi obiettivi aziendali. - Contribuire alla Negoziazione del Budget del Sito: Aiutare a guidare il budget del sito in linea con il Valore di Mercato Equo. - Altri compiti potrebbero essere assegnati di volta in volta per supportare la funzione CDMA nel suo insieme. Chi sei? Sei un professionista organizzato e attento ai dettagli che prospera in ambienti veloci e matricizzati. Sei un collaboratore nato che gode nel risolvere complessi problemi amministrativi lavorando con team globali diversi. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, porti: - Formazione Educativa: Un diploma di laurea in Business o in un campo correlato (o esperienza equivalente e rilevante nel settore sanitario). - Esperienza di Settore: 3-5+ anni di esperienza professionale, con esperienza specifica nella creazione degli ordini di acquisto (POs) e nella gestione delle fatture. L'esperienza nella definizione dei budget con i siti clinici è un plus. - Competenze Tecniche: Prova esperienza nel tracciamento dei dati finanziari come accantonamenti e pagamenti all'interno di ambienti aziendali complessi. - Mentalità Collaborativa: La capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente mentre si collabora con le funzioni come Legal, Procurement e Clinical Operations. - Flessibilità e Adattabilità: Dimostra flessibilità e adattabilità per operare in un ambiente veloce e matricizzato in cui la collaborazione cross-team fluida è fondamentale. - Eccellenti Abilità di Comunicazione Verbale e Scritta** (Inglese). Cosa? A Roche, prospererai in una cultura che apprezza le diverse prospettive e pieghe un posto di appartenenza, dove ci sfidiamo a eccellere e raggiungere risultati forti insieme. Per questo ruolo, la percentuale viene fornita in base alla località principale di pubblicazione. Per questo ruolo, la località principale è Sant Cugat del Vallès. Se sei interessato ad altre località in cui il ruolo potrebbe essere disponibile, perniamo i dettagli sulla percezione durante il processo di assunzione. Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visita il nostro sito web o contatta il nostro team delle risorse umane.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Data Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

At Roche, we believe care should start before disease takes hold. As a Senior Clinical Data Specialist within our Clinical Operations team, you will perform expert-level data management activities that directly enable innovation, data-driven insights, and continuous improvement across our clinical and development projects. In this pivotal role, you will ensure the delivery of complete, accurate data ready for analysis and regulatory submission, helping us deliver life-changing healthcare solutions faster and more efficiently.

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead Complex Projects : Function as the Lead Data Manager (LDM) and primary point of contact for clinical data management issues, guiding data management teams on large-scale programs and managing timelines and resource planning.

• Define Data Architecture : Use your professional expertise to define study-specific data workflows, clinical database requirements, and create comprehensive data management documentation (including CRFs, DMPs, database specifications, and data transfer specifications).

• Ensure Data Excellence : Oversee data quality by defining performance metrics, analysing trends, and performing expert data reviews to identify and resolve incomplete or discrepant data.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally : Represent Data Management in cross-functional study team meetings, providing technical clarification and fostering strong partnerships across departments.

• Mentor and Coach : Drive departmental excellence by mentoring team members, sharing best practices, and supporting the implementation of new technologies.

Who You Are

You are a collaborative, analytical problem-solver who thrives in a dynamic environment and excels at translating complex technical data concepts for non-technical colleagues. You bring strong professional judgment, a dedication to data quality, and a passion for mentoring others to reach their full potential. To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Educational Background : A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a scientific discipline.

• Clinical Data Expertise : Extensive, progressive experience in clinical data management with a comprehensive understanding of the clinical study process.

• Regulatory Knowledge : A solid understanding of regulatory and

descriptionByLocale.it: # Mansioni At Roche, ogni voce conta. Qui puoi essere te stesso, apprezzato per le tue unicità e incoraggiato a esprimerti personalmente, dialogare apertamente e creare connessioni genuine. La nostra cultura valorizza, accetta e rispetta ogni individuo, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. Questo è il modo in cui miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie, garantendo a tutti l'accesso alle cure oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche e contribuisci a fare la differenza. ## La Posizione Presso Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), la nostra missione è chiara: diagnosticare prima, sviluppare più velocemente e personalizzare il trattamento perché ogni paziente è unico. Il nostro team di Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) guida l'innovazione per migliorare i risultati sanitari a livello globale. Ci consideriamo una squadra che può raggiungere il suo pieno potenziale solo lavorando insieme ai nostri clienti. Ascoltando attentamente i pazienti e i medici e sfruttando la digitalizzazione e le nuove tecnologie, ci avviciniamo alle loro esigenze reali. Questo spirito collaborativo crea un ambiente in cui le idee possono crescere e si possono provare nuovi modi di fare le cose - con il risultato di prodotti competitivi che arrivano ai pazienti più velocemente. Il nostro lavoro copre l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla scoperta al post-lancio. Collaborando con i team interni, i partner esterni e i pazienti, il capitolo CDMA fornisce preziose informazioni mediche, progetta ed esegue gli studi clinici e offre il supporto sul mercato. Infine, generiamo le prove cliniche complete che dimostrano la sicurezza, l'efficacia e la validità scientifica del prodotto - facilitando la registrazione, l'adozione e il rimborso dei prodotti a livello globale per salvare vite e migliorare la qualità della vita dei pazienti. ## L'Opportunità In Roche crediamo che le cure debbano iniziare prima che la malattia si manifesti. Come Senior Clinical Data Specialist nel nostro team di Clinical Operations, svolgerai attività di gestione dei dati di livello esperto che consentono directly l'innovazione, le intuizioni basate sui dati e il miglioramento continuo sui nostri progetti clinici e di sviluppo. In questo ruolo chiave, ti assicurerai che i dati completi e accurati siano pronti per l'analisi e la presentazione regolamentare, aiutandoci a consegnare soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita più velocemente ed efficientemente. ## Responsabilità Chiave - **Guida Progetti Complessi**: Funziona come Lead Data Manager (LDM) e punto di contatto principale per le questioni di gestione dei dati clinici, guida i team di gestione dei dati sui programmi di grandi dimensioni e gestisce i tempi e la pianificazione delle risorse. - **Definizione dell'Architettura dei Dati**: Utilizza la tua esperienza professionale per definire i flussi di lavoro dei dati specifici dello studio, le esigenze del database clinico e crea la documentazione di gestione dei dati completa (inclusi i moduli CRF, i piani di gestione dei dati, le specifiche del database e le specifiche del trasferimento dei dati). - **Garantire l'Eccellenza dei Dati**: Sorveglia la qualità dei dati definendo le metriche di prestazione, analizzando le tendenze e eseguendo revisioni dei dati esperte per identificare e risolvere i dati incompleti o discordanti. - **Collaborazione Cross-Funzionale**: Rappresenta la Gestione dei Dati negli incontri del team di studio cross-funzionale, fornendo chiarimenti tecnici e favorendo forti partnership tra i dipartimenti. - **Mentoring e Coaching**: Promuovi l'eccellenza del dipartimento mentendo i membri del team, condividendo le migliori pratiche e supportando l'implementazione di nuove tecnologie. ## Chi Sei Sei un collaboratore analitico che risolve i problemi e che prospera in un ambiente dinamico, eccellendo nella traduzione dei complessi concetti tecnici dei dati per i colleghi non tecnici. Porti un forte giudizio professionale, una dedizione alla qualità dei dati e una passione per la mentoring degli altri per raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, porti: - **Formazione Accademica**: Una laurea o una laurea magistrale in una disciplina scientifica. - **Esperienza nella Gestione dei Dati Clinici**: Esperienza estesa e progressiva nella gestione dei dati clinici con una comprensione completa del processo di studio clinico. - **Conoscenza Regolamentare**: Una solida conoscenza delle normative e delle linee guida internazionali per la gestione dei dati clinici. ## Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visita il nostro sito web o contatta il nostro team delle risorse umane.

descriptionByLocale.de: Sendungen Bei Roche zählt jede Stimme. Hier können Sie sich selbst sein, für Ihre Einzigartigkeit geschätzt und ermutigt, sich persönlich auszudrücken, offen Dialog und echte Verbindungen zu schaffen. Unsere Kulturwerte, akzeptiert und respektiert jedes Individuum und ermöglicht es Ihnen, sowohl auf persönlicher als auch auf professioneller Ebene zu leben. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen, den Zugang zur Pflege heute und für zukünftige Generationen gewährleisten. Begleiten Sie Roche und helfen, einen Unterschied zu machen. Die Lage Bei Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) ist unsere Mission klar: zuerst diagnostizieren, schneller entwickeln und die Behandlung anpassen, weil jeder Patient einzigartig ist. Unser Team von Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) leitet Innovationen, um die Gesundheitsergebnisse weltweit zu verbessern. Wir betrachten uns als ein Team, das sein volles Potenzial nur durch die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden erreichen kann. Wenn wir Patienten und Ärzte aufmerksam zuhören und die Digitalisierung und neue Technologien nutzen, nähern wir uns ihren wirklichen Bedürfnissen. Dieser kollaborative Geist schafft eine Umgebung, in der Ideen wachsen können, und Sie können neue Wege versuchen, Dinge zu tun - mit dem Ergebnis von wettbewerbsfähigen Produkten, die zu Patienten schneller kommen. Unsere Arbeit deckt den gesamten Lebenszyklus des Produktes ab, von der Entdeckung bis zum Post-Lunch. In Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams, externen Partnern und Patienten bietet das CDMA-Kapitel wertvolle medizinische Informationen, Designs und führt klinische Studien durch und bietet Marktunterstützung. Schließlich generieren wir komplette klinische Studien, die die Sicherheit, Wirksamkeit und wissenschaftliche Gültigkeit des Produktes demonstrieren - die Registrierung, Annahme und Erstattung von Produkten weltweit, um Leben zu retten und die Qualität des Patientenlebens zu verbessern. Die Chance In Roche glauben wir, dass die Behandlung beginnen sollte, bevor sich die Krankheit manifestiert. Als Senior Clinical Data Specialist in unserem Klinischen Operations-Team werden Sie kompetente Datenmanagement-Aktivitäten durchführen, die Innovationen, datenbasierte Erkenntnisse und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen in unseren klinischen und Entwicklungsprojekten direkt ermöglichen. In dieser Schlüsselrolle stellen Sie sicher, dass vollständige und genaue Daten für die regulatorische Analyse und Präsentation bereit sind und helfen uns, Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern, die das Leben schneller und effizienter verändern. Schlüsselverantwortung - Guide Complex Projects: Es arbeitet als Lead Data Manager (LDM) und Hauptkontaktpunkt für klinische Datenmanagement-Probleme, führt Datenmanagement-Teams zu großen Programmen und verwaltet Zeit- und Ressourcenplanung. - Definition von Data Architecture: Benutzen Sie Ihre Berufserfahrung, um studienspezifische Daten-Workflows, klinische Datenbankanforderungen zu definieren und eine vollständige Datenverwaltungsdokumentation zu erstellen (einschließlich CRF-Module, Datenmanagementpläne, Datenbankspezifikationen und Datentransferspezifikationen). - Datenschutz-Exzellenz: Es überwacht die Qualität der Daten durch Definition von Leistungsmetriken, Analyse von Trends und Durchführung von Expertendaten-Revisionen, um unvollständige oder diskrete Daten zu identifizieren und zu lösen. - Cross-Function-Kollaboration: Es stellt das Data Management in den Sitzungen des funktionsübergreifenden Studienteams dar und bietet technische Klärung und Förderung starker Partnerschaften zwischen den Abteilungen. - Mentoring and Coaching: Fördern Sie die Exzellenz der Abteilung durch lügende Teammitglieder, teilen Sie die besten Praktiken und unterstützen Sie die Umsetzung neuer Technologien. Wer sind Sie? Sie sind ein analytischer Mitarbeiter, der Probleme und Drives in einem dynamischen Umfeld löst und sich in der Übersetzung komplexer technischer Datenkonzepte für nichttechnische Kollegen auszeichnet. Bringen Sie ein starkes professionelles Urteil, Engagement für die Datenqualität und eine Leidenschaft für Mentoring andere, um ihr volles Potenzial zu erreichen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie: - Akademische Ausbildung: Master-Abschluss oder Abschluss in einer wissenschaftlichen Disziplin. - Erfahrung im klinischen Datenmanagement: Umfangreiche und fortschrittliche Erfahrung im klinischen Datenmanagement mit einem vollständigen Verständnis der klinischen Studie. - Regelmäßiges Wissen: Ein fundiertes Wissen über internationale Vorschriften und Richtlinien für die Verwaltung von klinischen Daten. Kontakt Für weitere Informationen oder um sich zu bewerben, besuchen Sie unsere Website oder kontaktieren Sie unser Personalteam.

Notre équipe Développement clinique et affaires médicales (CDMA) guide l'innovation pour améliorer les résultats de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale. Enfin, nous produisons des essais cliniques complets qui démontrent l'innocuité, l'efficacité et la validité scientifique du produit - facilitant l'enregistrement, l'adoption et le remboursement des produits dans le monde entier pour sauver des vies et améliorer la qualité de vie des patients. Possibilités À Roche, nous pensons que les soins devraient commencer avant que la maladie ne se manifeste. En tant que spécialiste principal des données cliniques au sein de notre équipe des opérations cliniques, vous effectuerez des activités de gestion des données d'experts qui permettent directement l'innovation, les idées fondées sur les données et l'amélioration continue de nos projets cliniques et de développement. Dans ce rôle clé, vous veillerez à ce que des données complètes et précises soient prêtes pour l'analyse et la présentation réglementaires, nous aidant à fournir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie plus rapidement et efficacement. Key Responsibility - Guida Progetti Complessi: Il fonctionne comme gestionnaire de données principal (DND) et principal point de contact pour les questions de gestion des données cliniques, guide les équipes de gestion des données sur les grands programmes et gère la planification du temps et des ressources. - Définition de l'architecture des données : Utilisez votre expérience professionnelle pour définir les flux de données spécifiques à l'étude, les besoins des bases de données cliniques et créer une documentation complète de gestion des données (y compris les modules CRF, les plans de gestion des données, les spécifications des bases de données et les spécifications de transfert de données). - Assurer l'excellence des données : Il supervise la qualité des données en définissant des paramètres de rendement, en analysant les tendances et en effectuant des révisions de données d'experts pour identifier et résoudre des données incomplètes ou discordantes. - Collaboration interfonctions : Représente la gestion des données aux réunions de l'équipe d'étude interfonctionnelle, fournissant des éclaircissements techniques et favorisant des partenariats solides entre les ministères. - Mentorat et coaching : Promouvoir l'excellence du département en faisant partie de l'équipe, en partageant les meilleures pratiques et en appuyant la mise en oeuvre de nouvelles technologies. Qui êtes-vous un collaborateur analytique qui résout les problèmes et prospère dans un environnement dynamique, excellent dans la traduction de concepts de données techniques complexes pour les collègues non techniques. Apportez un jugement professionnel fort, un dévouement à la qualité des données et une passion pour le mentorat afin d'atteindre leur plein potentiel. Pour y arriver, vous devrez : - Formation académique : Maîtrise ou diplôme dans une discipline scientifique. - Expérience en gestion des données cliniques: Expérience étendue et progressive en gestion des données cliniques avec une compréhension complète de l'essai clinique. - Connaissances régulières : Une connaissance solide des règlements et lignes directrices internationaux pour la gestion des données cliniques. Contact Pour plus d'informations ou pour postuler, visitez notre site Web ou contactez notre équipe de ressources humaines.
