At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption, and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

As a Lead Clinical Site Manager specialising in IVDR and Study Start-Up, you will be responsible for designing, planning, coordinating, and independently conducting all activities involved in initiating, monitoring, and completing clinical research studies. You will play a vital role in ensuring studies are delivered, recorded, and reported in accordance with protocols, standard operating procedures, and global regulatory guidelines
In this role, you will:

• Lead end-to-end study start-up activities , driving site selection, activation, and qualification assessments to ensure clinical trials launch efficiently and are compliance-ready.

• Manage Ethics Committee (EC) and Competent Authority (CA) submissions , ensuring all trial documentation, local contracts, and institutional approvals meet stringent regulatory timelines.

• Provide robust CRO oversight , monitoring external partner deliverables, tracking milestones, and ensuring vendor performance aligns with Roche quality standards.

• Act as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, providing training, technical assistance, and coordinating necessary certifications.

• Develop critical study documentation , including Study Monitoring Plans, informed consent documents, patient instruction guides, and case report forms tailored to diagnostic protocols.

• Deliver comprehensive site monitoring and data validation activities, executing site visits throughout all study phases from early start-up to final close-out.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with global, local, and virtual teams, across Research & Development, Study Management, and Biometrics to deliver top-tier clinical diagnostic solutions.

• Leadership & Coaching : You will dedicate time to coaching colleagues, helping others develop their skills, and acting as a resource for less-experienced team members.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, collaborative, and highly organised clinical research professional who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You possess strong problem-solving skills, make sound independent decisions, and excel at managing external vendor relationships. To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Education & Experience : A degree in a scientific discipline o

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

As a Global Study Lead, you will take full accountability for the design, planning, and execution of global sponsored clinical trials from protocol development through to close-out. Joining a dynamic, matrixed team within our Clinical Development and Medical Affairs communities, you will oversee diverse study portfolios, including companion diagnostics, early adopter programs, and research collaborations, ensuring operational excellence, budget control, and absolute inspection readiness.

• Drive Study Excellence : Lead the global cross-functional study team with full accountability for high-quality study designs, clinical deliverables, budgets, and timelines.

• Shape Evidence Strategies : Partner with Program Leadership to map out innovative scenarios for global evidence generation, collaborating across Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and medical project teams.

• Author Core Study Documentation : Develop critical, high-impact clinical documents including study protocols, Design Validation Plans, study forms, and comprehensive study reports.

• Champion Strategic Partnerships : Oversee external service providers and Contract Research Organisations (CROs), driving vendor performance, selection, and relationship management at the study level.

• Advance Diagnostics Innovation : Direct the operational aspects of companion diagnostics studies sponsored by external partners alongside early access and research collaboration portfolios.

• Cultivate Expert Networks : Collaborate closely with international medical opinion leaders, investigators, and key external stakeholders to bring advanced external insights in-house.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, analytical clinical operations professional who thrives in fast-paced, global environments. You bring a collaborative mindset, excellent communication skills, and a passion for delivering life-changing clinical insights.

• A degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, or a related scientific field (an advanced degree is a plus).

• Strong, progressive experience in clinical trial management or study-level execution within the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology sectors. Preferably experience study managing Molecular IVD clinical trials.

• Solid working knowledge of clinical research standards and gl

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), notre mission est claire : diagnostiquer plus tôt, développer plus rapidement et personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. Notre équipe du développement clinique et des affaires médicales (CDMA) stimule l'innovation pour améliorer les résultats en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale. Nous nous voyons nous-mêmes et nos clients comme une équipe qui ne peut atteindre son plein potentiel ensemble. En écoutant attentivement les patients et les médecins, en tirant parti de la numérisation et des nouvelles technologies, nous nous rapprochons de leurs besoins réels. Cet esprit de collaboration crée un environnement où les idées peuvent croître et de nouvelles façons de faire peuvent être essayées - ce qui donne lieu à des produits compétitifs qui parviennent plus rapidement aux patients. Notre travail couvre tout le cycle de vie du produit, de la découverte à la post-lancement. En collaborant avec des équipes internes, des partenaires externes et des patients, le chapitre CDMA fournit des informations médicales cruciales, conçoit et exécute des études cliniques et offre un soutien sur le marché. En fin de compte, nous produisons les preuves cliniques complètes qui démontrent l'innocuité, l'efficacité et la validité scientifique des produits - en facilitant l'enregistrement, l'adoption et le remboursement des produits à l'échelle mondiale afin que nous puissions sauver des vies et améliorer la qualité de vie des patients. L'opportunité En tant que responsable de l'étude mondiale, vous serez pleinement responsable de la conception, de la planification et de l'exécution d'essais cliniques parrainés à l'échelle mondiale, depuis l'élaboration de protocoles jusqu'à la clôture. En vous joignant à une équipe dynamique et matricielle au sein de nos communautés de développement clinique et d'affaires médicales, vous superviserez divers portefeuilles d'études, y compris des diagnostics complémentaires, des programmes d'adoption précoce et des collaborations de recherche, assurant l'excellence opérationnelle, le contrôle budgétaire et la préparation absolue à l'inspection.
• L'excellence de l'étude : Dirigez l'équipe mondiale d'étude interfonctionnelle avec une responsabilité totale pour les études de haute qualité, les résultats cliniques, les budgets et les délais.
• Stratégies de mise en forme des données probantes : partenariat avec le leadership du programme pour définir des scénarios novateurs pour la production de données probantes à l'échelle mondiale, la collaboration entre les équipes des Affaires réglementaires, de la R-D et des projets médicaux.
• Author Core Study Documentation : Élaborer des documents cliniques critiques à impact élevé incluant des protocoles d'étude, des plans de validation de conception, des formulaires d'étude et des rapports d'étude approfondie.
• Champion Partenariats stratégiques : Superviser les fournisseurs de services externes et les organismes de recherche sous contrat (ORC), qui conduisent les performances des fournisseurs, la sélection et la gestion des relations au niveau de l'étude.
• Advance Diagnostics Innovation : Diriger les aspects opérationnels des études de diagnostics complémentaires parrainées par des partenaires externes, ainsi que les portefeuilles de collaborations d'accès et de recherche précoces.
• Cultiver les réseaux d'experts : Collaborer étroitement avec les leaders internationaux de l'opinion médicale, les chercheurs et les principales parties prenantes externes afin d'apporter des informations externes avancées à l'interne. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel proactif et analytique des opérations cliniques qui prospère dans des environnements rapides et mondiaux. Vous apportez un état d'esprit collaboratif, d'excellentes compétences en communication et une passion pour fournir des perspectives cliniques changeantes.
• Un diplôme en sciences de la vie, santé, ou un domaine scientifique connexe (un diplôme avancé est un plus).
• Expérience solide et progressive de la gestion des essais cliniques ou de l'exécution au niveau de l'étude dans les secteurs des soins de santé, des produits pharmaceutiques ou des biotechnologies. De préférence, l'expérience d'une étude portant sur la gestion des essais cliniques de DIV moléculaires.
• Bonne connaissance pratique des normes de recherche clinique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Global Study Lead to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will lead global study teams to ensure the successful execution of clinical studies. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality study designs, adhering to timelines and budgets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to support evidence generation strategies.

If you have a passion for advancing clinical trials in the cardiovascular/metabolic disease area (CVMD), specifically in Core Lab SWA (Serum Work Area) Systems and Automation, we would love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead and oversee the global study team, ensuring full accountability for study deliverables including quality, budget, and timelines.

• Collaborate with Program Leadership to prepare different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g., study, real-world evidence) and ensure cross-functional cooperation with Regulatory Affairs, R&D,Biostatistics, Data Management and CDMA Project Teams.

• Develop key study documents such as Design Validation Plans, study protocols, training materials, study forms, templates, and study reports.

• Maintain responsibility for the study-level budget of assigned studies.

• Ensure compliance with regulations, guidelines, and standard operating procedures, while ensuring audit/inspection readiness.

• Oversee execution of sponsored studies for registrational and non-registrational purposes through all study phases (planning, start-up, conduct, and close-out).

• Manage study activities outsourced to service providers, including CROs, ensuring timely and quality execution.

• Work with the Publication Team to ensure study results are effectively published.

• Track project performance and ensure that projects are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.

• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including cross-functional teams, CROs, opinion leaders, investigators, and key customers.

Who are you:

• Strong experience in clinical trial management, particularly in the cardiovascular/metabolic indication. Experience with IVD clinical and analytical system studies in the Core Lab Serum Work Area setting is a plus.

• You have a degree in Life Sciences, Healthc

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Working independently, you will serve as the primary clinical trial expert, ensuring data generation methodologies are delivered in alignment with global quality protocols. This role offers an exciting opportunity to validate product performance claims, supply crucial data for regulatory submissions, and directly help deliver innovative diagnostic solutions to patients worldwide.

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead Site Execution : Act as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, delivering technical assistance and coordinating necessary training.

• Conduct Site Assessments : Perform comprehensive site assessments and qualification visits to drive informed site selection decisions.

jobs.title: Clinical Development Lead (Neuroscience)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the future of healthcare by leading the clinical development strategy for next-generation diagnostic solutions? As a Clinical Development Lead, Neuroscience within our Clinical and Medical Affairs organisation in Diagnostics, you will play a pivotal role in planning and implementing clinical development activities that bring medically-differentiated solutions to patients globally. In this role, you will act as a senior strategic voice and trusted advisor, fostering an environment where science and collaboration thrive.

Key Responsibilities :

• Drive Clinical Strategy : Lead the clinical development strategy for clinical diagnostic studies and complex programs, in the Neuroscience area, defining clinical utility, intended use, and claim extensions across our portfolio.

• Lead Health Authority Interactions : Work closely with Global Regulatory Affairs in the completion and submission of global regulatory filings, authoring critical sections of meeting packages and reviewing clinical documents for international regulatory submissions.

• Forge Stakeholder Partnerships : Act as the clinical lead in external interactions with health authorities, build strategic relationships with international Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and drive development partnerships across industry and academia.

• Foster Communication Excellence : Oversee the implementation of communication strategies for clinical studies, representing the organisation at major medical congresses, advisory boards, and in key publications.

• Champion Innovation & Excellence : Act as a key driver for competitive differentiation, innovation, and early pipeline activities while developing intellectual property strategies and optimising clinical processes.

• Coach and Mentor : Act as a dedicated coach for team members, nurturing confidence and helping colleagues develop their skills and expertise.

Who You Are

You are an analytical, strategic thinker who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You are passionate about customer and patient-centricity, and you excel at integrating multiple cross-functional perspectives into a unified clinical strategy.

• Education : Medical degree (MD) or an advanced degree (PhD) in Neuroscience or related fields.

• Experien

Chi sei? Sei un pensatore analitico e strategico che prospera in un ambiente frenetico e a matrice. Siete appassionati di customer and paziente-centricity, e eccellete nell'integrazione di molteplici prospettive interfunzionali in una strategia clinica unificata.
• Requisiti Qualifiche e esperienze - Grado medico (MD) o grado avanzato (PhD) in cardiologia o un campo correlato - Rilevato record di traccia nello sviluppo clinico, con una forte attenzione alle malattie cardiovascolari e metaboliche - Esperienza nei processi normativi globali e nelle interazioni tra autorità sanitarie - Capacità dimostrata di costruire e mantenere relazioni strategiche con gli stakeholder esterni - Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e presentazione, con esperienza nel rappresentare le organizzazioni nei principali congressi medici e nelle pubblicazioni chiave - Forte leadership e competenze di coaching, con esperienza nella mentoring membri del team e guida innovazione - Fluenza in inglese; la competenza in altre lingue è un bene Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visitare il sito web di Roche o contattare il nostro team delle Risorse Umane.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally. We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster . Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life . The Opportunity Are you ready to shape the future of healthcare by leading the clinical development strategy for next-generation diagnostic solutions? As a Clinical Development Lead, Cardiovascular and metabolic diseases (CVMD) within our Clinical and Medical Affairs organisation in Diagnostics, you will play a pivotal role in planning and implementing clinical development activities that bring medically-differentiated solutions to patients globally. In this role, you will act as a senior strategic voice and trusted advisor, fostering an environment where science and collaboration thrive. Key Responsibilities :
• Drive Clinical Strategy : Lead the clinical development strategy for large-scale studies and complex programs, in the CVMD area, defining clinical utility, intended use, and claim extensions across our portfolio.
• Lead Health Authority Interactions : Work closely with Global Regulatory Affairs in the completion and submission of global regulatory filings, authoring critical sections of meeting packages and reviewing clinical documents for international regulatory submissions.
• Forge Stakeholder Partnerships : Act as the medical lead in external interactions with health authorities, build strategic relationships with international Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and drive development partnerships across industry and academia.
• Foster Communication Excellence : Oversee the implementation of communication strategies for clinical studies, representing the organisation at major medical congresses, advisory boards, and in key publications.
• Champion Innovation & Excellence : Act as a key driver for competitive differentiation, innovation, and early pipeline activities while developing intellectual property strategies and optimising clinical processes.
• Coach and Mentor : Act as a dedicated coach for team members, nurturing confidence and helping colleagues develop their skills and expertise. Who You Are You are an analytical, strategic thinker who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You are passionate about customer and patient-centricity, and you excel at integrating multiple cross-functional perspectives into a unified clinical strategy. Qualifications & Experience :
• Medical degree (MD) or an advanced degree (PhD) in cardiolo

Mansioni Équipe du développement clinique et des affaires médicales (CDMA) Chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), notre mission est de diagnostiquer plus tôt, de développer plus rapidement et de personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. Les Vous êtes un penseur analytique et stratégique qui prospère dans un environnement matriciel rapide. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
职位名称：（高级）治疗领域专员

您是谁：
（高级）治疗领域专员是公司与相应疾病领域医生的主要接触点,发掘和管理内外部资源,通过各种学术活动、推广或非推广活动把罗氏的专业知识、科学和技术、产品关键信息带入生态系统,准确及时的传达给客户,并与客户和合作伙伴共同发现潜在的合作机会,以改善对患者旅程的影响,实现患者最终获益。

您的机会：
客户管理
1. 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士(HCP)观念、学术需求
2. 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

学科建设
1. 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程
2. 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

计划管理
1. 组织和支持区域专家会议
2.了解医生观念、需求、会议安排;制定会议及覆盖计划;执行会议计划;回访收集反馈

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
1. 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变,实现规范化诊疗
2. 和患者解决方案经理协同合作,关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
1. 成为产品和疾病领域的专家
2. 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

我们期待这样的您加入：
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
•3 年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Training & Service Quality Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

• The mission of the GPC Training & Service Quality Specialist is to collaborate with local and
• global colleagues to design and deliver comprehensive training for both new and existing team
• members.

• This role is also responsible for executing Service Quality Assurance in line with
• the GPC Training and Quality Framework involving case, channel and documentation reviews,
• to ensure that customer interactions meet established GPC standards. While maintaining
• awareness of the regulated environment, the focus is on driving continuous improvement in
• advisor performance, soft skills, and documentation accuracy.

The Opportunity:
• ● Service Quality Optimization: Develop measures for the continuous maintenance and
• optimization of service quality standards.
• ● Monitoring & Review: Monitor customer interactions and documentation (calls, cases,
• and chats) to ensure they correspond to set GPC quality standards and service
• guidelines.
• ● Soft Skills Coaching: Lead activities to increase the quality of advisor documentation
• and soft skills through regular feedback and targeted coaching sessions.
• ● Proactive Training: Train team members on service quality issues and quality
• concepts, involving internal or external partners as needed to close identified gaps.
• ● Interface Participation: Act as an active contact person for quality, knowledge, and
• product launch topics; participate in GPC projects and initiatives.
• ● Information Flow: Ensure all relevant information (e.g., product launches, quality
• notifications) is delivered and communicated to the organization in a timely manner.
• ● Knowledge Management: Maintain and further develop the customer services
• knowledge database in partnership with local and global colleagues.
• ● Training Coordination: Act as the recipient of “Train the Trainer” instruction and
• coordinate the rollout of training for internal and external team members.
• ● Onboarding & Side-by-Sides: Coordinate and deliver training for new advisors,
• including classroom sessions and side-by-side (buddy-up) training/monitoring.
• ● External Partner Certification: Responsible for Train the Trainer for external partners,
• including the formal certification of external trainers to ensure they are fully qualified
• and compliant with all Roche service quality requirements.
• ● Content Maintenance: Create, review, and maintain training content and
• documentation for job-oriented training.

Who you are:
• ● Associate Degree with at least 2 years’ industry-related experience.
• ● Specialized in-depth knowledge and experience in call center operations
• ● Good understanding of knowledge management solutions and the specific requirements
• of a multiskilled, matrix organized contact center.
• ● Experience in Training and Learning Management.
• ● Understanding of documentation compliance within a medical environment, though the
• primary focus is on service quality.
• ● Excellent listening, communication, and presentation skills.
• ● Proactive and results-oriented with a strong team-player attitude.
• ● Agile and flexible to adapt to changes in a fast-paced environment.
• ● Strong organization and planning skills with an ability to work autonomously.
• ● Role model in IT navigation and a fast learner of new technologies and support tools.
• ● Fluent spoken and written English.

jobs.title: Customer Logistics Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary

As a Customer Logistics Partner, you will be responsible for in-country distribution and Order-to-Cash to ensure timely delivery to customers. You will oversee in-country supply chain activities to ensure we meet our service goals. You will be responsible to ensure world class service levels and right-to-operate for local distribution and to implement supply chain strategies that successfully deliver our innovative medicines to customers and patients. This is a key role within the end-to-end supply chain operating model that interacts with local and global stakeholders.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Main 
• Responsibilities
● Ensure in-market supply on time in full at the right quality and cost
● Ensure “right to operate” for distribution
● Oversee successful in-market supply and distribution management (Commercial, Promotional, Clinical/IMP affiliate level)
● Partner with CSM for upstream replenishment coordination including artwork, shipment qty and RSL from central packaging site incl. exception management.
● Monitor and inform CLM and CVSP around the exceptions related to our inbound process before triggering importation
● Depending on the local finance model: ownership to oversight of the order to cash process
● Manage contracts and optimize performance with supply chain service providers (e.g. O2C, logistics and distrib) incl. establishing and monitoring KPI metric
● Monitor and control Warehouse & Distribution and/or Logistic Service Provider operational cost as part of the Supply Chain budget
● Leverage data for decision making by using e.g. analytics, simulation tools and customer insights
● Drive efficiency through identifying value-adding and productivity-enhancing in-market opportunities through technology and data (e.g. CWP, IMIP, Robotics ASPIRE etc) in-line with the digital roadmap
● Collaborate with different functions in the affiliate to understand the changes which may impact supply to and within the country and aligns with CSM to adjust the repl. Plan
● Contribute to the supply chain design together with the CVSP and support implementation of supply solutions to meet customer requirements
● Ensure appropriate supply chain set-up (incl. e.g. master data) in-line with the life cycle status of the product/portfolio
● Implement in-market supply projects/initiatives to gain efficiency and meet customer needs (e.g. cold chain, home delivery etc).
● Monitor local supply chain risk management plan (e.g. financial and operations)
● For Inbound process oversee operations of our agent in which regards to custom clearance and logistic to ensure our importation orders arrives on time respecting complying with Roche standard and local regulation

Skills & Competencies

● Undergraduate degree in Business/Commerce, Engineering, Finance or related fields
● Deep understanding of the distribution environment (transportation, customs and health authority regulations, GXP, country(s) infrastructure)
● Able to build and maintain strong internal and external partnerships
● Solid understanding of supply chain planning and execution systems with at least 3 years of work experience in logistics operations
● Possess strong business, logistics, and Supply Chain acumen
● Strong sense of urgency and problem-solving skills
● Knowledgeable of master data impact
● Strong communicator and connector between the Business, Finance, Quality, Regulatory and Supply Chain teams
● Systems thinker, deep listener, able to uncover novel insights
● Capability to trans

jobs.title: ERP Business Analyst - Finance
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a ERP Business Analyst - Finance, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity, strong ability to translate complex business-finance processes into functional specifications. You will demonstrate a full understanding of the business-finance domain, as well as integrate with other domains like commercial, supply chain and procurement, and related technologies, eco-systems and the interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manages end-to-end business analysis workstreams without guidance, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks, mentors junior and intermediate BAs, and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, performs thorough domain research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to solution selection, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers impact that extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster, contributing to domain goals by ensuring solutions provide demonstrable business value. Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans, influences tactical decisions, and contributes to long-term solution roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Works at a solution or product level involving multiple solutions, handling ambiguous requirements and systematically interacting with stakeholders across a broader product environment. Evaluates solution impacts considering both immediate and long-term business implications.

• Business / Technical ability: Demonstrates a deep understanding of business and technical domains, technologies, and their interdependencies. Independently applies tools, principles, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis to manage interconnections and improve overall efficiency.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• 2+ years of solid finance experience with SAP S4 and integrated eco-systems, with demonstrated ability to translate complex business-finance processes into functional specifications;

• Rich Business Analysis or project experience in finance and integrate with commercial, supply chain and procurement;

• Proven experience independently managing end-to-end BA workstreams, navigating ambiguous requirements, and evaluating strategic solution options.

• Demonstrated experience in translating requirements into strategic implementation

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Service Engineer

W Roche Diagnostics skupiamy się na wprowadzaniu innowacyjnych rozwiązań w obszarze medycyny laboratoryjnej. W Polsce działamy od kilkudziesięciu lat i należymy do wiodących pracodawców na światowym rynku diagnostycznym. Opracowujemy i wdrażamy rozwiązania diagnostyczne, które odpowiadają dzisiejszym wyzwaniom i są przygotowane na przyszłe potrzeby.

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy Specjalisty/-ki ds. Serwisu Technicznego z województwa mazowieckiego .

Zatrudnienie przez zewnętrzną agencję na okres 18 miesięcy

Zadania:

• Instalacje i wdrażanie aparatury laboratoryjnej

• Naprawy gwarancyjne i pogwarancyjne sprzętu

• Szkolenia klientów z obsługi aparatury i systemów laboratoryjnych

• Pomoc techniczna dla klientów

• Raportowanie wyników pracy

O Tobie:

• Mieszkasz na terenie województwa mazowieckiego

• Posiadasz wyższe wykształcenie techniczne (preferowane: mechanika precyzyjna, elektronika lub pokrewne)

• Z łatwością potrafisz zrozumieć potrzeby Klienta i efektywnie się komunikować

• Posiadasz prawo jazdy kategorii B

• Dobrze znasz język angielski (min. B2)

• Umiesz priorytetyzować zadania i pracować pod presją czasu

• Doświadczenie w pracy na podobnym stanowisku będzie dodatkowym atutem

Oferujemy:

• Zatrudnienie na podstawie umowy o pracę tymczasową

• Pracę w przyjaznej atmosferze w międzynarodowym środowisku

• Możliwość wdrażania własnych inicjatyw

• Program szkoleniowy i wdrożeniowy

Brzmi interesująco? Nie czekaj - aplikuj!

Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl

Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia nieprawidłowości związanych z naszą działalnością, wszelkie niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgłaszania naruszeń znajdują się na naszej stronie internetowej: https://www.roche.pl/kontakt/ochrona-sygnalistow-zglaszanie-naruszen .

Compensation & Benefits
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Poland. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Information about the compensation package for this position will be provided ahead of any interview

jobs.title: 医药信息顾问实习生
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （ 1） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （ 2） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （ 3） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （ 4） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （ 1）在校大学生
• （ 2）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （ 3）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4）熟练运用 Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （ 5）拥有良好的英语书写能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This includes platforms supporting Group Audit and Risk Advisory, Group Compliance spanning global teams across Pharma and Diagnostics. The Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner will play a key role in analyzing complex business processes, identifying optimization opportunities, and enabling automation and digitization of the compliance processes, from review, approval, oversight, to monitoring, review and governance frameworks, ensuring alignment with the "One Roche" philosophy.

Description of the area
About RDT Group Functions Compliance Product in Legal, Compliance & Group Communication sub-function: as a trusted and agile partner, we are empowered to boost global innovative solutions on the group risk, compliance and assurance digital prioritization journey.
The Compliance Product allows Roche to manage global risk, ensure financial and legal compliance and provide assurance of compliant processes and behavior in other words ensuring that the provisions of these regulations are met in practice. As part of the Compliance Product, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) creates, manages and operates solutions which improve processes, efficiency, effectiveness and collaboration especially among Group Compliance communities, Group Audit and Risk Advisory (GA & RA).

The opportunity:

• Drive the detailed discovery, scoping, and analysis of compliance, audit, and risk processes across global teams to target current pain points and maximize optimization opportunities .

• Translate complex business requirements into clear, functional specifications and technical specifications for development teams, bridging the gap between business and tech .

• Develop comprehensive business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and impact assessments for compliance products to systematically quantify and deliver measurable business value .

• Collaborate closely with the Business Product Owner to define compliance product strategies, roadmap priorities, and long-term tech goals like AI-driven solutions .

• Lead vendor selection processes by defining business criteria, conducting fit-for-purpose assessments, and partnering with Procurement to satisfy privacy and data security rules .

• Facilitate global requirements workshops across Compliance, GA&RA, Pharma, and Diagnostics teams to seamlessly harmonize and prioritize cross-functional business needs .

• Own the technical solution definition and requirements management from initial ideation and prototyping through to testing, adoption, and support transitions .

• Ensure all compliance platforms fully align with Roche’s legal, regulatory, data privacy, and security standards while strictly maintaining requirement traceability trails .

Who you are:

• Education & Experience: You possess a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field, combined with previous experience as a Technical Business Analyst or Product Owner.

• Industry Expertise: You have a proven track record working within compliance, audit, risk, or governance environments, ideally within the global corporate, pharmaceutical, or diagnostics industries.

• Analyt

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Potrai guidare la visione strategica, roadmap e la consegna di prodotti correlati a conformità all'interno di Roche. Questo include piattaforme che supportano il Gruppo Audit e Risk Advisory, Compliance di Gruppo che spazia tra i team globali di Pharma e Diagnostics. descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione Analyste d'affaires professionnel - Fonction de groupe RDT Nous recherchons un analyste technique d'affaires et un propriétaire de produits expérimentés pour nous associer aux propriétaires de produits d'affaires afin de traduire les exigences de conformité en solutions numériques stratégiques. Vous dirigerez la vision stratégique, la feuille de route et la livraison des produits liés à la conformité à Roche. Cela comprend des plateformes d'appui à la vérification de groupe et à l'avis sur les risques, la conformité de groupe couvrant les équipes mondiales à travers Pharma et Diagnostics. L'analyste technique des affaires et le propriétaire du produit joueront un rôle clé dans l'analyse des processus opérationnels complexes, la détermination des possibilités d'optimisation et la facilitation de l'automatisation et de la numérisation des processus de conformité, depuis l'examen, l'approbation, la surveillance, jusqu'aux cadres de surveillance, d'examen et de gouvernance, en passant par l'harmonisation avec la philosophie « One Roche ». Descrizione dell'Area À propos du Groupe RDT Fonctions Conformité Produit dans la sous-fonction juridique, Conformité & Communication du Groupe: en tant que partenaire fiable et agile, nous sommes habilités à stimuler des solutions innovantes au niveau mondial sur le parcours de priorité numérique de risque, de conformité et d'assurance de groupe. Le produit de conformité permet à Roche de gérer le risque mondial, d'assurer la conformité financière et juridique et d'assurer la conformité des processus et des comportements, c'est-à-dire de s'assurer que les dispositions de ces règlements sont respectées dans la pratique. Dans le cadre du produit Conformité, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) crée, gère et exploite des solutions qui améliorent les processus, l'efficience, l'efficacité et la collaboration, en particulier entre les communautés Conformité de Groupe, Audit de Groupe et Avis de Risque (GA & RA). L'Oportunità: - Diriger la découverte détaillée, la détermination de la portée et l'analyse des processus de conformité, d'audit et de risque dans les équipes mondiales afin de cibler les points de douleur actuels et de maximiser les possibilités d'optimisation. - Traduire des exigences opérationnelles complexes en spécifications fonctionnelles claires et techniques pour les équipes de développement, combler l'écart entre les entreprises et les technologies. - Élaborer des analyses de rentabilisation complètes, des analyses coûts-avantages et des analyses d'impact pour les produits de conformité afin de quantifier et de produire systématiquement une valeur opérationnelle mesurable. - Collaborer étroitement avec le propriétaire de produit d'entreprise pour définir les stratégies de conformité des produits, les priorités de la feuille de route et les objectifs technologiques à long terme comme les solutions axées sur l'IA. - Diriger les processus de sélection des fournisseurs en définissant les critères opérationnels, en procédant à des évaluations adaptées à l'usage et en établissant des partenariats avec Approvisionnement pour satisfaire aux règles de confidentialité et de sécurité des données. - Faciliter l'organisation d'ateliers sur les exigences mondiales à l'échelle des équipes Conformité, AG&RA, Pharma et Diagnostics afin d'harmoniser et de prioriser les besoins opérationnels interfonctionnels. - Posséder la définition de la solution technique et la gestion des exigences, de l'idée initiale et du prototypage à l'essai, l'adoption et le soutien des transitions. - Veiller à ce que toutes les plateformes de conformité s'harmonisent pleinement avec les normes légales, réglementaires, de confidentialité des données et de sécurité de Roche, tout en maintenant strictement les pistes de traçabilité des exigences. C'est quoi ? - Istruzione & Esperienza: Vous possédez un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en technologie de l'information, administration des affaires, ou un domaine connexe, combiné avec une expérience antérieure en tant qu'analyste technique des affaires ou propriétaire de produit. - Esperienza Settoriale: Vous avez une expérience éprouvée de travail dans des environnements de conformité, d'audit, de risque ou de gouvernance, idéalement dans les industries mondiales de l'entreprise, pharmaceutique, ou de diagnostic. - Analyse

jobs.title: Head of Project Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Head of Project Management for Roche Information Solutions (RIS), you will be at the heart of our digital transformation. You will lead a high-performing chapter of project management experts dedicated to delivering life-changing digital healthcare products.
In this role, you will:

- Shape Strategy : Partner with the Portfolio & Project Management Leadership Team to design and execute mid-to-long-term strategies that drive excellence across Roche Diagnostics.
- Lead with Vision : Act as the primary expert for digital product development project management, ensuring our capabilities evolve with industry trends.
- Empower People : Serve as a VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leader, mentoring Sub-Chapter and Network Leads to reach their full professional potential.
- Optimize Resources : Collaborate across functions to break down silos, ensuring the right expertise is allocated to the most impactful organizational priorities.
- Drive Innovation : Champion the evolution of our Digital Foundation, leveraging data, systems, and AI to enhance project execution.
- Build Partnerships : Cultivate trusting relationships with executive stakeholders, influencing global alignment to achieve our Diagnostics Vision.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, strategic leader who thrives on building diverse teams and navigating complex, global environments. You bring a coaching mindset and a passion for developing talent in a networked organization. To be successful in this role, you bring:

- Extensive Leadership Experience : Significant track record in line management and leading diverse, international teams within a technology-driven industry.
- Digital Expertise : Over 15 years of experience in project management specifically for software and digital products, ideally within Life Sciences or Diagnostics.
- Methodological Mastery : Deep knowledge of project management frameworks, including proficiency in Scaled Agile (SAFe) and regulated product development.
- Strategic Mindset : Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and challenge the status quo with innovative ideas.
- Global Collaboration: Excellent communication skills in English and the flexibility to partner with teams across Europe and US time zones, including 10-20% travel.

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Leadership & People Management

• Exhibit exceptional leadership aligned with the VACC model, demonstrating a capacity to craft and execute forward-thinking strategies. Cultivate a high-impact environment by systematically eliminating barriers, advancing both people and technical capabilities, and enabling individuals to perform at their peak potential.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team, with a strong emphasis on people development, fostering individual growth, and enhancing collective skillsets to meet evolving organizational needs. Champion team building and cohesion to create a collaborative environment where shared success is prioritized.

• Serve as an unwavering advocate for Roche's mission of advancing and boldly championing diversity, equity, and inclusion, shaping an organizational ethos that reflects these pillars in all initiatives.

• Forge and sustain strategic alliances with site leaders to ensure alignment on high-priority initiatives, drive synergy across cross-functional operations, and achieve mutually advantageous relationships that deliver enduring organizational success.

• Oversee the implementation and continuous evolution of site SHE procedures, embedding best-in-class programs to surpass corporate/site SHE KPIs. Lead cultural transformation by embedding SHE principles into the organizational DNA and fostering a proactive employee safety mindset.

• Inspire, mentor, and direct the organization, while driving performance excellence and advancing team members’ development toward achieving both organizational objectives and their personal and professional aspirations.

• Build a strong pipeline of talent and robust succession plans for key positions.

• Spearhead a culture of relentless continuous improvement by embodying and advocating lean leadership principles, driving operational excellence that aligns with global benchmarks.

• Instill a transparent, innovation-driven, and high-performance culture built on empowerment, ownership, and bold thinking, ensuring the organization sustains a competitive edge in a dynamic market environment.

• Acts as a mentor and coach to less experienced colleagues, providing guidance in mastering complex Q&V workflows, troubleshooting technical challenges, and developing skills in MSAT operations.

Technical
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Actively contribute to the design and construction of the new facility, encompassing key activities such as IOPQ, APS, and process/cleaning validation for seamless technology transfer, ensuring successful project execution and delivery.

• Lead and develop a high-performing qualification and validation team, fostering a culture of innovation, technical rigor, and cross-functional collaboration.

• Act as a technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) and people leader, guiding team members in qualification, process and cleaning validation, manufacturing support and troubleshooting to drive operational excellence.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Technology Accounts and Software Asset Management

Head of Technology Accounts and Software Asset Management ( Practice Leader) is accountable for the integrated management of major Technology Accounts (Platform, Cloud, and Software providers) and the Software Asset Management (SAM) practice. You will lead a team responsible for optimizing technology spending, maximizing ROI, and ensuring strict license compliance across the RDT landscape. This role requires a distinctive blend of technical proficiency in modern technology stacks and deep expertise in software licensing and asset governance.

Description of the area

Asset Management & Technology Accounts manages the lifecycle of RDT’s technology assets. This includes the governance of major technology partners (e.g., SAP, AWS, Microsoft) and the execution of SAM processes to ensure compliance and financial optimization. This sub-function ensures that these high-scale partnerships deliver maximum value through structured governance, risk management, and continuous improvement frameworks.

Job Responsibilities

• SAM Governance: Own the functional roadmap for Software Asset Management. Ensure the entire lifecycle of software assets is managed to maintain compliance and minimize risk.

• Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serves as the main contact for internal partners, actively managing relationships and expectations regarding the (sub-)function's performance and deliverables. Works closely with IT stakeholders and internal users to identify, prioritize, and address the needs for policies, their operationalization, and associated controls.

• Technology Account Strategy: Align technology account roadmaps with modern architecture (Cloud, AI/ML, SaaS) in regulated environments.

• Asset Compliance: Lead enterprise-wide technology risk assessments and ensure timely remediation of findings or licensing deviations.

• Operational Execution: Implement and oversee tools and processes for tracking asset utilization and license entitlement.

• Operational Excellence: Define and monitor KPIs/OKRs to analyze vendor performance. Use data to drive continuous improvement and optimize the service delivery model.

• Team Leadership: Lead and develop a high-performing team of vendor account managers. Mentor staff and ensure alignment of resources with RDT project requirements.

• Influence & Collaboration: Partner closely with Architecture, Security, and Finance to ensure technology platforms support critical business processes efficiently.

Qualifications

• Education/Experience: 10+ years in IT Asset Management, Technology Sourcing, or IT Operations. Leadership experience in global, multidisciplinary teams is required.

• Functional Skills: Strong understanding of modern technology landscapes (Cloud, DevOps, Digital Platforms). Expert knowledge of SAM frameworks and major vendor licensing models.

• Leadership: Ability to lead through influence and partnership. Strong ability to mentor a technical team in a complex, global stakeholder ecosystem.

What you get*:

• Salary range 23,300 - 43,300 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 20%).

• Company car or car allowance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Capo dei conti tecnologici e della gestione dei beni software Responsabile dei conti tecnologici e della gestione patrimoniale software (Practice Leader) è responsabile per la gestione integrata dei principali account tecnologici (Platform, Cloud e fornitori di software) e della pratica Software Asset Management (SAM). Potrai guidare un team responsabile per ottimizzare la spesa tecnologica, massimizzare il ROI e garantire una rigorosa conformità della licenza attraverso il paesaggio RDT. Questo ruolo richiede un mix distintivo di competenza tecnica negli stack tecnologici moderni e una profonda esperienza nel software di licensing e asset governance. Descrizione dell'Area Asset Management & Technology Accounts gestisce il ciclo di vita dei beni tecnologici di RDT. Questo include la governance dei principali partner tecnologici (ad esempio SAP, AWS, Microsoft) e l'esecuzione dei processi SAM per garantire la conformità e l'ottimizzazione finanziaria. Questa sotto-funzione garantisce che queste partnership di alto livello forniscono il massimo valore attraverso la governance strutturata, la gestione dei rischi e i quadri di miglioramento continuo. Mansioni - SAM Governance: proprio la roadmap funzionale per la gestione del patrimonio software. Assicurare l'intero ciclo di vita dei beni software è gestito per mantenere la conformità e minimizzare il rischio. - Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve come il principale contatto per i partner interni, gestendo attivamente le relazioni e le aspettative circa le prestazioni e i consegnabili della (sub-)funzione. Funziona a stretto contatto con le parti interessate IT e gli utenti interni per identificare, prioritizzare e affrontare le esigenze delle politiche, la loro operativizzazione e controlli associati. - Strategia dell'account tecnologico: Allineare le roadmap della tecnologia con l'architettura moderna (Cloud, AI/ML, SaaS) in ambienti regolamentati. - Asset Compliance: Guidare le valutazioni di rischio di tecnologia a livello aziendale e garantire una tempestiva bonifica dei risultati o delle deviazioni di licenze. - Esecuzione Operativa: implementare e supervisionare strumenti e processi per il monitoraggio dell'utilizzo e del diritto di licenza. - Eccellenza Operativa: Definire e monitorare i KPI/OKR per analizzare le prestazioni del fornitore. Utilizzare i dati per migliorare continuamente e ottimizzare il modello di consegna del servizio. - Team Leadership: Guidare e sviluppare un team di manager di account fornitori altamente performanti. Personale di mentore e garantire l'allineamento delle risorse con i requisiti di progetto RDT. - Influenza e collaborazione: collaborare a stretto contatto con Architettura, Sicurezza e Finanza per garantire che le piattaforme tecnologiche supportino in modo efficiente i processi aziendali critici.
• Requisiti - Istruzione/Esperienza: 10+ anni in IT Asset Management, Technology Sourcing o IT Operations. È richiesta un'esperienza di leadership in team multidisciplinari globali. - Competenze Funzionali: Forte comprensione dei paesaggi tecnologici moderni (Cloud, DevOps, Piattaforme digitali). Conoscenza esperta delle strutture SAM e dei principali modelli di licenza del fornitore. - Leadership: Capacità di condurre attraverso l'influenza e la partnership. Forte capacità di mentore un team tecnico in un ecosistema di stakeholder complesso e globale. Cosa? - Gamma di insalata 23.300 - 43.300 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro. - Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 20%). - Indennità di automobile o di automobile. - Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.). - Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile). - Prenda tempo Programma (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile. - Posizione Flex (possibilità) Contatto *(Nessun recapito fornito nel testo originale)*

Cette sous-fonction assure que ces partenariats à grande échelle offrent une valeur maximale grâce à des cadres structurés de gouvernance, de gestion des risques et d'amélioration continue. Mansioni - Gouvernance SAM : Posséder la feuille de route fonctionnelle pour la gestion d'actifs logiciels. Collaborer étroitement avec les intervenants en TI et les utilisateurs internes pour déterminer, classer par ordre de priorité et répondre aux besoins en matière de politiques, de leur opérationnalisation et de contrôles connexes. - Stratégie de compte technologique : Aligner les feuilles de route des comptes technologiques avec l'architecture moderne (Cloud, AI/ML, SaaS) dans les environnements réglementés. - Conformité des actifs : Diriger les évaluations des risques technologiques à l'échelle de l'entreprise et veiller à ce que les constatations ou les écarts de licence soient corrigés en temps opportun. - Exécution opérationnelle : Mettre en œuvre et superviser les outils et les processus de suivi de l'utilisation des biens et des droits de licence. - Excellence opérationnelle : Définir et surveiller les ICR/ROK pour analyser le rendement des fournisseurs. Utilisez les données pour obtenir une amélioration continue et optimiser le modèle de prestation de services. - Leadership d'équipe : Diriger et développer une équipe de gestionnaires de comptes fournisseurs hautement performants. Le personnel du mentor et assurer l'alignement des ressources sur les exigences du projet RDT. - Influence et collaboration : S'associer étroitement avec Architecture, Sécurité et Finances pour s'assurer que les plateformes technologiques soutiennent efficacement les processus opérationnels critiques.

Connaissances spécialisées des cadres SAM et des principaux modèles de licences de fournisseurs. - Leadership : Capacité de diriger par l'influence et le partenariat. Forte capacité à encadrer une équipe technique dans un écosystème complexe et mondial d'intervenants. Cosa

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Principal Domain Architect designs business-driven, future-ready solutions for our International Pharma Commercial Marketing & Customer Engagement portfolio. In this strategic role, you will define the architectural vision for how we engage with patients and HCPs across international markets. You will align technology deployments with commercial priorities, ensuring our "Global-to-Local" scaling strategy is seamless, compliant, and data-driven
Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a Multiple Solution, Platform, or Product Line Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and strictly aligns with the architecture community for governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Guides others in resolving highly complex issues and problems with implications on cross-functional organizational processes and outcomes. Defines and manages architecture, governance, and technology aligned with stakeholder needs. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for a complete platform or product line. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are systematically recorded and published across the platform. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including comprehensive vendor assessments.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates complex ideas and influences senior-level stakeholders to adopt new approaches. Deeply connects with and understands the business needs, closely partnering with Commercial Excellence, Medical Affairs and Marketing stakeholders. Drives seamless information sharing across the complete customer engagement products .

• Impact: Provides high-level technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies strategic opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Platform or Product.

• Domain Strategy: Maintain the technology roadmap for the International Commercial landscape, focusing on CRM, Omnichannel Marketing, and other capabilities

• Business / Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge across multiple technology areas. Serves as a recognized leader in Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• 5+ years of experience in designing and architecting business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a multiple solution, platform, or product line context.

• Experience resolving highly complex issues with implications on cross-functional organizational processes and outcomes.

• Proven track record acting as a recognized leader in architecture practices, including significant experience mentoring and developing architectural talent.

• Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry

Technical Skills

• Demonstrates deep technical authority across diverse technology stacks to solve complex, enterprise-scale challenges.

• Expert at designing Conceptual and Logical Data Models, Taxono
