jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. This is a temporary or secondment position

As Global Business Process Specialist—Capital Investment Finance , you are part of the Business Process Management Finance team at Roche Services & Solutions. This position actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy and is responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design related to financial processes in the domains of asset accounting, CAPEX & Lease accounting. The person in this role is the empowered decision-maker for their area across divisions and in line with the E2E Business Process Management guardrails from the Global Business Process Managers. This position works closely with various stakeholders in the Business Process Management organization & beyond, with the goal to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions and contributes as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in an ongoing large scale global SAP S4 deployment across our Pharmaceutical and Diagnostics Division.

The Opportunity:

• Lead and drive the deployment of large-scale SAP S4 initiatives, owning key areas such as Asset Accounting, CAPEX, and Lease Accounting while ensuring successful project delivery and integration.

• Execute and continuously enhance end-to-end business process management (E2E BPM) strategies, delivering integrated solutions across processes, technology, and analytics while enabling global business adoption.

• Design and redesign global, cross-divisional processes to be standardized, lean, and fit-for-purpose, ensuring alignment with best practices and organizational goals.

• Govern business processes by prioritizing and implementing change requests, ensuring effective execution, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement, while creating meaningful impact across both business and IT.

Who You Are:

• You bring a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering, or a related field, along with 5–7 years of experience in business process management, finance, accounting, or similar functions.

• You possess strong technical and process expertise, including deep knowledge of end-to-end processes, IFRS Accounting, SAP FI/CO, ICFR, procurement, and hands-on experience in asset and lease accounting within SAP environments.

• You demonstrate a strong methodological foundation (BPM, Six Sigma, Lean, Scrum, PDCA, Kaizen) combined with an agile, customer-centric mindset and high attention to detail and quality.

• You excel in stakeholder management, communication, and leadership, with a proven ability to influence, manage change, navigate ambiguity, and collaborate effectively across global, multicultural, and matrixed organizations, with business-fluent English.

Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are fearless in both decision-making and taking action.

You will be the primary operational anchor and practitioner-leader for our delivery organization, bridging the gap between strategic intent and technical execution. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead engineering teams in building sustainable products that accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines.

Description of the Area
We are seeking a hands-on leader, ideally with experience as an STE, RTE, Program Manager or Initiative Owner, to guide a diverse delivery team, including Senior Project/Program Managers, Deployment Leads, RTEs, and STEs. You will operate as a practitioner-leader, balancing deep mentorship with Network Execution. Success in this role relies on establishing absolute trust with Business and IT leaders through constant communication and active partnership.
The Opportunity:

• Drive Product Strategy: Accountable for setting the product direction, ensuring all features and roadmaps align with defined financial objectives and organizational goals.

• Lead Cross-Functional Excellence: Orchestrate the continuous flow of the Agile Value Stream while simultaneously driving distinct programs and projects to successful completion.

• Foster Trusted Partnerships: Build deep alliances with Business and IT executives through transparent communication to bridge the gap between strategy and execution.

• Champion Customer-Centricity: Act as the primary owner of the customer's problem, prioritizing internal user needs to deliver solutions that provide tangible value.

• Execute End-to-End Lifecycle Management: Lead the entire product lifecycle from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement.

• Innovate with AI: Proactively integrate relevant Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities into the product roadmap to maintain a competitive and future-ready portfolio.

• Optimize Performance: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and user satisfaction metrics to inform data-driven product iterations and optimizations.

• Nurture Team Development: Act as a practitioner-coach, mentoring your team to master SAFe facilitation and navigate complex hybrid (Agile/Waterfall) landscapes.

Who you are:

• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 5+ years of experience in product management or business analysis with a proven track record of launching technology products.

• Industry Specialist: You possess 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry.

• Proven People Lead: You have 1+ years of experience in a leadership role managing multidisciplinary technical teams and holding people authority.

• Technically Proficient: You have a strong understanding of software architecture (APIs, cloud) and the product development lifecycle, including GxP and GDPR.

• Strategic Communicator: You excel at translating high-level scientific goals into concrete roadmaps and influencing diverse groups toward a common vision.

• Agile Expert: You are skilled in SAFe facilitation and capable of removing systemic impediments to maintain operational excellence and flow.

• Academic Foundation: You are highly educated in a relevant scientific, technical, or business field, supporting your ability

descriptionByLocale.it: # Mansioni - **Product Manager - Delivery Organization Primary Operational Anchor and Practitioner-Leader** # Descrizione dell'Area - Guida una squadra di consegna diversificata, composta da Senior Project/Program Managers, Deployment Leads, RTEs e STEs. - Opera come un leader praticante, bilanciando la mentorship approfondita con l'esecuzione della rete. - Stabilisce una fiducia assoluta con i leader aziendali e IT attraverso una comunicazione costante e una partnership attiva. # Opportunità: - **Guida la Strategia del Prodotto:** Responsabile della direzione del prodotto, garantendo che tutte le funzionalità e le roadmap si allineino con gli obiettivi finanziari e gli obiettivi organizzativi definiti. - **Dirige l'Eccellenza Cross-Funzionale:** Orchestra il flusso continuo del flusso di valore Agile mentre guida distinti programmi e progetti verso il completamento riuscito. - **Favorisce Partnerships Fiduciarie:** Costruisce alleanze profonde con i dirigenti aziendali e IT attraverso una comunicazione trasparente per colmare il divario tra strategia ed esecuzione. - **Promuove la Centralità del Cliente:** Funziona come il proprietario principale del problema del cliente, priorizzando i bisogni interni degli utenti per consegnare soluzioni che forniscono un valore tangibile. - **Esegue la Gestione del Ciclo di Vita End-to-End:** Guida l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla pianificazione strategica iniziale all'ideazione, al lancio, all'espansione e alla fine al pensionamento. - **Innova con l'IA:** Integra proattivamente le capacità rilevanti dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) nella roadmap del prodotto per mantenere un portafoglio competitivo e pronto per il futuro. - **Ottimizza le Prestazioni:** Definisce e traccia gli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI) e le metriche di soddisfazione dell'utente per informare le iterazioni e le ottimizzazioni del prodotto basate sui dati. - **Nurture Team Development:** Funziona come un coach praticante, mentor della squadra per padroneggiare la facilitazione SAFe e navigare paesaggi ibridi complessi (Agile/Waterfall). # Chi sei: - **Leader Esperto del Prodotto:** Porti 5+ anni di esperienza in gestione del prodotto o analisi aziendale con un track record comprovato di lancio di prodotti tecnologici. - **Specialista del Settore:** Possiedi 2+ anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o nella tecnologia regolamentata del settore sanitario. - **Leader Esperto:** Possiedi 1+ anni di esperienza in una posizione di leadership nella gestione di squadre tecniche multidisciplinary e nell'esercizio dell'autorità sulle persone. - **Tecnicamente Proficuo:** Hai una forte comprensione dell'architettura del software (API, cloud) e del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del prodotto, compresi GxP e GDPR. - **Comunicatore Strategico:** Eccelli nella traduzione degli obiettivi scientifici di alto livello in roadmap concrete e nell'influenzare gruppi diversi verso una visione comune. - **Esperto di Agile:** Sei esperto nella facilitazione SAFe e sei in grado di rimuovere gli ostacoli sistemici per mantenere l'eccellenza operativa e il flusso. - **Fondamento Accademico:** Sei altamente istruito in un campo scientifico, tecnico o aziendale rilevante, che sostiene la tua capacità. # Contatto - Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visita il sito web di Roche o contatta il tuo recruiter dedicato.

Wer sind Sie: - Expert Product Leader: 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Produktmanagement- oder Unternehmensanalyse mit einem bewährten Rekord von der Einführung technologischer Produkte. - Spezialist für den Bereich: Sie haben 2+ Jahre Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen, biotechnologischen oder regulatorischen Gesundheitstechnologie. - Expert Leader: Sie haben 1+ Jahre Erfahrung in einer Führungsposition in der Verwaltung von multidisziplinären technischen Teams und der Ausübung Autorität über Menschen. - Technisch rentabel: Sie haben ein starkes Verständnis für Softwarearchitektur (API, Cloud) und Produktentwicklungslebenszyklus, einschließlich GxP und DSGVO. - Strategische Kommunikation: Eccelli bei der Umsetzung hochrangiger wissenschaftlicher Ziele in konkrete Fahrpläne und der Beeinflussung verschiedener Gruppen in Richtung einer gemeinsamen Vision. - Experte von Agile: Sie sind Experte für SAFe-Facilitation und sind in der Lage, systemische Hindernisse zu beseitigen, um operative Exzellenz und Fluss zu erhalten. - akademische Stiftung: Sie sind hoch ausgebildet in einem wissenschaftlichen, technischen oder relevanten Geschäftsfeld, das Ihre Fähigkeit unterstützt. descriptionByLocale.fr: Mansioni - Gestionnaire de produits - Organisation de livraison - Secteur principal de l'ancrage opérationnel et du chef de file Description - Guidez une équipe de livraison diversifiée, composée de gestionnaires principaux de projets et de programmes, de chefs de déploiement, d'ETR et d'ECE. - Travaille comme un chef de file en conciliant le mentorat approfondi et l'exécution en réseau. - Oui. Il établit une confiance absolue avec les chefs d'entreprise et de TI par une communication constante et un partenariat actif. Possibilité : - Guider la stratégie du produit : Responsable de la gestion du produit, s'assurer que toutes les caractéristiques et les feuilles de route correspondent aux objectifs financiers et aux objectifs organisationnels définis. - Dirige l'excellence trans-fonction : orchestre le flux continu de la valeur Agile tout en conduisant des programmes et des projets distincts vers la réussite. - Promotion des partenariats fiduciaires : Elle crée des alliances profondes avec les dirigeants des entreprises et des TI grâce à une communication transparente pour combler le fossé entre la stratégie et l'exécution. - Promotion de la centralité client: Il fonctionne comme le principal propriétaire du problème du client, en priorisant les besoins internes de l'utilisateur pour fournir des solutions qui fournissent une valeur tangible. - Exécute la gestion du cycle de vie de bout en bout : Dirigez tout le cycle de vie du produit, de la planification stratégique initiale à l'idée, le lancement, l'expansion et éventuellement la retraite. - Innovation avec l'IA: intègre de manière proactive les capacités pertinentes de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) dans la feuille de route des produits afin de maintenir un portefeuille compétitif et prêt à porter. - Excellente performance : Définit et suit les indicateurs de performance clés (ICP) et les mesures de la satisfaction des utilisateurs pour éclairer les itérations et les optimisations de produits basées sur les données. - Développement de l'équipe Nurture : Il travaille comme entraîneur, mentor de l'équipe pour maîtriser la facilitation SAFe et naviguer dans des paysages hybrides complexes (Agile/Waterfall). Qui êtes-vous : - Expert Product Leader : 5+ ans d'expérience dans la gestion de produits ou l'analyse d'affaires avec une expérience éprouvée de lancement de produits technologiques. - Spécialiste du Secteur : Vous avez plus de 2 ans d'expérience dans les technologies pharmaceutiques, biotechnologiques ou réglementaires de la santé. - Chef d'équipe : Vous avez 1+ ans d'expérience en leadership dans la gestion d'équipes techniques multidisciplinaires et l'exercice de l'autorité sur les gens. - Techniquement rentable: Vous avez une bonne compréhension de l'architecture logicielle (API, cloud) et du cycle de vie du développement de produits, y compris GxP et GDPR. - Communication stratégique: Eccelli traduit les objectifs scientifiques de haut niveau en feuilles de route concrètes et influence les différents groupes vers une vision commune. - Expert d'Agile: Vous êtes expert en facilitation Safe et êtes en mesure d'éliminer les obstacles systémiques pour maintenir l'excellence opérationnelle et le flux. - Fondement académique: Vous êtes très instruit dans un domaine scientifique, technique ou pertinent, qui soutient votre capacité. Contact - Pour plus d'informations ou pour postuler, visitez le site Web de Roche ou contactez votre recruteur dédié.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be :

• Actively pursue the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, according to guardrails set by the E2E GBPO and GBPMs

• Deliver solutions including processes, technology & analytics for the Receivables, Sales & Treasury Integration Sub Chapter in line with the E2E BPM strategy & guardrails as well as continuous improvements, with support of the GBPM and GBPSs

• Support business acceptance globally across divisions and functions on an operating level for the dedicated business process area

• Drive and implement the BPM strategy for his/her own dedicated area

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering or a comparable education

• 5 - 7 years professional experience in Business process management, Finance & accounting or equivalent function

• Proven methodological skills e.g. BPM, Six Sigma (DMAIC), agile ways of working (Scrum), continuous improvement (Lean, PDCA, Kaizen) . Agile mindset (speed, stability, flexibility) - works according to and brings in the agile mindset and concepts in daily operations

• Good collaboration, teamwork and interpersonal skills ; Strong analytical thinking and problem solving mindset ; Proven customer-centric mindset (internal & external) ; High attention to qualqity and details ; Highly comfortable with handling ambiguity and taking decisions

• Experience in working in multicultural teams, organizational and project management skills, especially in matrix structures, considering/balancing interests of senior stakeholders from different functions . Strong influencing skills and ability to work in complex global networks with international teams

• Extensive change management and conflict management skills and experience . Business fluency in English . Willingness to travel internationally (up to 10%)

jobs.title: Head of Healthcare Transformation
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose

• The Head of Healthcare Transformation serves as a cornerstone in advancing Roche Diagnostics' commitment to enhancing patient care. By synthesizing clinical evidence, access frameworks, and governmental advocacy with business development, this leader ensures that breakthrough diagnostics gain market entry, clinical recognition, and financial sustainability within Taiwan. This executive role fundamentally evolves the local medical landscape while establishing Roche as a premier partner in the health ecosystem.

• A primary focus involves the evaluation and refinement of healthcare pathways and public policy to foster robust internal and external partnerships, thereby modernizing the local environment to drive substantive commercial growth. Achieving systemic change necessitates the seamless integration of policy shaping, medical insights and reimbursement expertise. Furthermore, you will identify and cultivate emerging business opportunities that respond to shifting clinical trends, overseeing the launch of programs that improve healthcare delivery and ensure the enduring availability of innovative diagnostic tools.

• Possessing a profound sense of purpose, the incumbent will mobilize teams to achieve superior outcomes under the "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan" vision, directly contributing to the execution of the RDTW 1000 days strategic roadmap.

• In this capacity, you will demonstrate an entrepreneurial spirit and system-wide perspective, converting visionary concepts into disciplined, high-impact strategies that secure organizational success across both immediate and future horizons.

• As a member of the RD Taiwan Leadership Team, you will role model VACC behaviors and uphold the LT Purpose Statement. Close collaboration with peers across the Leadership Team is essential to realize the company's broader objectives. This leadership approach centers on cultivating high-performing, customer-centric teams within an agile and continuously evolving organizational culture.

• Ultimately, you must exhibit the determination and resilience required to transform Taiwan's healthcare landscape, embodying the core Roche mission: "Doing what patients need next."

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute an integrated medical, market access & policy strategy aligned with global/regional guidelines and local business objectives.

• Medical Affairs Strategy: Lead the generation and dissemination of scientific evidence, foster strategic relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and medical societies, and ensure scientific accuracy in all activities.

• Market Access & Reimbursement: Drive successful NHI (National Health Insurance) listing and optimal pricing strategies for key diagnostic products, utilizing health economics and outcomes research (HEOR).

• Public Policy & Government Affairs: Proactively monitor the healthcare policy landscape. Engage collaboratively with government authorities (e.g., MOHW, NHIA), industry associations, and patient advocacy groups to shape favorable policies for diagnostic innovations.

• Business Development: Identify, develop, and manage strategic emerging business opportunities and partnerships that promote growth and innovation and ensure the delivery of scalable and impactful healthcare solutions.

• Team Leadership & VACC Culture: Lead, coach, and inspire a cross-functional Medical, Market Access, Policy and Business Development team to unl

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Manufacturing Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Security Engineer plays a vital role in protecting Roche Manufacturing systems and networks against cybersecurity threats. This role is responsible for local architecture and engineering support, helping system owners and administrators in keeping their manufacturing environment up to date with the latest Roche Manufacturing Cybersecurity standards, baselines and industry best practices. Some of this role’s responsibilities are:

• Taking part in technical design reviews, integration, testing, and documentation activities concerning new OT systems and/or changes to existing manufacturing system or infrastructure

• Supporting development of Manufacturing Cybersecurity standards and baselines OT Cybersecurity Advisor during OT System planning phase and OT System Risk Assessment process

• Advising System Owners in selecting appropriate security measures to mitigate risk

• Coordinating of OT services and activities delivered by Vendors

• Reviewing local technical designs as part of Manufacturing Cybersecurity Requests (in ServiceNow)

• Designing and sustaining OT Security Monitoring (IIDS) at the Manufacturing Site

• Providing technical support during Incident Response process including steps to minimize the impact, conducting a technical and forensic investigation into how the breach happened and the extent of the damage

• Working closely with System Owners, Cybersecurity Site Representative and is a catalyst for cross-site collaboration on topics related to Manufacturing Cybersecurity

The Senior Security Engineer is a member of the Manufacturing Cybersecurity Engineering team led by the Head of Manufacturing Cybersecurity Engineering and part of the Security Platforms subfunction in the Information Security function at Roche.

Job Responsibilities

• Independently manages end-to-end security analysis tasks across various capabilities and contributes to more complex problems

• Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of security best practices

• Stakeholder Management

• Identifies a diverse range of security stakeholders across functional areas and effectively manages relationships to build reliance through deep business and technical understanding, acting as a trusted advisor

• Acts as a strategic influencer, defining and driving stakeholder engagement strategies for complex initiatives, facilitating workshops, resolving conflicts, and proactively shaping stakeholder perspectives to align with project goals

• Impact/Strategy

• Demonstrates strong and consistent performance across diverse products, with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster

• Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overall business objectives, and takes a proactive role in shaping team processes Complexity

• Manages business analysis activities on more complex projects or across multiple products within a domain

• Capable of handling ambiguous requirements, navigating intricate stakeholder environments, and evaluating solution impacts considering both immediate and longer-term implications within the domain

• Business/Technical ability

• Demonstrates a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies

• Can independently apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis, effectively managing interconnections to improve overall efficiency and effectiveness

jobs.title: Account Value Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Position: Account Value Partner
Report to: Account Value Lead
Area : Petchaburi, Prachuabkhirikhan, Chumporn, Ranong

Purpose of the Job
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
As an Account Value Partner, you are at the forefront of our mission, driving the sales of Roche's innovative diagnostic products within your assigned territory in Thailand. You will be a trusted partner to healthcare professionals, providing them with the solutions and expertise they need to improve patient outcomes. This is a dynamic field-based role where you will build strong relationships, exceed sales targets, and be a key contributor to our success.

Role-Specific Accountabilities

• Define and own the medical education event and KOL engagement strategy.

• Gather and analyze insights to co-create solutions with hospital management, KOLs, and key customers.

• Take accountability for achieving budgeted sales while keeping costs under control.

• Seek out opportunities in key accounts and lead/organize promotional activities or product/solution presentations to achieve sales growth.

• Develop and implement territory and key account plans that align with the marketing plan, demonstrating effective time management and prioritization.

• Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction post-sale, including coordinating technical support or addressing initial product inquiries to maintain long-term partnerships.

• Manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiation, closing deals, and contract implementation.

QUALIFICATIONS
Experience and Competencies:

• Deep understanding of business drivers, products, the local market, and competition.

• Ability to influence at all levels, position/sell ideas to client groups, and manage expectations in line with the agreed portfolio.

• Builds trustful and effective relationships.

• Capable of finding creative solutions to complex problems, taking responsibility, driving results, and achieving expected outcomes.

Industry Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Medical Technology.

• 3+ years of work experience in a related sales or clinical field.

• Flexibility to be based in various locations across Thailand, including Bangkok, upcountry provinces, or in a hybrid model, depending on the assigned territory.

• Preferred area Petchaburi, Prachuabkhirikhan, Chumporn, Ranong

• Proficient language skills in Thai and a good command of spoken and written English.

• A valid driver's license and willingness to travel frequently are required.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Technical Service Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every patient deserves the best diagnostic outcome. As a Technical Service Manager, you will be the driving force behind the reliability of Roche diagnostic instruments in Indonesia — leading a team of Field Service Engineers and ensuring that every laboratory we serve can trust their equipment, every day. If you are a hands-on technical leader who thrives in the field, takes ownership of outcomes, and genuinely cares about the people you lead and the customers you serve, we want to hear from you.

The Opportunity
You will lead the Field Service Engineer (FSE) team for Roche Diagnostics Indonesia, owning the full lifecycle of instrument service — from installation and preventive maintenance through to troubleshooting and customer escalation management. Reporting to the Head of Customer Support, you will be accountable for team performance, customer satisfaction, and the operational discipline that keeps our instruments — and our customers' laboratories — running at their best.

In this role, you will:

• Lead, develop, and manage a team of Field Service Engineers — setting clear targets, monitoring performance, and building their technical and professional capability

• Own instrument reliability across your territory: plan and execute preventive maintenance, manage escalations, and ensure all service activities are documented and traceable in line with Roche SOPs

• Drive customer satisfaction by resolving hardware and software issues with urgency, following up within 24 hours on all raised problems, and handling customer complaints with accountability

• Ensure operational compliance across all service activities — including case management in Rexis, service bulletin implementation, and trunk stock and spare parts management

• Report on team performance and operational metrics to the Head of Customer Support, providing clear monthly reviews and contributing to continuous service improvement

Who You Are
You bring:

• A Bachelor's degree in Electro Medical Engineering or Electrical Engineering from a reputable university

• Minimum 5 years of technical service experience in the medical device, diagnostics, or healthcare industry — with direct people management experience

• Proven ability to lead and develop field-based teams, with a track record of driving accountability, performance, and team capability

• Strong technical grounding in instrument troubleshooting, installation, and preventive maintenance, with the judgment to know when to escalate

• A customer-first mindset: you take ownership of issues, communicate proactively, and are not satisfied until the customer is

• Comfort working independently in a field-intensive environment — including travel across Indonesia and flexibility for weekend responsibilities when required

• Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken, for reporting and cross-functional communication

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Unsere Abteilung

Im Produktmanagement & Marketing des Bereichs Labordiagnostik der Roche Diagnostics Deutschland GmbH betreuen und vertreiben wir Lösungen für diagnostische Labore im deutschen Markt. Unser Produktportfolio umfasst Analysensysteme und Assays für die Klinische Chemie, Immunologie, Gerinnungs- und Urindiagnostik. Ganzheitliche Konzepte für Labore aller Größenordnungen werden durch innovative Hardware und Software Lösungen zur automatisierten Prä- und Postanalytik, zur Steuerung des Proben- und Datenflusses sowie zur Unterstützung der operativen und medizinischen Entscheidungsfindung realisiert. Im Marketing- und Produktmanagement stellen wir eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Verkauf, Service und Produktentwicklung dar.

Die Position

Bist Du auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum, in dem Du Dich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst? In diesem Praktikum bieten wir Bachelor- und Masterstudierenden die Möglichkeit, die Arbeit im Marketing und Produktmanagement kennenzulernen und aktiv mitzugestalten. Hier werden naturwissenschaftliche Grundlagen mit betriebswirtschaftlichen und technologischen Themen vereint. Mögliche Aufgabenfelder beinhalten:

• Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung von Multi-Channel Marketingkampagnen, Schulungen und Events

• Mitarbeit bei der Einführung von neuen Produkten

• Konzeption von Marketingmaterialien (z.B. Online- und Social Media Marketing, Präsentationen und Broschüren)

• Identifikation, Analyse und Zusammenfassung von wissenschaftlicher Literatur und Studienergebnissen

• Markt- und Potentialanalysen

Qualifikationen

Für Dein Praktikum im Produktmanagement und Marketing bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen und Kenntnisse mit:

• Du bist immatrikulierte/r, fortgeschrittene/r Bachelor- oder Masterstudierende/r der Natur- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, der Medizin, des Ingenieurwesens, der Informationstechnologie oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs

• Du bist es gewohnt, selbständig und mit hohem Engagement zu arbeiten und verfügst über eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe

• Komplexe Fragestellungen aus dem Gesundheitswesen motivieren Dich und Herausforderungen treiben Dich an

• Du hast Spaß, im Team zu arbeiten und gemeinsam Erfolge zu erzielen

• Du bist sicher in der Anwendung der gängigen MS Office und Google-Programme

• Deutsch ist Deine Muttersprache oder Du hast C2 Niveau

• Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Einsatzbereitschaft runden Dein Profil ab

Die Benefits

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 4 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

Die Bewerbung

Bitte bewirb Dich ausschließlich online und füge Deiner Bewerbung Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, Zeugniskopien sowie eine aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung in einem Dokument bei.

Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum ausschließlich an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden.

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Zeitraum : für 6 Monat

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de comptes clés (Histologie et séquençage)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
Roche Diagnostics is seeking a Key Account Manager (Histology & Sequencing) based preferably in the Western Cape with commercial experience in the Diagnostic / Medical industry. The role will involve developing account and portfolio strategies, identifying and securing sales opportunities, building relationships with key executive decision makers in customers to grow Roche market share. While the focus is on the Western Cape, the role will involve travel to other provinces.

Key Challenges

Stakeholder Engagement and Management

• To build customer relationships by participating in Roche and industry events, identifying and engaging with executive decision makers, understanding market trends and provide feedback and input as required

• To create and maintain the customer account mapping by identifying stakeholders, preparing a profile on the formal and informal decision makers and create an organogram of the account as required

• To identify sales data trends at portfolio level by extracting the sales data, undertaking the analysis, identifying trends and variances and engaging with this information and providing reasons monthly

• Understanding the customer needs and wants

• To maintain effective internal relationships by engaging with relevant individuals and departments, influencing alignment and mobilisation towards key account and portfolio strategies, providing information and feedback and addressing any queries as required

• To maintain relevant product, industry and sector knowledge by engaging with the market players including but not limited to competitors and customers, analysing information and activities, identifying issues and trends and providing feedback to the relevant individuals or departments as required

Account Management

• To implement the account and portfolio strategy by understanding customer requirements, collaborating with marketing, implementing strategies in market segments and securing new clients and/or expanding footprint in existing clients as required

• To identify sales opportunities by engaging with customers to understand new product or opportunities, analysing the opportunity, developing proposals and presenting to customers monthly and as required

• To implement campaigns by engaging with Product Managers, engaging with customers and running campaign events as required

• To respond to sales related queries by understanding the issue, sourcing the appropriate feedback and providing feedback to clients as required

• To report on sales performance by understanding KPIs, analyzing sales data daily, identifying trends and patterns, providing feedback on performance, monitoring and achieving profitability and drafting reports monthly and as required

• To achieve sales targets by managing sales opportunities, loading onto the CRM system, engaging with customers, preparing and presenting proposals, securing deals, monitoring customer satisfaction in implementation, identifying risks and implementing corrective action daily

• To administer the sales process by loading all sales information into the CRM system, updating information, tracking pipeline progress, identifying areas of risk and opportunity and implementing appropriate ac

descriptionByLocale.it: Roche - Descrizione del lavoro Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Roche Diagnostics sta cercando un Key Account Manager (Histology & Sequencing) basato preferibilmente nel Western Cape con esperienza commerciale nel settore diagnostico / medico. Il ruolo coinvolgerà lo sviluppo di strategie di conto e portafoglio, l'identificazione e la sicurezza delle opportunità di vendita, la costruzione di relazioni con i decisori esecutivi chiave nei clienti per aumentare la quota di mercato Roche. Mentre l'attenzione è sul Capo occidentale, il ruolo coinvolgerà i viaggi in altre province. Le sfide chiave Stakeholder Engagement and Management - Per costruire relazioni con i clienti partecipando a Roche e eventi del settore, identificare e coinvolgere i decisori esecutivi, comprendere le tendenze del mercato e fornire feedback e input come richiesto - Per creare e mantenere la mappatura dell'account cliente identificando gli stakeholder, preparando un profilo sui decisori formali e informali e creando un organogramma del conto come richiesto - Per identificare le tendenze dei dati di vendita a livello di portafoglio estraendo i dati di vendita, intraprendendo l'analisi, identificando le tendenze e le variazioni e coinvolgendo queste informazioni e fornendo motivi mensili - Capire le esigenze del cliente e vuole - Mantenere relazioni interne efficaci coinvolgendo persone e dipartimenti pertinenti, influenzando l'allineamento e la mobilitazione verso le strategie di account e portafoglio chiave, fornendo informazioni e feedback e affrontando eventuali quesiti come richiesto - Mantenere le conoscenze relative ai prodotti, all'industria e al settore, coinvolgendo i giocatori di mercato, inclusi ma non limitati ai concorrenti e ai clienti, analizzando le informazioni e le attività, identificando i problemi e le tendenze e fornendo un feedback alle persone o ai dipartimenti pertinenti, come richiesto Gestione account - Per implementare la strategia di account e portfolio comprendendo i requisiti dei clienti, collaborando con il marketing, implementando strategie nei segmenti di mercato e garantendo nuovi clienti e/o espandendo l'impronta nei clienti esistenti, come richiesto - Per identificare le opportunità di vendita impegnandosi con i clienti a comprendere nuovi prodotti o opportunità, analizzando l'opportunità, sviluppando proposte e presentando ai clienti mensilmente e come richiesto - Per implementare campagne coinvolgendo Product Managers, coinvolgendo i clienti e facendo eventi campagna come richiesto - Per rispondere alle domande relative alle vendite comprendendo il problema, sourcing il feedback appropriato e fornire feedback ai clienti come richiesto - Per segnalare le prestazioni di vendita comprendendo i KPI, analizzando quotidianamente i dati di vendita, identificando tendenze e modelli, fornendo feedback sulle prestazioni, monitoraggio e raggiungimento della redditività e redazione report mensili e come richiesto - Per raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita gestendo le opportunità di vendita, caricando sul sistema CRM, impegnandosi con i clienti, preparando e presentando proposte, assicurando offerte, monitorando la soddisfazione del cliente nell'implementazione, identificando i rischi e implementando azioni correttive ogni giorno - Per amministrare il processo di vendita caricando tutte le informazioni di vendita nel sistema CRM, aggiornando le informazioni, tracciando il progresso delle tubazioni, identificando le aree di rischio e opportunità e implementando un'azione appropriata

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Opportunity Roche Diagnostics is seeking a Key Account Manager (Histology & Sequencing) based preferably in the Western Cape with commercial experience in the Diagnostic / Medical industry. The role will involve developing account and portfolio strategies, identifying and securing sales opportunities, building relationships with key executive decision makers in customers to grow Roche market share. While the focus is on the Western Cape, the role will involve travel to other provinces. Key Challenges Stakeholder Engagement and Management
• To build customer relationships by participating in Roche and industry events, identifying and engaging with executive decision makers, understanding market trends and provide feedback and input as required
• To create and maintain the customer account mapping by identifying stakeholders, preparing a profile on the formal and informal decision makers and create an organogram of the account as required
• To identify sales data trends at portfolio level by extracting the sales data, undertaking the analysis, identifying trends and variances and engaging with this information and providing reasons monthly
• Understanding the customer needs and wants
• To maintain effective internal relationships by engaging with relevant individuals and departments, influencing alignment and mobilisation towards key account and portfolio strategies, providing information and feedback and addressing any queries as required
• To maintain relevant product, industry and sector knowledge by engaging with the market players including but not limited to competitors and customers, analysing information and activities, identifying issues and trends and providing feedback to the relevant individuals or departments as required Account Management
• To implement the account and portfolio strategy by understanding customer requirements, collaborating with marketing, implementing strategies in market segments and securing new clients and/or expanding footprint in existing clients as required
• To identify sales opportunities by engaging with customers to understand new product or opportunities, analysing the opportunity, developing proposals and presenting to customers monthly and as required
• To implement campaigns by engaging with Product Managers, engaging with customers and running campaign events as required
• To respond to sales related queries by understanding the issue, sourcing the appropriate feedback and providing feedback to clients as required
• To report on sales performance by understanding KPIs, analyzing sales data daily, identifying trends and patterns, providing feedback on performance, monitoring and achieving profitability and drafting reports monthly and as required
• To achieve sales targets by managing sales opportunities, loading onto the CRM system, engaging with customers, preparing and presenting proposals, securing deals, monitoring customer satisfaction in implementation, identifying risks and implementing corrective action daily
• To administer the sales process by loading all sales information into the CRM system, updating information, tracking pipeline progress, identifying areas of risk and opportunity and implementing appropriate ac
descriptionByLocale.de: Roche - Job Beschreibung Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Die Chance Roche Diagnostics sucht einen Key Account Manager (Histology & Sequencing), der vorzugsweise im Westkap mit kommerziellen Erfahrungen in der Diagnostischen / Medizinischen Industrie basiert. Die Rolle wird die Entwicklung von Konto- und Portfoliostrategien, die Identifizierung und Sicherung von Vertriebsmöglichkeiten, die Zusammenarbeit mit den wichtigsten Entscheidungsträgern der Geschäftsleitung bei Kunden zur Steigerung des Marktanteils von Roche beinhalten. Während der Schwerpunkt auf dem Westkap liegt, wird die Rolle Reise in andere Provinzen beinhalten. Die wichtigsten Herausforderungen Stakeholder Engagement und Management - Um Kundenbeziehungen durch die Teilnahme an Roche- und Branchenveranstaltungen aufzubauen, Entscheidungsträger zu identifizieren und zu engagieren, Markttrends zu verstehen und nach Bedarf Feedback und Input zu liefern - Erstellung und Aufrechterhaltung des Kundenkontos durch Identifizierung von Interessenvertretern, Erstellung eines Profils auf den formellen und informellen Entscheidungsträgern und Erstellung eines Organogramms des Kontos nach Bedarf - Ermittlung der Verkaufsdatentrends auf Portfolioebene durch Extraktion der Verkaufsdaten, Analyse, Identifizierung von Trends und Abweichungen und Einbeziehung dieser Informationen und Bereitstellung von Gründen monatlich - Verständnis der Kundenbedürfnisse und Wünsche - effektive interne Beziehungen zu pflegen, indem sie relevante Individuen und Abteilungen einbeziehen, die Ausrichtung und Mobilisierung auf Key-Account- und Portfoliostrategien beeinflussen, Informationen und Feedback bereitstellen und alle erforderlichen Abfragen ansprechen - Um relevante Produkt-, Branchen- und Branchenkenntnisse zu erhalten, indem sie mit den Marktteilnehmern zusammenarbeiten, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Wettbewerber und Kunden, die Analyse von Informationen und Aktivitäten, die Identifizierung von Problemen und Trends und die Bereitstellung von Rückmeldungen für die betreffenden Personen oder Abteilungen nach Bedarf Kontoverwaltung - Um die Konto- und Portfoliostrategie durch das Verständnis der Kundenanforderungen zu implementieren, mit Marketing zusammenzuarbeiten, Strategien in Marktsegmenten umzusetzen und neue Kunden zu sichern und/oder den Footprint in bestehenden Kunden nach Bedarf zu erweitern - Um Vertriebschancen zu identifizieren, indem sie sich mit den Kunden beschäftigen, um neue Produkte oder Möglichkeiten zu verstehen, die Möglichkeit zu analysieren, Vorschläge zu entwickeln und den Kunden monatlich und nach Bedarf zu präsentieren - Um Kampagnen zu implementieren, indem Sie sich mit Product Managers engagieren, mit Kunden und laufenden Kampagnen-Events wie erforderlich einbinden - Um auf verkaufsrelevante Fragen zu reagieren, indem Sie das Problem verstehen, das passende Feedback ausgeben und den Kunden nach Bedarf Feedback geben - Bericht über die Verkaufsleistung durch das Verständnis von KPIs, Analyse von Verkaufsdaten täglich, Identifizierung von Trends und Mustern, Feedback zu Leistung, Überwachung und Erzielung von Rentabilität und Erstellung von Berichten monatlich und nach Bedarf - Um Verkaufsziele durch die Verwaltung von Verkaufsmöglichkeiten zu erreichen, das Laden auf das CRM-System, das Mitnehmen mit Kunden, die Vorbereitung und Präsentation von Vorschlägen, die Sicherung von Angeboten, die Überwachung der Kundenzufriedenheit bei der Umsetzung, die Identifizierung von Risiken und die Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmen täglich - Verwalten des Verkaufsvorgangs durch Verladen aller Verkaufsinformationen in das CRM-System, Aktualisierung von Informationen, Verfolgung von Pipeline-Fortschritten, Identifizierung von Risiko- und Gelegenheitsbereichen und Umsetzung geeigneter Maßnahmen
descriptionByLocale.fr: Roche - Description du travail Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. L'opportunité Roche Diagnostics est à la recherche d'un responsable de compte clé (Histologie et séquençage) basé de préférence dans l'ouest du Cap avec une expérience commerciale dans l'industrie diagnostique / médicale. Le rôle consistera à élaborer des stratégies de compte et de portefeuille, à identifier et à obtenir des débouchés commerciaux, à établir des relations avec les principaux décideurs de la clientèle afin d'accroître la part de marché de Roche. Bien que l'accent soit mis sur le cap ouest, le rôle consistera à se rendre dans d'autres provinces. Principaux défis Engagement et gestion des intervenants - Établir des relations avec la clientèle en participant aux événements de Roche et de l'industrie, en identifiant les décideurs et en les engageant avec eux, en comprenant les tendances du marché et en fournissant des commentaires et des commentaires au besoin - Créer et maintenir la cartographie des comptes clients en identifiant les parties prenantes, en établissant un profil des décideurs officiels et informels et en créant un organigramme du compte au besoin - Déterminer les tendances des ventes au niveau du portefeuille en extrayant les données sur les ventes, en procédant à l'analyse, en identifiant les tendances et les écarts et en s'engageant avec ces informations et en fournissant des raisons mensuelles - Comprendre les besoins et les désirs du client - Maintenir des relations internes efficaces en s'engageant avec les personnes et les départements concernés, en influençant l'alignement et la mobilisation vers les principales stratégies de comptabilité et de portefeuille, en fournissant des informations et des commentaires et en répondant aux demandes de renseignements, au besoin - Maintenir les connaissances pertinentes en matière de produits, d'industries et de secteurs en s'engageant avec les acteurs du marché, notamment les concurrents et les clients, en analysant l'information et les activités, en identifiant les problèmes et les tendances et en fournissant des commentaires aux personnes ou aux ministères concernés au besoin Gestion des comptes - Mettre en œuvre la stratégie de compte et de portefeuille en comprenant les besoins des clients, en collaborant avec le marketing, en mettant en œuvre des stratégies dans les segments de marché et en obtenant de nouveaux clients et/ou en élargissant l'empreinte des clients existants au besoin - Identifier les opportunités de vente en s'engageant avec les clients pour comprendre les nouveaux produits ou opportunités, en analysant les opportunités, en développant des propositions et en présentant aux clients chaque mois et selon les besoins - Mettre en œuvre des campagnes en s'engageant avec les responsables de produits, en s'engageant avec les clients et en organisant des manifestations de campagne au besoin - Répondre aux questions relatives aux ventes en comprenant le problème, en obtenant les commentaires appropriés et en fournissant les commentaires aux clients au besoin - Faire rapport sur les résultats des ventes en comprenant les KPI, en analysant les données sur les ventes chaque jour, en identifiant les tendances et les tendances, en fournissant une rétroaction sur les résultats, en surveillant et en réalisant la rentabilité et en rédigeant des rapports mensuels et au besoin - Pour atteindre les objectifs de vente en gérant les opportunités de vente, en chargeant sur le système CRM, en engageant les clients, en préparant et en présentant des propositions, en obtenant des offres, en surveillant la satisfaction des clients dans la mise en œuvre, en identifiant les risques et en mettant en œuvre des mesures correctives quotidiennement - Administrer le processus de vente en chargeant toutes les informations sur les ventes dans le système CRM, en mettant à jour les informations, en suivant les progrès des pipelines, en identifiant les risques et les possibilités et en mettant en œuvre les mesures appropriées

jobs.title: (Sr.) Data Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The (Sr.) Data Expert is responsible for advancing the ASPIRE/S4 master data framework while driving data quality, consistency, and security. This role will spearhead Commercial Master Data Governance, including defining governance rules for the Data Competence Center and the Tagging Ecosystem. Furthermore, the role leads the Master Data Governance Community. By translating business strategies into data rules, managing the tag lifecycle, and empowering Business Data Owners (BDOs) through community leadership, the expert will enable precise omnichannel engagement and data-driven decision-making. This position requires strong governance expertise, analytical skills, and cross-functional leadership.

Key Responsibilities
Master Data Governance Architecting

• Fully implement ASPIRE/S4 Master Data governance in alignment with global standards to support decision-making within Roche's Digital Backbone.

• Define and harmonize Commercial Data Governance rules with master data community to ensure architectural consistency with the Data Capability Center to achieve a Single Source of Truth.

• Standardize end-to-end lifecycle management for master data to ensure cross-system consistency and regulatory compliance.

• Conduct upstream and downstream lineage analysis for master data across systems, monitor data quality, and drive continuous improvement.

Mater Data Community Leadership and Organization

• Lead and facilitate the Master Data Community to foster a cross-functional, data-driven culture.

• Act as the core liaison across strategic, tactical, and operational layers to ensure the implementation of the Master Data Management Policy.

• Continuously upskill BDOs through practical capability-building initiatives.

• Project Management: Lead data governance/analytical governance and other relevant projects by applying professional methodologies (e.g., BPM, Lean, Six Sigma, or PMP).

• Benchmarking: Serve as a liaison to the global master data team and benchmark pharmaceutical industry practices to support future corporate needs.

• Stakeholder Influence: Influence stakeholders to adopt new approaches and data-centric mindsets.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree above preferred

• Pharma industry experience preferred

• 3-5 years’ experience in data management, system development or relevant experience

• 1-3 years’ experience in process, project management and digital transformation experience

• Professions in Process management, Data Governance , Project management and lean methodologies

• Strong data analysis and problem-solving skills.

• Strong stakeholder management and ability to influence others and achieve results in complex environments.

• Business acumen and solid business knowledge in pharma industry

• DAMA, PMP and Six Sigma certificate will be a plus

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• 2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范
• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验

• ● 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• ● 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)
• ● 既往有销售/市场/医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
• 教育程度/所获资格证书

Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Soluzione Architettura Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead
titleByLocale.en: Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead
titleByLocale.de: Lösung Architektur Praxis Lead & Architektur Community Lead
titleByLocale.fr: Solution Architecture Pratique Responsable et Architecture Responsable communautaire

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead

As the Enterprise Architect - Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead, you will be the principal orchestrator of our global Architecture Community. You will bridge the gap between high-level strategy and practical execution, ensuring our architectural practices are co-created with the very teams that bring them to life. Join us in transforming architecture into a dynamic catalyst for global delivery and innovation.

Description of the area
The Enterprise Architecture Foundations team acts as the backbone of the architecture function, focusing on Community, Ways of Working, and Enablement. We define Enterprise and Solution Architecture practices, oversee our integrated toolchain (including ArchiMEDES/SAP LeanIX, ITONICS, and our AI Architecture Co-Pilot), and build organizational capability through learning curriculums and the Tech University. Our goal is to connect architects across a federated organization, empowering them to design sustainable technology solutions through shared principles and active community engagement.

The Opportunity:

• Lead the continuous maturation of Solution Architecture practices to adapt to evolving business needs and agile delivery models.

• Drive the transition from static documentation to dynamic solution modeling by leveraging our ArchiMEDES platform.

• Design and host global engagement forums, workshops, and community events to foster knowledge sharing and collaboration.

• Serve as the principal facilitator for the Architecture Community, inspiring a shared sense of identity across our global network.

• Partner with federated delivery teams to co-create standards that reduce friction and accelerate high-quality product delivery.

• Collaborate with Tech University to develop learning curriculums and upskill the community on modern solution design.

• Own and evolve the Solution Architect Onboarding Kit to ensure a seamless entry for new joiners into our culture and tools.

• Champion a data-driven approach to architecture, promoting the use of integrated toolchains to support transparent decision-making.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with professional background in solution or enterprise architecture within complex organizations.

• You possess applied experience as a Solution Architect, demonstrating a deep understanding of the practical realities of technology delivery.

• You offer comprehensive expertise in solution architecture methodologies and modern digital platforms like Cloud, Data, and AI.

• You are proficient with architecture modeling platforms (e.g., SAP LeanIX) and can translate enterprise principles into actionable designs.

• You have a proven track record in cultivating, motivating, and facilitating vibrant and active communities of practice.

• You demonstrate a co-creation mindset, viewing practice development as a shared journey rather than a top-down mandate.

• You are a master of influencing and storytelling, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders through empathy and clear communication.

What you get:

• Salary range 23 300 - 43 300 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subs

descriptionByLocale.it: Mansioni Soluzione Architettura Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead Descrizione del ruolo Come Enterprise Architect - Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead, sarai il principale orchestratore della nostra comunità globale di architettura. Ponteggerai il potenziale tra la strategia di alto livello e l'esecuzione pratica, assicurandoti che le nostre pratiche di architettura siano co-create con i team che le rendono vive. Unisciti a noi per trasformare l'architettura in un catalizzatore dinamico per la consegna globale e l'innovazione. Descrizione dell'area Il team di Enterprise Architecture Foundations agiscono la spina dorsale della funzione di architettura, concentrandosi sulla Comunità, i Modi di Lavorare e l'Enablement. Definiamo le pratiche di Enterprise e Solution Architecture, sovrintendiamo alla nostra catena di strumenti integrati (compresi ArchiMEDES/SAP LeanIX, ITONICS e il nostro AI Architecture Co-Pilot) e costruiamo la capacità organizzativa attraverso i curricula di apprendimento e la Tech University. Il nostro obiettivo è connettere gli architetti in un'organizzazione federata, empowermentli a progettare soluzioni tecnologiche sostenibili attraverso principi condivisi e l'impegno della comunità. Opportunità - Guidare la maturazione continua delle pratiche di Solution Architecture per adattarsi alle esigenze aziendali in evoluzione e ai modelli di consegna agile. - Guidare la transizione dalla documentazione statica al modello di soluzione provvisoria utilizzando la nostra piattaforma ArchiMEDES. - Progettare e ospitare forum di impegno globale, workshop e eventi organizzati per favorire la condivisione delle conoscenze e la collaborazione. - Fare da facilitatore principale per la comunità di architettura, ispirando un senso di identità condiviso nella nostra rete globale. - Collaborare con i team di consegna federati per co-creare gli standard che servono gli attriti e accelerano la consegna dei prodotti di alta qualità. - Collaborare con la Tech University per sviluppare i curricula di apprendimento e aggiornare la comunità sulle moderne progettazioni di soluzione. - Possedere e evolvere il Kit di Onboarding del Solution Architect per garantire un ingresso fluido per i nuovi arrivati nella nostra cultura e negli strumenti. - Promuovere un approccio basato sui dati all'architettura, promuovendo l'uso delle catene di strumenti si integrano per supportare le decisioni trasparenti. Chi sei? - Hai un Bachelor's o Master's Degree con un'esperienza professionale in soluzione o enterprise architecture all'interno di organizzazioni complesse. - Offri un'esperienza applicata come Solution Architect, dimostrando una profonda comprensione delle realtà pratiche della consegna tecnologica. - Offri un'esperienza completa nelle metodologie di soluzione architecture e nelle piattaforme digitali moderne come Cloud, Data e AI. - Sei esperto nelle piattaforme di modellazione dell'architettura (ad esempio SAP LeanIX) e puoi tradurre i principi aziendali in pianificazione azionabili. - Hai un'esperienza comprovata nella coltivazione, motivazione e facilitazione di comunità di pratica attive e vivaci. - Dimostri un mindset di co-creazione, vedendo lo sviluppo delle pratiche come un viaggio condiviso piuttosto che un mandato dall'alto. - Sei un maestro dell'influenza e della narrazione, con la capacità di discernere i senior stakeholder attraverso l'empatia e la comunicazione chiara. Cosa? - Gamma salariale 23 300 - 43 300 PLN lordi basati sul contratto di lavoro. - Bonus annuale basato sulla tua performance. - Budget di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati, ecc.). - Venerdì di ricarica (2 venerdì liberi per trimestre disponibili). - Programma di congedo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Congedo vacanza

jobs.title: Zonal Manager - Molecular Lab (Bhubaneswar)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position - Zonal Manager - Molecular Lab

Your Opportunity

In this role you will be responsible for total account management and selling the full Molecular portfolio. You will have the responsibility to drive molecular business in Bhubaneswar and the states of Odisha, Bihar, and Jharkhand . Understanding of the market and also willingness to travel for better penetration in the given territory will be required. You will manage channel partners. Exposure of working with Molecular segment would be added preference. As part of the Roche Molecular portfolio you will also be positioning IT solutions that will connect instruments across the continuum of care in both inpatient and outpatient settings. This position requires conducting presentations and business reviews to potential customers thereby demonstrating in-depth knowledge of our product line, as well as relevant healthcare/industry trends including related products or services.

Role Responsibilities:

• Generates new customer demand and expansion for Molecular products.

• Penetrates large, complex accounts to gain access to and favor with all buying influences and key decision makers.

• Demonstrates strong clinical and financial acuity with ability to listen and understand customer needs and align Roche Molecular products within segment.

• Translates customers’ defined business/technical and personal goals into internal action while balancing key business priorities and goals.

• Balances the need to advocate for customers while also demonstrating the drive and ability to negotiate and achieve strong business results for Roche.

• Develops territory-specific executional strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

• Applies competitive, customer, and product knowledge to establish competitive barriers.

• Works cross functionally with internal colleagues and peers to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

• Demonstrates strong oral and written communication skills including making impactful presentations.

• Conducts system demonstrations & presentations where applicable; Molecular Committee Meetings, Trade Shows, VIPS, etc.

Who you are

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 5+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of field sales experience in Molecular Diagnostics/ Oncology

• 5+ years of experience negotiating contracts with Integrated Health Networks

• 5+ years of experience driving revenue growth via strategic territory development

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Pharmazeutischer Assistent (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Pharma-Vision
Medikamente schnell zu den Patienten zu bringen und das beste Ergebnis für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. Das ist es, was uns in Sterile Drug Product Manufacturing (SDPM) in Mannheim antreibt. So tragen wir auch dazu bei, bis 2029 unser Ziel zu erreichen: 20 bahnbrechende Medikamente zur Behandlung der Krankheiten mit der größten gesellschaftlichen Belastung bereitzustellen. Unsere Arbeit, unser täglicher Einsatz und unser Engagement bedeuten für sehr viele große Hoffnung und Zuversicht und deswegen müssen wir anders denken und arbeiten. Mit dem Patient im Fokus setzen wir auf eine neue Organisation und zwar #WIRGEMEINSAM in SDPM! ​

Was Dich erwartet:
Als Pharmazeutischer Assistent (m/w/d) unterstützt Du die Leitung der Herstellung im Produktionsbetrieb im Rahmen der folgenden Aufgaben:

• Du stellst sicher, dass die GMP-konforme Herstellpraxis und die GMP-gerechte Dokumentation im Produktionsbetrieb eingehalten werden. Für den Chargenreview sowie konzeptionelle Erstellung der GMP-Dokumente in deutscher und englischer Sprache bist Du verantwortlich

• Du bearbeitest die Chargendokumentation (Batch Record Review) vor der Freigabe durch den Leiter der Herstellung.

• Du erstellst und bearbeitest Abweichungen, Reklamationen und Changes.

• Du erstellst und aktualisierst Arbeitsanweisungen und Vorschriften eigenständig.

• Du wirkst bei behördlichen Inspektionen mit und unterstützt bei der Umsetzung von Maßnahmen.

Wer Du bist:

• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes naturwissenschaftliches Studium (Master), idealerweise mit Approbation als Apotheker.

• Du bringst erste Erfahrungen in der Pharmaindustrie mit, zum Beispiel in den Bereichen Verpackung, aseptische Produktion, Qualitätskontrolle oder Qualitätssicherung.

• Du überzeugst mit deinen Sprachkenntnissen und deinem Ausdrucksvermögen in Deutsch und Englisch (in Wort und Schrift)

• Du besitzt ein hohes Maß an Teamfähigkeit und Verantwortungsbereitschaft

• Die Fähigkeit zu interdisziplinärem Denken, Konfliktbewältigung sowie Integrations- und Überzeugungsfähigkeit runden dein Profil ab

Diese Stelle ist befristet auf 24 Monate.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus:
https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.
Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir freuen uns!
