jobs.title: Customer Operations Agent (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du möchtest in einem dynamischen Umfeld arbeiten und aktiv dazu beitragen, unsere Servicequalität auf das nächste Level zu heben? Als Customer Operations Agent bei Roche Diagnostics übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle, um einen reibungslosen End-2-End Prozess in der Auftragsabwicklung zu gewährleisten.

Die Position ist vorerst auf 2 Jahre befristet und wird über ein Partnerunternehmen abgewickelt.

Was dich erwartet:

• Operative Auftragsabwicklung in SAP sowie Bearbeitung telefonischer und schriftlicher Kund:innenanfragen

• Selbstständige Betreuung eines zugewiesenen Kund:innenbereichs sowie Bearbeitung von Retouren, Gutschriften und Reklamationen

• Bearbeitung von Abrechnungsrückmeldungen der österreichischen Gesundheitskassen sowie Befundabrechnung im Labor- und Krankenhaussegment

• Engpassmanagement zur Sicherstellung und Optimierung der Liefertreue und enge Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Logistikteams, dem Außendienst sowie dem lokalen Material- und Produktmanagement und externen Logistikpartner:innen

• Exception Handling: Monitoring und Bearbeitung von Systemfehlern in internen und externen Anwendungen sowie Abstimmung mit relevanten Schnittstellen und Fachbereichen

• Anlage, Pflege und Aktualisierung von Kund:innenstammdaten im Patient:innenmanagement

• Unterstützung bei der Einführung, Automatisierung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Bestellmöglichkeiten in der Auftragsabwicklung

• Prozessverantwortung für definierte End-to-End-Prozesse (E2E)

Wer Du bist:

• Kaufmännische Ausbildung, FH-/Universitätsabschluss oder relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich Auftragsabwicklung und Kund:innenbetreuung

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Abteilungen sowie externen Kund:innen und Logistikpartner:innen (Deutsch C1, Englisch B2)

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen (idealerweise SAP) sowie Kenntnisse in Google Workspace, Office 365 und Salesforce von Vorteil

• Strukturierte, effiziente und selbstständige Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägtem Organisationstalent und hoher Detailgenauigkeit

• Hohe Kundenorientierung sowie eine zuverlässige und kommunikative Teamplayer-Persönlichkeit

• Analytisches Denkvermögen, Belastbarkeit und eine ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Aufgeschlossene Persönlichkeit mit lösungsorientierter und eigenverantwortlicher Arbeitsweise

Es erwartet dich ein Jahresgehalt ab € 48.000,00 brutto Vollzeit, sowie ein leistungsorientierter Bonus und attraktive Benefits. Pensionskasse, Betriebsrestaurant, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung und vielfältige Sportangebote, sind nur einige davon. Abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung besteht die Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Organisation “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, Teil der globalen Group Function “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, stellt die Infrastruktur und Services für den gesamten Standort bereit und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich und auf innovative Art weiter. Wir arbeiten mit allen Anspruchsgruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zusammen, von der frühen Forschung bis zur Versorgung der Patient:innen. Bei uns kannst du dich auf ein modernes Organisationsmodell freuen, in welchem du in Eigenverantwortung deine Talente in sinnhafter Arbeit einbringen kannst. Wir garantieren Gestaltungsspielraum und Entscheidungsfreiheit in unserer Organisation. Klassische Vorgesetzte suchst du bei uns vergebens.
Innerhalb der Organisation “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst” gestalten wir im Cluster “Business Solutions” gemeinsam mit unseren Anspruchsgruppen massgeschneiderte Lösungen.

Innerhalb der Abteilung Pharma Engineering – Qualifizierung Drug Substance (DS) am Standort Kaiseraugst betreuen wir die Erstqualifizierung von Produktionsanlagen und Systemen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld bieten wir dir die Gelegenheit, als Praktikant:in oder im Rahmen einer Bachelorarbeit aktiv an der digitalen Transformation unserer Abteilung mitzuwirken. Der Fokus liegt dabei auf der Steigerung der Effizienz und Qualität durch den Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) sowie der Standardisierung unserer Dokumentationsprozesse.

Die Möglichkeit
KI-gestützte Prozessoptimierung und Standardisierung

• KI-Integration: Du arbeitest aktiv bei der Optimierung von Qualifizierungsabläufen mit, indem Du KI Applikationen evaluierst und implementierst, um die operative Effizienz zu steigern.

• Standardisierung: Du unterstützt uns bei der Erarbeitung von Konzepten zur Vereinheitlichung von Qualifizierungstätigkeiten durch technologische Hilfsmittel.

• Innovations-Management: Du wirkst bei der Identifikation von Potenzialen mit, um manuelle Prozesse in digitale, KI-gestützte Workflows zu überführen.

Dokumentenwesen und Template-Optimierung

• Smart Documentation: Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Lösungen, um Qualifizierungsdokumente automatisiert mittels KI erstellen zu lassen.

• Lifecycle-Management: Du analysierst und optimierst bestehende Templates sowie Standarddokumente hinsichtlich Nutzerfreundlichkeit und Automatisierbarkeit.

Compliance und GxP-Standards

• Richtlinien-Einhaltung: Du hilfst dabei, die Einhaltung und Dokumentation von GxP-Richtlinien sowie internen Standards bei der Einführung neuer KI-Tools sicherzustellen. Du unterstützt uns bei der Erstellung einer lückenlosen Lifecycle-Dokumentation für die qualifizierten Systeme.

Anforderungen / Kenntnisse

• Grundverständnis für den Bereich Qualifizierung / Validierung sowie Interesse an GxP-Richtlinien.

• Affinität zu KI-Technologien und modernen Software-Tools und deren Anwendung

• Eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für den Austausch in einem interdisziplinären Team.

Wer Du bist

• Du bist aktuell immatrikulierte/r Student:in (Bachelor/Master) oder hast dein Studium in den Bereichen Life Sciences, Pharmazie, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Fachbereich innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich; gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Zusätzliche Information

• Startdatum: Nach Vereinbarung (ideal Q3 2026)

• Dauer: 6 Monate

• Im Rahmen des P

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L’organizzazione “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, parte della funzione “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, fornisce l’infrastruttura e i servizi per l’intero sito e li sviluppa continuamente e in modo innovativo. Lavoriamo con tutti gli stakeholder lungo tutta la catena del valore, dalla ricerca precoce alla cura dei pazienti. Con noi si può aspettare un modello organizzativo moderno, in cui è possibile contribuire i vostri talenti nel lavoro sensuale. Garantiamo la libertà di progettazione e di decisione nella nostra organizzazione. Stai cercando dei superiori classici. All’interno dell’organizzazione “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst” creiamo soluzioni su misura nel cluster “Business Solutions” insieme ai nostri stakeholder. All'interno del Dipartimento di Ingegneria Farmacia – Qualificazione Drug Substance (DS) presso il sito Kaiseraugst, sosteniamo la qualificazione iniziale di impianti e sistemi di produzione. In un ambiente dinamico, vi offriamo l'opportunità di partecipare attivamente alla trasformazione digitale del nostro dipartimento come stagista: in o come parte di una tesi di laurea. L'obiettivo è aumentare l'efficienza e la qualità attraverso l'uso dell'intelligenza artificiale (AI) e standardizzare i nostri processi di documentazione. La possibilità Ottimizzazione e standardizzazione dei processi basati su AI
• Integrazione dell'intelligenza artificiale: si sta lavorando attivamente per ottimizzare i processi di formazione, valutando e implementando applicazioni AI per aumentare l'efficienza operativa.
• Standardizzazione: Lei ci sostiene nello sviluppo di concetti per la standardizzazione della formazione mediante strumenti tecnologici.
• Gestione dell'innovazione: è possibile identificare i potenziali per trasferire i processi manuali ai flussi di lavoro basati su AI digitali. Documentazione e ottimizzazione dei modelli
• Smart Documentation: Supporti la concezione e l'implementazione di soluzioni per creare automaticamente documenti di qualificazione utilizzando AI.
• Gestione del ciclo di vita: analizza e ottimizza i modelli esistenti, nonché i documenti standard relativi alla facilità d'uso e all'automazione. Standard di conformità e GxP
• Conformità delle policy: l'utente aiuta a garantire la conformità e la documentazione delle politiche GxP e degli standard interni durante l'introduzione di nuovi strumenti AI. Ci supporta nella creazione di una documentazione completa del ciclo di vita per sistemi qualificati. Requisiti / conoscenza
• Comprensione di base per la qualificazione / validazione e l'interesse per le linee guida GxP.
• Affinità per tecnologie AI e strumenti software moderni e la loro applicazione
• Un modo di lavoro strutturato e indipendente
• Buone capacità di comunicazione per lo scambio in un team interdisciplinare. Chi sei
• Sei attualmente uno studente immatricato: in (Bachelor/Master) o hai completato con successo i tuoi studi nei campi delle scienze della vita, della farmacia, delle scienze ingegneristiche o di un soggetto paragonabile negli ultimi 12 mesi.
• Le competenze linguistiche tedesche nella parola e nella scrittura sono assolutamente necessarie; le buone abilità inglesi sono di vantaggio. Ulteriori informazioni
• Data di inizio: Con accordo (ideale Q3 2026)
• Durata: 6 mesi
• Sotto la P

jobs.title: Qualification Engineer/Qualifizierungsingenieur (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Pharma-Vision
Medikamente schnell zu den Patienten zu bringen und das beste Ergebnis für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. Das ist es, was uns in Sterile Drug Product Manufacturing (SDPM) in Mannheim antreibt. So tragen wir auch dazu bei, bis 2029 unser Ziel zu erreichen: 20 bahnbrechende Medikamente zur Behandlung der Krankheiten mit der größten gesellschaftlichen Belastung bereitzustellen. Unsere Arbeit, unser täglicher Einsatz und unser Engagement bedeuten für sehr viele Menschen große Hoffnung und Zuversicht und deswegen müssen wir anders denken und arbeiten. Mit dem Patient im Fokus setzen wir auf eine neue Organisation und zwar #WIRGEMEINSAM in SDPM! ​

Was Dich erwartet:

Als Qualification Engineer/Qualifizierungsingenieur (m/w/d) bist Du Teil des Teams MSAT und sorgst gemeinsam mit den Kollegen*innen dafür, dass unsere pharmazeutischen Anlagen reibungslos laufen und alle gesetzlichen und GMP -Vorgaben eingehalten werden. Werde Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur die Einhaltung höchster Standards sicherstellt, sondern auch aktiv eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, des Lean Managements und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung
(#WIRGEMEINSAM) vorlebt.

Darüber hinaus übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Du erstellst selbstständig und verantwortest Qualifizierungs- und
Requalifizierungsdokumente wie Pläne, Berichte und Risikoanalysen für Produktionsanlagen und Equipment anhand der geltenden Anforderungen, regulatorischen Vorgaben und Validierung skonzepten.

• Du vertrittst deine Arbeit souverän bei internen und externen Inspektionen und Audits gegenüber Behörden wie der EMA und FDA.

• Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung von Qualifizierungskonzepten hin zu einer kontinuierlichen, datenbasierten Qualifizierung, um die Effizienz zu steigern.

• Du steuerst, beauftragst und kontrollierst externe Dienstleister und interne Schnittstellenabteilungen effizient.

• Du tauschst dich proaktiv mit anderen Standorten aus, um das Fachgebiet weiterzuentwickeln und Best Practices zu etablieren.

Wer Du bist:

• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (Bachelor, Master) in Pharmatechnik, Biotechnologie , Verfahrenstechnik oder eine einschlägige Berufsausbildung mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung.

• Du hast ausgeprägte Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Industrie, insbesondere im Bereich der Sterilproduktion und Qualifizierung.

• Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse der pharmazeutischen Herstellungsverfahren und Technologien sowie der GMP , EU und FDA Richtlinien und relevanten Arzneibüchern.

• Du überzeugst mit deinen fließenden Sprachkenntnissen und deinem Ausdrucksvermögen in Deutsch und Englisch (in Wort und Schrift).

• Du besitzt ein hohes Maß an Teamfähigkeit und Verantwortungsbereitschaft.

• Die Fähigkeit zu interdisziplinärem Denken, Konfliktbewältigung sowie Integrations- und Überzeugungsfähigkeit runden dein Profil ab.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus:
https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend

jobs.title: 实习医药信息顾问
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （1 ）在校大学生
• （2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4 ）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力
• tag #LI-DNI

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: ERP Solution Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The ERP Solution Architect designs business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready E2E solutions that involve, but go beyond ERP. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements and evolving the architecture throughout the product life cycle. By solving complex technical problems, defining reference architectures, and aligning with the broader architecture community for governance, you will ensure robust implementations that deliver enhanced value to the organization.
Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope: Primary point of contact on all matters concerning mediation and digital product provisioning. Designs solutions that meet requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR). Documents and evolves the architecture and ensures alignment with RDT architecture and governance.

• Accountability: Solves complex problems, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the assigned solution. Assesses and consults on impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Owns all technical matters related to usage mediation and the provisioning of digital products in accordance to defined commercial models

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive technical information and works collaboratively to build consensus among product teams, business stakeholders, and technical peers. Drive all discussions with digital product teams to ensure adoption of commercial backoffice standards and processes

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation for digital product teams. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies.

• Business / Technical ability: Brings technical expertise together with strong business understanding to lead the integration of digital product teams with commercial backoffice products

• Support and operations: Supports the operational processes by analyzing end to end production issues and ensuring accurate and timely corrective actions.

Qualifications

• Possess a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field.

• Extensive experience with System Integration Technologies and common Integration Design Pattern (MuleSoft and CPI preferred).

• Knowledge of Convergent mediation (by digital Route)

• Ability to work effectively in a complex, integrated system landscape.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Proficient in using API tools like Postman/Bruno.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support, design or write functional specifications to ensure correct implementation of end to end / cross application features

• Use your expertise in Agile methods like SAFe and Scrum, along with excellent interpersonal skills, to work seamlessly with local, nearshore and offshore teams.

Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing and implementing business-driven, standards-based solutions within an ERP environment.

• Proven track record of maintaining

jobs.title: PostDoc Position in Bioorganic Chemistry (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you interested in developing novel reagents and workflows for next generation sequencing?
We are looking for a highly talented and motivated postdoctoral fellow (m/f/d) to join our team on
this mission.

The Chemistry Technologies department provides the full spectrum of chemical diagnostic
reagents, ranging from small molecules to biooligomers and polymers. Leveraging modern
synthetic and analytical methods we design and develop tailor-made molecules to find the right
solutions for diagnostic questions and beyond. We work as a team, are driven by passion for
science and commitment to continuous learning to stay at the forefront of research.

Our culture is defined by trust, transparency, and a strong collaborative spirit. We are looking for
a proactive colleague who balances independent critical thinking with team spirit and the
flexibility to collaborate across diverse departments and interdisciplinary teams.

Your tasks

• Design and synthesize complex oligonucleotide-conjugates by contemporary bioconjugation techniques and small molecular entities by chemical synthesis

• Establish DNA templated proximity reactions for initial testing of your new reagent classes

• Collaborate proactively with project partners from biology, analytics and the sequencing test development teams to gain a deep insight into the relationship of structural design and assay performance

• Independently plan, execute and analyze experiments to effectively advance the projects

• Present scientific progress through internal meetings and visit scientific conferences to ensure the state-of-the-art knowledge in the field of bioorganic synthesis, chemical biology and surface chemistry

• Be part of a highly motivated and cross-functional team

Your profile

• You hold a PhD in the field of (bio)organic chemistry, chemical biology or life science.

• You possess profound knowledge in the synthesis of oligonucleotide-conjugates, preferably in context of biomolecules (proteins, peptides, nucleic acids)

• You are well experienced in organic synthesis

• Hands-on experience in the field of DNA-templated reactions, proximity reactions and nucleic acid detection completes your profile.

• Your qualification should be clearly demonstrated by at least one first author paper published or accepted in a high impact journal.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are your strength. You are sensitive to intercultural and interdisciplinary matters - working in a team comes natural to you.

• You are a proactive individual with passion and commitment to innovate healthcare through our Roche Diagnostics Postdoc Program.

• Excellent English skills are required, German is not mandatory.

When does it start?
This position will be filled with effect Septmber 2026 and is limited to 2 years.

Have we aroused your interest?
# If we are convinced, a virtual interview will take place
# If you also manage to convince us here, the last step is an interview and presentation in the
Penzberg area

Your application
Please submit your application by sending an updated CV (including publication list and
references) together with your latest certificates. Before sending your application, please note
that no further documents can be added subsequently.

We are looking forward to your application!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Developing enzymes for Roche internally as well as externally means for us the development of tailor-made biocatalysts and biological targets for creating the best-in-class molecules for Roche and our clients. Combining several biotechnological methods such as expression profiling, cell cultivation, enzyme purification portfolio, enzyme engineering and biochemical investigations, we always try to improve, to maintain or to design new enzymes. Mandatory, the complete value chain as a platform thought of Roche is given. We are working cross-functional for both the diagnostic and pharma division of Roche worldwide. Being an R&D function we always try to keep close contacts with our clients as with our production for ensuring a fast, but qualitatively high development which should result in functional Roche products finally. As a Post-Doc Position in Novel Enzymes (m/f/d) , you actively shape the development of new enzymes using biotechnological and bioinformatic methods. Become part of an innovative research team that consolidates a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab to develop customized enzymes for our diagnostics. We offer you a unique opportunity to translate your scientific ideas into practice and thus contribute to the improvement of patient health. The opportunity
• You ensure the development of new enzymes using a combination of biotechnological and bioinformatic methods
• You are responsible for the independent production of tailored proteins/enzymes using molecular biological methods or the establishment of new production and screening methods for protein variants
• You support the consolidation of a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab, suitable for the protein engineering of novel enzymes
• You implement new biochemical and biophysical readouts suitable for the screening and development of tailored enzymes
• You pursue scientific and technical education by continuously following and reading the relevant scientific literature Who you are
• You possess a university degree (Dr. / Ph.D.) in a relevant field
• You have specialized knowledge in the areas of protein engineering, bioinformatics, and molecular biology
• Experience in microbiology, downstream and upstream processing, as well as chemistry, is an advantage
• You demonstrate knowledge and expertise in recombinant protein expression, protein purification, and the development of protein analytical methods for protein characterization
• You are willing to provide consultation and troubleshooting regarding enzyme challenges in Research & Development and Production This position is limited to 2 years. Application documents To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only a motivation letter and your updated CV . References and certificates are not required at this stage. We look forward to receiving your application! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver

titleByLocale.it: Gruppo Lead Device Process Engineering - Global MSAT
titleByLocale.en: Group Lead Device Process Engineering - Global MSAT
titleByLocale.fr: Ingénierie des procédés de l'appareil principal de groupe - Global MSAT

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Global MSAT & Engineering function is undergoing a strategic modernization initiative to introduce innovative, efficient, and sustainable manufacturing technologies across our global device manufacturing footprint. As the Group Lead for Device Process Engineering, you will be the architect of our technical talent and process excellence. This is a dual-impact leadership role: you will serve as a senior technical authority for our most complex device programs and lead a world-class chapter of Process Engineers, ensuring they have the skills, tools, and standardized methodologies to deliver next-generation medical devices and drug-device combination products to patients worldwide.

The Opportunity

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of process engineers, setting clear expectations for technical excellence and functional capability.

• Define and drive the global process-engineering strategy for device and combination product assembly, packaging, and sterilization across the entire product lifecycle.

• Act as the senior technical authority for complex engineering decisions, balancing quality, compliance, supply, and speed-to-market.

• Drive structured process characterization using DOE and statistical tools to define operating windows and ensure process understanding.

• Establish methodologies for identifying critical process parameters (CPPs) and material attributes to ensure robust control strategies.

• Own design transfer activities, translating design outputs into production specifications, equipment requirements, and manufacturing work instructions.

• Define and govern risk-based validation strategies for manufacturing processes, equipment qualification, and sterilization.

• Manage the process-engineering framework for continued process verification, investigation support, and lifecycle optimization.

• Ensure all engineering practices comply with global regulatory requirements, including FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, and EU MDR.

Who you are
You are a strategic and technically credible leader who moves fluently between executive decision-making and deep engineering problem-solving. You have the ability to explain complex validation decisions to diverse audiences, translating technical risks into clear business impacts. You are a dedicated coach and talent developer who sets high standards for technical rigor while empowering your team to act. As an effective communicator and resilient collaborator, you build trust across matrixed organizations and remain focused on shared objectives even during periods of ambiguity or change.

Further you have the following qualifications and experiences:

• Degree (B.S., M.S., or Ph.D.) in Mechanical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 12-15+ years of experience in process engineering or technical operations within regulated medical device or pharma environments.

• Proven track record in formal people leadership and influencing across a matrixed global organization.

• Deep expertise in device assembly, packaging, sterilization, and automated manufacturing from development to commercial scale.

• Strong knowledge of design controls, risk management (ISO 14971), DfM, and technical transfer processes.

• Experience working with global external manufacturing partners and supplier networks.

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Who we are
A healthier future drives u

descriptionByLocale.it: Roche - Opportunità di lavoro Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Mansioni La funzione Global MSAT & Engineering sta subendo un'iniziativa di modernizzazione strategica per introdurre tecnologie di produzione innovative, efficienti e sostenibili attraverso la nostra impronta globale di produzione di dispositivi. In qualità di Gruppo Lead for Device Process Engineering, sarai l'architetto del nostro talento tecnico e dell'eccellenza del processo. Questo è un ruolo di leadership dual-impact: servirai come autorità tecnica senior per i nostri programmi di dispositivo più complessi e condurre un capitolo di livello mondiale di ingegneri di processo, assicurando loro di avere le competenze, gli strumenti e metodologie standardizzate per fornire dispositivi medici di prossima generazione e prodotti combinati droga-dispositivi a pazienti in tutto il mondo. Opportunità - Lead, coach e sviluppare un team di ingegneri di processo altamente performanti, ponendo chiare aspettative per l'eccellenza tecnica e la funzionalità. - Definire e guidare la strategia globale di ingegneria del processo per l'assemblaggio, l'imballaggio e la sterilizzazione del prodotto di dispositivo e combinazione in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. - Agire come autorità tecnica senior per decisioni di ingegneria complesse, bilanciare la qualità, la conformità, la fornitura e la velocità di mercato. - Guidare la caratterizzazione del processo strutturato utilizzando DOE e strumenti statistici per definire le finestre operative e garantire la comprensione del processo. - Stabilire metodologie per identificare i parametri di processo critici (CPP) e gli attributi materiali per garantire strategie di controllo robuste. - Attività di trasferimento di progettazione proprie, traducendo uscite di progettazione in specifiche di produzione, requisiti di attrezzature e istruzioni di lavoro di fabbricazione. - Definire e governare strategie di validazione basate sui rischi per processi di produzione, qualificazione delle attrezzature e sterilizzazione. - Gestire il quadro di ingegneria del processo per la verifica continua del processo, il supporto di indagine e l'ottimizzazione del ciclo di vita. - Assicurarsi che tutte le pratiche ingegneristiche siano conformi ai requisiti normativi globali, tra cui FDA QMSR, ISO 13485 e EU MDR. Chi sei? Sei un leader strategico e tecnicamente credibile che si muove fluentemente tra il processo decisionale esecutivo e la risoluzione dei problemi di ingegneria profonda. Hai la capacità di spiegare complesse decisioni di validazione a diversi pubblico, traducendo i rischi tecnici in chiari impatti aziendali. Sei un allenatore dedicato e sviluppatore di talenti che stabilisce standard elevati per il rigore tecnico, consentendo al tuo team di agire. Come un efficace comunicatore e collaboratore resiliente, si costruisce fiducia tra le organizzazioni matrici e si concentrano su obiettivi condivisi anche durante i periodi di ambiguità o cambiamento. Inoltre, hai le seguenti qualifiche ed esperienze: - Laurea (B.S., M.S. o Ph.D.) in Ingegneria Meccanica, Ingegneria Farmaceutica, o un campo tecnico correlato. - 12-15 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria dei processi o nelle operazioni tecniche all'interno di dispositivi medici regolamentati o in ambienti farmaci. - Provato record di traccia nella leadership delle persone formali e influenzando attraverso un'organizzazione globale matrice. - Profonda competenza nel montaggio, imballaggio, sterilizzazione e produzione automatizzata da sviluppo a scala commerciale. - Forte conoscenza dei controlli di progettazione, gestione dei rischi (ISO 14971), DfM e processi di trasferimento tecnico. - Esperienza di lavoro con partner di produzione esterni globali e reti di fornitori. Contatto Sei pronto a fare la differenza per i nostri pazienti? Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione – unisciti a noi ora e diventi parte del nostro viaggio! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci guida.

jobs.title: Public Key Infrastructure - Junior Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At the heart of our digital security is the trust we build through encrypted communication. As a PKI Engineer, you will join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team to help manage the core certificate infrastructure. You’ll be instrumental in ensuring that our digital certificates are issued, tracked, and renewed without a hitch. This is a growth-oriented role where you will learn to navigate complex security infrastructures while contributing to the automation of high-volume security tasks.

Job Responsibilities

Scope

• Support the day-to-day administration of Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), including basic template management and standard troubleshooting.

• Use Keyfactor Command to monitor certificate health, identify expiring assets, and assist in bringing untracked certificates into compliance.

• Support the deployment of ACME clients (like Certbot) for automated certificate issuance across web server environments.

• Participate in the automation of routine certificate tasks using Version Control systems and scripting as required (PowerShell or Python).

• Collaborate with senior engineers to orchestrate certificate distribution to load balancers, firewalls, and application servers.

Impact/Strategy

• Collaborate in the automation of routine certificate tasks using basic scripting (PowerShell or Python) and maintain scripts using version control systems.

• Assist in maintaining team internal wikis, standard operating procedures, and runbooks for certificate lifecycle management.

• Collaborate with senior engineers to route, distribute, and install certificates to load balancers, firewalls, and application servers .

​
Complexity

• Focuses primarily on executing defined procedures, troubleshooting routine issues, and escalating complex anomalies to senior team members.

• Contributes to team agility by identifying operational inefficiencies and proposing minor process improvements within immediate daily tasks.

• Demonstrates growing autonomy within the specific domain by translating daily requirements into structured tasks under direct supervision.

​
Business/Technical ability

• Possesses a working knowledge of the relevant business domain and supporting technologies

• Understands sources of influence, comprehending internal and external factors affecting the problem space, and is capable of identifying and analyzing basic business problems or opportunities holistically

​
Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Experience: 1–2 years of experience in an IT Helpdesk, Systems Administration, or junior Security Operations (SOC) role. An internship focused on infrastructure or security is highly valued.

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, or equivalent practical experience.

• Working knowledge of relevant business domains and supporting cybersecurity technologies

• Demonstrated ability to independently handle defined tasks and contribute to various stages of the security and business analysis lifecycle

​
Technical Skills

• Understanding of Zero Trust principles, authentication factors and cryptography.

• A solid understanding of cryptography basics (Symmetric vs. Asymmetric, Hashing, Digital Signatures).

• Experience with Windows Server and Active Directory. Exposure to web servers like IIS, Apache, or Nginx. Comfortable using Git for basic file management and collaboration.

• Knowledge of the ACME protocol or experience using tools like Certbot.

• Familiarity with PowerShell o

jobs.title: Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste de la stratégie et de l'analyse des données

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is based in the Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS) team which drives data excellence and analytics to power enhanced decision-making and evidence-generation within Roche Product Development. We develop and implement data strategies that unlock the value of clinical, operational, and real-world data to accelerate evidence generation, decision-making, and innovation across PD and beyond. By embedding FAIR principles, advancing data governance, and enabling data productization, RWCDS ensures that data is not only findable and usable, but also a driver of scientific rigor, regulatory readiness, and AI-powered transformation. Through deep partnerships with internal functions and external collaborators, we shape a future-ready data ecosystem that supports personalized healthcare and efficient drug development.

The Opportunity:

The Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist contributes to the design and execution of data strategies and analyses that enable decision-making and insight generation across a therapeutic area or molecule portfolio. Working under the Data Strategy & Analytics Lead, you will partner with cross-functional teams to align data strategy with clinical and translational goals, identify key data assets, and support the delivery of integrated evidence plans. You will also contribute to the translation of scientific and business needs into analytical frameworks and data-driven solutions. This role demands a strong foundation in data science, analytics planning and execution, and an ability to bridge scientific questions with practical data solutions.

• You assist in documenting data strategies and requirements for programs and therapeutic areas

• You support data integration and harmonization efforts by applying templates and standard protocols

• You contribute to analytic execution for use cases leveraging multi-modal data sources across real-world, clinical, and operational domains

• You contribute to mapping exercises and data lineage documentation to support reuse and data quality

• You analyze data structure and support the standardization of terminology and metadata

• You collaborate with team members and internal partners to maintain structured and accessible data assets

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Informatics, Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field

• You have a strong background in real-world data (RWD)

• You have 2+ years of experience working with structured data in a research or healthcare setting ( excluding internships)

• You have basic knowledge of R or Python

• You understand data dictionaries, mappings, or metadata tagging

• You are familiar with data systems used in clinical or operational settings

• You demonstrate capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles

• You exhibit excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond the technical domain

• You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace

• You possess excellent verbal and written communication skills, specifically in the areas of presentation and writing, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear language

Preferred Qualifications:

• Exposure to healthcare data models or clinical trial datasets

• Experience working in a matrixed or agile team environment

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo ruolo si basa sul team Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS) che guida l'eccellenza dei dati e l'analisi per potenziare il processo decisionale e la generazione delle prove all'interno di Roche Product Development. Sviluppiamo e implementiamo strategie di dati che sbloccano il valore dei dati clinici, operativi e reali per accelerare la generazione delle prove, il processo decisionale e l'innovazione in PD e oltre. Integrando i principi FAIR, promuovendo la governance dei dati e consentendo la produzione dei dati, RWCDS assicura che i dati non siano solo reperibili e utilizzabili, ma anche un driver di rigore scientifico, di prontezza regolamentare e di trasformazione AI-powered. Attraverso partnership profonde con funzioni interne e collaboratori esterni, forniamo un ecosistema di dati pronto per il futuro che supporta la salute personalizzata e lo sviluppo efficiente della droga. L'opportunità: Il Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist contribuisce alla progettazione e all'esecuzione delle strategie e delle analisi dei dati che consentono la creazione di decisioni e approfondimenti in un'area terapeutica o in un portafoglio di molecole. Lavorando nell'ambito di Data Strategy & Analytics Lead, collaborerai con team interfunzionali per allineare la strategia dei dati con obiettivi clinici e traduttivi, identificare le risorse di dati chiave e supportare la fornitura di piani di prova integrati. Contribuirai anche alla traduzione delle esigenze scientifiche e aziendali in ambiti analitici e soluzioni basate sui dati. Questo ruolo richiede una solida base nella scienza dei dati, nella pianificazione e nell'esecuzione di analisi, e una capacità di colmare le domande scientifiche con soluzioni pratiche dei dati.
• Si assiste a documentare strategie e requisiti di dati per programmi e aree terapeutiche
• Supporti gli sforzi di integrazione e armonizzazione dei dati applicando modelli e protocolli standard
• Contribuisci all'esecuzione analitica per casi di utilizzo sfruttando fonti di dati multi-modali in ambiti reali, clinici e operativi
• Contribuisci alla mappatura degli esercizi e alla documentazione della linea di dati per supportare il riutilizzo e la qualità dei dati
• Analizzi la struttura dei dati e supporti la standardizzazione della terminologia e dei metadati
• Collaborate con i membri del team e con i partner interni per mantenere asset di dati strutturati e accessibili Chi sei:
• Hai una laurea o un master in Informatica, Scienze della vita, Scienza informatica, o un campo correlato
• Hai uno sfondo forte in dati reali (RWD)
• Hai 2+ anni di esperienza lavorando con i dati strutturati in un ambiente di ricerca o assistenza sanitaria (esclusi gli stage)
• Hai conoscenza di base di R o Python
• Capisci dizionari di dati, mappature, o tagging dei metadati
• Conoscete i sistemi di dati utilizzati nelle impostazioni cliniche o operative
• Dimostra la capacità di pensare indipendente e la capacità di prendere decisioni basate su principi sani
• Esibisci un'eccellente agilità strategica, tra cui capacità di problem solving e di pensiero critico, e agilità che si estende oltre il dominio tecnico
• Lei dimostra il rispetto delle differenze culturali quando interagisce con i colleghi sul posto di lavoro globale
• Possiedi eccellenti capacità comunicative verbali e scritte, in particolare nei settori della presentazione e della scrittura, con la capacità di spiegare concetti tecnici complessi in linguaggio chiaro Preferiti:
• Esposizione a modelli di dati sanitari o set di dati clinici
• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente di squadra matrice o agile I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa pubblicazione
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This role is based in the Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS) team which drives data excellence and analytics to power enhanced decision-making and evidence-generation within Roche Product Development. We develop and implement data strategies that unlock the value of clinical, operational, and real-world data to accelerate evidence generation, decision-making, and innovation across PD and beyond. By embedding FAIR principles, advancing data governance, and enabling data productization, RWCDS ensures that data is not only findable and usable, but also a driver of scientific rigor, regulatory readiness, and AI-powered transformation. Through deep partnerships with internal functions and external collaborators, we shape a future-ready data ecosystem that supports personalized healthcare and efficient drug development. The Opportunity: The Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist contributes to the design and execution of data strategies and analyses that enable decision-making and insight generation across a therapeutic area or molecule portfolio. Working under the Data Strategy & Analytics Lead, you will partner with cross-functional teams to align data strategy with clinical and translational goals, identify key data assets, and support the delivery of integrated evidence plans. You will also contribute to the translation of scientific and business needs into analytical frameworks and data-driven solutions. This role demands a strong foundation in data science, analytics planning and execution, and an ability to bridge scientific questions with practical data solutions.
• You assist in documenting data strategies and requirements for programs and therapeutic areas
• You support data integration and harmonization efforts by applying templates and standard protocols
• You contribute to analytic execution for use cases leveraging multi-modal data sources across real-world, clinical, and operational domains
• You contribute to mapping exercises and data lineage documentation to support reuse and data quality
• You analyze data structure and support the standardization of terminology and metadata
• You collaborate with team members and internal partners to maintain structured and accessible data assets Who you are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Informatics, Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field
• You have a strong background in real-world data (RWD)
• You have 2+ years of experience working with structured data in a research or healthcare setting ( excluding internships)
• You have basic knowledge of R or Python
• You understand data dictionaries, mappings, or metadata tagging
• You are familiar with data systems used in clinical or operational settings
• You demonstrate capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles
• You exhibit excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond the technical domain
• You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace
• You possess excellent verbal and written communication skills, specifically in the areas of presentation and writing, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear language Preferred Qualifications:
• Exposure to healthcare data models or clinical trial datasets
• Experience working in a matrixed or agile team environment Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Diese Rolle basiert im Team Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS), das Daten Exzellenz und Analytik antreibt, um die Entscheidungsfindung und die Beweiskraft innerhalb der Roche Product Development zu steigern. Wir entwickeln und implementieren Datenstrategien, die den Wert von klinischen, operativen und realen Daten entsperren, um die Datenerzeugung, Entscheidungsfindung und Innovation über PD und darüber hinaus zu beschleunigen. Durch die Einbettung von FAIR-Prinzipien, die Weiterentwicklung der Datenverwaltung und die Ermöglichung der Datenproduktisierung stellt RWCDS sicher, dass Daten nicht nur nachweisbar und nutzbar sind, sondern auch ein Treiber von wissenschaftlicher Strenge, regulatorischer Bereitschaft und AI-powered Transformation. Durch tiefe Partnerschaften mit internen Funktionen und externen Mitarbeitern gestalten wir ein zukunftsbereites Daten-Ökosystem, das personalisierte Gesundheitsversorgung und effiziente Arzneimittelentwicklung unterstützt. Die Gelegenheit: Der Data Strategy & Analytics Spezialist trägt zur Gestaltung und Durchführung von Datenstrategien und -analysen bei, die eine Entscheidungs- und Einsichtserzeugung über einen therapeutischen Bereich oder ein Molekülportfolio ermöglichen. Unter der Data Strategy & Analytics Lead arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um die Datenstrategie mit klinischen und übersetzungsbezogenen Zielen auszurichten, Schlüsseldaten Assets zu identifizieren und die Bereitstellung integrierter Beweispläne zu unterstützen. Sie werden auch zur Übersetzung von wissenschaftlichen und geschäftlichen Bedürfnissen in analytische Rahmenbedingungen und datengetriebene Lösungen beitragen. Diese Rolle erfordert eine starke Grundlage in der Datenwissenschaft, der Analytikplanung und -ausführung und die Möglichkeit, wissenschaftliche Fragen mit praktischen Datenlösungen zu überbrücken.
• Sie unterstützen die Dokumentation von Datenstrategien und -anforderungen für Programme und therapeutische Bereiche
• Sie unterstützen die Integration und Harmonisierung der Daten durch Vorlagen und Standardprotokolle
• Sie tragen zur analytischen Ausführung bei, wenn Sie multimodale Datenquellen in realen, klinischen und operativen Bereichen nutzen
• Sie tragen zur Kartierung von Übungen und Datenreihendokumenten bei, um die Wiederverwendung und Datenqualität zu unterstützen
• Sie analysieren die Datenstruktur und unterstützen die Standardisierung von Terminologie und Metadaten
• Sie arbeiten mit Teammitgliedern und internen Partnern zusammen, um strukturierte und zugängliche Datenbestände zu erhalten Wer du bist:
• Sie halten einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Life Sciences, Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich
• Sie haben einen starken Hintergrund in realen Daten (RWD)
• Sie haben 2+ Jahre Erfahrung mit strukturierten Daten in einer Forschungs- oder Gesundheitsumgebung (ohne Praktika)
• Sie haben Grundkenntnisse von R oder Python
• Sie verstehen Datenwörterbücher, Karten oder Metadaten-Tagging
• Sie kennen Datensysteme, die in klinischen oder betrieblichen Einstellungen verwendet werden
• Sie demonstrieren die Fähigkeit des unabhängigen Denkens und der Fähigkeit, Entscheidungen basierend auf soliden Prinzipien zu treffen
• Sie zeigen ausgezeichnete strategische Agilität einschließlich Problemlösung und kritische Denkfähigkeiten und Agilität, die über die technische Domäne hinausreicht
• Sie zeigen Respekt vor kulturellen Unterschieden bei der Interaktion mit Kollegen am globalen Arbeitsplatz
• Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, insbesondere in den Bereichen Präsentation und Schreiben, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Konzepte in klarer Sprache zu erklären Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:
• Exposition gegenüber Gesundheitsdatenmodellen oder klinischen Testdatensätzen
• Erleben Sie die Arbeit in einer Matrix oder agilen Teamumgebung Verlagerungsleistungen sind für diese Buchung nicht verfügbar
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Ce rôle repose sur l'équipe de la Stratégie mondiale et clinique des données (RWCDS), qui stimule l'excellence et l'analyse des données afin d'améliorer la prise de décisions et la production de données probantes au sein du développement de produits Roche. Nous élaborons et mettons en oeuvre des stratégies de données qui débloquent la valeur des données cliniques, opérationnelles et réelles pour accélérer la production de données probantes, la prise de décisions et l'innovation dans la DP et au-delà. En intégrant les principes FAIR, en faisant progresser la gouvernance des données et en permettant la production de données, RWCDS s'assure que les données sont non seulement exploitables et utilisables, mais aussi un moteur de rigueur scientifique, de préparation réglementaire et de transformation assistée par l'IA. Grâce à des partenariats profonds avec des fonctions internes et des collaborateurs externes, nous formons un écosystème de données prêt à l'avenir qui soutient des soins de santé personnalisés et un développement efficace des médicaments. La possibilité : Le Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist contribue à la conception et à l'exécution de stratégies et d'analyses de données qui permettent de prendre des décisions et de générer des idées dans un domaine thérapeutique ou un portefeuille de molécules. Travaillant sous la direction de Data Strategy & Analytics, vous travaillerez en partenariat avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour aligner la stratégie de données sur les objectifs cliniques et translationnels, identifier les principaux éléments de données et appuyer la mise en oeuvre de plans intégrés de données probantes. Vous contribuerez également à la traduction des besoins scientifiques et commerciaux en cadres d'analyse et en solutions basées sur les données. Ce rôle exige une base solide dans les domaines de la science des données, de la planification et de l'exécution des analyses, et la capacité de concilier les questions scientifiques avec des solutions pratiques en matière de données.
• Vous aidez à documenter les stratégies et les exigences en matière de données pour les programmes et les domaines thérapeutiques
• Vous soutenez les efforts d'intégration et d'harmonisation des données en appliquant des modèles et des protocoles standard
• Vous contribuez à l'exécution analytique pour les cas d'utilisation utilisant des sources de données multimodales dans des domaines réels, cliniques et opérationnels
• Vous contribuez aux exercices de cartographie et à la documentation de la ligne de données pour soutenir la réutilisation et la qualité des données
• Vous analysez la structure des données et soutenez la normalisation de la terminologie et des métadonnées
• Vous collaborez avec les membres de l'équipe et les partenaires internes pour maintenir des données structurées et accessibles Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en informatique, sciences de la vie, informatique ou un domaine connexe
• Vous avez une solide expérience en données du monde réel (RWD)
• Vous avez plus de 2 ans d'expérience en travaillant avec des données structurées dans un cadre de recherche ou de santé (à l'exclusion des stages)
• Vous avez une connaissance de base de R ou Python
• Vous comprenez les dictionnaires de données, les mappages ou le marquage des métadonnées
• Vous connaissez les systèmes de données utilisés en clinique ou en fonctionnement
• Vous démontrez votre capacité de penser et de prendre des décisions indépendantes sur la base de principes solides
• Vous présentez une excellente agilité stratégique, y compris la résolution de problèmes et la pensée critique, et l'agilité qui va au-delà du domaine technique
• Vous démontrez le respect des différences culturelles lors de vos interactions avec vos collègues sur le lieu de travail mondial
• Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite, en particulier dans les domaines de la présentation et de l'écriture, avec la capacité d'expliquer des concepts techniques complexes dans un langage clair Qualifications préférées :
• Exposition à des modèles de données de soins de santé ou à des ensembles de données d'essais cliniques
• Expérience de travail en équipe matricielle ou agile Les prestations de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour cette affectation

jobs.title: Junior Systembetreuer (m/w/d), Raum Hannover
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein neues Team:
Du wirst Teil unseres "Simplify Implementation Teams" innerhalb des Vertriebs Services. Wir sind ein dynamisches Team von Spezialist:innen, das in ganz Deutschland unterwegs ist, um unsere Diagnostiksysteme bei unseren Kunden (z. B. in Krankenhäusern und Laboren) zu implementieren. Als Team arbeiten wir eng zusammen, unterstützen uns gegenseitig bei komplexen Installationen und teilen unser technisches Wissen. Du bist ein wichtiger Knotenpunkt zwischen unseren Kund:innen, dem Vertrieb und dem technischen Service, um eine reibungslose Inbetriebnahme sicherzustellen.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Dein Fokus liegt auf der erfolgreichen Implementierung unserer Diagnostiksysteme. Dabei übernimmst du folgende Tätigkeiten:

• Du übernimmst die fachgerechte Aufstellung, Installation und Modifikation unserer Standard-Diagnostikgeräte direkt beim Kunden.

• Du führst eigenständig Testläufe durch, nimmst Applikationseinstellungen vor und stellst sicher, dass alle Systeme vom Start weg reibungslos funktionieren.

• Du bist der Schlüssel zu zufriedenen Kund:innen. Du übergibst das betriebsbereite System an das Laborpersonal und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Start.

• Falls bei der Installation technische oder applikative Fehler auftreten, bist Du zur Stelle. Du analysierst die Ursache und behebst Störungen im Rahmen der Implementierung.

• Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sorgfältig im CRM-System und handelst stets im Einklang mit den gesetzlichen Vorgaben (z.B. als Medizinprodukteberater:in).

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Neben einer erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Ausbildung als staatlich geprüfte:r Techniker:in oder ein Studium (z.B. FH) in Elektrotechnik, Elektronik, Mechatronik oder einer ähnlichen Fachrichtung bringst Du idealerweise erste praktische Berufserfahrung (z.B. durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeit oder eine technische Ausbildung) im Umgang mit komplexen technischen Systemen mit - sei es in der Elektronik, Hydraulik oder Messtechnik. Folgende Punkte runden Dein Profil ab:

• Aufgrund der regionalen Einsatzplanung und der Fahrzeiten lebst Du im Raum Hannover und bist bereit regelmäßig deutschlandweit zu reisen.

• Du bewegst dich sicher im Umgang mit Steuerungs- und Betriebssoftware und verstehst die IT-Anbindung moderner Analysesysteme.

• Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse (ca. B1/B2-Niveau), um technische Dokumentationen zu verstehen und dich im Team auszutauschen.

• Ein chemisches und technisches Grundverständnis hilft dir, die Funktionsweise unserer Diagnostiksysteme schneller zu erfassen.

• Du arbeitest eigenständig sowie ergebnisorientiert, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und schätzt den engen fachlichen Austausch innerhalb unseres deutschlandweiten Teams.

• Du überzeugst durch eine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und die Fähigkeit, professionell sowie zielgerichtet mit Kunden zu kommunizieren.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir freuen uns!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer for Network Security
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.

You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Network Security, you will lead the Design, Build, and Improvement of critical security infrastructures, specifically focusing on Cisco ISE, Wired Access Control (WAC), and Palo Alto Networks. This is a dual-impact role: you are the technical authority for the secure access layer, while simultaneously leading the engineering of a custom observability framework. You will develop the front-end, back-end, and integration logic required to provide deep visibility into the security product health and asset inventory.

Job Responsibilities

1. SME:
Secure Access (ISE, WAC, Palo Alto)

• Design & Architecture: Lead the high-level and low-level design (HLD/LLD) for global Cisco ISE deployments and Wired Access Control (WAC) strategies to ensure seamless, identity-based security.

• Palo Alto SME: Serve as the primary engineer for Palo Alto NGFW architectures, including advanced threat prevention, decryption, and secure egress/ingress traffic management.

• Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify gaps in the current security posture and implement technical enhancements to NAC policies, SGT (TrustSec) propagation, and firewall rule-sets.

• Build & Implementation: Act as the lead "implementer" for complex global migrations and new feature rollouts across the network security stack.

​
2. Observability Framework Engineering

• Full-Stack Development: Architect and develop a custom framework (front-end and back-end) to provide a "single pane of glass" for infrastructure health.

• Inventory & Integration: Build automated integrations with external data sources (CMDB, IPAM, etc.) to maintain a real-time, dynamic inventory of all network assets and security nodes.

• Telemetry Logic: Design custom logic to ingest and visualize telemetry from ISE, WAC, and Palo Alto using APIs, SNMP, and Syslog.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the lead engineer for complex network security escalations, providing root-cause analysis and implementing long-term, automated architectural fixes.

• Security Observability: Develop dashboards and reporting to provide real-time visibility into the "connected landscape," identifying insecure nodes or unauthorized devices before they can affect the network.

• Automation & Orchestration: Manage security policies as code while continuously improving automation workflows and cross-platform orchest

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pharma Technical Operations (PT) is responsible for manufacturing, supply chain, and quality across the pharmaceutical network. Within PT, PTT (MSAT & Engineering) is responsible for ensuring that PT stays at the forefront of technology in our facilities and supports our robust processes & efficient operations. We focus on integrating product health, process health with equipment fit for purpose, and facility readiness in support of the manufacturing network.
Global Device, Packaging and Distribution MSAT ensures our device-related products including platforms and packaging systems are robustly engineered, efficiently manufactured, and safely delivered and maintained.
The medical device platform team at Roche advances innovative drug delivery systems supporting Roche’s therapeutic, eye care and incretin portfolios. We are seeking a highly skilled Medical Device Platform Design Engineer to contribute to the design and maintenance of Autoinjector and/or PFS-Needle Safety Device platforms utilized in drug-device combination products.

The Opportunity

The successful candidate is a hands-on problem solver, a strategic thinker, and a trusted technical advisor who can both dive deep into engineering challenges and provide actionable guidance and feedback across Roche’s development and sustaining engineering lifecycles.

• Act as technical product design expert supporting product development and sustaining engineering teams throughout the platform-based combination product lifecycle.

• Provide professional mechanical engineering design expertise on multiple products, from concept generation and engineering analysis to both internally and externally utilized device design platform technologies.

• Interface with external suppliers and partners to provide technical oversight on the mechanical design of components and subassemblies used in combination products (prefilled syringes and autoinjectors), driving performance, accountability, and innovation.

• Lead reliability engineering assessments including edge-of-failure testing, variance management activities, tolerance sensitivity assessments, and creation/maintenance of Computer Aided Engineering models and digital twins for virtual analytical data collection.

• Actively seek out, anticipate, and solve significant functional and assembly related technical challenges of platform based Autoinjector and PFS-NSD combination products.

• Lead technical investigations, both within Roche as well as at third party manufacturers, for technical challenges related to design, manufacturing, and scale-up processes, to resolve device and assembly issues timely and effectively.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Business Analyst - Pharma R&D

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As a Senior Business Analyst , you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity. You will demonstrate a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

The opportunity:

Within the Pharma Organisation Medical Affairs serves as the bridge between clinical development and the commercialization of medicines. The domain is increasingly focused on External Stakeholder Engagement, aiming to derive deep insights into unmet medical needs, treatment barriers, and patient perceptions of data. By synthesizing these insights, Medical Affairs shapes the organization’s overall strategic direction. As an IT Business Analyst in this space, you will support the digital transformation of how scientific evidence is generated , managed, and communicated to the global medical community.

• Scope/(Content Leadership) : Independently manages end-to-end business analysis workstreams, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks, mentors junior and intermediate BAs, and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, performs thorough domain research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to solution selection, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals.
