La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Modalità di lavoro Roche offre un modello di lavoro ibrido che abbina flessibilità con la collaborazione in presenza. Al momento, richiediamo ai nostri dipendenti di essere nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici in ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni di squadra e altri eventi collaborativi. Responsabilità Mansioni - Gestisce in modo indipendente i flussi di lavoro dell'analisi aziendale dall'inizio alla fine, affrontando problemi con ambiguità emergente. - Adatta con disinvoltura una serie di framework standard, mentor analisti junior e intermedi e plasma in modo proattivo i modi di lavorare della squadra e le migliori pratiche. Responsabilità/Problem Solving - Guida l'analisi dei problemi aziendali, esegue ricerche approfondite nel dominio e guida l'analisi delle cause fondamentali. - È responsabile della consegna di requisizione completa, significativamente alla selezione della soluzione e identifica proattivamente le discrepanze tra esigenze e soluzioni per arrivare creativi. Gestione degli Stakeholder - Identifica una vasta gamma di stakeholder cross-functionali e costruite la fiducia attraverso una profonda comprensione del business per agire come un consulente affidabile. - Organizza workshop, risolve e plasma proattivamente le prospettive degli stakeholder per gestire strategicamente le aspettative e allinearle con gli obiettivi del progetto. Impatto/Strategia - Indicare un impatto su un prodotto, un'iniziativa o un cluster specifico, contribuendo agli obiettivi del dominio garantito che le soluzioni aggiuntive valore. Opportunità All'interno dell'Organizzazione Farmaceutica, la Medical Affairs fa da ponte tra lo sviluppo clinico e la commercializzazione dei medicinali. Il dominio si concentra sempre di più sull'impegno con gli stakeholder esterni, con l'obiettivo di derivare approfondite informazioni sulle esigenze mediche non soddisfatte, sulle barriere terapeutiche e sulle percezioni dei pazienti sui dati. Sintetizzando queste informazioni, la Medical Affairs plasma la direzione strategica dell'organizzazione. In qualità di IT Business Analyst in questo spazio, supporterai la trasformazione digitale di come le prove scientifiche vengono genera, gestite e comunicate alla comunità medica globale.
• Requisiti Esperienza - Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione di progetti complessi e nella collaborazione con team cross-functionali. - Esperienza nella gestione di progetti IT e nella definizione di requisizione. - Esperienza nella gestione di progetti di trasformazione digitale. Condividi su Twitter - Conoscenza approfondita delle migliori pratiche nell'analisi aziendale e nella gestione dei progetti. - Conoscenza delle tecnologie IT e delle loro interrelazioni. - Conoscenza del dominio farmaceutico e della ricerca medica. Competenze - Capacità di analisi e risoluzione dei problemi. - Capacità di gestione dei progetti e dei team. - Capacità di comunicazione efficace e di gestione degli stakeholder. - Capacità di adattamento e di apprendimento rapido. Cosa? Benefici - Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e rispettoso. - L'opportunità di lavorare su progetti che hanno un impatto significativo sulla salute delle persone in tutto il mondo. - Un pacchetto di beneficio competitivo, tra cui una equa e vantaggiosa, programmi di formazione e sviluppo professionale, e un'ampia gamma di beneficio per la salute e il benessere. Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visita il nostro sito web o contatta il nostro team delle Risorse Umane.

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
En Roche , estamos comprometidos con la excelencia en el área de Neurociencias. Buscamos un profesional con visión estratégica y capacidad analítica para integrarse como Marketing Specialists para el portafolio de Neurociencias.

Este rol es una pieza clave en la coordinación transfuncional para el diseño, ejecución y éxito de las estrategias de mercadotecnia en todo el ciclo de vida del producto.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Strategic Execution: Brindar soporte en la implementación de estrategias de portafolio, segmentación y targeting, colaborando estrechamente con Patient Journey Partners (PJP) para asegurar el posicionamiento de marca.

• Business Intelligence & Forecasting: Desarrollo de pronósticos mensuales de ventas y pacientes por canal, realizando un seguimiento riguroso de indicadores clave (KPIs) frente a los objetivos establecidos.

• Product Launch & Pipeline: Asegurar la ejecución impecable de lanzamientos y extensiones de línea, gestionando la logística y la administración presupuestaria (P&L).

• Compliance & Content Creation: Desarrollar materiales promocionales y de entrenamiento bajo estrictos estándares de Compliance , gestionando el proceso de aprobación e implementación en sistemas como Veeva .

• Stakeholder Management: Coordinar esfuerzos con áreas cross-funcionales (Médico, Comercial, Legal y Finanzas) y gestionar relaciones con proveedores estratégicos para Market Research.

• Operational Excellence: Liderar la planificación y ejecución logística de eventos de educación médica continua y programas de pacientes, asegurando el cumplimiento de tiempos y presupuestos.

• Digital Marketing: Generar materiales y colaborar en la estrategia omnichannel en conjunto con el Marketing Manager, para lograr el mejor impacto de la estrategia.

Tu perfil:

Buscamos candidatos con un alto sentido de responsabilidad, atención al detalle y mentalidad de crecimiento:

• Licenciaturas económicas administrativas, ingenieras industriales o afines

• Inglés intermedio-avanzado (capacidad de interactuar en entornos globales).

• Experiencia previa en la industria farmacéutica. Dominio de google environment, paqueteria microsoft, capacidad de análisis de datos y comprensión de auditorías de mercado.

•
Manejo de Veeva, SAP, Simple buy es un diferencial

• Comunicación asertiva e influencia. Pensamiento analítico y orientación a resultados. Resiliencia y gestión del cambio.

• Capacidad de colaboración en equipos multidisciplinarios.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

As a Cloud DevOps Infrastructure Engineer at the SE6 level, you will be responsible for solving unusually complex business problems with innovative DevOps solutions across the entire infrastructure landscape. Possessing deep knowledge of the impact of DevOps practices on business infrastructure, you will make critical technical decisions across multiple product lines with considerable independence. In this role, you will proactively influence technology strategy, mentor teams, and ensure alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory standards.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Establishes technical direction to the whole lifecycle of platforms and services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and retirement. Applies software engineering principles to build and manage large-scale IT infrastructure products and services, abstracting away the complexity of infrastructure to provide self-service tools and APIs for developers. Designs complex CI/CD pipelines, designs and develops self-healing features, and leads Disaster Recovery design and execution plans.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Strategically applies advanced problem-solving and decision-making skills to address highly complex issues spanning multiple product lines within a domain. Leads the maintenance of live services by designing metrics to measure availability, latency, and system health, and is responsible for identifying critical metrics used to establish SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs. Proactively plans for IT Infrastructure capacity, performance, and scalability, and leads large initiatives aimed at optimizing inter-related platforms. Accountable for availability, tuning, efficiency, change and configuration management, and emergency response.

• Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates exceptional customer and delivery focus by proactively leading partnership and collaboration with developers, Managed Services suppliers, and vendors to continuously improve application development velocity and optimize services reliability. Works closely with development teams to ensure new features are rolled out with a strategic understanding of reliability. Provides direction, guidance, and priority setting, acting as a senior analyst to transform customer and developer needs into specific requirements.

• Impact/Strategy: Ensures implemented solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and is responsible for implementing and updating cost, compliance, and security best practices. Leads complex audit exercises, providing required evidence to audit teams, and leads audit remediation plans. Manages ITSM processes, challenges requirements to scale systems sustainably, and applies innovation to foster business strategy.

• Complexity/ (Product Size): Demonstrates proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse virtual teams globally, driving success across multiple product lines within a domain. Leads geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing specialized guidance to optimize performance and innovation.

• Business/Technical ability: Utilizes wide experience applying Software Engineering principles, automated testing, and CI/CD tools to define technical computing infrastructure entirely under the control of software with no human intervention. Implements and maintains Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and CI/CD pipelines. Applies design thinking, lean, prioritization, and agile methodologies to evo

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
F
ield Application Specialist (Molecular Biology & Pathology) – Castilla y León

¿Te apasiona la intersección entre la ciencia de vanguardia y la tecnología de diagnóstico? En Roche, no solo trabajamos; somos pioneros en biotecnología para mejorar la salud y el bienestar en todo el mundo. Buscamos un Field Application Specialist con base en Valladolid (valorando otras zonas de Castilla y León) para liderar nuestras líneas de Biología Molecular y Anatomía Patológica .

Tu Misión: Transformar el Diagnóstico
Tu rol será el motor que garantice que nuestras soluciones operen con la máxima excelencia. Serás el referente científico y técnico para nuestros clientes, asegurando que cada sistema instalado se convierta en una ventaja competitiva que mejore la vida de los pacientes.
¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

• Excelencia Operativa: Ejecutarás instalaciones, configuraciones y mantenimientos (preventivos y correctivos) de nuestros analizadores y software.

• Empoderamiento del Cliente: Capacitarás y entrenarás a los usuarios en el manejo de soluciones de alta tecnología.

• Consultoría Científica: Proporcionarás información técnica profunda y apoyo en la implementación de nuevos protocolos y controles de calidad.

• Socio Estratégico: Colaborarás estrechamente con el equipo de Ventas y Marketing para identificar necesidades y respaldar nuevas oportunidades comerciales.

• Gestión Digital: Reportarás tu actividad en CRM, asegurando que toda la documentación técnica esté siempre al día y bajo los más altos estándares.
¿Quién eres?

• Formación: Grado en Ciencias de la Salud (Biología, Biomedicina, Biotecnología o similar) o Ingeniería.

• Experiencia: Se valorará muy positivamente contar con experiencia previa en el sector del diagnóstico in vitro o laboratorios clínicos , así como conocimiento en flujos de trabajo automatizados.

• Especialización: Conocimiento o especialización en Biología Molecular y/o Anatomía Patológica .

• Idiomas: Nivel fluido de español e inglés (capacidad para interactuar con referentes globales).

• Habilidades: Eres una persona curiosa, con gran capacidad de comunicación, liderazgo y una clara vocación de servicio al cliente.

• Movilidad: Tienes carnet de conducir B1 y disponibilidad para viajar por el territorio nacional e internacional cuando sea necesario.

• Residencia: Preferiblemente en Valladolid u otras zonas de Castilla y León.
¿Qué te ofrecemos?

• Impacto Real: Participar en un proyecto donde tu trabajo mejora directamente la calidad de las decisiones clínicas.

• Entorno de Innovación: Trabajar con la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector.

• Crecimiento Profesional: Desarrollo continuo en una empresa líder, con un entorno de trabajo inclusivo, colaborativo y dinámico .

• Paquete Competitivo: Salario y beneficios sociales

¿Estás listo para dar el siguiente paso en tu carrera y sumarte a un equipo que se esfuerza por lograr lo mejor de sí mismo y de los demás? ¡Esperamos tu candidatura!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A equipe de FEP atua como o braço analítico e financeiro junto às áreas de Vendas e Marketing. O escopo do time de FEP é estritamente focado em governança comercial, precificação corporativa ( Pricing ), gestão de capital de giro ( Working Capital ) e maximização da rentabilidade.

A Oportunidade:
Como Estagiário(a) de FEP no time de NPC, você atuará como um co-piloto estratégico de Vendas e Marketing, focando na linha de frente dos negócios. O dia a dia envolve o suporte à modelagem de business cases, análises de precificação e gestão da saúde financeira (AR/AP) de clientes Retail e Non-Retail.

• Modelagem Financeira: Suportar a estruturação e análise de business cases para avaliar a viabilidade financeira e a margem de contribuição de novos contratos comerciais e participação em pregões públicos.

• Gestão de Receita: Auxiliar no acompanhamento de KPIs dos portfólios de NPC, monitorando os impactos de descontos e verbas comerciais na rentabilidade das linhas de produto.

• Capital de Giro e Risco: Apoiar no controle e a visibilidade dos indicadores de Contas a Receber (análise de aging e DSO) e Contas a Pagar comerciais, garantindo a correta alocação e conciliação de provisões ( accruals ).

• Reporte Gerencial: Auxiliar na consolidação de bases de dados financeiras, atualizar dashboards de performance de vendas e auxiliar na automação de rotinas analíticas para os fóruns de revisão de resultados com as áreas de negócios.

Quem é você:

• Você está cursando graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas (com previsão de formatura a partir de Dezembro/2027).

• Você possui domínio de Excel, incluindo o uso de funções lógicas, manipulação de grandes bases de dados e noções de modelagem financeira.

• Você tem nível de inglês intermediário ou avançado.

Desejável:

• Você possui conhecimento em Power BI, LookerStudio, macros (VBA) ou outras ferramentas de visualização/manipulação de dados (considerado um diferencial competitivo).

Informações Adicionais:

• Local de Trabalho: Zona Sul de São Paulo;

• Modelo de Trabalho: Atuação em modelo híbrido, presencial 3x por semana

*Benefícios de relocalização não estão disponíveis para esta vaga.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Digital Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Digital Sales Specialist

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity

Come join the Roche Digital Solutions sales organization as a Digital Central Lab Consultant where you will be responsible for selling the Roche navify digital portfolio to IHN, hospital, and reference laboratory customers. This field-based position requires consultative sales experience and expertise in lab workflow, IT infrastructure, data flow, informatics, laboratory medicine, laboratory operations, digital applications (i.e. middleware, business intelligence tools, etc.), and Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) to effectively consult with clinical laboratory stakeholders on customized Roche digital solutions and provide strategic recommendations on digital processes. This position engages early in the sales cycle to understand customer needs, deliver customized demos, and design customized digital solutions in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Roche’s and customers’ teams.

Responsibilities

• Generates new customer demand across the full portfolio of Core Lab and Molecular navify products (middleware, connectivity, informatics, apps, etc).

• Engage in strategic digital discussions with key customer buying influences, from technical end users to executive level decision makers.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across sales and implementation teams to define and align on total solution sales strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

• Conduct laboratory process analysis, develop solution proposal presentations, and deliver recommendations to customers in close alignment with internal stakeholders.

• Deliver software demos and tailored technical presentations to internal and external audiences.

• Adept at translating customer needs into internal action to meet those needs while balancing key business priorities and goals.

• Strong clinical and financial acumen with a demonstrated ability to understand and translate customer needs to effectively position the value of Roche digital solutions.

• Effectively qualify leads and utilize outcomes from workflow analysis and impact studies to provide competitive differentiation and value to the overall customer solution.

• Provides in-depth technical expertise regarding assigned product lines.

• Work cross functionally with internal stakeholders to share information and best practices while remaining actively informed on industry/customer trends that impact business.

• Follow a standardized end-to-end approach that creates evidence-based, differentiated value for the solution portfolio, both inside and outside the walls of the laboratory.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (i.e. Information Technology, Medical Technology, Life Sciences) or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years relevant or equivalent experience (i.e. healthcare digital solutions sales, laboratory diagnostics sales)

• Must be autonomous and organized with effective communication, negotiation, and problem solving skills

• Familiarity with digital solutions, laboratory middleware solutions and hospital LIS systems

• Experience with presenting technical information to large external and internal audiences

Preferred Qualifications

• Preferred experience in the chem

descriptionByLocale.it: Mansioni Specialista di vendita digitale Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Specialista di vendita digitale Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Unisciti all'organizzazione di vendita Roche Digital Solutions come Digital Central Lab Consultant dove sarai responsabile della vendita del portafoglio digitale Roche Navify ai clienti di IHN, ospedale e laboratorio di riferimento. Questa posizione basata sul campo richiede esperienza di vendita consultiva e competenza nel flusso di lavoro di laboratorio, infrastrutture IT, flusso di dati, informatica, medicina di laboratorio, operazioni di laboratorio, applicazioni digitali (cioè middleware, strumenti di business intelligence, ecc.), e Sistemi Informativi di laboratorio (LIS) per consultare efficacemente gli stakeholder di laboratorio clinici sulle soluzioni digitali Roche personalizzate e fornire raccomandazioni strategiche sui processi digitali. Questa posizione si impegna presto nel ciclo di vendita per comprendere le esigenze dei clienti, fornire demo personalizzati e progettare soluzioni digitali personalizzate in collaborazione con gli stakeholder interfunzionali tra i team di Roche e i clienti. Responsabilità - Genera la nuova domanda del cliente attraverso il portafoglio completo dei prodotti Core Lab e Molecular Navify (middleware, connettività, informatica, applicazioni, ecc). - Impegnarsi nelle discussioni strategiche digitali con influenze chiave di acquisto dei clienti, dagli utenti finali tecnici ai decisori di livello esecutivo. - Collabora con gli stakeholder interni tra i team di vendita e implementazione per definire e allineare le strategie di vendita di soluzioni totali per soddisfare e superare costantemente gli obiettivi di vendita. - Condurre analisi di processo di laboratorio, sviluppare presentazioni di proposte di soluzione e fornire raccomandazioni ai clienti in stretta allineamento con gli stakeholder interni. - Fornire demo software e presentazioni tecniche su misura per il pubblico interno ed esterno. - Adept per tradurre le esigenze del cliente in azione interna per soddisfare tali esigenze, mentre bilanciare le priorità e gli obiettivi aziendali chiave. - Forte acume clinico e finanziario con una capacità dimostrata di comprendere e tradurre le esigenze del cliente per posizionare efficacemente il valore delle soluzioni digitali Roche. - Efficacemente qualificare i cavi e utilizzare i risultati dell'analisi del flusso di lavoro e gli studi di impatto per fornire differenziazione e valore competitivi alla soluzione globale del cliente. - Fornisce competenze tecniche approfondite per quanto riguarda le linee di prodotto assegnate. - Il lavoro intercorre in modo funzionale con gli stakeholder interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, pur rimanendo attivamente informati sulle tendenze del settore/cliente che influiscono sul business. - Seguire un approccio end-to-end standardizzato che crea valori differenziati e basati su prove per il portafoglio soluzioni, sia all'interno che all'esterno delle pareti del laboratorio. Chi sei? - Corso di laurea in un campo relativo (ossia tecnologia dell'informazione, tecnologia medica, scienze della vita) o esperienza equivalente. - 5+ anni di esperienza rilevante o equivalente (ad es. vendite di soluzioni digitali sanitarie, vendita di diagnostica di laboratorio) - Deve essere autonomo e organizzato con efficaci capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e problem solving - Familiarità con soluzioni digitali, soluzioni di middleware di laboratorio e sistemi LIS ospedalieri - Esperienza con la presentazione di informazioni tecniche a grandi pubblico esterno e interno Qualifiche Preferite - Esperienza preferenziale nella chem
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Digital Sales Specialist A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Opportunity Come join the Roche Digital Solutions sales organization as a Digital Central Lab Consultant where you will be responsible for selling the Roche navify digital portfolio to IHN, hospital, and reference laboratory customers. This field-based position requires consultative sales experience and expertise in lab workflow, IT infrastructure, data flow, informatics, laboratory medicine, laboratory operations, digital applications (i.e. middleware, business intelligence tools, etc.), and Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) to effectively consult with clinical laboratory stakeholders on customized Roche digital solutions and provide strategic recommendations on digital processes. This position engages early in the sales cycle to understand customer needs, deliver customized demos, and design customized digital solutions in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Roche’s and customers’ teams. Responsibilities
• Generates new customer demand across the full portfolio of Core Lab and Molecular navify products (middleware, connectivity, informatics, apps, etc).
• Engage in strategic digital discussions with key customer buying influences, from technical end users to executive level decision makers.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across sales and implementation teams to define and align on total solution sales strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.
• Conduct laboratory process analysis, develop solution proposal presentations, and deliver recommendations to customers in close alignment with internal stakeholders.
• Deliver software demos and tailored technical presentations to internal and external audiences.
• Adept at translating customer needs into internal action to meet those needs while balancing key business priorities and goals.
• Strong clinical and financial acumen with a demonstrated ability to understand and translate customer needs to effectively position the value of Roche digital solutions.
• Effectively qualify leads and utilize outcomes from workflow analysis and impact studies to provide competitive differentiation and value to the overall customer solution.
• Provides in-depth technical expertise regarding assigned product lines.
• Work cross functionally with internal stakeholders to share information and best practices while remaining actively informed on industry/customer trends that impact business.
• Follow a standardized end-to-end approach that creates evidence-based, differentiated value for the solution portfolio, both inside and outside the walls of the laboratory. Who You Are
• Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (i.e. Information Technology, Medical Technology, Life Sciences) or equivalent experience.
• 5+ years relevant or equivalent experience (i.e. healthcare digital solutions sales, laboratory diagnostics sales)
• Must be autonomous and organized with effective communication, negotiation, and problem solving skills
• Familiarity with digital solutions, laboratory middleware solutions and hospital LIS systems
• Experience with presenting technical information to large external and internal audiences Preferred Qualifications
• Preferred experience in the chem
descriptionByLocale.de: Mansion Digital Sales Spezialist Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Digital Sales Spezialist Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Die Chance Kommen Sie als Digital Central Lab Consultant bei der Roche Digital Solutions-Verkaufsorganisation, wo Sie für den Verkauf des digitalen Portfolios von Roche an IHN, Krankenhaus und Referenzlaborkunden verantwortlich sind. Diese feldbasierte Position erfordert konsultierende Vertriebserfahrung und Expertise im Labor-Workflow, IT-Infrastruktur, Datenfluss, Informatik, Labormedizin, Labor-Operationen, Digital-Anwendungen (d.h. Middleware, Business Intelligence Tools, etc.) und Laborinformationssysteme (LIS), um effektiv mit klinischen Labor-Stakeholdern auf maßgeschneiderte Roche-digitale Lösungen zu konsultieren und strategische Empfehlungen zu digitalen Prozessen bereitzustellen. Diese Position beschäftigt sich früh im Verkaufszyklus, um Kundenbedürfnisse zu verstehen, maßgeschneiderte Demos zu liefern und maßgeschneiderte digitale Lösungen in Partnerschaft mit funktionsübergreifenden Interessenvertretern in den Teams von Roche und Kunden zu entwickeln. In den Warenkorb - Erstellt neue Kundennachfrage im gesamten Portfolio von Core Lab und Molecular navify Produkten (Middleware, Konnektivität, Informatik, Apps, etc.). - Engagieren Sie in strategischen digitalen Diskussionen mit wichtigen Kundenkaufeinflüssen, von technischen Endnutzern bis hin zu Führungskräften. - Mit internen Stakeholdern über Vertriebs- und Implementierungsteams zusammenarbeiten, um die Gesamtlösungsverkaufsstrategien zu definieren und auszurichten, um die Vertriebsziele konsequent zu erreichen und zu übertreffen. - Durchführung von Laborprozessanalysen, Entwicklung von Lösungsvorschlägen und Empfehlungen an Kunden in enger Abstimmung mit internen Interessenvertretern. - Liefern Sie Software-Demos und maßgeschneiderte technische Präsentationen auf interne und externe Publikum. - Adept bei der Umsetzung von Kundenbedürfnissen in interne Maßnahmen, um diese Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen, während die wichtigsten Geschäftsprioritäten und Ziele ausgleichen. - Starker klinischer und finanzieller Aufwand mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, den Kunden zu verstehen und zu übersetzen, muss den Wert von Roche Digitallösungen effektiv positionieren. - Effektiv qualifizieren Leads und nutzen Ergebnisse von Workflow-Analysen und Folgenstudien, um wettbewerbsfähige Differenzierung und Wert für die gesamte Kundenlösung zu bieten. - Bietet fundiertes technisches Know-how in Bezug auf zugeordnete Produktlinien. - Arbeiten Sie funktionell mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um Informationen und bewährte Praktiken zu teilen und weiterhin aktiv über Trends in der Industrie/Kunden zu informieren, die das Geschäft beeinflussen. - Folgen Sie einem standardisierten End-to-End-Ansatz, der einen evidenzbasierten, differenzierten Wert für das Lösungsportfolio schafft, sowohl innerhalb als auch außerhalb der Laborwände. Chi Sei - Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich (d.h. Informationstechnologie, Medizintechnik, Life Sciences) oder gleichwertige Erfahrung. - 5+ Jahre relevante oder gleichwertige Erfahrung (d.h. Vertrieb von digitalen Gesundheitslösungen, Vertrieb von Labordiagnostik) - Muss autonom und mit effektiver Kommunikation, Verhandlungen und Problemlösung Fähigkeiten organisiert werden - Vertrautheit mit digitalen Lösungen, Labor Middleware-Lösungen und Krankenhaus LIS-Systemen - Erfahrung mit der Präsentation technischer Informationen für große externe und interne Publikum Qualifiche Präferenz - Bevorzugte Erfahrung im Chem
descriptionByLocale.fr: Mansioni Spécialiste des ventes numériques Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Spécialiste des ventes numériques Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. L'opportunité Venez rejoindre l'organisation de vente de Roche Digital Solutions en tant que consultant de Digital Central Lab où vous serez responsable de la vente du portefeuille numérique de Roche navify à des clients IHN, hôpital et laboratoire de référence. Ce poste sur le terrain exige de l'expérience et de l'expertise en matière de ventes consultatives dans les domaines suivants : flux de travail en laboratoire, infrastructure informatique, flux de données, informatique, médecine de laboratoire, opérations de laboratoire, applications numériques (c.-à-d. intergiciels, outils d'intelligence d'affaires, etc.) et systèmes d'information de laboratoire (SIL) afin de consulter efficacement les intervenants des laboratoires cliniques sur les solutions numériques Roche personnalisées et de formuler des recommandations stratégiques sur les processus numériques. Cette position s'engage dès le début du cycle de vente pour comprendre les besoins des clients, fournir des démos personnalisées et concevoir des solutions numériques personnalisées en partenariat avec des intervenants interfonctionnels dans les équipes de Roche et de clients. Responsabilité - Génére une nouvelle demande cliente dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits Core Lab et Molecular navify (milieux, connectivité, informatique, applications, etc.). - S'engager dans des discussions numériques stratégiques avec des influences clés sur l'achat des clients, des utilisateurs techniques aux décideurs de niveau exécutif. - Collaborer avec les intervenants internes des équipes de vente et de mise en oeuvre afin de définir et d'aligner les stratégies de vente de solutions totales pour atteindre et dépasser systématiquement les objectifs de vente. - Effectuer des analyses de processus en laboratoire, élaborer des propositions de solutions et présenter des recommandations aux clients en étroite harmonie avec les intervenants internes. - Fournir des démos logicielles et des présentations techniques adaptées aux publics internes et externes. - Aider à traduire les besoins des clients en actions internes pour répondre à ces besoins tout en conciliant les priorités et les objectifs opérationnels clés. - Forte concentration clinique et financière avec une capacité démontrée de comprendre et de traduire les besoins des clients pour positionner efficacement la valeur des solutions numériques Roche. - Qualifier efficacement les pistes et utiliser les résultats de l'analyse de flux de travail et des études d'impact pour fournir une différenciation concurrentielle et de la valeur à la solution globale du client. - Fournit une expertise technique approfondie concernant les gammes de produits attribuées. - Travailler de concert avec les intervenants internes pour partager l'information et les pratiques exemplaires tout en restant activement informé des tendances de l'industrie et des clients qui ont une incidence sur les entreprises. - Suivre une approche standard de bout en bout qui crée une valeur factuelle différenciée pour le portefeuille de solutions, tant à l'intérieur qu'à l'extérieur des murs du laboratoire. Chi Sei - Baccalauréat Diplôme dans un domaine connexe (p. ex. technologie de l'information, technologie médicale, sciences de la vie) ou expérience équivalente. - 5 ans d'expérience pertinente ou équivalente (vente de solutions numériques de soins de santé, ventes de diagnostics de laboratoire) - Doit être autonome et organisé avec des compétences de communication, de négociation et de résolution de problèmes efficaces - Familiarité avec les solutions numériques, les solutions intermédiaires de laboratoire et les systèmes LIS hospitaliers - Expérience de la présentation de l'information technique à un large public externe et interne Qualifiche Preferite - Expérience préférée dans la chimie

jobs.title: Becario Area Finanzas Roche
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre Roche

En Roche, nos impulsa el propósito de innovar en ciencia y apoyar transformaciones al sistema de salud para asegurar que las generaciones presentes y futuras disfruten de más y mejor tiempo con sus seres queridos. Creemos que la innovación no solo está en nuestros medicamentos, sino también en la excelencia de nuestros procesos internos.

La Oportunidad

Buscamos un becario proactivo con interés en tener una experiencia profesional de alto impacto en el área financiera, específicamente en Procurement y Supply Chain. En este rol, participarás en proyectos estratégicos para impulsar la eficiencia y agilidad operativa, experimentando la vida laboral en una farmacéutica de alta especialidad líder en el mundo.

Tus Responsabilidades

• Due Diligence: Mantener el tracker al día y asegurar que la documentación esté completa en gDrive.

• Procesos de Licitación: Gestionar procesos de invitación a cotizar, asegurando el cumplimiento de los timelines y el resguardo de documentación.

• Data & Analytics: Mantener actualizadas las gráficas del Dashboard de Procurement y realizar la extracción de reportes.

• Gestión de Contenidos: Actualizar el GSite de Procurement y el material de capacitación según los requerimientos.

• Soporte Operativo: Apoyo en el seguimiento al proceso de alta de proveedores.

• Gestión de Órdenes: Registro y seguimiento de órdenes de compra (OC), garantizando precisión en datos y disponibilidad de stock.

• Cumplimiento Normativo: Control y elaboración de cartas de canje y corta caducidad.

• Reporting: Extracción de datos para la actualización de indicadores clave (KPIs) del área.

¿Quién eres?

Para destacar en este rol, buscamos el siguiente perfil:

• Formación: Estudiante activo de Ingeniería Industrial, Negocios Internacionales, Finanzas o carreras afines.

• Mindset: Gran motivación por aprender, proactividad y una marcada orientación a resultados.

• Pasión: Interés por el manejo de información, el análisis de datos y la mejora continua de procesos.

• Habilidades: Capacidad para desarrollar visión estratégica y gestión de proyectos dentro del sector salud.

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Sobre Roche En Roche, nos impulsa el propósito de innovar en ciencia y apoyar transformaciones al sistema de salud para asegurar que las generaciones presentes y futuras disfruten de más y mejor tiempo con sus seres queridos. Creemos que la innovación no solo está en nuestros medicamentos, sino también en la excelencia de nuestros procesos internos. La Oportunidad Buscamos un becario proactivo con interés en tener una experiencia profesional de alto impacto en el área financiera, específicamente en Procurement y Supply Chain. En este rol, participarás en proyectos estratégicos para impulsar la eficiencia y agilidad operativa, experimentando la vida laboral en una farmacéutica de alta especialidad líder en el mundo. Tus Responsabilidades
• Due Diligence: Mantener el tracker al día y asegurar que la documentación esté completa en gDrive.
• Procesos de Licitación: Gestionar procesos de invitación a cotizar, asegurando el cumplimiento de los timelines y el resguardo de documentación.
• Data & Analytics: Mantener actualizadas las gráficas del Dashboard de Procurement y realizar la extracción de reportes.
• Gestión de Contenidos: Actualizar el GSite de Procurement y el material de capacitación según los requerimientos.
• Soporte Operativo: Apoyo en el seguimiento al proceso de alta de proveedores.
• Gestión de Órdenes: Registro y seguimiento de órdenes de compra (OC), garantizando precisión en datos y disponibilidad de stock.
• Cumplimiento Normativo: Control y elaboración de cartas de canje y corta caducidad.
• Reporting: Extracción de datos para la actualización de indicadores clave (KPIs) del área. ¿Quién eres? Para destacar en este rol, buscamos el siguiente perfil:
• Formación: Estudiante activo de Ingeniería Industrial, Negocios Internacionales, Finanzas o carreras afines.
• Mindset: Gran motivación por aprender, proactividad y una marcada orientación a resultados.
• Pasión: Interés por el manejo de información, el análisis de datos y la mejora continua de procesos.
• Habilidades: Capacidad para desarrollar visión estratégica y gestión de proyectos dentro del sector salud. Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Maintenance Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Supply Chain Maintenance Specialist, you will be able to contribute to shape the future of the Roche Global Supply Chain organization by maintaining the reliability and performance of the equipment utilized within the Hub Operations Americas group located in Indianapolis.

Your Opportunity

Position’s most important individual tasks:

• Complete preventative maintenance tasks according to detailed procedures and schedules.

• Perform electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning equipment, used within warehousing areas.

• Dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches, or drawings.

• Use test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts & rebuild equipment as required.

• Perform equipment modifications including installation, validation support and start-up of new equipment, as well as decommissioning activities as directed by engineers

• Use predictive maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies.

• Apply advanced knowledge and skills to complete assignments requiring judgment and initiative. You will understand the implications of work and make recommendations for solutions. You will receive little instruction on daily assignments and may determine methods and procedures on new assignments.

Who you are:

Minimum qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• 2+ years of related experience in maintenance experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Associates degree, journeyman’s card or equivalent military training related to maintenance of equipment in an industrial setting.

• At least 5 years of experience in technical support and maintenance roles.

• Preferred credentials: CMRT, CRL, CMRP, etc

• Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience with electrical, mechanical and pneumatic systems. Preferred experience: familiar with conveyor systems and other equipment used within warehouse operations.

• Proficiency in troubleshooting and diagnosing technical issues, using diagnostic tools, and interpreting equipment manuals and schematics.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Familiarity with preventive maintenance programs, spare parts management, and relevant safety regulations.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, managing multiple priorities and adapting to changing circumstances.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Pay transparency
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson is 54,300.00 - 100,800.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Assistant / Event Planner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced professional to join our team as a Senior Administrative Assistant / Event Planner.

Your Opportunity

The responsibilities for this role include:

Corporate Event Management:

• Lead the planning, scheduling, and execution of various and complex events, such as inaugurations, town halls, global leadership team meetings, and other engagement or business events.

• Coordinate and manage facilities required for engagement events, including arrangement of cleaning, dining needs (e.g., coffee, tea), and other necessary resources.

• Liaise with suppliers and vendors for service contracts, event material procurement, and other necessary engagements.

• Create and manage budgets for events, track expenses, and ensure cost-effectiveness.

• Address and resolve any issues that may arise during event planning and execution.

• Develop and maintain strong working relationships with internal departments and external partners.

• Oversee all logistical aspects, such as transportation, accommodation, and on-site event setup and teardown.

• Arrange for audiovisual equipment, staging, and other technical requirements needed for the event.

• Act as the main point of contact for event stakeholders, including speakers, sponsors, and partners.

• Negotiate contracts with vendors, venues, and service providers to secure favorable terms and conditions.

• Develop and implement contingency plans to address potential risks and issues that may arise before and during the event.

• Conduct post-event evaluations to gather feedback from attendees, vendors, and team members.

• Analyze event success metrics, compile evaluation reports, and provide insights for future improvements.

• Support occupational health needs, participate in or provide input to the Emergency Committee and SHE (Safety, Health & Environment).

Administrative Support:

• Manage calendars, workshops, and events for the organization.

• Handle financial support tasks, such as processing purchase orders (POs), invoices, and statements of work.

• Plan and schedule diverse types of meetings (e.g., events, offsites, interviews, stakeholder meetups) across multiple time zones for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring high confidentiality.

• Provide administrative support for business operations, including financial management processes, onboarding/offboarding activities, relationship management, learning management support, and department organization.

Communication & Collaboration:

• Maintain relationships and information flow with the global management team.

• Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, ensuring effective teamwork.

• Skillfully manage the expectations and needs of internal and external stakeholders.

Operational Efficiency:

• Schedule appointments, manage travel itineraries, and coordinate related arrangements.

• Prepare and manage expense reports through to settlement.

• Attend meetings, record and distribute meeting minutes.

• Prepare and analyze complex trends, reports, and presentations using data from various sources.

• Assist in preparing budget and project reports as required.

• Research, collect, compile, and analyze diverse data and information requests.

• Identify bottlenecks in administrative processes and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency.

Quality & Improvement:

• Continuously improve quality and objectives.

• Manage all purchasing activities from order to execution of POs in the system.

• Review invoices

• Lead the planning, scheduling, and execution of various and complex events, such as inaugurations, town halls, global leadership team meetings, and other engagement or business events.
• Coordinate and manage facilities required for engagement events, including arrangement of cleaning, dining needs (e.g., coffee, tea), and other necessary resources.
• Liaise with suppliers and vendors for service contracts, event material procurement, and other necessary engagements.
• Create and manage budgets for events, track expenses, and ensure cost-effectiveness.
• Address and resolve any issues that may arise during event planning and execution.
• Develop and maintain strong working relationships with internal departments and external partners.
• Oversee all logistical aspects, such as transportation, accommodation, and on-site event setup and teardown.
• Arrange for audiovisual equipment, staging, and other technical requirements needed for the event.
• Act as the main point of contact for event stakeholders, including speakers, sponsors, and partners.
• Negotiate contracts with vendors, venues, and service providers to secure favorable terms and conditions.
• Develop and implement contingency plans to address potential risks and issues that may arise before and during the event.
• Conduct post-event evaluations to gather feedback from attendees, vendors, and team members.
• Analyze event success metrics, compile evaluation reports, and provide insights for future improvements.
• Support occupational health needs, participate in or provide input to the Emergency Committee and SHE (Safety, Health & Environment). Administrative Support:
• Manage calendars, workshops, and events for the organization.
• Handle financial support tasks, such as processing purchase orders (POs), invoices, and statements of work.
• Plan and schedule diverse types of meetings (e.g., events, offsites, interviews, stakeholder meetups) across multiple time zones for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring high confidentiality.
• Provide administrative support for business operations, including financial management processes, onboarding/offboarding activities, relationship management, learning management support, and department organization. Communication & Collaboration:
• Maintain relationships and information flow with the global management team.
• Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, ensuring effective teamwork.
• Skillfully manage the expectations and needs of internal and external stakeholders. Operational Efficiency:
• Schedule appointments, manage travel itineraries, and coordinate related arrangements.
• Prepare and manage expense reports through to settlement.
• Attend meetings, record and distribute meeting minutes.
• Prepare and analyze complex trends, reports, and presentations using data from various sources.
• Assist in preparing budget and project reports as required.
• Research, collect, compile, and analyze diverse data and information requests.
• Identify bottlenecks in administrative processes and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency. Quality & Improvement:
• Continuously improve quality and objectives.
• Manage all purchasing activities from order to execution of POs in the system.
• Review invoices

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

As a R2R Period-End Close Senior Analyst based in San José, Costa Rica, you will be an integral part of our Global Shared Services organization. This role serves as a subject matter expert, delivering advanced accounting support and complex financial analysis while driving process improvements and automation initiatives. You will act as a key point of contact for accounting and reporting matters, serving as a trusted advisor for our supported affiliates.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Accounting Expertise & Audit Leadership: Lead complex accounting analyses and audit activities for assigned areas. You will serve as a subject matter expert for affiliates and internal stakeholders, ensuring technical accounting excellence.

• Financial Reporting & Close Activities: Prepare and review complex financial statements and reports. You will manage month-end close activities, including journal entries, cost allocations, and reconciliations, while maintaining a proper audit trail and compliance with standards.

• Analysis, Commentary & Advisory: Analyze financial results to investigate variances and provide clear, actionable insights to management. You will interpret and communicate financial data effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.

• Compliance & Governance: Ensure strict compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.

• Team Development: Support the growth of the team through coaching, reviewing work, and contributing to cross-functional initiatives and global projects.

• Continuous Improvement: Drive process improvements and support automation initiatives to increase the efficiency of the Record-to-Report flow.

Who you are:

You are a highly analytical finance professional with a strong attention to detail, capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment to meet tight deadlines.
Requirements and Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance , or a related field. A professional certification ( CPA, ACCA , or equivalent) is preferred.

• Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of experience in accounting or finance. Prior experience in a Finance Shared Services environment is preferred. Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry is a plus.

• Technical Skills: * Strong knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS .

• Experience with ERP systems, specifically SAP (FI, CO/PA, MM, FA, FCC) and BlackLine is highly desirable.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace.

• Languages: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluent in English and Spanish . Portuguese and or French is preferred.

• Core Competencies: * Strong stakeholder management and collaboration abilities.

• Problem-solving mindset with a focus on process automation and continuous improvement.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) is the market leader in the In-Vitro Diagnostics business. Within that ecosystem, Research & Early Development is the home for early research activities and plays an integral role in rapidly delivering innovation in discovery and specific customer area needs. For the business to remain competitive in the future, a dedicated management of innovation is of central importance.

To be successful as an Innovation Manager in our organization, a unique capability to thrive in ambiguity is needed, managing research process design to accelerate discovery while ensuring alignment with long-term business strategy. Beyond technical oversight, the role is defined by strategic diplomacy. An Innovation Manager must excel as a research ambassador, translating complex scientific impact into value propositions for diverse stakeholders.

The Opportunity:
• ● Influencing Without Authority: Using organizational and interpersonal awareness and finesse to drive delivery across levels.
• ● Systems Thinking: Navigating the interface between science, medical, and business sectors to manage dependencies at scale.
• ● Resilient Execution: Combining project management rigor with change management and persistence to ensure critical work reaches completion despite structural obstacles.
• ● Supports enterprise research in creating, funneling and harvesting cutting-edge innovation ideas, acts as a neutral thought partner to practice the idea acceptability
• ● Hosts innovation challenges addressing shared problem statements of global RDS Research
● Sparks and cultivates a cross-divisional innovation mindset, acts as change agent to coach the organization on the global research strategy and vision and advocate for the customer and the business role in innovation
• ● Uses independent evaluation, selection, and substantial adaptation and modification of standard project management and communication techniques, procedures and
• criteria to navigate the complex flexible dynamic nature of research and early
• development projects
• ● Actively builds and cultivates connections into the scientific network and maintains
• expert knowledge of industry trends, competition, and emerging innovations,
• contributes to strategic innovation roadmapping for early research
● Organizes and facilitates interdisciplinary workshops applying innovative and agile methodologies to achieve workshop outcomes in creative and effective ways, in order to contribute to problem discovery and challenge-driven ideation
• ● Plans, manages and monitors research operations to support the activities,
• processes, communication and digital infrastructure of research and early
• development and its innovation framework
• ● Collaborates cross-functionally with experts within Research & Development (R&D),CDMA (Clinical Development and Medical Affairs), Partnering and beyond
• ● Monitors and optimizes processes in order to increase quality and efficiency
• standards, promotes and participates in the professional development of best
• practices and process principles to manage risks, to achieve objectives in creative and effective ways and to increase quality and efficiency standards
• ● Coaches and trains other members of the team on the subject matter exp

jobs.title: Facilities Technician II
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Work shift: M-F 2:00pm - 10:30pm

The Facilities Technician II at GenMark Diagnostics, A Member of the Roche Group, is responsible for the overall maintenance, upkeep, and cleanliness of the designated facility, preventative or otherwise. In this position, you are

• Preventative Maintenance & Operations – Perform routine maintenance on HVAC and central plant equipment, conduct daily facility tours, monitor all rooftop and building systems, and make necessary operational adjustments
• Work Request Management & Response – Handle internal customer facility work requests, respond to alarm system alerts 24/7, investigate and document process alarms, and provide on-call coverage
• Equipment & Inventory Support – Maintain spare parts inventory, manage repair parts for work requests, conduct maintenance on specialized systems (water purification, heating/cooling, humidity control, building controls), and support validation protocols
• Quality & Compliance – Ensure all duties comply with ISO, FDA, and regulatory requirements; demonstrate awareness of quality consequences and potential device defects; support Quality Management System implementation
• Coordination & Professional Development – Coordinate contractor/vendor site escorts and training, support cross-functional staff training, collaborate with technicians on daily tasks, and maintain professionalism with internal and external stakeholders

Who you are

• You possess a High School Diploma, or Technical Education with 2 to 4 years of maintenance experience preferably in Biotech, cGMP, medical or health related environment or equivalent.

• You must be available to work any shift and be “on call” via pager and/or cell phone.

• You possess a clean & valid CA driver’s license

Behaviors, Competencies, and Qualities of the ideal applicant.

• Proficiency with power tools and machine shop equipment, knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration systems, and plumbing; ability to read schematics and drawings.

• Experience in high-paced manufacturing environments, routine building and grounds maintenance, and familiarity with welding and precision tools (drill press, hand tools).

• Excellent understanding and application of safety procedures; knowledge of federal regulations including QSR, ISO, and ISO 13485 standards; CMDR familiarity preferred.

• Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently; basic computer skills (MS Word, Excel, Access, Google); excellent documentation and record-keeping abilities.

• Strong interpersonal, communication, and cooperation skills; ability to work effectively with diverse teams in regulated environments.

Work Environment
The essential functions of the job are usually performed in an environmentally controlled facility where the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. This position may involve a combination of office and biotechnology laboratory environments. You may be exposed to hazardous chemicals, blood-borne, pathogens and automated equipment.

While performing the job duties, you are regularly required to sit; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. You are frequently required to stand and walk. You may sometimes be required to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

Relocation benefits are not offered for this job posting

The expected salary range for this position based on California is 53,800.00 - 99,800

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love, that is what makes us Roche.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager, Roche Diagnostics Australia is looking for a Field Service Engineer, ideally with specific experience working with Mass Spectrometry. As a Field Service Engineer, you are responsible to perform the field service activities for all our Diagnostics portfolios with a primary focus on Mass Spectrometry, by provision and coordination of all activities relating to instrument installation, instrument preventative maintenance, instrument troubleshooting, software and hardware modifications, relating to both pre, during, and post sales requirements. Service will need to be performed locally, interstate, and including travel overseas to support Roche Diagnostics New Zealand when needed.

This service is provided on the basis of hours of employment typically being from 9 am to 5 pm Monday to Friday. In addition, you will be asked to participate in an on-call roster to cover the out of hours’ service requirements from 5 pm to 9 am Monday to Friday and 24 hours Saturday and Sunday.
Field Service Engineers are required to actively collaborate with the local account management teams and to participate in local and national team meetings.

We are looking for an experienced engineer with a proactive mindset, who enjoys working collaboratively in a close team environment, and is capable of working fully independently.

Key responsibilities include:

• Provide outstanding quality instrument service and support, in a timely manner, to meet the high standards expected by our customers of Roche and the products we supply and support.

• Responsible for the timely pre-installation inspection and installation of Roche and other analytical systems working with Regional Engineering Manager, Application Specialist, Project Lead, Solutions Manager, and Local Account Management Team to ensure successful installations occur.

• Ensure all Preventative Maintenance is carried out in a timely manner as per the manufacturer's guidelines.

• Ensure any ongoing instrument problems or issues are communicated to Regional Engineering Manager, Head of Service & Support, Local Account Manager, Solutions Team and or manufacturer.

• Accurately capture and report all field activities undertaken, including all labour and travel incurred via CRM system in a timely manner.

• Compliance with all Roche processes as documented in policies and procedures- complete all mandatory training by the due date.

• Ensures compliance and promotion of all safety, health, and environmental policies and procedures to ensure the safety, health and wellbeing of all employees and visitors.

Who You Are:

• Tertiary biomedical engineering or equivalent qualification with 3+ years of experience in field services engineering, ideally with specialist Mass Spectrometry knowledge and hands-on experience.

• Experience with Lab IT and middleware systems.

• Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple projects.

• Availability to travel locally, regionally, nationally and internationally as required.

• Able to build and maintain strong internal and external partnerships

• Exhibit a passion for digital transformation and process enhancem

• Responsible for the timely pre-installation inspection and installation of Roche and other analytical systems working with Regional Engineering Manager, Application Specialist, Project Lead, Solutions Manager, and Local Account Management Team to ensure successful installations occur.
• Ensure all Preventative Maintenance is carried out in a timely manner as per the manufacturer's guidelines.
• Ensure any ongoing instrument problems or issues are communicated to Regional Engineering Manager, Head of Service & Support, Local Account Manager, Solutions Team and or manufacturer.
• Accurately capture and report all field activities undertaken, including all labour and travel incurred via CRM system in a timely manner.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple projects.
• Availability to travel locally, regionally, nationally and internationally as required.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责/责任
客户管理

• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求

• 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案

• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈

• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理

• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

• 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作

• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家

• 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
