jobs.title: Head of US Government Affairs & Policy

titleByLocale.en: Head of US Government Affairs & Policy

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Head of US Government Affairs & Policy leads Roche Diagnostics’ US government affairs and public policy strategy, shaping the legislative and regulatory environment to advance innovation, protect market access, influence healthcare policy, and mitigate risk.
Based in Washington, D.C., this executive serves as Roche Diagnostics’ principal representative to policymakers, regulatory agencies, trade associations and external stakeholders, while acting as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on political and policy developments affecting the business.
This role reports to the Global Head of Quality, Regulatory & External Affairs, with a dotted-line relationship to the President and CEO, Roche Diagnostics North America.

KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Policy Strategy & Advocacy

• Develop and lead Roche Diagnostics’ US government affairs and policy strategy aligned with business priorities.

• Influence federal and state policy impacting diagnostics, reimbursement, healthcare innovation, trade and regulatory matters.

• Anticipate risks and opportunities and shape advocacy strategies to support growth and patient access.

• Serve as a strategic partner ensuring the US Government Affairs agenda is co-created with commercial leaders; translate complex political and regulatory shifts into strategic implications that inform business planning and investment decisions.

Strategic Trade Association Leadership:

• Evaluate and recommend Roche Diagnostics’ participation in industry trade associations;

• Direct executive engagement within these forums to lead cross-industry efforts on critical medical technology and policy issues.

Government & Stakeholder Engagement

• Serve as Roche’s senior liaison with Congress, Administration officials, federal agencies and state policymakers.

• Lead engagement with key trade associations, coalitions, patient groups and external stakeholders to advance Roche’s policy agenda. Partners with external stakeholders, as appropriate, to build alignment with Roche Diagnostics’ policy positions and encourage external advocacy efforts consistent with those positions. (e.g., non-profit associations, industry organizations, think tanks, coalitions).

• Lead Roche’s presence in government forums and strategically deploy internal subject matter experts (from manufacturing to R&D) to testify, brief officials, and provide technical guidance that advances the company's policy objectives.

Strategic Counsel & Business Partnership

• Advise senior leaders on political, legislative and policy developments affecting Roche Diagnostics.

• Bring external insights into business strategy and translate policy developments into actionable implications.

• Support executive engagement with policymakers and key public affairs opportunities.

Policy Leadership in Partnership with Commercial Organization

• Lead customer communications on policy in partnership with the US commercial team.

• Engage with policy counterparts from key customers as well as laboratory industry trade associations.

• Participate in US Commercial leadership forums including USLT (US Leadership Team) and ELT (Enterprise Leadership Team).

Team Leadership & Capability Building

• Lead and develop a high-performing US Government Affairs and Policy team, including talent development, succession planning, coaching and organizational capability building.

• Assess resource needs and manage use of external advisors, consultants and advocacy partnerships.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Head of US Government Affairs & Policy leads Roche Diagnostics’ US government affairs and public policy strategy, shaping the legislative and regulatory environment to advance innovation, protect market access, influence healthcare policy, and mitigate risk.
Based in Washington, D.C., this executive serves as Roche Diagnostics’ principal representative to policymakers, regulatory agencies, trade associations and external stakeholders, while acting as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on political and policy developments affecting the business.
This role reports to the Global Head of Quality, Regulatory & External Affairs, with a dotted-line relationship to the President and CEO, Roche Diagnostics North America.

KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Policy Strategy & Advocacy

• Develop and lead Roche Diagnostics’ US government affairs and policy strategy aligned with business priorities.

• Influence federal and state policy impacting diagnostics, reimbursement, healthcare innovation, trade and regulatory matters.

• Anticipate risks and opportunities and shape advocacy strategies to support growth and patient access.

• Serve as a strategic partner ensuring the US Government Affairs agenda is co-created with commercial leaders; translate complex political and regulatory shifts into strategic implications that inform business planning and investment decisions.

Strategic Trade Association Leadership:

• Evaluate and recommend Roche Diagnostics’ participation in industry trade associations;

• Direct executive engagement within these forums to lead cross-industry efforts on critical medical technology and policy issues.

Government & Stakeholder Engagement

• Serve as Roche’s senior liaison with Congress, Administration officials, federal agencies and state policymakers.

• Lead engagement with key trade associations, coalitions, patient groups and external stakeholders to advance Roche’s policy agenda. Partners with external stakeholders, as appropriate, to build alignment with Roche Diagnostics’ policy positions and encourage external advocacy efforts consistent with those positions. (e.g., non-profit associations, industry organizations, think tanks, coalitions).

• Lead Roche’s presence in government forums and strategically deploy internal subject matter experts (from manufacturing to R&D) to testify, brief officials, and provide technical guidance that advances the company's policy objectives.

Strategic Counsel & Business Partnership

• Advise senior leaders on political, legislative and policy developments affecting Roche Diagnostics.

• Bring external insights into business strategy and translate policy developments into actionable implications.

• Support executive engagement with policymakers and key public affairs opportunities.

Policy Leadership in Partnership with Commercial Organization

• Lead customer communications on policy in partnership with the US commercial team.

• Engage with policy counterparts from key customers as well as laboratory industry trade associations.

• Participate in US Commercial leadership forums including USLT (US Leadership Team) and ELT (Enterprise Leadership Team).

Team Leadership & Capability Building

• Lead and develop a high-performing US Government Affairs and Policy team, including talent development, succession planning, coaching and organizational capability building.

• Assess resource needs and manage use of external advisors, consultants and advocacy partnerships.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was macht unseren Bereich aus
Diagnostics Operations Penzberg ist als Teil der Diagnostics Global Operations der wichtigste Produzent von qualitativ hochwertigen Einsatzstoffen bis hin zu speziellen Kits für die Diagnostik-Division von Roche. Es erwartet Sie eine vielseitige, interessante und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe im Bereich Manufacturing. Hier werden biochemische und chemische Reagenzien und Einsatzstoffe für alle Geschäftsbereiche und vor allem die In-vitro-Diagnostik mehrerer Roche Geschäftseinheiten hergestellt.

Das Team
Unser Team im Themencluster Festphasenchemie produziert modifizierte Oligonucleotide, Peptide und Konjugate im kleinen Maßstab unter GMP-Bedingungen. Diese Produkte unterstützen zahlreiche diagnostische Assays wie PCR, Immundiagnostik und Sequencing. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Herstellung qualitativ hochwertiger Produkte, der Einführung innovativer Artikel und der kontinuierlichen Optimierung unserer Produktionsprozesse in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Experte in der organischen Chemie/Festphasenchemie stellst du hochwertige Produkte für die In-vitro-Diagnostik her. Deine Tätigkeiten finden in einem GMP-regulierten Bereich statt.
Neben der Abarbeitung von Produktionsaufträgen unterstützt du unser Team aktiv bei folgenden Themen:

• Übernahme neuer Verfahren und Implementierung neuer Produkte.

• Bearbeitung von Abweichungen, CAPAs, OOS-Fällen und Troubleshootings.

• Prozessverbesserungen, Scale-ups und Changes.

• Erstellung und Überarbeitung von HVs und SOPs.

• Unterstützung bei Validierungen und Qualifizierungen sowie bei technischen Themen.

• Mitarbeit bei der Produktionsplanung und Unterstützung bei Arbeitssicherheitsthemen.

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast dein Studium der Chemie (Bachelor oder Master) erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Du bringst theoretische und praktische Erfahrung in der organischen Chemie mit. Idealerweise verfügst du über Erfahrung im Bereich der Festphasenchemie.

• Du besitzt theoretische und praktische Erfahrung in der analytischen und präparativen Chromatographie.

• Berufserfahrung in einem Produktionsumfeld sowie Kenntnisse im Bereich der Arbeitssicherheit sind ein Plus.

• Auf deine sehr guten Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr guten Kenntnisse gängiger EDV-Anwendungen können wir uns jederzeit verlassen.

Die Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise.

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Unser Team im Themencluster Festphasenchemie produziert modifizierte Oligonucleotide, Peptide und Konjugate im kleinen Maßstab unter GMP-Bedingungen. Diese Produkte unterstützen zahlreiche diagnostische Assays wie PCR, Immundiagnostik und Sequencing. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Herstellung qualitativ hochwertiger Produkte, der Einführung innovativer Artikel und der kontinuierlichen Optimierung unserer Produktionsprozesse in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Experte in der organischen Chemie/Festphasenchemie stellst du hochwertige Produkte für die In-vitro-Diagnostik her. Deine Tätigkeiten finden in einem GMP-regulierten Bereich statt.
Neben der Abarbeitung von Produktionsaufträgen unterstützt du unser Team aktiv bei folgenden Themen:

• Übernahme neuer Verfahren und Implementierung neuer Produkte.

• Bearbeitung von Abweichungen, CAPAs, OOS-Fällen und Troubleshootings.

• Prozessverbesserungen, Scale-ups und Changes.

• Erstellung und Überarbeitung von HVs und SOPs.

• Unterstützung bei Validierungen und Qualifizierungen sowie bei technischen Themen.

• Mitarbeit bei der Produktionsplanung und Unterstützung bei Arbeitssicherheitsthemen.

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast dein Studium der Chemie (Bachelor oder Master) erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Du bringst theoretische und praktische Erfahrung in der organischen Chemie mit. Idealerweise verfügst du über Erfahrung im Bereich der Festphasenchemie.

• Du besitzt theoretische und praktische Erfahrung in der analytischen und präparativen Chromatographie.

• Berufserfahrung in einem Produktionsumfeld sowie Kenntnisse im Bereich der Arbeitssicherheit sind ein Plus.

• Auf deine sehr guten Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr guten Kenntnisse gängiger EDV-Anwendungen können wir uns jederzeit verlassen.

Die Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise.

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

---

## Mansioni

- Progettare, pianificare, coordinare e condurre tutte le attività coinvolte nell’inizio, nel monitoraggio e nel completamento degli studi clinici presso i siti di studio clinico e fornire, ove appropriato, altre metodologie di generazione dati
- Svolgere attività di lavoro autonomo per garantire che gli studi siano eseguiti, registrati e riportati in conformità con il protocollo, le procedure standard operative, le buone pratiche cliniche e altre normative applicabili
- Agire come contatto principale ed esperto di trial clinico per il personale del sito di studio assegnato, inclusa la formazione e la coordinazione della certificazione del personale del sito di studio e fornire assistenza tecnica, se necessario
- Effettuare valutazioni dei siti e visite di qualificazione dei siti nel processo di selezione del sito
- Partecipare e garantire che l’attivazione del sito (contratti, approvazioni IRB/EC/Autorità Sanitarie, ecc.) siano ottenute, mantenute e rispettino le normative regolamentari in collaborazione con le funzioni RDS prior alla messa in atto dello studio investigativo
- Sviluppare documenti chiave per il sito di studio (ad esempio, Piano di Monitoraggio dello Studio, documenti di consenso informato, documenti sorgente, guide per pazienti e moduli di rapporto dei casi, ecc.) e contribuire all’esperienza tecnica nella revisione di protocolli di studio, piani di gestione dei dati, rapporti e manoscritti, ecc.
- Collaborare in modo trasversale con R&D, Field Service, Gestione Studi, Biometria, ecc. per fornire le migliori soluzioni
- Fornire tutte le attività di generazione e validazione dei dati e di monitoraggio dei siti, incluse le visite di sito finali secondo le normative e i processi rilevanti
- Partecipare alla supervisione della gestione del sito da parte di CRO, inclusa la formazione dei CRAs di CRO. Questo include l’escalation di qualsiasi problema
- Possibile collaborazione con investigatori internazionali e clienti chiave
- Possibile coaching di colleghi e aiuto nello sviluppo delle competenze/abilità
- Responsabilità per il budget a livello di sito dei siti assegnati
- Lavoro autonomo e indipendente

---

## Requisiti

- Possesso di una laurea di primo livello in una disciplina scientifica
- Esperienza di 3 anni in un ambiente regolamentato, CRO, diagnostico e/o farmaceutico
- Aderenza alle normative, linee guida e procedure standard operative e garantire la preparazione continua per audit/verifiche ispettive
- Esperienza pregressa nella gestione dei trial clinici e nella gestione dei campioni biologici (test clinico) e assicurazione della qualità
- Esperienza pregressa nella validazione delle affermazioni di prestazione dei prodotti, nella fornitura di dati per le richieste regolamentari critiche, nella definizione dell’utilità funzionale e clinica dei nostri prodotti e nell’obtinzione delle opinioni e del feedback sui nostri prodotti da laboratori o clienti
- Esperienza nella gestione del sito per studi sponsorizzati per aree di focus assegnate, sia registrationali che non registrationali, attraverso tutte le fasi dello studio (start-up, condotta e chiusura)
- Esperienza nel lavoro in team locali e globali, inclusi team virtuali, e dimostrazione di diversità e consapevolezza culturale
- Capacità di costruire e mantenere relazioni collaborative forti con membri del team funzionale, stakeholder interni ed esterni, nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali

---

## Cosa Offriamo

- Possibilità di lavorare in un ambiente che valorizza l’espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuine, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per ciò che sei
- Opportunità di contribuire a un futuro più sano, innovando e avanzando la scienza per garantire a tutti l’accesso a cure di qualità oggi e per le generazioni future
- Un ambiente che promuove la crescita sia professionale che personale

---

The Position
Sobre Roche:
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.
Oportunidad:

• Título del Puesto: Becario / Practicante de Farmacoeconomía

• Departamento: Acceso al Mercado / Farmacoeconomía

• Reporta a: Gerente de Farmacoeconomía

• Propósito del Puesto: Brindar soporte técnico y analítico al equipo de Farmacoeconomía en la generación de evidencia local, optimizando los tiempos de entrega de los dosieres de valor y materiales económicos necesarios para el posicionamiento de las terapias de Productos Roche.

Responsabilidades:

• Investigación y análisis de datos: Realizar búsquedas sistemáticas de literatura científica, guías clínicas y datos epidemiológicos o de costos locales en fuentes oficiales.

• Soporte en Modelaje: Apoyar en la adaptación, control de calidad y actualización de modelos de impacto presupuestal y costo-efectividad.

• Desarrollo de Entregables: Colaborar en la redacción y armado de secciones técnicas de los dossiers de valor para sometimientos institucionales.

• Gestión de Información: Mantener actualizadas las bases de datos internas del área (precios, competidores, resoluciones institucionales).

Quién eres:

• Educación: Estudiante activo de los últimos semestres (con al menos 6 meses a 1 año restante de carrera) en Licenciaturas de Economía, Actuaría, Matemáticas o carreras afines con un fuerte enfoque analítico.

• Habilidades Técnicas: * Manejo de Excel a nivel intermedio-avanzado (fórmulas, tablas dinámicas).

• Comprensión de lectura técnica en inglés (indispensable para la revisión de artículos científicos).

• Deseable (no exclusivo): Conocimiento básico o interés en estadística o economía de la salud.

• Competencias: * Atención al detalle y rigurosidad analítica.

• Proactividad y alta capacidad de organización.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita.

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.
Oportunidad:

• Título del Puesto: Becario / Practicante de Farmacoeconomía

• Departamento: Acceso al Mercado / Farmacoeconomía

• Reporta a: Gerente de Farmacoeconomía

• Propósito del Puesto: Brindar soporte técnico y analítico al equipo de Farmacoeconomía en la generación de evidencia local, optimizando los tiempos de entrega de los dosieres de valor y materiales económicos necesarios para el posicionamiento de las terapias de Productos Roche.

Responsabilidades:

• Investigación y análisis de datos: Realizar búsquedas sistemáticas de literatura científica, guías clínicas y datos epidemiológicos o de costos locales en fuentes oficiales.

• Soporte en Modelaje: Apoyar en la adaptación, control de calidad y actualización de modelos de impacto presupuestal y costo-efectividad.

• Desarrollo de Entregables: Colaborar en la redacción y armado de secciones técnicas de los dossiers de valor para sometimientos institucionales.

• Gestión de Información: Mantener actualizadas las bases de datos internas del área (precios, competidores, resoluciones institucionales).

Quién eres:

• Educación: Estudiante activo de los últimos semestres (con al menos 6 meses a 1 año restante de carrera) en Licenciaturas de Economía, Actuaría, Matemáticas o carreras afines con un fuerte enfoque analítico.

• Habilidades Técnicas: * Manejo de Excel a nivel intermedio-avanzado (fórmulas, tablas dinámicas).

• Comprensión de lectura técnica en inglés (indispensable para la revisión de artículos científicos).

• Deseable (no exclusivo): Conocimiento básico o interés en estadística o economía de la salud.

• Competencias: * Atención al detalle y rigurosidad analítica.

• Proactividad y alta capacidad de organización.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita.

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Especialista de Dados em Supply Chain, você terá a oportunidade de transformar dados em inteligência estratégica para otimizar a Cadeia Logística da Roche Diagnóstica Brasil. Seu foco está em elevar a experiência do cliente e maximizar a rentabilidade através de decisões fundamentadas. Você será responsável por promover a cultura de dados utilizando desde soluções analíticas clássicas até Advanced Analytics , atuando como um facilitador para parceiros de negócios na identificação de casos de uso de alto impacto. Você é um agente ativo na transformação digital da companhia, convergindo tecnologia e logística para atender às demandas do cliente.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Supervisão de KPIs, metas e governança de dados para o chapter de Supply Chain, garantindo a integridade dos cálculos.

• Atuação como parceiro estratégico de stakeholders, direcionando soluções de dados alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio.

• Gestão de Produtos de Dados através da manutenção e otimização contínua das ferramentas e produtos de dados da área.

• Desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards de visualização para suporte à tomada de decisão.

• Automação através da criação de bots e scripts para extração automatizada de dados em diversas plataformas e sistemas.

• Engenharia de Dados (ETL): Desenho e gerenciamento de rotinas de estruturação, movimentação e organização de dados.

• Mapeamento de fluxos de informação para erradicar tarefas manuais e maximizar o uso de recursos nativos.

• Liderança de projetos do subchapter de Supply Chain Excellence, apoiando a governança e a excelência operacional.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Física, Matemática ou similares.

• Experiência relevante em Análise de Dados, administração e manutenção de bancos de dados, aliadas ao desenho de fluxo de informações e processos.

• Proficiente no desenvolvimento de scripts e uso de linguagem de programação.

• Experiência com uso de linguagem de programação para banco de dados e automações, como Python, SQL ou similares.

• Experiência em uso de ferramentas de visualização como Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio ou similares.

• Desejável experiência com fluxos e conteúdos ligados a operações logísticas, manufaturas e/ou supply chain.

• Inglês avançado

• Disponibilidade para atuar com base na zona sul de São Paulo no modelo híbrido (3x escritório)

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

Você é um agente ativo na transformação digital da companhia, convergindo tecnologia e logística para atender às demandas do cliente.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Supervisão de KPIs, metas e governança de dados para o chapter de Supply Chain, garantindo a integridade dos cálculos.

• Atuação como parceiro estratégico de stakeholders, direcionando soluções de dados alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio.

• Gestão de Produtos de Dados através da manutenção e otimização contínua das ferramentas e produtos de dados da área.

• Desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards de visualização para suporte à tomada de decisão.

• Automação através da criação de bots e scripts para extração automatizada de dados em diversas plataformas e sistemas.

• Engenharia de Dados (ETL): Desenho e gerenciamento de rotinas de estruturação, movimentação e organização de dados.

• Mapeamento de fluxos de informação para erradicar tarefas manuais e maximizar o uso de recursos nativos.

• Liderança de projetos do subchapter de Supply Chain Excellence, apoiando a governança e a excelência operacional.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Física, Matemática ou similares.

• Experiência relevante em Análise de Dados, administração e manutenção de bancos de dados, aliadas ao desenho de fluxo de informações e processos.

• Proficiente no desenvolvimento de scripts e uso de linguagem de programação.

• Experiência com uso de linguagem de programação para banco de dados e automações, como Python, SQL ou similares.

• Experiência em uso de ferramentas de visualização como Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio ou similares.

• Desejável experiência com fluxos e conteúdos ligados a operações logísticas, manufaturas e/ou supply chain.

• Inglês avançado

• Disponibilidade para atuar com base na zona sul de São Paulo no modelo híbrido (3x escritório)

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

This is a field-based role. The territory is within the San Diego area. Ideal candidate must reside in the territory.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $71,000 and $132,000 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law . A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

titleByLocale.it: Digital Quality Strategy Delivery Lead - Pharma Technical Operations
titleByLocale.de: Digital Qualität Strategy Delivery Lead - Pharma Technical Operations

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. An integral part to achieving this vision is to deliver new and innovative data analytics solutions to our scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT).

To do so, we have formed a new organization called PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) with the aspiration to build industry-leading digital and lean operations across functions and our entire manufacturing footprint. PTE is the organization that catalyzes global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy to enable PT to realize our performance promises. We build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, further develop the Lean and Digital skills across PT, and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients. We aim to activate data citizenship and digital mindset, revolutionize our FAIR data ecosystem and systems landscape, re-design excellent processes, and generate transformative insights.

The Opportunity

You will be responsible for driving the digital technology strategy through the delivery of key digital initiatives and use cases in the Quality domain and you take the role of an Agile Product Owner (PO) to partner with customers across PT functions to architect the planning (e.g. diagnose), execution (e.g. design & build), and sustainment of digital solutions to achieve the PT Digital Aspirations.

• Strategic Digital Transformation: Architecting key initiatives and acting as a digital translator between business needs and technical roles by navigating across both domains seamlessly.

• Impact: Defining impact aspirations (e.g. product vision, roadmap, value assessments, business cases) as well as leading deployment of a global solution in a function or site. Enable significant improvements in quality management processes through innovative digital solutions, confirmed through the measurement of key business metrics.

• Requirements Analysis: Utilize your broad Quality end to end Business understanding to perform detailed requirement analyses with the team, with a strong focus on balancing process requirements, stakeholder requirements with digital product simplicity, network scalability and sustainability.

• Prioritization and Team Setup: Conducting use case prioritization and assuming the product owner role to catalyze the implementation of key digital use cases. Coach teams that are developing and deploying digital use cases, e.g. share best practices, agile ways of working, backlog management, sprint planning and ensure full impact capture & coordination between different initiatives. Lead cross-functional project teams with digital experts and SMEs across multiple sites and time zones.

• Compliance and Solution Shaping: Facilitating compliant solutions for data and digital products in the GxP environment.

• Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Identify potential risks associated with digital quality initiatives and develop strategies to mitigate these risks.

• Innovation and Improvement: Continuously explore and assess emerging digital technologies and industry trends. Drive innovation and process improvements within the Quality domain to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

Who you are

As an R&D Scientist in our NGS Library Preparation and Target Enrichment team, you will be a key player in executing sample preparation workflows . You will work within a dynamic environment dedicated to advancing molecular biology research and contributing to innovative development efforts . This is an opportunity to thrive in a collaborative team that values technical excellence and scientific curiosity .

The Opportunity

• Execute NGS library preparation from diverse sample types using various construction methods .

• Perform DNA and RNA extraction from biological samples, optimizing protocols for high yield and purity .

• Quantify nucleic acids accurately using instruments like Qubit and NanoDrop .

• Operate and troubleshoot sequencing platforms for routine laboratory runs .

• Conduct quality control for nucleic acids and libraries utilizing Agilent TapeStation .

• Maintain precise experimental records in laboratory notebooks and digital formats .

• Analyze experimental data to contribute to technical reports and team presentations .

• Collaborate with cross-functional team members on experimental design and troubleshooting .

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biochemistry, or a related field .

• You possess 2-4 years of relevant laboratory experience, ideally within an industry setting .

• You have hands-on experience with NGS library preparation protocols such as DNA-seq or RNA-seq .

• You are proficient in PCR, nucleic acid extraction, and standard molecular biology techniques .

• You demonstrate strong critical thinking skills and meticulous attention to detail in a fast-paced environment .

Preferred

• Experience with advanced DNA QC instruments like Tapestation and Nanodrop .

• Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability to work independently or as part of a collaborative team .

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills to meet project timelines .

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting .

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Pleasanton is 68 900,00 - 106 000,00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qual
